````python
    company = (await session.execute(
        select(Company).where(Company.code == company_code)
    )).scalar_one_or_none()
    if company is None:
        company = Company(
            name=company_name,
            code=company_code,
            currency_code=company_currency,
            tax_country="CI",
            is_active=True,
        )
        session.add(company)
        await session.flush()
        created["companies"].append(company.name)
        # + devise autorisée
        await session.execute(
            company_currencies.insert().values(
                company_id=company.id, currency_code=company_currency
            )
        )

    # 3. Agence principale
    agency = (await session.execute(
        select(Agency).where(Agency.company_id == company.id).limit(1)
    )).scalar_one_or_none()
    if agency is None:
        agency = Agency(
            company_id=company.id,
            name=agency_name,
            code=agency_code,
            is_active=True,
        )
        session.add(agency)
        await session.flush()
        created["agencies"].append(agency.name)
# 4. Permissions système
    perm_map: dict[str, Permission] = {}
    for resource, actions in SYSTEM_PERMISSIONS.items():
        for action in actions:
            perm = (await session.execute(
                select(Permission).where(
                    Permission.resource == resource,
                    Permission.action == action,
                    Permission.company_id == company.id,
                )
            )).scalar_one_or_none()
            if perm is None:
                perm = Permission(
                    resource=resource,
                    action=action,
                    description=f"{action} {resource}",
                    company_id=company.id,
                )
                session.add(perm)
                await session.flush()
                created["perms"].append(f"{resource}:{action}")
            perm_map[f"{resource}:{action}"] = perm

    # 5. Rôles système
    role_map: dict[str, Role] = {}
    for role_def in ROLES:
        role = (await session.execute(
            select(Role).where(
                Role.code == role_def["code"], Role.company_id == company.id
            )
        )).scalar_one_or_none()
        if role is None:
            role = Role(
                name=role_def["name"],
                code=role_def["code"],
                description=role_def["description"],
                is_system=role_def["is_system"],
                is_global=role_def["is_global"],
                company_id=company.id,
            )
            session.add(role)
            await session.flush()

            # Permissions du rôle
            if role_def["permissions"] is None:
                # Admin → toutes les permissions
                for key, perm in perm_map.items():
                    session.add(RolePermission(role_id=role.id, permission_id=perm.id))
            else:
                for res, actions in role_def["permissions"].items():
                    for action in actions:
                        perm = perm_map.get(f"{res}:{action}")
                        if perm:
                            session.add(RolePermission(role_id=role.id, permission_id=perm.id))
            await session.flush()
            created["roles"].append(role_def["code"])
        role_map[role_def["code"]] = role
# 6. Compte super-administrateur initial
    admin_user = (await session.execute(
        select(User).where(User.email == admin_email)
    )).scalar_one_or_none()

    if admin_user is None:
        admin_user = User(
            email=admin_email,
            first_name=admin_first_name,
            last_name=admin_last_name,
            password_hash=hash_password(admin_password),
            company_id=company.id,
            agency_id=agency.id,
            is_active=True,
            is_verified=True,
            is_superuser=True,
        )
        session.add(admin_user)
        await session.flush()
        # Attache le rôle admin
        if "admin" in role_map:
            session.add(UserRole(user_id=admin_user.id, role_id=role_map["admin"].id))
        created["users"].append(admin_user.email)

    # 7. Arborescence standard des catégories de produits
    from app.modules.catalogue.services.category_seed import seed_categories

    cat_created = await seed_categories(session, company.id)
    if cat_created:
        created["categories"] = cat_created

    # 8. Plan comptable OHADA + journaux standards
    from app.modules.accounting.services.account_service import AccountService

    acct_service = AccountService(session)
    accounts_created = await acct_service.seed_ohada_chart(company.id)
    journals_created = await acct_service.seed_default_journals(company.id)
    if accounts_created or journals_created:
        created["accounts"] = accounts_created
        created["journals"] = journals_created

    await session.commit()
    return created


async def _sync_system_permissions(session: AsyncSession) -> list[str]:
    """Synchronisation *add-only* des permissions et rôles système.

    Le bootstrap ne tourne que sur une base vide : toute permission ajoutée
    ultérieurement à ``SYSTEM_PERMISSIONS`` (ex. les actions ``delete`` de la
    cascade de suppression) n'existerait jamais sur une base existante.
    Idempotent — ne crée ni ne supprime rien d'autre :

    - crée les lignes ``Permission`` manquantes (par entreprise) ;
    - complète les grants ``RolePermission`` des rôles système existants
      d'après les définitions de ``ROLES`` (admin → toutes).

    Retourne la liste des ajouts (``["invoice:delete", "manager+=quote:delete", …]``).
    """
    from app.core.models.company import Company
    from app.core.models.role import Permission, Role, RolePermission

    added: list[str] = []
    companies = (await session.execute(select(Company))).scalars().all()

    for company in companies:
        # 1. Permissions manquantes pour cette entreprise
        existing = (await session.execute(
            select(Permission).where(Permission.company_id == company.id)
        )).scalars().all()
        perm_map: dict[str, Permission] = {
            f"{p.resource}:{p.action}": p for p in existing
        }
        for resource, actions in SYSTEM_PERMISSIONS.items():
            for action in actions:
                code = f"{resource}:{action}"
                if code in perm_map:
                    continue
                perm = Permission(
                    resource=resource,
                    action=action,
                    description=f"{action} {resource}",
                    company_id=company.id,
                )
                session.add(perm)
                await session.flush()
                perm_map[code] = perm
                added.append(code)

        # 2. Grants des rôles système existants (add-only)
        role_defs = {r["code"]: r for r in ROLES}
        roles = (await session.execute(
            select(Role).where(Role.company_id == company.id, Role.is_system.is_(True))
        )).scalars().all()
        for role in roles:
            role_def = role_defs.get(role.code)
            if role_def is None:
                continue
            granted = set((await session.execute(
                select(RolePermission.permission_id).where(
                    RolePermission.role_id == role.id
                )
            )).scalars().all())
            if role_def["permissions"] is None:
                wanted = list(perm_map.keys())
            else:
                wanted = [
                    f"{res}:{act}"
                    for res, acts in role_def["permissions"].items()
                    for act in acts
                ]
            for code in wanted:
                perm = perm_map.get(code)
                if perm is None or perm.id in granted:
                    continue
                session.add(RolePermission(role_id=role.id, permission_id=perm.id))
                granted.add(perm.id)
                added.append(f"{role.code}+={code}")

    await session.commit()
    if added:
        logger.info("Permissions système synchronisées : %s", ", ".join(added))
    return added


async def sync_system_permissions() -> list[str]:
    """Point d'entrée — ouvre sa session puis délègue à la synchro add-only."""
    from app.core.database import AsyncSessionLocal

    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        return await _sync_system_permissions(session)


async def run_bootstrap_if_needed() -> dict[str, list[str]] | None:
    """Exécute le bootstrap au démarrage (dev uniquement) si la base est vide."""
    if not settings.bootstrap_on_startup:
        return None

    from app.core.database import AsyncSessionLocal
    from app.core.models.user import User

    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        count = (await session.execute(
            select(User.id)
        )).scalars().first()
        if count is not None:
            logger.info("Bootstrap ignoré : des utilisateurs existent déjà.")
            return None

        created = await bootstrap_defaults(session)
        if created["users"]:
            logger.info(
                "🚀 Premier démarrage — comptes créés : "
                "entreprise=%s, admin=%s",
                created["companies"], created["users"],
            )
        return created
````

````python
"""
Service de numérotation — génère les numéros de documents uniques.

Nomenclature pilotée par le paramètre ``doc_nomenclature`` (JSON) :
    {"quote": {"prefix": "DEV", "padding": 6, "reset": "month",
               "suffix_type": "mmaa", "suffix_custom": ""}, ...}

Composition : PREFIX-SERIE-SUFFIXE — ex. ``DEV-000123-2609``
(reset mensuel, suffixe MMYY), ``DEV-000123-2026`` (suffixe AAAA),
``DEV-000123`` (sans suffixe) ou ``DEV-000123-GEA`` (personnalisé).

La table ``sequences`` conserve le compteur et la clé de période :
le compteur est remis à zéro quand la période (mois / trimestre /
semestre / année) change.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.models.sequence import Sequence

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

VALID_RESETS = ("never", "month", "quarter", "semester", "year")


class SequenceService:
    """Génère des numéros de documents uniques."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    async def next_value(
        self,
        model: str,
        prefix: str | None = None,
        company_id: int = 1,
    ) -> str:
        """Prochaine référence complète — ex. ``DEV-000001-2609``.

        ``prefix`` sert de repli si aucune nomenclature n'est configurée.
        """
        seq = await self._get_or_create(model, company_id, prefix)
        cfg = await self._get_config(model)
        current = self._advance(seq, cfg) + seq.number_increment
        seq.last_number = current
        await self.session.flush()
        return self._compose(cfg, seq, current)

    async def next_number(self, model: str, company_id: int) -> str:
        """Compatibilité — identique à ``next_value`` (config-driven)."""
        seq = await self._get_or_create(model, company_id, None)
        cfg = await self._get_config(model)
        current = self._advance(seq, cfg) + seq.number_increment
        seq.last_number = current
        await self.session.flush()
        return self._compose(cfg, seq, current)

    async def preview(self, model: str, company_id: int = 1) -> str:
        """Aperçu de la prochaine référence SANS consommer le compteur."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Sequence).where(
                Sequence.model == model,
                Sequence.company_id == company_id,
                Sequence.is_active.is_(True),
            )
        )
        seq: Sequence | None = result.scalars().first()
        cfg = await self._get_config(model)
        reset = str(cfg.get("reset") or "never").lower()
        if reset not in VALID_RESETS:
            reset = "never"
        current = seq.last_number if seq else 0
        key = self._period_key(reset, date.today())
        if key is not None and (
            seq is None or (seq.date_ranges or {}).get("last_period") != key
        ):
            current = 0
        increment = seq.number_increment if seq else 1
        return self._compose(cfg, seq, current + increment)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Nomenclature (configuration par type de document)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _get_config(self, model: str) -> dict:
        """Lit la nomenclature du type de document (paramètre JSON).

        Tolère la valeur renvoyée en dict ou en chaîne JSON (double
        sérialisation possible via l'API des paramètres).
        """
        import json

        from app.core.services.setting_service import SettingService

        raw = await SettingService(self.session).get("doc_nomenclature", None)
        if isinstance(raw, str):
            try:
                raw = json.loads(raw)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                raw = None
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            entry = raw.get(model)
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                return entry
            # Entree absente (ex. type produit ajoute apres coup) :
            # serie 6 chiffres par defaut, prefixe fourni par la Sequence.
            return {"padding": 6, "reset": "never", "suffix_type": "none"}
        return {}

    @staticmethod
    def _resolve_suffix(cfg: dict) -> str:
        """Suffixe courant : MMYY (mmaa), YYYY (aaaa) ou texte personnalisé."""
        stype = str(cfg.get("suffix_type") or "none").lower()
        today = date.today()
        if stype == "mmaa":
            return today.strftime("%m%y")
        if stype == "aaaa":
            return today.strftime("%Y")
        if stype == "custom":
            return str(cfg.get("suffix_custom") or "").strip()
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _period_key(reset: str, today: date) -> str | None:
        """Clé de la période courante (None = pas de reset)."""
        if reset == "month":
            return today.strftime("%Y%m")
        if reset == "quarter":
            return f"{today.year}-T{(today.month - 1) // 3 + 1}"
        if reset == "semester":
            return f"{today.year}-S{1 if today.month <= 6 else 2}"
        if reset == "year":
            return today.strftime("%Y")
        return None

    def _compose(self, cfg: dict, seq: Sequence | None, current: int) -> str:
        """Compose la référence : PREFIX-SERIE[-SUFFIXE]."""
        prefix = str(cfg.get("prefix") or "").strip().strip("-")
        if not prefix and seq is not None:
            prefix = (seq.prefix or "").strip().strip("-")
        padding = int(cfg.get("padding") or (seq.number_padding if seq else 6) or 6)
        number_str = str(current).rjust(padding, "0")
        body = f"{prefix}-{number_str}" if prefix else number_str
        suffix = self._resolve_suffix(cfg)
        return f"{body}-{suffix}" if suffix else body

    def _advance(self, seq: Sequence, cfg: dict) -> int:
        """Applique le reset périodique — renvoie le compteur de base."""
        reset = str(cfg.get("reset") or "never").lower()
        if reset not in VALID_RESETS:
            reset = "never"
        seq.reset = reset
        seq.number_padding = int(cfg.get("padding") or seq.number_padding or 6)
        current = seq.last_number
        key = self._period_key(reset, date.today())
        if key is not None:
            ranges = dict(seq.date_ranges or {})
            if ranges.get("last_period") != key:
                ranges["last_period"] = key
                seq.date_ranges = ranges
                current = 0
        return current

    async def _get_or_create(
        self, model: str, company_id: int, prefix: str | None
    ) -> Sequence:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Sequence)
            .where(
                Sequence.model == model,
                Sequence.company_id == company_id,
                Sequence.is_active.is_(True),
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        seq: Sequence | None = result.scalars().first()
        if seq is None:
            seq = Sequence(
                company_id=company_id,
                model=model,
                name=f"Sequence {model}",
                prefix=(prefix or model.upper())[:10],
                suffix="",
                number_padding=4,
                number_increment=1,
                last_number=0,
                reset="never",
                is_active=True,
            )
            self.session.add(seq)
            await self.session.flush()
        elif prefix and not seq.prefix:
            seq.prefix = prefix
        return seq
````

````python
class SettingService:
    """Service pour lire/écrire les paramètres de configuration."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    async def get(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        """Récupère la valeur d'un paramètre (cache + entreprise + global).

        Le cache est indexé par ``(company_id, key)`` pour éviter qu'une
        entreprise lise le paramètre (déjà chargé) d'une autre.
        """
        # 1) Contexte tenant courant (défini par l'authentification)
        from app.core.tenant import get_current_company

        cid = get_current_company()

        # 2) Cache par (entreprise, clé)
        cache_key = (cid, key)
        if cache_key in _CACHE:
            return _CACHE[cache_key]

        # 3) Lecture DB — filtrée par le listener multi-tenant
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Setting).where(Setting.key == key).order_by(Setting.company_id)
        )
        setting: Setting | None = result.scalars().first()

        if setting is None:
            if key in DEFAULT_SETTINGS:
                val = DEFAULT_SETTINGS[key]["value"]
                _CACHE[cache_key] = val
                return val
            return default

        val = self._deserialize(setting.value, setting.type)
        _CACHE[cache_key] = val
        return val

    async def update(
        self, key: str, value: Any, type: str | None = None,
        is_public: bool | None = None, description: str | None = None,
company_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> Setting | None:
        """Met a jour un parametre existant (None si introuvable)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Setting).where(
                Setting.key == key, Setting.company_id == company_id,
            )
        )
        setting: Setting | None = result.scalars().first()
        if setting is None:
            return None
        setting.value = self._serialize(value, type or setting.type)
        if type:
            setting.type = type
        if is_public is not None:
            setting.is_public = is_public
        if description:
            setting.description = description
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(setting)
        # Invalide les entrées de cache de cette clé (toutes entreprises)
        for ck in [k for k in _CACHE if k[1] == key]:
            _CACHE.pop(ck, None)
        return setting

    async def set(
        self, key: str, value: Any, type: str = "string",
        is_public: bool = False, description: str | None = None,
        company_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> Setting:
        """Crée ou met à jour un paramètre."""
        serialized = self._serialize(value, type)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Setting).where(
                Setting.key == key, Setting.company_id == company_id,
            )
        )
        setting: Setting | None = result.scalars().first()
        if setting is None:
            setting = Setting(
                key=key, value=serialized, type=type,
                is_public=is_public, description=description,
                company_id=company_id,
            )
            self.session.add(setting)
        else:
            setting.value = serialized
            setting.type = type
            setting.is_public = is_public
            if description:
                setting.description = description
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(setting)
        # Invalide les entrées de cache de cette clé (toutes entreprises)
        for ck in [k for k in _CACHE if k[1] == key]:
            _CACHE.pop(ck, None)
        return setting

    async def get_all(
        self, company_id: int | None = None, public_only: bool = False,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Retourne tous les paramètres sous forme de dictionnaire."""
        stmt = select(Setting)
        if company_id is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(
                (Setting.company_id == company_id) |
                (Setting.company_id.is_(None))
            )
        if public_only:
            stmt = stmt.where(Setting.is_public.is_(True))
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt.order_by(Setting.key))
        output: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for s in result.scalars().all():
            output[s.key] = self._deserialize(s.value, s.type)
        return output

    def _serialize(self, value: Any, type: str) -> str:
        if type == "json":
            return json.dumps(value)
        if type == "boolean":
            return "true" if value else "false"
        if type == "integer":
            return str(value)
        return str(value)

    def _deserialize(self, value: str, type: str) -> Any:
        if type == "json":
            return json.loads(value)
        if type == "boolean":
            return value.lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")
        if type == "integer":
            return int(value)
        return value
````

````python
"""
Service utilisateur — CRUD et gestion des rôles.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.models.role import Role
from app.core.models.user import User, UserRole
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.core.schemas.user import UserCreate, UserUpdate
from app.core.security import hash_password

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class UserService:
    """Service pour la gestion des utilisateurs."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # CRUD
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create(self, data: UserCreate, created_by: int | None = None) -> User:
        """Crée un nouvel utilisateur."""
        # Vérifie l'unicité de l'email
        existing = await self.session.execute(
            select(User).where(User.email == data.email)
        )
        if existing.scalar_one_or_none():
            raise ValueError(f"Un utilisateur avec l'email {data.email} existe déjà")

        user = User(
            email=data.email,
            phone=data.phone,
            first_name=data.first_name,
            last_name=data.last_name,
            company_id=data.company_id,
            agency_id=data.agency_id,
            password_hash=hash_password(data.password),
            created_by=created_by,
        )
        self.session.add(user)
        await self.session.flush()  # génère l'ID

        # Attribue les rôles
        if data.role_ids:
            await self.assign_roles(user.id, data.role_ids)

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(user)
        logger.info("Utilisateur créé : %s (id=%s)", user.email, user.id)
        return user

    async def get_by_id(self, user_id: int) -> User | None:
        """Récupère un utilisateur par ID."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(User).where(User.id == user_id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def get_by_email(self, email: str) -> User | None:
        """Récupère un utilisateur par email."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(User).where(User.email == email)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def update(self, user_id: int, data: UserUpdate) -> User:
        """Met à jour un utilisateur."""
        user = await self.get_by_id(user_id)
        if not user:
            raise ValueError("Utilisateur introuvable")

        update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)

        # Mot de passe : rehashé uniquement si fourni non vide
        if "password" in update_data:
            pwd = update_data.pop("password") or ""
            if pwd:
                update_data["password_hash"] = hash_password(pwd)

        # Les rôles sont gérés via la table d'association, pas comme colonne
        update_data.pop("role_ids", None)

        for field, value in update_data.items():
            if hasattr(user, field):
                setattr(user, field, value)

        # Gestion des rôles : uniquement si explicitement fournie
        if data.role_ids is not None:
            await self.assign_roles(user_id, data.role_ids)

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(user)
        return user

    async def delete(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Supprime un utilisateur."""
        await self.session.delete(await self.session.get(User, user_id))
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Utilisateur supprimé : id=%s", user_id)

    async def deactivate(self, user_id: int) -> User:
        """Désactive un utilisateur."""
        user = await self.get_by_id(user_id)
        if not user:
            raise ValueError("Utilisateur introuvable")
        user.is_active = False
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(user)
        return user

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Rôles
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def assign_roles(self, user_id: int, role_ids: list[int]) -> None:
        """Assigne des rôles à un utilisateur (remplace les existants)."""
        # Supprime les anciens rôles
        await self.session.execute(
            UserRole.__table__.delete().where(UserRole.user_id == user_id)
        )
        # Ajoute les nouveaux
        for role_id in role_ids:
            self.session.add(UserRole(user_id=user_id, role_id=role_id))
        await self.session.flush()

    async def get_roles(self, user_id: int) -> list[Role]:
        """Récupère les rôles d'un utilisateur."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Role)
            .join(UserRole, Role.id == UserRole.role_id)
            .where(UserRole.user_id == user_id)
            .order_by(Role.id)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())
````

````python
"""
Abstraction du stockage de fichiers — interface et factory.

Fournit une interface unifiée pour stocker et récupérer des fichiers
peu importe le backend (S3/MinIO, local, etc.).

Indépendant des modules métier : le stockage cloud ne dépend pas des Ventes.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from app.core.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class StorageInterface:
    """Interface abstraite pour le stockage de fichiers."""

    async def upload(self, file_data: bytes, key: str, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
        """Téléverse un fichier. Retourne l'URL/le chemin."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def download(self, key: str) -> bytes:
        """Télécharge un fichier."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        """Supprime un fichier."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def exists(self, key: str) -> bool:
        """Vérifie si un fichier existe."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def list_files(self, prefix: str = "") -> list[str]:
        """Liste les fichiers avec un préfixe."""
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def get_url(self, key: str, expires_in: int = 3600) -> str:
        """Génère une URL signée pour télécharger le fichier."""
        raise NotImplementedError


def get_storage() -> StorageInterface:
    """Retourne l'instance de stockage appropriée selon la configuration."""

        from app.core.storage.s3 import S3Storage

        return S3Storage()

    from app.core.storage.local import LocalStorage

    return LocalStorage()
````

````python
"""
Stockage local — pour le développement et les tests.

Permet de tester l'application sans serveur S3/MinIO.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
from typing import Any

from app.core.storage import StorageInterface

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class LocalStorage(StorageInterface):
    """
    Stockage sur le système de fichiers local.

    Les fichiers sont stockés dans ``backend/resources/uploads`` par défaut,
    chemin piloté par le réglage ``LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH`` (voir ``config.py``).
    Un chemin relatif est résolu depuis la racine du backend ; un chemin
    absolu est respecté tel quel.
    """

    def __init__(self, base_path: str | None = None):
        if base_path:
            resolved = base_path
        else:
            from app.core.config import settings

            resolved = settings.local_storage_path

        # ``local.py`` vit dans ``backend/app/core/storage/`` → 4 niveaux
        # remontent à la racine du backend (et non au-delà du dépôt).
        backend_root = os.path.dirname(
            os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
        )
        self.base_path = (
            resolved
            if os.path.isabs(resolved)
            else os.path.join(backend_root, resolved)
        )
        os.makedirs(self.base_path, exist_ok=True)

    def _full_path(self, key: str) -> str:
        """Convertit une clé en chemin de fichier local (sécurisé)."""
        safe_key = key.lstrip("/").replace("..", "_").replace("\\", "/")
        return os.path.join(self.base_path, safe_key)

    async def upload(self, file_data: bytes, key: str, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
        path = self._full_path(key)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(file_data)
        return f"local://{key}"

    async def download(self, key: str) -> bytes:
        path = self._full_path(key)
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            return f.read()

    async def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        path = self._full_path(key)
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)
            return True
        return False

    async def exists(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return os.path.exists(self._full_path(key))

    async def list_files(self, prefix: str = "") -> list[str]:
        prefix_path = os.path.join(self.base_path, prefix)
        keys: list[str] = []
        if os.path.exists(prefix_path):
            for root, _, files in os.walk(prefix_path):
                for f in files:
                    full = os.path.join(root, f)
                    rel = os.path.relpath(full, self.base_path)
                    keys.append(rel.replace("\\", "/"))
        return keys

    async def get_url(self, key: str, expires_in: int = 3600) -> str:
        return f"/files/{key}"
````

````python
"""
Stockage S3 / MinIO — implémentation asynchrone via ``aioboto3``.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.storage import StorageInterface

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _s3_session_kwargs() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Construit les kwargs pour la session aioboto3."""
    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if settings.s3_access_key:
        kwargs["aws_access_key_id"] = settings.s3_access_key
    if settings.s3_secret_key:
        kwargs["aws_secret_access_key"] = settings.s3_secret_key
    if settings.s3_endpoint_url:
        kwargs["endpoint_url"] = settings.s3_endpoint_url
    if settings.s3_region:
        kwargs["region_name"] = settings.s3_region
    return kwargs


class S3Storage(StorageInterface):
    """Stockage sur cluster S3 / MinIO compatible."""

    def __init__(self, bucket: str | None = None):
        self.bucket = bucket or settings.s3_bucket_name

    async def _client(self):
        import aioboto3
        return aioboto3.Session(**_s3_session_kwargs())

    async def upload(self, file_data: bytes, key: str, **kwargs: Any) -> str:
        session = await self._client()
        async with session.client("s3") as client:
            await client.put_object(
                Bucket=self.bucket, Key=key, Body=file_data, **kwargs
            )
            logger.info("Uploaded: s3://%s/%s", self.bucket, key)
            return f"s3://{self.bucket}/{key}"

    async def download(self, key: str) -> bytes:
        session = await self._client()
        async with session.client("s3") as client:
            response = await client.get_object(Bucket=self.bucket, Key=key)
            async with response["Body"] as body:
                return await body.read()

    async def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        session = await self._client()
        async with session.client("s3") as client:
            await client.delete_object(Bucket=self.bucket, Key=key)
            return True

    async def exists(self, key: str) -> bool:
        session = await self._client()
        async with session.client("s3") as client:
            try:
                await client.head_object(Bucket=self.bucket, Key=key)
                return True
            except Exception:
                return False

    async def list_files(self, prefix: str = "") -> list[str]:
        session = await self._client()
        async with session.client("s3") as client:
            paginator = client.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
            keys: list[str] = []
            async for page in paginator.paginate(
                Bucket=self.bucket, Prefix=prefix
            ):
                for obj in page.get("Contents", []):
                    keys.append(obj["Key"])
            return keys

    async def get_url(self, key: str, expires_in: int = 3600) -> str:
        session = await self._client()
        async with session.client("s3") as client:
            return await client.generate_presigned_url(
                "get_object",
                Params={"Bucket": self.bucket, "Key": key},
                ExpiresIn=expires_in,
            )
````

````python
"""
Configuration centrale de l'application.

Utilise Pydantic Settings pour charger la configuration depuis les variables
d'environnement.  Toutes les sections (Core, modules métier, storage, backup, etc.)
sont centralisées ici.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Annotated, Literal

from pydantic import Field, field_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, NoDecode, SettingsConfigDict

# Capturé par le validator ``environment`` (validé avant ``secret_key``)
settings_env: str = "development"


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    """Paramètres globaux de l'ERP."""

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=".env",
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        extra="ignore",
        case_sensitive=False,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Application
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    app_name: str = "ERP Matériaux de Construction"
    app_version: str = "0.1.0"
    debug: bool = False
    environment: Literal["development", "staging", "production"] = "development"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # API
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    api_v1_prefix: str = "/api/v1"
    docs_enabled: bool = True
    # Origines autorisées pour le CORS (frontend, site web...). `*` interdit
    # avec credentials — toujours lister explicitement en production.
    # Variable d'env : CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:3000,https://erp.exemple.ci
    cors_origins: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["http://localhost:3000", "http://127.0.0.1:3000"]
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Base de données
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    database_url: str = Field(
        default="postgresql+psycopg://erp_user:erp_pass@localhost:5432/erp_db"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Redis / Celery
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    redis_url: str = "redis://localhost:6379/0"
    celery_broker_url: str = "redis://localhost:6379/1"
    celery_result_backend: str = "redis://localhost:6379/2"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Auth / JWT
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    secret_key: str = Field(default="change-this-in-production-use-openssl-rand")
    jwt_algorithm: str = "HS256"
    access_token_expire_minutes: int = 60 * 24  # 24h
    refresh_token_expire_days: int = 30
    jwt_issuer: str = "erp-materiaux"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Bootstrap — premier compte administrateur (créé si la base est vide)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    first_company_name: str = "Entreprise ABC"
    first_company_code: str = "ABC"
    first_company_currency: str = "XOF"
    first_agency_name: str = "Agence principale"
    first_agency_code: str = "AG-01"
    first_admin_email: str = "admin@abc.com"
    first_admin_password: str = "Admin@12345"
    first_admin_first_name: str = "Admin"
    first_admin_last_name: str = "Système"
    bootstrap_on_startup: bool = True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Storage (S3 / MinIO)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    s3_endpoint_url: str | None = None
    s3_access_key: str | None = None
    s3_secret_key: str | None = None
    s3_bucket_name: str = "erp-files"
    s3_region: str = "us-east-1"
    s3_use_ssl: bool = True

    # Repli sur disque quand aucun credential S3 n'est configuré.
    # Chemin relatif → résolu depuis la racine du backend ; chemin absolu →
    # utilisé tel quel (utile pour un volume monté hors du dépôt, ex. Docker).
    # Variable d'env : LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH=resources/uploads
    local_storage_path: str = "resources/uploads"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Sentry
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    sentry_dsn: str | None = None
    prometheus_enabled: bool = True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Modules activés par défaut (peuvent être modifiés via la DB)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    default_modules: Annotated[list[str], NoDecode] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: [
            "core",
            "catalogue",
            "crm",
            "sales",
            "stock",
            "purchases",
            "delivery",
            "invoicing",
            "payments",
            "finance",
            "reporting",
            "accounting",
        ]
    )

    @field_validator("database_url", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _validate_database_url(cls, v: str | None) -> str | None:
        """Normalise l'URL de la base de données."""
        if isinstance(v, str):
            if v.startswith("postgresql://"):
                v = v.replace("postgresql://", "postgresql+psycopg://")
        return v

    @field_validator("default_modules", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _parse_default_modules(cls, v: object) -> object:
        """Accepte soit une liste JSON soit une chaîne séparée par des virgules."""
        if isinstance(v, str):
            v = v.strip()
            if v.startswith("[") and v.endswith("]"):
                import json

                return json.loads(v)
            return [item.strip() for item in v.split(",") if item.strip()]
        return v

    @field_validator("cors_origins", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _parse_cors_origins(cls, v: object) -> object:
        """Accepte une liste JSON ou une chaîne séparée par des virgules."""
        if isinstance(v, str):
            v = v.strip()
            if v.startswith("[") and v.endswith("]"):
                import json

                return json.loads(v)
            return [item.strip() for item in v.split(",") if item.strip()]
        return v

    @field_validator("cors_origins")
    @classmethod
    def _check_cors_origins(cls, v: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        """
        Sécurité (S-4) : refuse `*` en production.

        Une liste VIDE est autorisée (et même recommandée derrière nginx) :
        aucun en-tête CORS n'est alors émis, donc seul le même origine peut
        appeler l'API — c'est la configuration la plus restrictive.
        Le wildcard est interdit avec allow_credentials=True de toute façon ;
        on l'interdit explicitement pour éviter une config silencieusement
        cassée (navigateurs) ou trop permissive.
        """
        if settings_env == "production":
            if "*" in v:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "CORS_ORIGINS='*' interdit en production (allow_credentials). "
                    "Listez explicitement les origines autorisées, ou laissez "
                    "vide pour un déploiement même-origine derrière nginx."
                )
            for origin in v:
                if not origin.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                    raise RuntimeError(
                        f"Origine CORS invalide : {origin!r} — attendu une URL "
                        "complète (ex. https://erp.exemple.ci)."
                    )
        return v

    @field_validator("secret_key")
    @classmethod
    def _check_secret_key(cls, v: str) -> str:
        weak = len(v) < 32 or v.startswith("change-this")
        if weak and settings_env == "production":
            raise RuntimeError(
                "SECRET_KEY faible ou par défaut interdite en production. "
                "Générez-en une : openssl rand -hex 32"
            )
        return v

    @field_validator("environment", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _capture_env(cls, v: object) -> object:
        global settings_env
        settings_env = str(v)
        return v


settings = Settings()
````

````python
"""
Configuration de la base de données.

Fournit :
- ``engine``      — moteur asynchrone SQLAlchemy 2
- ``AsyncSession`` — session asynchrone injectable
- ``Base``        — classe de base déclarative partagée
- ``TenantMixin`` — colonnes multi-entreprise + audit
- ``init_db``     — création des tables (dev / tests)
- ``close_db``    — fermeture du moteur
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, AsyncIterator

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, Integer, or_
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import (
    AsyncSession,
    async_engine_from_config,
    async_sessionmaker,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    DeclarativeBase,
    Mapped,
    MappedColumn,
    declared_attr,
    sessionmaker,
)
from sqlalchemy import event

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.tenant import get_current_company, TENANT_EXCLUDED_MODELS


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Helpers
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
def _camel_to_snake(name: str) -> str:
    s1 = re.sub("(.)([A-Z][a-z]+)", r"\1_\2", name)
    return re.sub("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", s1).lower()


def _pluralize(snake: str) -> str:
    if snake.endswith("y"):
        return snake[:-1] + "ies"
    if not snake.endswith("s"):
        return snake + "s"
    return snake


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Declarative base
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    """Classe de base — génère __tablename__ en snake_case pluriel."""

    @declared_attr  # type: ignore[misc]
    def __tablename__(cls) -> str:  # noqa: N805
        snake = _camel_to_snake(cls.__name__)
        return _pluralize(snake)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# TenantMixin — colonnes communes multi-entreprise + audit
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
class TenantMixin:
    """
    Mixin ajoutant les colonnes communes à tous les modèles métier.

    - id          — clé primaire auto-incrémentée
    - company_id  — isolation multi-entreprise
    - created_at / updated_at  — audit temporel
    - created_by / updated_by  — traçabilité utilisateur (optionnel)
    """

    __allow_unmapped__ = True

    id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    @declared_attr  # type: ignore[misc]
    def company_id(cls) -> Mapped[int]:
        return MappedColumn(
            Integer,
            ForeignKey("companies.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
            nullable=False,
            index=True,
        )

    @declared_attr  # type: ignore[misc]
    def created_at(cls) -> Mapped[datetime]:
        return MappedColumn(default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)

    @declared_attr  # type: ignore[misc]
    def updated_at(cls) -> Mapped[datetime]:
        return MappedColumn(
            default=datetime.utcnow,
            onupdate=datetime.utcnow,
            nullable=False,
        )

    @declared_attr  # type: ignore[misc]
    def created_by(cls) -> Mapped[int | None]:
        return MappedColumn(
            Integer,
            ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
            nullable=True,
        )

    @declared_attr  # type: ignore[misc]
    def updated_by(cls) -> Mapped[int | None]:
        return MappedColumn(
            Integer,
            ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
            nullable=True,
        )


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Engine & session
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
engine = async_engine_from_config(
    {"sqlalchemy.url": str(settings.database_url)},
    pool_size=20,
    max_overflow=30,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
    pool_recycle=3600,
    echo=settings.debug,
    future=True,
)

AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(
    bind=engine,
    class_=AsyncSession,
    expire_on_commit=False,
    autoflush=False,
    autocommit=False,
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Isolation multi-tenant automatique
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@event.listens_for(AsyncSession.sync_session_class, "do_orm_execute")
def _apply_tenant_filter(orm_exec_state):  # noqa: ANN001
    """
    Ajoute automatiquement ``WHERE company_id = ?`` à toute requête SELECT
    ORM ciblant un modèle multi-tenant, si une entreprise est définie dans
    le contexte d'exécution (utilisateur non-superadmin authentifié).

    - Superadmin / tâches système / login : contexte ``None`` → pas de filtre.
    - Les chargements de colonnes/relations (selectinload, lazy) ne sont pas
      refiltrés : ils dérivent d'objets parents déjà filtrés.
    - Opt-out ponctuel : ``.execution_options(include_all_tenants=True)``.
    """
    if not orm_exec_state.is_select:
        return
    if orm_exec_state.is_column_load or orm_exec_state.is_relationship_load:
        return
    company_id = get_current_company()
    if company_id is None:
        return
    if orm_exec_state.execution_options.get("include_all_tenants"):
        return

    clauses = []
    seen: set[type] = set()
    for mapper in orm_exec_state.all_mappers:
        cls = mapper.class_
        if cls in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(cls)
        if cls.__name__ in TENANT_EXCLUDED_MODELS:
            continue
        table = cls.__table__
        if "company_id" in table.columns:
            clauses.append(table.c.company_id == company_id)

    if clauses:
        orm_exec_state.statement = orm_exec_state.statement.where(or_(*clauses))


async def get_session() -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    """Dépendance FastAPI — fournit une session async."""
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        yield session


SessionDep = AsyncSession


async def init_db() -> None:
    """Crée toutes les tables (développement / tests uniquement)."""
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)


async def close_db() -> None:
    """Ferme le moteur — appelée au shutdown de l'application."""
    await engine.dispose()
````

````python
"""
Registre des modules — charge et suit l'état des modules métier.

Le Core est toujours actif. Les modules métier peuvent être installés,
activés, désactivés ou désinstallés indépendamment.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Any

from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.models.module_info import ModuleInfo

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

CORE_MODULE = "core"

AVAILABLE_MODULES: dict[str, str] = {
    "catalogue": "app.modules.catalogue",
    "crm": "app.modules.crm",
    "sales": "app.modules.sales",
    "stock": "app.modules.stock",
    "purchases": "app.modules.purchases",
    "delivery": "app.modules.delivery",
    "invoicing": "app.modules.invoicing",
    "payments": "app.modules.payments",
    "finance": "app.modules.finance",
    "reporting": "app.modules.reporting",
    "accounting": "app.modules.accounting",
}


class ModuleRegistry:
    """Gère le cycle de vie et l'état des modules du système."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.modules: dict[str, ModuleInfo] = {}
        self._initialized = False

    async def load_modules(self) -> None:
        """Charge l'état des modules depuis la base de données.

        Les modules par défaut (config ``default_modules``) sont persistés
        dans ``module_infos`` s'ils n'existent pas encore, afin que l'état
        soit lisible via la base (et l'API de gestion des modules).
        """
        from app.core.database import AsyncSessionLocal
        from sqlalchemy import select

        async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
            result = await session.execute(select(ModuleInfo))
            for module in result.scalars().all():
                self.modules[module.name] = module

            # Core toujours actif — persiste s'il manque
            if CORE_MODULE not in self.modules:
                core = ModuleInfo(
                    name=CORE_MODULE, version=settings.app_version,
                    status="active", is_active=True,
                )
                session.add(core)
                self.modules[CORE_MODULE] = core

            # Modules par défaut — persiste ceux qui manquent
            for name in settings.default_modules:
                if name not in self.modules:
                    info = ModuleInfo(
                        name=name, version="0.1.0",
                        status="installed", is_active=True,
                    )
                    session.add(info)
                    self.modules[name] = info

            await session.commit()

        self._initialized = True
        logger.info("Modules chargés : %s", self.list_active_modules())

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        """Nettoie les ressources à l'arrêt."""
        pass

    def is_module_active(self, module_name: str) -> bool:
        """Vérifie si un module est actif."""
        info = self.modules.get(module_name)
        return info is not None and info.is_active and info.status == "active"

    def list_active_modules(self) -> list[str]:
        """Liste les modules actifs."""
        return [
            name for name, info in self.modules.items()
            if info.is_active and info.status == "active"
        ]

    def get_module_info(self, module_name: str) -> ModuleInfo | None:
        return self.modules.get(module_name)

    def get_module_config(self, module_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        info = self.modules.get(module_name)
        return info.config or {} if info else {}

    def set_module_config(
        self, module_name: str, config: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> None:
        info = self.modules.get(module_name)
        if info is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Module '{module_name}' inconnu")
        info.config = config
````

## File: backend/app/core/security.py
````python
"""
Utilitaires de sécurité : hachage de mots de passe, JWT, tokens.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import bcrypt
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any

import jwt  # PyJWT

from app.core.config import settings

# Compatibilité : les appelants attrapent ``JWTError`` (nom historique de
# python-jose). PyJWT expose la même hiérarchie sous ``PyJWTError``
# (DecodeError, ExpiredSignatureError... en dérivent tous).
JWTError = jwt.PyJWTError


def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    """Hache un mot de passe avec bcrypt (API native, compatible bcrypt >= 4)."""
    if len(password.encode("utf-8")) > 72:
        password = password[:72]
    hashed = bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt())
    return hashed.decode("utf-8")


def verify_password(plain: str, hashed: str) -> bool:
    """Vérifie un mot de passe contre son hash bcrypt."""
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(plain.encode("utf-8"), hashed.encode("utf-8"))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def create_access_token(
    subject: str | Any,
    expires_delta: timedelta | None = None,
    *,
    company_id: int | None = None,
    scopes: list[str] | None = None,
) -> str:
    """
    Crée un token d'accès JWT.

    Le token contient :
    - ``sub`` : identifiant de l'utilisateur
    - ``company_id`` : entreprise courante
    - ``scopes`` : permissions accordées
    - ``exp`` / ``iat`` : date d'expiration / d'émission
    """
    expire = datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc) + (
        expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=settings.access_token_expire_minutes)
    )
    to_encode: dict[str, Any] = {
        "sub": str(subject),
        "exp": expire,
        "iat": datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc),
        "iss": settings.jwt_issuer,
        "type": "access",
    }
    if company_id is not None:
        to_encode["company_id"] = company_id
    if scopes:
        to_encode["scopes"] = scopes
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.secret_key, algorithm=settings.jwt_algorithm)


def create_refresh_token(
    subject: str | Any,
    expires_delta: timedelta | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Crée un token de rafraîchissement JWT."""
    expire = datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc) + (
        expires_delta
        or timedelta(days=settings.refresh_token_expire_days)
    )
    to_encode: dict[str, Any] = {
        "sub": str(subject),
        "exp": expire,
        "iat": datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc),
        "iss": settings.jwt_issuer,
        "type": "refresh",
    }
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.secret_key, algorithm=settings.jwt_algorithm)


def decode_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Décode un token JWT — lève JWTError si invalide."""
    return jwt.decode(
        token,
        settings.secret_key,
        algorithms=[settings.jwt_algorithm],
        issuer=settings.jwt_issuer,
    )


def decode_access_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Décode un access token — lève JWTError si invalide ou si mauvais type."""
    payload = decode_token(token)
    if payload.get("type") != "access":
        raise JWTError("Invalid token type")
    return payload


def decode_refresh_token(token: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Décode un refresh token."""
    payload = decode_token(token)
    if payload.get("type") != "refresh":
        raise JWTError("Invalid token type")
    return payload
````

## File: backend/app/core/tenant.py
````python
"""
Isolation multi-tenant — contexte « entreprise courante ».

Le contexte est défini par la dépendance d'authentification
(``get_current_user``) à partir de l'utilisateur authentifié :

- superadmin         → ``None``  (aucun filtre, voit tout)
- utilisateur simple → son ``company_id`` (source de vérité : la base)

Le listener SQLAlchemy (``database.py``) applique ensuite automatiquement
``WHERE company_id = ?`` sur toutes les requêtes SELECT des modèles métier,
empêchant toute fuite de données entre entreprises (y compris via
``session.get()``).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from contextvars import ContextVar

_current_company_id: ContextVar[int | None] = ContextVar(
    "current_company_id", default=None
)

# Modèles exclus du filtrage automatique :
# - Role / Permission : partagés entre entreprises (rôles système, catalogues
#   de permissions) — les filtrer casserait le RBAC des autres tenants.
TENANT_EXCLUDED_MODELS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({"Permission", "Role"})


def set_current_company(company_id: int | None) -> None:
    """Définit l'entreprise du contexte d'exécution courant."""
    _current_company_id.set(company_id)


def get_current_company() -> int | None:
    """Retourne l'entreprise courante (``None`` = pas de filtrage)."""
    return _current_company_id.get()
````

````python
"""
````

````python
Routes préfixées par /api/v1/accounting, isolées par tenant (company_id).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_company_id
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.accounting.schemas import (

):

    service = LedgerService(session)
    return await service.get_allocations_for_invoice(company_id, invoice_id)


@router.get(
    "/allocations/payment/{payment_id}",
    response_model=list[InvoiceAllocationRead],
)
async def list_allocations_for_payment(
    payment_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("account", "view")),
):
    """Liste les lettrages d'un paiement."""
    service = LedgerService(session)
    return await service.get_allocations_for_payment(company_id, payment_id)


@router.get(
    "/allocations/summary",
    response_model=list[InvoiceAllocationSummary],
)
async def allocation_summary(
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    partner_id: int | None = Query(
        default=None, description="Filtrer par tiers (client/fournisseur)"
    ),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("account", "view")),
):
    """Résumé des factures avec montant alloué et solde restant."""
    from sqlalchemy import func, select

    from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
    from app.modules.accounting.models.invoice_allocation import InvoiceAllocation

    # Factures de l'entreprise
    stmt = select(Invoice).where(Invoice.company_id == company_id)
    if partner_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Invoice.partner_id == partner_id)

    invoices = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all()
    if not invoices:
        return []

    # Sommes allouées par facture
    alloc_stmt = (
        select(
            InvoiceAllocation.invoice_id,
            func.coalesce(func.sum(InvoiceAllocation.allocated_amount), 0).label(
                "allocated"
            ),
        )
        .where(InvoiceAllocation.company_id == company_id)
        .group_by(InvoiceAllocation.invoice_id)
    )
    alloc_map = {
        row.invoice_id: float(row.allocated)
        for row in (await session.execute(alloc_stmt)).all()
    }

    result = []
    for inv in invoices:
        allocated = alloc_map.get(inv.id, 0.0)
        result.append(
            InvoiceAllocationSummary(
                invoice_id=inv.id,
                invoice_reference=inv.reference,
                amount_total=float(inv.amount_total),
                allocated_amount=allocated,
                remaining_amount=round(float(inv.amount_total) - allocated, 2),
            )
        )
    return result
````

````python
from datetime import date

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_company_id
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.accounting.models.credit_note import CreditNote

router = APIRouter()


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Création / lecture / mise à jour d'avoir
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@router.post(
    "/credit-notes",
    response_model=CreditNoteRead,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
async def create_credit_note(
    body: CreditNoteCreate,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Crée un avoir au statut draft (pas encore comptabilisé)."""
    from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService

    body.company_id = company_id
    payload = body.model_dump()
    # La colonne reference est NOT NULL : numérotation via SequenceService
    # (même mécanique que INV pour les factures, BC pour les bons de commande).
    payload["reference"] = await SequenceService(session).next_value(
        "credit_note", "AV", company_id=company_id
    )
    cn = CreditNote(**payload)
    session.add(cn)
    await session.flush()
    await session.commit()
    return cn


@router.get(
    "/credit-notes",
    response_model=list[CreditNoteSummary],
)
async def list_credit_notes(
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    status_filter: str | None = Query(
        default=None, alias="status", description="Filtrer par statut (draft/issued/applied)"
    ),
    partner_id: int | None = Query(
        default=None, description="Filtrer par tiers (client/fournisseur)"
    ),
    cn_type: str | None = Query(
        default=None, alias="type", description="customer ou supplier"
    ),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "view")),
):
    """Liste les avoirs de l'entreprise."""
    from sqlalchemy import select

    stmt = select(CreditNote).where(CreditNote.company_id == company_id)
    if status_filter:
        stmt = stmt.where(CreditNote.status == status_filter)
    if partner_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(CreditNote.partner_id == partner_id)
    if cn_type:
        stmt = stmt.where(CreditNote.type == cn_type)
    stmt = stmt.order_by(CreditNote.credit_date.desc(), CreditNote.id.desc())

    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    notes = result.scalars().all()
    return [
        CreditNoteSummary(
            id=n.id,
            reference=n.reference,
            type=n.type,
            amount_total=float(n.amount_total or 0),
            currency_code=n.currency_code,
            status=n.status,
            credit_date=n.credit_date,
            partner_id=n.partner_id,
            amount_due=float(n.amount_total or 0),
        )
        for n in notes
    ]


@router.get(
    "/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}",
    response_model=CreditNoteRead,
)
async def get_credit_note(
    credit_note_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "view")),
):
    """Récupère un avoir par son ID."""
    cn = await session.get(CreditNote, credit_note_id)
    if cn is None or cn.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Avoir {credit_note_id} introuvable")
    return cn


@router.put(
    "/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}",
    response_model=CreditNoteRead,
)
async def update_credit_note(
    credit_note_id: int,
    body: CreditNoteUpdate,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Met à jour un avoir (seulement s'il est encore en draft)."""
    cn = await session.get(CreditNote, credit_note_id)
    if cn is None or cn.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Avoir {credit_note_id} introuvable")
    if cn.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"Impossible de modifier un avoir déjà {cn.status}",
        )
    for field, value in body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
        setattr(cn, field, value)
    await session.commit()
    return cn


@router.post(
    "/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/issue",
    response_model=CreditNoteRead,
)
async def issue_credit_note(
    credit_note_id: int,
    body: CreditNoteIssue,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Émet (comptabilise) un avoir : passe de draft → issued.

    Génère l'écriture comptable OHADA correspondante (source_type=credit_note).
    Idempotent : une écriture déjà existante pour ce source_id est ignorée.
    """
    cn = await session.get(CreditNote, credit_note_id)
    if cn is None or cn.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Avoir {credit_note_id} introuvable")
    if cn.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=f"L'avoir {cn.reference} est déjà {cn.status}",
        )

    # Générer une référence si absente
    if not cn.reference:
        from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService

        seq = SequenceService(session)
        cn.reference = await seq.next_value("credit_note", company_id=company_id)

    # Mettre à jour la date / notes si fournis
    if body.credit_date:
        cn.credit_date = body.credit_date
    if body.notes is not None:
        cn.notes = body.notes

    # Comptabiliser via PostingService (idempotent par source_type/source_id)
    result = await PostingService(session).post_credit_note(cn)
    await session.commit()

    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422, detail="Avoir non comptabilisable (montant nul)"
        )

    entry, created = result
    if created:
        cn.journal_entry_id = entry.id
        cn.status = "issued"
        await session.commit()

    return cn


@router.post(
    "/credit-notes/{credit_note_id}/apply",
    response_model=CreditNoteRead,
)
async def apply_credit_note(
    credit_note_id: int,
    body: CreditNoteApply,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Impute un avoir sur sa facture d'origine : passe issued → applied.

    Réduit le solde restant de la facture (paid_amount) du montant imputé.
    Idempotent : un avoir déjà applied est retourné tel quel.
    """
    cn = await session.get(CreditNote, credit_note_id)
    if cn is None or cn.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Avoir {credit_note_id} introuvable")
    if cn.status == "applied":
        return cn
    if cn.status != "issued":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail=(
                f"L'avoir {cn.reference} doit être émis pour être imputé "
                f"(statut actuel : {cn.status})"
            ),
        )

    # Récupère la facture d'origine et vérifie la cohérence tiers / entreprise
    if cn.type == "customer":
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

        invoice = await session.get(Invoice, body.invoice_id)
        if invoice is None or invoice.company_id != company_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Facture {body.invoice_id} introuvable")
        if invoice.partner_id != cn.partner_id:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Le tiers de l'avoir ne correspond pas au client de la facture",
            )
    else:
        from app.modules.purchases.models import SupplierInvoice

        invoice = await session.get(SupplierInvoice, body.invoice_id)
        if invoice is None or invoice.company_id != company_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Facture {body.invoice_id} introuvable")
        if invoice.supplier_id != cn.partner_id:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail="Le tiers de l'avoir ne correspond pas au fournisseur de la facture",
            )

    amount_to_apply = float(body.amount_to_apply or cn.amount_total or 0)
    remaining = float(invoice.amount_total) - float(invoice.paid_amount or 0)
    amount_to_apply = min(amount_to_apply, remaining)
    if amount_to_apply <= 0:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="La facture est déjà soldée")

    invoice.paid_amount = float(invoice.paid_amount or 0) + amount_to_apply
    cn.status = "applied"
    cn.original_invoice_id = invoice.id

    await session.commit()
    await session.refresh(cn)
    return cn


__all__ = ["router"]
````

````python
"""
API Comptabilité — configuration fiscale et régimes d'imposition (Côte d'Ivoire).

Endpoints :
- GET  /api/v1/accounting/fiscal-regime      → lecture du régime actuel + alerte dépassement
- PUT  /api/v1/accounting/fiscal-regime      → mise à jour manuelle du régime
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_company_id
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.accounting.schemas import TaxRegimeRead, TaxRegimeUpdate
from app.modules.accounting.services.fiscal_regime import TaxRegimeService

router = APIRouter()


@router.get(
    "/fiscal-regime",
    response_model=TaxRegimeRead,
    summary="Lecture du régime fiscal de l'entreprise",
)
async def get_fiscal_regime(
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("company", "view")),
):
    """Retourne le régime fiscal actuel, la suggestion de changement et
    si la TVA est bloquée pour ce régime."""
    service = TaxRegimeService(session)
    result = await service.get_tax_regime(company_id)
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Entreprise introuvable")
    return result


@router.put(
    "/fiscal-regime",
    response_model=TaxRegimeRead,
    summary="Mise à jour manuelle du régime fiscal",
)
async def update_fiscal_regime(
    body: TaxRegimeUpdate,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("company", "edit")),
):
    """Définit manuellement le régime fiscal de l'entreprise.

    Aucun basculement automatique n'est appliqué ici.
    """
    service = TaxRegimeService(session)
    try:
        result = await service.update_tax_regime(company_id, body)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Entreprise introuvable")
    # Persistance effective du changement manuel (le service ne fait qu'un flush)
    await session.commit()
    return result


@router.post(

        gt=0,
    ),
):

    - Ne bascule JAMAIS automatiquement

    - L'utilisateur doit valider manuellement le changement
    """

    result = await service.detect_ca_threshold(company_id, ca_annual_ttc)
    if result is None:
````

````python
    return await OHADAService(session).upsert_exchange_rate(body, company_id)
````

## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/api/posting.py
````python
"""API Comptabilité — comptabilisation manuelle des flux métier.

Permet de (re)comptabiliser une facture, un paiement ou une dépense déjà
existants (rattrapage). La comptabilisation automatique à la création est
branchée directement dans les services métier ; ces endpoints sont
idempotents : une source déjà comptabilisée est simplement retournée.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_company_id
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

router = APIRouter()


@router.post("/post/invoice/{invoice_id}")
async def post_invoice(
    invoice_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Comptabilise une facture client (D 411 / C 701 + 4431) — idempotent."""
    from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

    invoice = await session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)
    if invoice is None or invoice.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(404, f"Facture {invoice_id} introuvable")
    result = await PostingService(session).post_invoice(invoice)
    await session.commit()
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            422, f"Facture {invoice.reference} non comptabilisable (statut {invoice.status})"
        )
    entry, _created = result
    return {"reference": entry.reference, "total": float(entry.total_debit)}


@router.post("/post/payment/{payment_id}")
async def post_payment(
    payment_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Comptabilise un paiement (511|531 ↔ 411|401) — idempotent."""
    from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

    payment = await session.get(Payment, payment_id)
    if payment is None or payment.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(404, f"Paiement {payment_id} introuvable")
    result = await PostingService(session).post_payment(payment)
    await session.commit()
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            422, f"Paiement {payment.reference} non comptabilisable (statut {payment.status})"
        )
    entry, _created = result
    return {"reference": entry.reference, "total": float(entry.total_debit)}


@router.post("/post/expense/{expense_id}")
async def post_expense(
    expense_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Comptabilise une dépense (charge ↔ 511|531) — idempotent."""
    from app.modules.finance.models.expense import Expense

    expense = await session.get(Expense, expense_id)
    if expense is None or expense.company_id != company_id:
        raise HTTPException(404, f"Dépense {expense_id} introuvable")
    result = await PostingService(session).post_expense(expense)
    await session.commit()
    if result is None:
        raise HTTPException(422, "Dépense vide ou déjà annulée")
    entry, _created = result
    return {"reference": entry.reference, "total": float(entry.total_debit)}


@router.post("/post/backfill")
async def backfill(
    session: SessionDep,
    company_id: int = Depends(get_current_company_id),
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("journal_entry", "create")),
):
    """Comptabilise en masse tous les flux métier non encore comptabilisés.

    Parcourt les factures (statuts comptabilisables), paiements (paid/pending)
    et dépenses ; les sources déjà comptabilisées sont ignorées (idempotence
    via ``source_type``/``source_id``). Retourne le nombre d'écritures créées.
    """
    from datetime import date as date_type

    from sqlalchemy import select

    from app.modules.finance.models.expense import Expense
    from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
    from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

    service = PostingService(session)
    created = {"invoices": 0, "payments": 0, "expenses": 0}

    # Factures comptabilisables (exclut proforma/brouillon/annulée/avoir)
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Invoice).where(
            Invoice.status.notin_(["draft", "proforma", "cancelled", "credit"]),
        )
    )
    for invoice in result.scalars():
        posted = await service.post_invoice(invoice)
        if posted is not None and posted[1]:
            created["invoices"] += 1

    # Paiements
    result = await session.execute(
        select(Payment).where(Payment.status.in_(["paid", "pending"]))
    )
    for payment in result.scalars():
        posted = await service.post_payment(payment)
        if posted is not None and posted[1]:
            created["payments"] += 1

    # Dépenses
    result = await session.execute(select(Expense))
    for expense in result.scalars():
        posted = await service.post_expense(expense)
        if posted is not None and posted[1]:
            created["expenses"] += 1

    await session.commit()
    total = sum(created.values())
    return {
        "created": created,
        "total": total,
        "date": date_type.today().isoformat(),
        "message": (
            f"{total} écriture(s) créée(s) : "
            f"{created['invoices']} facture(s), {created['payments']} paiement(s), "
            f"{created['expenses']} dépense(s)."
        ) if total else "Aucun flux restant à comptabiliser.",
    }
````

````python
class Account(Base, TenantMixin):

    code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(250))
    #: 1..9 — classe OHADA
    class_no: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(1), index=True)
    #: Type fonctionnel — sert aux écritures automatiques & états financiers

        String(30),
        default="asset",
        index=True,
````
