## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/models/credit_note.py
````python
"""
Modèle CreditNote (avoir / note de crédit).

Un avoir est un document comptable qui réduit le montant dû par un tiers
(client ou fournisseur), lié à une facture d'origine.

États :
- draft    : brouillon, pas encore comptabilisé
- issued   : émis / comptabilisé (écriture comptable créée)
- applied  : totalement imputé (soldé via lettrage ou paiement)

Comptabilisation OHADA :
- Avoir client   : D 709 (Ventes retournées) + 4431 (TVA à répercuter) / C 411 (Client)
- Avoir fournisseur : D 401 (Fournisseur) / C 609 (Achats retournés) + 4452 (TVA déductible)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import CheckConstraint, Date, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin

__all__ = ["CreditNote"]


class CreditNote(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Avoir / note de crédit client ou fournisseur."""

    __tablename__ = "credit_notes"

    __table_args__ = (
        CheckConstraint(
            "amount_total >= 0",
            name="ck_credit_note_amount_total_nonnegative",
        ),
        CheckConstraint(
            "type IN ('customer', 'supplier')",
            name="ck_credit_note_type_valid",
        ),
        CheckConstraint(
            "status IN ('draft', 'issued', 'applied')",
            name="ck_credit_note_status_valid",
        ),
    )

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)

    # Facture d'origine à laquelle cet avoir est rattaché
    original_invoice_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        Integer, nullable=True, index=True
    )

    # Type d'avoir : client (on doit de l'argent au client) ou fournisseur
    type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), nullable=False, index=True)

    # Tiers concerné
    partner_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer, nullable=True, index=True)

    # Montants
    amount_untaxed: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    amount_total: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    currency_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(3), default="XOF")

    # État du cycle de vie
    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default="draft", nullable=False, index=True
    )

    # Dates
    credit_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, default=date.today, index=True)

    # Motif / justification
    reason: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(1000))
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(2000))

    # Comptabilisation liée
    journal_entry_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        Integer, nullable=True, index=True
    )

    # Relations
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship("Company")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<CreditNote {self.reference} [{self.status}] {self.amount_total}>"

    @property
    def amount_due(self) -> float:
        """Montant encore à imputer (non utilisé si applied)."""
        return max(float(self.amount_total or 0), 0.0)

    @property
    def is_customer(self) -> bool:
        return self.type == "customer"

    @property
    def is_supplier(self) -> bool:
        return self.type == "supplier"
````

## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/models/invoice_allocation.py
````python
"""
Modèle InvoiceAllocation — lettrage d'un paiement sur une facture.

Permet de rapprocher un paiement (encaissement ou décaissement) avec une ou
plusieurs factures, en allouant un montant partiel ou total. Le solde
restant à lettrer d'une facture = amount_total - Σ(allocations).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from sqlalchemy import Date, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String, UniqueConstraint
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship, validates

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin


class InvoiceAllocation(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Lettrage : alloue un paiement à une facture (client ou fournisseur)."""

    invoice_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        Integer,
        ForeignKey("invoices.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    payment_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        Integer,
        ForeignKey("payments.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    allocated_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(
        Numeric(14, 4), nullable=False, default=0
    )
    allocation_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, nullable=False)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))

    # Unicité : un couple (invoice, payment) ne peut être alloué qu'une fois
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("invoice_id", "payment_id", name="uq_invoice_payment_allocation"),
    )

    # Relations (chaînes pour éviter les imports circulaires inter-modules)
    invoice: Mapped["Invoice"] = relationship("Invoice", lazy="selectin")
    payment: Mapped["Payment"] = relationship("Payment", lazy="selectin")

    @validates("allocated_amount")
    def _validate_amount(self, key, value):
        if value is None or value < 0:
            raise ValueError("Le montant alloué doit être positif")
        return value

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return (
            f"<InvoiceAllocation invoice={self.invoice_id} "
            f"payment={self.payment_id} amount={self.allocated_amount}>"
        )


__all__ = ["InvoiceAllocation"]
````

````python
"""
Modèles Écriture comptable (JournalEntry + JournalEntryLine).

Une écriture est équilibrée : total débit == total crédit. Chaque ligne est
rattachée à un compte du plan (OHADA) et, optionnellement, à un tiers
(client / fournisseur).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import Date, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin

__all__ = ["JournalEntry", "JournalEntryLine"]


class JournalEntry(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Écriture comptable (en-tête)."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(40), index=True)
    entry_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, nullable=False, index=True)
    journal_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), index=True)
    fiscal_year_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("fiscal_years.id"), nullable=True
    )

    #: Origine de l'écriture : ``manual``, ``invoice``, ``payment``,
    #: ``expense``, ``purchase``, ``stock``, ``sale``…
    source_type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), default="manual")
    #: Identifiant du document source (facture, paiement, dépense…)
    source_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer)

    description: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))

    total_debit: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(16, 2), default=0)
    total_credit: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(16, 2), default=0)

    #: ``draft`` | ``posted`` | ``canceled``
    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), default="draft", index=True)

    lines: Mapped[list["JournalEntryLine"]] = relationship(
        "JournalEntryLine",
        back_populates="entry",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        lazy="selectin",
        order_by="JournalEntryLine.position",
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<JournalEntry {self.reference} [{self.status}]>"


class JournalEntryLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne d'une écriture (débit ou crédit)."""

    entry_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("journal_entries.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    account_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), index=True)
    label: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(250))
    debit: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(16, 2), default=0)
    credit: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(16, 2), default=0)
    #: Tiers associé (client / fournisseur / personnel…), optionnel
    partner_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer, nullable=True)
    position: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, default=0)

    entry: Mapped["JournalEntry"] = relationship("JournalEntry", back_populates="lines")
````

````python
"""
Modèles OHADA — paramètres comptables pour l'Ouagadougou Common Charge System.

Ce module contient la configuration par pays (taux de change, exercice fiscal,
taux TVA par défaut) ainsi que la gestion de l'exercice comptable.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Date,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin


class OHADAParameter(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Paramètre OHADA par entreprise.

    Chaque entreprise peut avoir un ou plusieurs pays associés, chacun avec :
    - une devise
    - un taux de change par rapport à la devise de la société
    - la période d'exercice comptable (ouverture / clôture)
    - le taux TVA par défaut applicable à ce pays
    - le statut d'activation

    Notes :
    - la clé primaire est id
    - la contrainte d'unicité par entreprise et pays est gérée au niveau
      application (voir OHADAService.upsert)
    """

    __tablename__ = "ohada_parameters"

    id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)

    company_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        Integer,
        ForeignKey("companies.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )

    country_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(2),
        index=True,
        default="BF",  # Burkina Faso par défaut
    )

    currency_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(3),
        ForeignKey("currencies.code"),
        default="XOF",
    )

    rate_to_fx: Mapped[Optional[float]] = MappedColumn(
        Numeric(10, 6),
        default=600.0,
        doc="Taux de change par rapport à la devise de la société.",
    )

    fiscal_year_start: Mapped[Optional[date]] = MappedColumn(Date)
    fiscal_year_end: Mapped[Optional[date]] = MappedColumn(Date)

    tax_rate_percentage: Mapped[Optional[float]] = MappedColumn(
        Numeric(5, 2),
        default=0.0,
        doc="Taux TVA par défaut pour ce pays.",
    )

    is_active: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=True)

    # Relations
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship(
        "Company",
        lazy="selectin",
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<OHADAParameter {self.company_id} {self.country_code} ({self.currency_code})>"
````

## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/services/account_service.py
````python
"""
Service Comptabilité — plan comptable OHADA.

Fournit :
- ``seed_ohada_chart`` — insère le plan complet (637 comptes) pour une entreprise
- ``seed_default_journals`` — crée les journaux standards (ACH, VTE, BAN, CAI, OD)
- accès comptes (CRUD léger)

Le type de compte (asset / liability / equity / income / expense) est dérivé
des règles SYSCOHADA pour alimenter les états financiers (bilan, résultat).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.accounting.data.ohada_chart import OHADA_ACCOUNTS
from app.modules.accounting.models.account import Account
from app.modules.accounting.models.journal import Journal

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Règles de type — dérivation depuis le code OHADA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
def account_type_for(code: str) -> str:
    """Détermine le type comptable d'un compte depuis son code OHADA."""
    cls = code[0]
    if cls == "1":
        # Capitaux propres vs dettes de capitaux
        if code.startswith(
            ("101", "102", "103", "104", "105", "106", "107", "108",
             "11", "12", "13", "14", "15")
        ):
            return "equity"
        return "liability"
    if cls in ("2", "3"):
        return "asset"
    if cls == "4":
        # Clients / TVA déductible / CCA / avances personnel → actifs
        if code.startswith(("41", "4421", "4422", "4423", "481", "488", "421")):
            return "asset"
        # Dépréciations & comptes transitoires → actifs (contre-valeurs)
        if code.startswith(("49", "47")):
            return "asset"
        return "liability"
    if cls == "5":
        # Crédits de trésorerie = dettes ; dépréciations = contre-actif
        if code.startswith("56"):
            return "liability"
        return "asset"
    if cls == "6":
        return "expense"
    if cls == "7":
        return "income"
    if cls == "8":
        # Charges HAO vs Produits HAO
        if code.startswith(("81", "83", "85", "87", "89")):
            return "expense"
        return "income"
    return "off_balance"


DEFAULT_JOURNALS: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = [
    ("VTE", "Ventes", "sale"),
    ("ACH", "Achats", "purchase"),
    ("BAN", "Banque", "bank"),
    ("CAI", "Caisse", "cash"),
    ("PAY", "Paiements reçus", "payment"),
    ("OD", "Opérations diverses", "misc"),
]
class AccountService:
    """Accès aux comptes du plan comptable (multi-entreprise)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_accounts(
        self,
        company_id: int,
        account_class: str | None = None,
        active_only: bool = True,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 500,
    ) -> list[Account]:
        stmt = select(Account).where(Account.company_id == company_id)
        if account_class:
            stmt = stmt.where(Account.class_no == account_class)
        if active_only:
            stmt = stmt.where(Account.is_active.is_(True))
        stmt = stmt.order_by(Account.code).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_account(
        self, company_id: int, code: str
    ) -> Account | None:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Account).where(
                Account.company_id == company_id, Account.code == code
            )
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def get_by_technical_name(
        self, company_id: int, technical_name: str
    ) -> Account | None:
        """Retrouve un compte via son nom technique stable (ex. ``customers``)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Account).where(
                Account.company_id == company_id,
                Account.technical_name == technical_name,
            )
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Seed
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def seed_ohada_chart(
        self, company_id: int, refresh_labels: bool = True
    ) -> int:
        """Insère le plan comptable OHADA complet pour une entreprise.

        Idempotent : ne crée que les comptes absents. Si ``refresh_labels``
        est vrai, met aussi à jour libellés et types des comptes existants
        (le code est la clé de référence du référentiel). Retourne le nombre
        de comptes créés.
        """
        by_code = {
            acc.code: acc
            for acc in await self.list_accounts(company_id, active_only=False, limit=2000)
        }
        created = updated = 0
        for code, name, technical in OHADA_ACCOUNTS:
            acc_type = account_type_for(code)
            acc = by_code.get(code)
            if acc is not None:
                if refresh_labels and (
                    acc.name != name or acc.technical_name != technical or acc.account_type != acc_type
                ):
                    acc.name = name
                    acc.technical_name = technical
                    acc.account_type = acc_type
                    updated += 1
                continue
            self.session.add(
                Account(
                    code=code,
                    name=name,
                    class_no=code[0],
                    account_type=acc_type,
                    technical_name=technical,
                    is_group=False,
                    is_active=True,
                    level=1,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )
            created += 1
        if created or updated:
            await self.session.flush()
            logger.info(
                "Plan OHADA : %d comptes insérés, %d mis à jour pour company %s",
                created, updated, company_id,
            )
        return created

    async def ensure_seeded(self, company_id: int) -> int:
        """Garantit que le plan est chargé (appelé avant toute écriture)."""
        if not await self.get_account(company_id, "411"):
            return await self.seed_ohada_chart(company_id)
        return 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Journaux
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def seed_default_journals(self, company_id: int) -> int:
        """Crée les journaux standards SYSCOHADA s'ils sont absents."""
        existing = {
            j.code
            for j in (
                await self.session.execute(
                    select(Journal).where(Journal.company_id == company_id)
                )
            ).scalars()
        }
        created = 0
        for code, name, jtype in DEFAULT_JOURNALS:
            if code in existing:
                continue
            self.session.add(
                Journal(
                    code=code,
                    name=name,
                    journal_type=jtype,
                    is_active=True,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )
            created += 1
        if created:
            await self.session.flush()
        return created


__all__ = ["AccountService", "account_type_for", "DEFAULT_JOURNALS"]
````

## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/services/financial_service.py
````python
"""
Service États financiers (SYSCOHADA).

Fournit :
- ``balance_report``   — balance générale (soldes débit/crédit par compte)
- ``trial_balance``    — balance de vérification (soldes non nuls)
- ``general_ledger``   — grand livre d'un compte (mouvements + cumul)
- ``journal_report``   — journal général (écritures d'une période)
- ``income_statement`` — compte de résultat (produits - charges)
- ``balance_sheet``    — bilan (actif / passif par grandes masses)

Principes :
- seules les écritures ``posted`` sont prises en compte
- le multi-entreprise est géré via ``company_id`` (tenant)
- les montants sont renvoyés en float, arrondis à 2 décimales
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.accounting.models.account import Account
from app.modules.accounting.models.journal_entry import JournalEntry, JournalEntryLine
from app.modules.accounting.services.account_service import AccountService
from app.modules.accounting.services.journal_service import LedgerService
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
from app.modules.purchases.models import SupplierInvoice

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Sections du bilan — (libellé, préfixes de comptes)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Sections du bilan — (libellé, préfixes de comptes, est une déduction).
#
# Une section « déduction » regroupe les comptes d'amortissements et de
# dépréciations (soldes normalement créditeurs) : ils réduisent l'actif.
# Les comptes « mixtes » (42x, 43x, 44x, 46x, 47x) sont classés selon le
# signe de leur solde : débit → actif, crédit → passif.
BALANCE_SHEET_ASSETS: list[tuple[str, list[str], bool]] = [
    ("Charges immobilisées", ["201", "202", "206"], False),
    ("Immobilisations incorporelles", ["21"], False),
    ("Immobilisations corporelles", ["22", "23", "24"], False),
    ("Immobilisations financières", ["25", "26", "27"], False),
    ("Amortissements et dépréciations des immobilisations", ["28", "29"], True),
    ("Stocks et encours", ["31", "32", "33", "34", "35", "36", "37", "38"], False),
    ("Dépréciations des stocks", ["39"], True),
    ("Clients et comptes rattachés", ["409", "41"], False),
    ("Autres créances", ["408", "42", "43", "44", "45", "46", "47", "48"], False),
    ("Dépréciations des comptes de tiers", ["49"], True),
    ("Trésorerie-actif", ["50", "51", "52", "53", "54", "55", "57", "58"], False),
    ("Dépréciations de trésorerie", ["59"], True),
]

BALANCE_SHEET_LIABILITIES: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = [
    ("Capital social", ["101", "102", "103", "109"]),
    ("Primes et réserves", ["104", "105", "106", "107", "108", "15"]),
    ("Report à nouveau", ["11"]),
    ("Résultat net de l'exercice", ["12"]),
    ("Subventions d'investissement", ["13"]),
    ("Provisions réglementées", ["14"]),
    ("Dettes financières et assimilées", ["16", "17", "18"]),
    ("Provisions financières pour risques et charges", ["19"]),
    ("Fournisseurs et comptes rattachés", ["40"]),
    ("Dettes fiscales et sociales", ["42", "43", "44", "45"]),
    ("Autres dettes", ["46", "47"]),
    ("Produits constatés d'avance", ["486"]),
    ("Trésorerie-passif", ["51", "52", "56", "57", "58"]),
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Sections du compte de résultat
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
INCOME_SECTIONS: list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]] = [
    ("Ventes", "income", ["70", "71", "72", "73"]),
    ("Subventions d'exploitation", "income", ["74"]),
    ("Autres produits d'exploitation", "income", ["75", "78", "79"]),
    ("Produits financiers", "income", ["76"]),
    ("Produits exceptionnels", "income", ["77"]),
]

EXPENSE_SECTIONS: list[tuple[str, str, list[str]]] = [
    ("Achats", "expense", ["60"]),
    ("Transports", "expense", ["61"]),
    ("Services extérieurs", "expense", ["62"]),
    ("Impôts et taxes", "expense", ["63"]),
    ("Charges de personnel", "expense", ["64"]),
    ("Autres charges d'exploitation", "expense", ["65", "68"]),
    ("Charges financières", "expense", ["66"]),
    ("Charges exceptionnelles", "expense", ["67"]),
    ("Impôts sur le résultat", "expense", ["69"]),
]


class FinancialService:
    """États financiers SYSCOHADA."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.accounts = AccountService(session)
        self.ledger = LedgerService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _account_map(self, company_id: int) -> dict[str, Account]:
        rows = await self.accounts.list_accounts(
            company_id, active_only=False, limit=2000
        )
        return {a.code: a for a in rows}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Balance générale
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def balance_report(
        self, company_id: int, date_from: date | None = None, date_to: date | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Balance générale : soldes débit/crédit par compte (toutes classes)."""
        balances = await self.ledger.account_balances(
            company_id, date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to
        )
        account_map = await self._account_map(company_id)

        lines = []
        total_debit = total_credit = 0.0
        for b in balances:
            acc = account_map.get(b["account_code"])
            if acc is None:
                continue
            debit = b["debit"]
            credit = b["credit"]
            total_debit += debit
            total_credit += credit
            lines.append(
                {
                    "account_code": acc.code,
                    "account_name": acc.name,
                    "class_no": acc.class_no,
                    "debit": round(debit, 2),
                    "credit": round(credit, 2),
                    "balance": round(b["balance"], 2),
                }
            )
        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "date_from": date_from,
            "date_to": date_to,
            "lines": lines,
            "total_debit": round(total_debit, 2),
            "total_credit": round(total_credit, 2),
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Balance de vérification (soldes résiduels non nuls)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def trial_balance(self, company_id: int) -> dict:
        """Soldes non nuls — base de la balance de vérification."""
        balances = await self.ledger.account_balances(company_id)
        account_map = await self._account_map(company_id)
        lines = []
        total_debit = total_credit = 0.0
        for b in balances:
            acc = account_map.get(b["account_code"])
            if acc is None or abs(b["balance"]) < 0.005:
                continue
            balance = b["balance"]
            if balance > 0:
                debit, credit = balance, 0.0
            else:
                debit, credit = 0.0, -balance
            total_debit += debit
            total_credit += credit
            lines.append(
                {
                    "account_code": acc.code,
                    "account_name": acc.name,
                    "debit": round(debit, 2),
                    "credit": round(credit, 2),
                    "balance": round(balance, 2),
                }
            )
        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "lines": lines,
            "total_debit": round(total_debit, 2),
            "total_credit": round(total_credit, 2),
            "balanced": abs(total_debit - total_credit) < 0.01,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Grand livre
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def general_ledger(
        self, company_id: int, account_code: str,
        date_from: date | None = None, date_to: date | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Grand livre d'un compte : mouvements chronologiques + cumul."""
        movements, opening, closing, total_debit, total_credit = (
            await self.ledger.account_movements(
                company_id, account_code, date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to
            )
        )
        account = await self.accounts.get_account(company_id, account_code)
        account_name = account.name if account else account_code
        return {
            "account_code": account_code,
            "account_name": account_name,
            "date_from": date_from,
            "date_to": date_to,
            "opening_balance": round(opening, 2),
            "closing_balance": round(closing, 2),
            "total_debit": round(total_debit, 2),
            "total_credit": round(total_credit, 2),
            "movements": movements,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Journal général
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def journal_report(
        self, company_id: int, journal_code: str | None = None,
        date_from: date | None = None, date_to: date | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Journal général : écritures publiées d'une période (ou par journal)."""
        entries = await self.ledger.list_entries(
            company_id, limit=1000,
            date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to, journal_code=journal_code,
        )
        lines = []
        total_debit = total_credit = 0.0
        for e in entries:
            for l in e.lines:
                total_debit += float(l.debit)
                total_credit += float(l.credit)
            lines.append(
                {
                    "reference": e.reference,
                    "entry_date": e.entry_date,
                    "journal_code": e.journal_code,
                    "description": e.description,
                    "status": e.status,
                    "lines": [
                        {
                            "account_code": l.account_code,
                            "label": l.label,
                            "debit": float(l.debit),
                            "credit": float(l.credit),
                        }
                        for l in e.lines
                    ],
                }
            )
        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "journal_code": journal_code,
            "date_from": date_from,
            "date_to": date_to,
            "entries": lines,
            "total_debit": round(total_debit, 2),
            "total_credit": round(total_credit, 2),
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Compte de résultat
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def income_statement(
        self, company_id: int, date_from: date | None = None, date_to: date | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Compte de résultat SYSCOHADA (produits - charges)."""
        balances = await self.ledger.account_balances(
            company_id, date_from=date_from, date_to=date_to
        )
        account_map = await self._account_map(company_id)

        def _sum(codes: list[str], sign: int) -> float:
            return round(
                sum(
                    sign * b["balance"]
                    for b in balances
                    if any(b["account_code"].startswith(c) for c in codes)
                ),
                2,
            )

        # Produits : solde créditeur (négatif) → signe -1 pour un montant positif.
        income_lines = [
            {"label": label, "codes": codes, "amount": _sum(codes, sign=-1)}
            for label, _, codes in INCOME_SECTIONS
        ]
        # Charges : solde débiteur (positif) → signe +1.
        expense_lines = [
            {"label": label, "codes": codes, "amount": _sum(codes, sign=1)}
            for label, _, codes in EXPENSE_SECTIONS
        ]

        total_income = round(sum(l["amount"] for l in income_lines), 2)
        total_expense = round(sum(l["amount"] for l in expense_lines), 2)
        net_income = round(total_income - total_expense, 2)

        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "date_from": date_from,
            "date_to": date_to,
            "income": income_lines,
            "expenses": expense_lines,
            "total_income": total_income,
            "total_expenses": total_expense,
            "net_income": net_income,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Bilan
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def balance_sheet(
        self, company_id: int, as_of: date | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Bilan SYSCOHADA (actif / passif par grandes masses).

        Règles :
        - les comptes « mixtes » (42x, 43x, 44x, 46x, 47x…) sont classés
          selon le signe de leur solde : débiteur → actif, crédititeur → passif ;
        - les sections « déduction » (amortissements 28x/29x, dépréciations
          39x/49x/59x) réduisent l'actif ;
        - le résultat net de l'exercice (classes 6-8 non soldées) est reporté
          au passif (bénéfice) ou à l'actif (perte) tant que la clôture n'a
          pas été comptabilisée au compte 12.
        """
        balances = await self.ledger.account_balances(company_id, date_to=as_of)

        def _amount(b: dict, prefixes: list[str], mode: str) -> float:
            if not any(b["account_code"].startswith(p) for p in prefixes):
                return 0.0
            bal = b["balance"]
            if mode == "debit":        # actif : solde débiteur uniquement
                return max(bal, 0.0)
            if mode == "credit":       # passif : solde créditeur uniquement
                return max(-bal, 0.0)
            return max(-bal, 0.0)      # déduction : solde créditeur déduit

        def _section(
            sections: list[tuple[str, list[str], bool]] | list[tuple[str, list[str]]],
            mode: str,
        ) -> tuple[list[dict], float]:
            out = []
            total = 0.0
            for section in sections:
                label, prefixes = section[0], section[1]
                is_deduction = bool(section[2]) if len(section) > 2 else False
                sec_mode = "deduction" if is_deduction else mode
                amount = round(
                    sum(_amount(b, prefixes, sec_mode) for b in balances), 2
                )
                total += amount
                out.append({"label": label, "amount": amount})
            return out, round(total, 2)

        assets, total_assets = _section(BALANCE_SHEET_ASSETS, mode="debit")
        liabilities, total_liabilities = _section(
            BALANCE_SHEET_LIABILITIES, mode="credit"
        )

        # Résultat net non soldé (classes 6-8) : crédits - débits.
        closing_result = round(
            sum(-b["balance"] for b in balances if b["account_code"][:1] in "678"),
            2,
        )
        has_account_12 = any(
            b["account_code"].startswith("12") and abs(b["balance"]) > 0.005
            for b in balances
        )
        if not has_account_12:
            if closing_result >= 0:
                for line in liabilities:
                    if line["label"] == "Résultat net de l'exercice":
                        line["amount"] = round(line["amount"] + closing_result, 2)
                total_liabilities = round(total_liabilities + closing_result, 2)
            else:
                loss = round(-closing_result, 2)
                assets.append({"label": "Résultat net de l'exercice (perte)", "amount": loss})
                total_assets = round(total_assets + loss, 2)

        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "as_of": as_of,
            "assets": assets,
            "liabilities": liabilities,
            "total_assets": total_assets,
            "total_liabilities": total_liabilities,
            "net_income": closing_result,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Balance âgée (aging clients / fournisseurs)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def aged_balance(
        self,
        company_id: int,
        partner_type: str = "customer",
        as_of: date | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Balance âgée par tiers : créances (clients) ou dettes (fournisseurs).

        Tranches d'échéance : ``not_due`` (non échues), ``d0_30``, ``d31_60``,
        ``d61_90``, ``d90_plus`` jours de retard. L'ancienneté se calcule
        depuis ``due_date`` (à défaut ``invoice_date``).

        Seules les factures non soldées émises au plus tard ``as_of`` sont
        retenues — brouillons, proformas, annulations et avoirs exclus.
        """
        as_of = as_of or date.today()
        excluded = ("draft", "proforma", "cancelled", "credit")

        if partner_type == "supplier":
            residual = SupplierInvoice.amount_total - SupplierInvoice.paid_amount
            stmt = (
                select(SupplierInvoice, Partner.name.label("partner_name"))
                .join(Partner, Partner.id == SupplierInvoice.supplier_id)
                .where(
                    SupplierInvoice.company_id == company_id,
                    ~SupplierInvoice.status.in_(excluded),
                    residual > 0.005,
                    SupplierInvoice.invoice_date <= as_of,
                )
            )
        else:
            partner_type = "customer"
            residual = Invoice.amount_total - Invoice.paid_amount
            stmt = (
                select(Invoice, Partner.name.label("partner_name"))
                .join(Partner, Partner.id == Invoice.partner_id)
                .where(
                    Invoice.company_id == company_id,
                    ~Invoice.status.in_(excluded),
                    residual > 0.005,
                    Invoice.invoice_date <= as_of,
                )
            )

        rows = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).all()

        grouped: dict[int, dict] = {}
        for obj, partner_name in rows:
            due = obj.due_date or obj.invoice_date
            late_days = (as_of - due).days
            if late_days < 0:
                key = "not_due"
            elif late_days <= 30:
                key = "d0_30"
            elif late_days <= 60:
                key = "d31_60"
            elif late_days <= 90:
                key = "d61_90"
            else:
                key = "d90_plus"

            pid = obj.partner_id if partner_type == "customer" else obj.supplier_id
            entry = grouped.get(pid)
            if entry is None:
                entry = grouped[pid] = {
                    "partner_id": pid,
                    "partner_name": partner_name,
                    "invoice_count": 0,
                    "total_due": 0.0,
                    "not_due": 0.0,
                    "d0_30": 0.0,
                    "d31_60": 0.0,
                    "d61_90": 0.0,
                    "d90_plus": 0.0,
                }
            amount = max(float(obj.amount_total) - float(obj.paid_amount), 0.0)
            entry["invoice_count"] += 1
            entry["total_due"] += amount
            entry[key] += amount

        keys = ("total_due", "not_due", "d0_30", "d31_60", "d61_90", "d90_plus")
        lines = sorted(grouped.values(), key=lambda x: -x["total_due"])
        totals = {k: 0.0 for k in keys}
        for line in lines:
            for k in keys:
                line[k] = round(line[k], 2)
                totals[k] += line[k]
        totals = {k: round(v, 2) for k, v in totals.items()}

        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "partner_type": partner_type,
            "as_of": as_of,
            "lines": lines,
            "totals": totals,
            "total_due": totals["total_due"],
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Cash-flow (flux de trésorerie)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def cash_flow(
        self,
        company_id: int,
        date_from: date | None = None,
        date_to: date | None = None,
    ) -> dict:
        """Flux de trésorerie : soldes d'ouverture/fin et mouvements par compte.

        Ne retient que les comptes de trésorerie (51x-53x, 54x, 55x, 57x,
        58x) des écritures ``posted``. ``inflows`` = débits (encaissements),
        ``outflows`` = crédits (décaissements), valeurs positives.
        """
        prefixes = ("51", "52", "53", "54", "55", "57", "58")
        is_treasury = or_(
            *[JournalEntryLine.account_code.like(f"{p}%") for p in prefixes]
        )
        account_map = await self._account_map(company_id)

        async def _movements(
            before: date | None = None,
            start: date | None = None,
            end: date | None = None,
        ) -> dict[str, tuple[float, float]]:
            stmt = (
                select(
                    JournalEntryLine.account_code,
                    func.coalesce(func.sum(JournalEntryLine.debit), 0.0).label("d"),
                    func.coalesce(func.sum(JournalEntryLine.credit), 0.0).label("c"),
                )
                .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntry.id == JournalEntryLine.entry_id)
                .where(
                    JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                    JournalEntry.status == "posted",
                    is_treasury,
                )
                .group_by(JournalEntryLine.account_code)
            )
            if before is not None:
                stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date < before)
            if start is not None:
                stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date >= start)
            if end is not None:
                stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date <= end)
            rows = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).all()
            return {code: (float(d), float(c)) for code, d, c in rows}

        opening_map = await _movements(before=date_from) if date_from else {}
        period_map = await _movements(start=date_from, end=date_to)

        by_account: list[dict] = []
        opening_balance = inflows = outflows = 0.0
        for code in sorted(set(opening_map) | set(period_map)):
            od, oc = opening_map.get(code, (0.0, 0.0))
            d, c = period_map.get(code, (0.0, 0.0))
            open_bal = od - oc
            close_bal = open_bal + d - c
            account = account_map.get(code)
            by_account.append(
                {
                    "account_code": code,
                    "account_name": account.name if account else code,
                    "opening_balance": round(open_bal, 2),
                    "inflows": round(d, 2),
                    "outflows": round(c, 2),
                    "net_flow": round(d - c, 2),
                    "closing_balance": round(close_bal, 2),
                }
            )
            opening_balance += open_bal
            inflows += d
            outflows += c

        return {
            "company_id": company_id,
            "date_from": date_from,
            "date_to": date_to,
            "opening_balance": round(opening_balance, 2),
            "inflows": round(inflows, 2),
            "outflows": round(outflows, 2),
            "net_flow": round(inflows - outflows, 2),
            "closing_balance": round(opening_balance + inflows - outflows, 2),
            "by_account": by_account,
        }


def _section_for(code: str, sections: list[tuple[str, list[str]]]) -> str:
    """Retourne le libellé de section pour un code, sinon ``""``."""
    for label, prefixes in sections:
        for p in prefixes:
            if code.startswith(p):
                return label
    return ""


__all__ = ["FinancialService"]
````

## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/services/fiscal_regime.py
````python
"""
Service de configuration fiscale — régimes d'imposition Côte d'Ivoire (TEE / RME / RSI / RNI).

Règle métier : pas de basculement automatique, pas de blocage des processus commerciaux.
Seule une alerte de dépassement de seuil est levée, avec suggestion de changement.
Le changement de régime reste une décision manuelle de l'utilisateur.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.models.company import Company
from app.modules.accounting.schemas import TaxRegimeRead, TaxRegimeUpdate
from app.shared.enums import TaxRegime, TAX_REGIME_THRESHOLDS


class TaxRegimeService:
    """Lecture, mise à jour et détection de dépassement de seuil du régime fiscal."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    @staticmethod
    def _regime_value(value: TaxRegime | str | None) -> str | None:
        """Normalise un régime en chaîne ('TEE'…), que la valeur soit un enum
        (objet encore en mémoire après assignment) ou une string lue en DB.

        `str(TaxRegime.TEE)` renverrait 'TaxRegime.TEE' — d'où ce helper.
        """
        if value is None:
            return None
        if isinstance(value, TaxRegime):
            return value.value
        return str(value)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def get_tax_regime(self, company_id: int) -> TaxRegimeRead | None:
        """Retourne le régime fiscal de l'entreprise avec indication de dépassement."""
        company = await self.session.get(Company, company_id)
        if company is None:
            return None

        current_regime = company.tax_regime
        suggested = company.suggested_tax_regime

        threshold = None
        if current_regime is not None:
            try:
                regime_enum = TaxRegime(current_regime)
                threshold = TAX_REGIME_THRESHOLDS.get(regime_enum)
            except ValueError:
                pass

        ca_exceeds = False
        if suggested is not None and suggested != current_regime:
            ca_exceeds = True

        tva_blocked = current_regime in (TaxRegime.TEE, TaxRegime.RME)

        return TaxRegimeRead(
            company_id=company.id,
            tax_regime=self._regime_value(current_regime),
            suggested_tax_regime=self._regime_value(suggested),
            ca_threshold=threshold,
            ca_exceeds_threshold=ca_exceeds,
            tva_blocked=tva_blocked,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Mise à jour manuelle (jamais automatique)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def update_tax_regime(
        self, company_id: int, payload: TaxRegimeUpdate
    ) -> TaxRegimeRead | None:
        """Définit manuellement le régime fiscal de l'entreprise."""
        company = await self.session.get(Company, company_id)
        if company is None:
            return None

        try:
            regime_enum = TaxRegime(payload.tax_regime)
        except ValueError:
            raise ValueError(f"Régime fiscal invalide : {payload.tax_regime}")

        company.tax_regime = regime_enum
        company.suggested_tax_regime = None

        await self.session.flush()
        return await self.get_tax_regime(company_id)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Détection de dépassement de seuil (appelée depuis le service métier)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def detect_ca_threshold(
        self, company_id: int, ca_annual_ttc: Decimal
    ) -> TaxRegimeRead | None:
        """Détecte si le CA annuel TTC dépasse le seuil du régime actuel.

        - Ne bascule JAMAIS automatiquement
        - Définit `suggested_tax_regime` si dépassement
        - Retourne la lecture mise à jour avec `ca_exceeds_threshold = True`
        """
        company = await self.session.get(Company, company_id)
        if company is None:
            return None

        current = company.tax_regime
        if current is None:
            return await self.get_tax_regime(company_id)

        try:
            regime_enum = TaxRegime(current)
        except ValueError:
            return await self.get_tax_regime(company_id)

        threshold = TAX_REGIME_THRESHOLDS.get(regime_enum)
        if threshold is None or threshold == 0:
            return await self.get_tax_regime(company_id)

        ca_exceeds = ca_annual_ttc > threshold

        suggested = company.suggested_tax_regime
        if ca_exceeds:
            suggested = self._next_regime(regime_enum)
            company.suggested_tax_regime = suggested

        await self.session.flush()
        return await self.get_tax_regime(company_id)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    @staticmethod
    def _next_regime(current: TaxRegime) -> TaxRegime:
        order = [TaxRegime.TEE, TaxRegime.RME, TaxRegime.RSI, TaxRegime.RNI]
        try:
            idx = order.index(current)
        except ValueError:
            return current
        if idx + 1 < len(order):
            return order[idx + 1]
        return current

    @staticmethod
    def is_tva_blocked(tax_regime: str | TaxRegime | None) -> bool:
        if tax_regime is None:
            return False
        if isinstance(tax_regime, TaxRegime):
            return tax_regime in (TaxRegime.TEE, TaxRegime.RME)
        try:
            return TaxRegime(tax_regime) in (TaxRegime.TEE, TaxRegime.RME)
        except ValueError:
            return False


__all__ = ["TaxRegimeService"]
````

## File: backend/app/modules/accounting/services/journal_service.py
````python
"""
Service Écritures comptables (Grand Livre).

Responsabilités :
- création d'une écriture équilibrée (débit == crédit)
- contrôle du solde avant publication
- numérotation des écritures (via SequenceService)
- agrégation des mouvements par compte (pour balances)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.accounting.models.invoice_allocation import InvoiceAllocation
from app.modules.accounting.models.journal_entry import (
    JournalEntry,
    JournalEntryLine,
)
from app.modules.accounting.schemas import JournalEntryCreate
from app.modules.accounting.services.account_service import AccountService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

BALANCE_EPSILON = Decimal("0.001")


class LedgerService:
    """Grand-livre : écritures comptables."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)
        self.accounts = AccountService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Création / publication
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_entry(
        self, company_id: int, data: JournalEntryCreate, *, post: bool = True
    ) -> JournalEntry:
        """Crée une écriture. Lève ``ValueError`` si non équilibrée."""
        total_debit = sum(Decimal(str(l.debit)) for l in data.lines)
        total_credit = sum(Decimal(str(l.credit)) for l in data.lines)
        if total_debit != total_credit:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Écriture non équilibrée : débit {total_debit} ≠ crédit {total_credit}"
            )
        if total_debit <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Écriture vide (aucun montant).")
        if not all(Decimal(str(l.debit)) * Decimal(str(l.credit)) == 0 for l in data.lines):
            raise ValueError("Une ligne ne peut pas être à la fois débit et crédit.")

        # Comptes existants
        accounts = {a.code: a for a in await self.accounts.list_accounts(
            company_id, active_only=False, limit=2000
        )}
        for line in data.lines:
            if line.account_code not in accounts:
                raise ValueError(f"Compte inconnu : {line.account_code}")

        reference = await self.sequences.next_value(
            "journal_entry", "EC", company_id=company_id
        )

        entry = JournalEntry(
            reference=reference,
            entry_date=data.entry_date,
            journal_code=data.journal_code,
            source_type=data.source_type,
            source_id=data.source_id,
            description=data.description,
            total_debit=total_debit,
            total_credit=total_credit,
            status="draft",
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        for i, l in enumerate(data.lines):
            entry.lines.append(
                JournalEntryLine(
                    account_code=l.account_code,
                    label=l.label,
                    debit=l.debit,
                    credit=l.credit,
                    partner_id=l.partner_id,
                    position=i,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )
        self.session.add(entry)
        await self.session.flush()

        if post:
            await self.post_entry(entry.id, company_id)
        return entry

    async def post_entry(self, entry_id: int, company_id: int) -> JournalEntry:
        """Valide et publie une écriture (draft → posted)."""
        entry = await self.get_entry(entry_id, company_id)
        if entry is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Écriture {entry_id} introuvable")
        if entry.status == "posted":
            return entry
        total_debit = sum(Decimal(str(l.debit)) for l in entry.lines)
        total_credit = sum(Decimal(str(l.credit)) for l in entry.lines)
        if abs(total_debit - total_credit) > BALANCE_EPSILON:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Écriture {entry.reference} non équilibrée : "
                f"{total_debit} ≠ {total_credit}"
            )
        entry.status = "posted"
        await self.session.flush()
        return entry

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def get_entry(
        self, entry_id: int, company_id: int
    ) -> JournalEntry | None:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(JournalEntry)
            .options(selectinload(JournalEntry.lines))
            .where(
                JournalEntry.id == entry_id,
                JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
            )
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def list_entries(
        self, company_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100,
        account_code: str | None = None,
        date_from: date | None = None,
        date_to: date | None = None,
        journal_code: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[JournalEntry]:
        stmt = (
            select(JournalEntry)
            .options(selectinload(JournalEntry.lines))
            .where(JournalEntry.company_id == company_id)
            .order_by(JournalEntry.entry_date.desc(), JournalEntry.id.desc())
            .offset(skip)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        if account_code:
            stmt = stmt.join(JournalEntryLine).where(
                JournalEntryLine.account_code == account_code
            )
        if date_from:
            stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date >= date_from)
        if date_to:
            stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date <= date_to)
        if journal_code:
            stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.journal_code == journal_code)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().unique().all())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Agrégats
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def account_balances(
        self, company_id: int, account_code: str | None = None,
        date_from: date | None = None, date_to: date | None = None,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Soldes par compte (débit, crédit, solde) sur les écritures publiées."""
        stmt = (
            select(
                JournalEntryLine.account_code,
                func.coalesce(func.sum(JournalEntryLine.debit), 0),
                func.coalesce(func.sum(JournalEntryLine.credit), 0),
            )
            .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntry.id == JournalEntryLine.entry_id)
            .where(
                JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                JournalEntry.status == "posted",
            )
            .group_by(JournalEntryLine.account_code)
            .order_by(JournalEntryLine.account_code)
        )
        if account_code:
            stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntryLine.account_code == account_code)
        if date_from:
            stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date >= date_from)
        if date_to:
            stmt = stmt.where(JournalEntry.entry_date <= date_to)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        rows = []
        for code, debit, credit in result.all():
            debit = Decimal(str(debit))
            credit = Decimal(str(credit))
            rows.append(
                {
                    "account_code": code,
                    "debit": float(debit),
                    "credit": float(credit),
                    "balance": float(debit - credit),
                }
            )
        return rows

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Grand livre — mouvements d'un compte avec solde cumulé
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def account_movements(
        self, company_id: int, account_code: str,
        date_from: date | None = None, date_to: date | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[list[dict], float, float, float, float]:
        """Mouvements chronologiques d'un compte + soldes (ouv., clôt.) débit/crédit.

        Retourne ``(movements, opening_balance, closing_balance, total)`` où
        ``opening_balance`` = solde cumulé avant ``date_from`` (ou 0).
        """
        stmt = (
            select(
                JournalEntryLine.entry_id,
                JournalEntry.reference,
                JournalEntry.entry_date,
                JournalEntry.journal_code,
                JournalEntryLine.label,
                JournalEntryLine.debit,
                JournalEntryLine.credit,
                JournalEntryLine.position,
            )
            .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntry.id == JournalEntryLine.entry_id)
            .where(
                JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                JournalEntry.status == "posted",
                JournalEntryLine.account_code == account_code,
            )
            .order_by(JournalEntry.entry_date, JournalEntry.id, JournalEntryLine.position)
        )
        rows = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).all()

        # Solde d'ouverture (mouvements avant la période)
        opening = 0.0
        if date_from:
            opening_stmt = (
                select(
                    func.coalesce(func.sum(JournalEntryLine.debit), 0)
                    - func.coalesce(func.sum(JournalEntryLine.credit), 0)
                )
                .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntry.id == JournalEntryLine.entry_id)
                .where(
                    JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                    JournalEntry.status == "posted",
                    JournalEntryLine.account_code == account_code,
                    JournalEntry.entry_date < date_from,
                )
            )
            opening = float((await self.session.execute(opening_stmt)).scalar() or 0)

        movements = []
        running = opening
        for entry_id, reference, entry_date, journal_code, label, debit, credit, pos in rows:
            running += float(debit) - float(credit)
            movements.append(
                {
                    "entry_id": entry_id,
                    "reference": reference,
                    "entry_date": entry_date,
                    "journal_code": journal_code,
                    "label": label,
                    "debit": float(debit),
                    "credit": float(credit),
                    "balance": round(running, 2),
                }
            )
        total_debit = sum(m["debit"] for m in movements)
        total_credit = sum(m["credit"] for m in movements)
        closing = opening + total_debit - total_credit
        return movements, opening, closing, total_debit, total_credit


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lettrage tiers — rapprochement paiement ↔ facture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def allocate_payment(
        self,
        company_id: int,
        invoice_id: int,
        payment_id: int,
        allocated_amount: float,
        allocation_date: date,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> InvoiceAllocation:
        """Alloue un paiement à une facture (lettrage tiers).

        Vérifie que le montant alloué ne dépasse ni le solde restant de la
        facture, ni le solde disponible du paiement. L'écriture comptable
        sous-jacente (D 511 / C 411 ou D 401 / C 511) a déjà été créée lors
        de la comptabilisation du paiement ; ce lettrage est un marquage
        analytique qui lie les deux documents.
        """
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
        from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

        invoice = await self.session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)
        if invoice is None or invoice.company_id != company_id:
            raise ValueError(f"Facture {invoice_id} introuvable pour cette entreprise")

        payment = await self.session.get(Payment, payment_id)
        if payment is None or payment.company_id != company_id:
            raise ValueError(f"Paiement {payment_id} introuvable pour cette entreprise")

        # Solde restant de la facture (montant total - déjà alloué)
        existing_alloc = await self.session.execute(
            select(func.coalesce(func.sum(InvoiceAllocation.allocated_amount), 0)).where(
                InvoiceAllocation.invoice_id == invoice_id
            )
        )
        allocated_so_far = float(existing_alloc.scalar() or 0)
        invoice_remaining = float(invoice.amount_total) - allocated_so_far

        # Solde disponible du paiement (montant - déjà alloué sur ce paiement)
        existing_pay_alloc = await self.session.execute(
            select(func.coalesce(func.sum(InvoiceAllocation.allocated_amount), 0)).where(
                InvoiceAllocation.payment_id == payment_id
            )
        )
        payment_allocated = float(existing_pay_alloc.scalar() or 0)
        payment_remaining = float(payment.amount) - payment_allocated

        if allocated_amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Le montant alloué doit être positif")
        if allocated_amount > invoice_remaining:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Montant alloué {allocated_amount} dépasse le solde restant de la facture ({invoice_remaining})"
            )
        if allocated_amount > payment_remaining:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Montant alloué {allocated_amount} dépasse le solde disponible du paiement ({payment_remaining})"
            )

        allocation = InvoiceAllocation(
            invoice_id=invoice_id,
            payment_id=payment_id,
            allocated_amount=allocated_amount,
            allocation_date=allocation_date,
            notes=notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(allocation)
        await self.session.flush()
        return allocation

    async def get_allocations_for_invoice(
        self, company_id: int, invoice_id: int
    ) -> list[InvoiceAllocation]:
        """Retourne tous les lettrages d'une facture."""
        stmt = select(InvoiceAllocation).where(
            InvoiceAllocation.company_id == company_id,
            InvoiceAllocation.invoice_id == invoice_id,
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_allocations_for_payment(
        self, company_id: int, payment_id: int
    ) -> list[InvoiceAllocation]:
        """Retourne tous les lettrages d'un paiement."""
        stmt = select(InvoiceAllocation).where(
            InvoiceAllocation.company_id == company_id,
            InvoiceAllocation.payment_id == payment_id,
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())


__all__ = ["LedgerService"]
````

````python
"""
Service OHADA — configuration par pays et gestion de l'exercice comptable.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.accounting.models.ohada import OHADAParameter
from app.modules.accounting.models.fiscal_year import FiscalYear
from app.modules.accounting.models.exchange_rate import ExchangeRate
from app.modules.accounting.schemas.ohada import (
    OHADAParameterCreate,
    OHADAParameterUpdate,
    FiscalYearCreate,
    FiscalYearUpdate,
    ExchangeRateCreate,
    OHADACheckConstraint,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class OHADAService:
    """
    Service métier OHADA.

    Activités:
    - Gestion des paramètres OHADA par pays (création, modification, récupération)
    - Gestion des exercices comptables (création, ouverture, clôture)
    - Gestion des taux de change
    - Vérification des contraintes d'OHADA
    """

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Paramètres OHADA
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    async def get_company_ohada_params(self, company_id: int) -> list[OHADAParameter]:
        """Retourne tous les paramètres OHADA d'une entreprise."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(OHADAParameter).where(OHADAParameter.company_id == company_id)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_country_default(
        self, company_id: int, country_code: str
    ) -> Optional[OHADAParameter]:
        """Retourne le paramètre OHADA pour un pays donné, s'il existe."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(OHADAParameter)
            .where(
                OHADAParameter.company_id == company_id,
                OHADAParameter.country_code == country_code,
            )
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def create_ohada_param(
        self, data: OHADAParameterCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> OHADAParameter:
        """Crée un paramètre OHADA."""
        param = OHADAParameter(company_id=company_id, **data.model_dump())
        self.session.add(param)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(param)
        return param

    async def update_ohada_param(
        self, company_id: int, parameter_id: int, data: OHADAParameterUpdate
    ) -> OHADAParameter:
        """Met à jour un paramètre OHADA."""
        param = await self._get_ohada_param(company_id, parameter_id)
        update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        for key, value in update_data.items():
            setattr(param, key, value)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(param)
        return param

    async def list_ohada_params(self, company_id: int) -> list[OHADAParameter]:
        """Retourne la liste des paramètres OHADA d'une entreprise."""
        return await self.get_company_ohada_params(company_id)

    async def upsert_ohada_param(
        self, data: OHADAParameterCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> OHADAParameter:
        """Insère ou met à jour un paramètre OHADA selon pays."""
        existing = await self.get_country_default(company_id, data.country_code)
        if existing:
            update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
            for key, value in update_data.items():
                setattr(existing, key, value)
            await self.session.commit()
            await self.session.refresh(existing)
            return existing
        return await self.create_ohada_param(data, company_id)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Exercices comptables
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    async def get_fiscal_year(self, company_id: int) -> Optional[FiscalYear]:
        """Retourne l'exercice comptable ouvert le plus récent d'une entreprise."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(FiscalYear)
            .where(
                FiscalYear.company_id == company_id,
                FiscalYear.status == "open",
            )
            .order_by(FiscalYear.start_date.desc())
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def list_fiscal_years(
        self, company_id: int, status: Optional[str] = None
    ) -> list[FiscalYear]:
        """Retourne les exercices comptables d'une entreprise (optionnellement filtrés)."""
        stmt = select(FiscalYear).where(FiscalYear.company_id == company_id)
        if status:
            stmt = stmt.where(FiscalYear.status == status)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def create_fiscal_year(
        self, data: FiscalYearCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> FiscalYear:
        """Crée un nouvel exercice comptable."""
        year = FiscalYear(
            company_id=company_id,
            status="open",
            **data.model_dump(),
        )
        self.session.add(year)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(year)
        return year

    async def update_fiscal_year(
        self, company_id: int, year_id: int, data: FiscalYearUpdate
    ) -> FiscalYear:
        """Met à jour un exercice comptable."""
        year = await self._get_fiscal_year(company_id, year_id)
        update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        for key, value in update_data.items():
            setattr(year, key, value)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(year)
        return year

    async def close_fiscal_year(self, company_id: int, year_id: int) -> FiscalYear:
        """Clôture un exercice comptable s'il est ouvert."""
        year = await self._get_fiscal_year(company_id, year_id)
        if year.status != "open":
            raise ValueError(
                f"L'exercice {year_id} est déjà {'fermé' if year.status == 'closed' else 'dans un état non gérable'}"
            )
        year.status = "closed"
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(year)
        return year

    async def is_fiscal_year_closed(self, company_id: int, year_id: int) -> bool:
        """Vérifie si un exercice comptable est clôturé."""
        year = await self._get_fiscal_year(company_id, year_id)
        return year.status == "closed"
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Taux de change
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    async def get_exchange_rate(
        self, company_id: int, base: str, quote: str
    ) -> Optional[ExchangeRate]:
        """Retourne un taux de change spécifique."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(ExchangeRate)
            .where(
                ExchangeRate.company_id == company_id,
                ExchangeRate.base_currency == base,
                ExchangeRate.quote_currency == quote,
            )
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def upsert_exchange_rate(
        self, data: ExchangeRateCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> ExchangeRate:
        """Insère ou met à jour un taux de change."""
        existing = await self.get_exchange_rate(
            company_id, data.base_currency, data.quote_currency
        )
        if existing:
            existing.rate = data.rate
            await self.session.commit()
            await self.session.refresh(existing)
            return existing
        rate = ExchangeRate(
            company_id=company_id,
            **data.model_dump(),
        )
        self.session.add(rate)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(rate)
        return rate
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Vérification de contraintes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    async def check_constraints(self, company_id: int) -> OHADACheckConstraint:
        """Vérifie les contraintes d'OHADA pour une entreprise."""
        params = await self.get_company_ohada_params(company_id)
        has_params = len(params) > 0
        has_active_param = any(p.is_active for p in params)

        open_years = [
            y for y in await self.list_fiscal_years(company_id) if y.status == "open"
        ]
        has_open_year = len(open_years) > 0
        only_one_open_year = len(open_years) <= 1

        can_open = has_active_param and has_open_year and only_one_open_year
        can_close = has_open_year

        message = ""
        if not has_params:
            message = "Aucun paramètre OHADA configuré."
        elif not has_active_param:
            message = "Aucun paramètre OHADA actif."
        elif not has_open_year:
            message = "Aucun exercice comptable ouvert."
        elif not only_one_open_year:
            message = "Plusieurs exercices comptables ouverts."

        return OHADACheckConstraint(can_open=can_open, message=message)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Méthodes privées
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    async def _get_ohada_param(self, company_id: int, param_id: int) -> OHADAParameter:
        """Récupère un paramètre OHADA (vérification de l'appartenance à l'entreprise)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(OHADAParameter)
            .where(
                OHADAParameter.company_id == company_id,
                OHADAParameter.id == param_id,
            )
        )
        param = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if param is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Paramètre OHADA {param_id} introuvable pour cette entreprise.")
        return param

    async def _get_fiscal_year(self, company_id: int, year_id: int) -> FiscalYear:
        """Récupère un exercice comptable (vérification de l'appartenance à l'entreprise)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(FiscalYear)
            .where(
                FiscalYear.company_id == company_id,
                FiscalYear.id == year_id,
            )
        )
        year = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if year is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Exercice comptable {year_id} introuvable pour cette entreprise.")
        return year

    async def list_exchange_rates(self, company_id: int) -> list[ExchangeRate]:
        """Retourne tous les taux de change de l entreprise."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(ExchangeRate).where(ExchangeRate.company_id == company_id)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())
````
