````python
"""
Modèles Client / Fournisseur (Partner), Contacts et Adresses.

Un ``Partner`` peut être :
- un client (particulier, entreprise, professionnel)
- un fournisseur
- les deux (client ET fournisseur)

Le CRM gère les chantiers (Sites) attachés aux clients.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import JSON, Boolean, Date, Float, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String, UniqueConstraint
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.shared.enums import AddressType, EntityType, Gender
from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import ProductCategory


class Partner(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Partenaire commercial : client ou fournisseur.

    - ``role`` : client, supplier, ou les deux (both)
    - ``entity_type`` : individual / company / professional
    - ``credit_limit`` : limite de crédit
    """

    name: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(200), nullable=False, index=True)
    code: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(30), index=True)
    role: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), default="client")

    entity_type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default=EntityType.INDIVIDUAL.value)
    gender: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), default=Gender.UNSET.value)

    phone: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(50))
    email: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(200))
    website: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(200))

    # Informations fiscales
    tax_number: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(50))
    registration_number: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(50))

    # Conditions commerciales
    credit_limit: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))
    payment_terms_days: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer)
    price_list_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer)
    default_discount: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(6, 2))

    # Fournisseurs — évaluation (1-5) et délai d'approvisionnement moyen
    rating: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(3, 2))
    delivery_days: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer)

    # Statut
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=True)

    # Relations
    contacts: Mapped[list["Contact"]] = relationship(
        "Contact", back_populates="partner",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    addresses: Mapped[list["PartnerAddress"]] = relationship(
        "PartnerAddress", back_populates="partner",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    sites: Mapped[list["Site"]] = relationship(
        "Site", back_populates="partner",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    # Classification fournisseur : catégories de produits approvisionnées
    category_links: Mapped[list["PartnerCategory"]] = relationship(
        "PartnerCategory", back_populates="partner",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Partner {self.name} [{self.role}]>"


class Contact(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Contact d'un partenaire (nom, téléphone, email, fonction)."""

    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False
    )
    first_name: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(100), nullable=False)
    last_name: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(100), nullable=False)
    phone: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(50))
    email: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(200))
    job_title: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(100))
    is_primary: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False)

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner", back_populates="contacts")

    @property
    def full_name(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.first_name} {self.last_name}".strip()

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Contact {self.full_name}>"


class PartnerAddress(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Adresse d'un partenaire.

    - ``address_type`` : billing (facturation), delivery (livraison), site (chantier)
    """

    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False
    )
    address_type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default=AddressType.BILLING.value)
    label: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(100))

    line_1: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(200))
    line_2: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(200))
    city: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(100))
    state: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(100))
    postal_code: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(20))

    latitude: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Float)
    longitude: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Float)
    is_primary: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False)

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner", back_populates="addresses")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PartnerAddress {self.address_type} - {self.city}>"


class PartnerCategory(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Classification fournisseur <-> catégories de produits.

    Un fournisseur est rattaché aux catégories de produits qu'il
    approvisionne — base du suggesteur de fournisseurs par produit (BC).
    """

    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    category_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("product_categories.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner", back_populates="category_links")
    category: Mapped["ProductCategory"] = relationship(ProductCategory, lazy="selectin")

    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint(
            "partner_id", "category_id", name="uq_partner_category"
        ),
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PartnerCategory partner={self.partner_id} cat={self.category_id}>"
````

````python
"""Service CRM — logique métier des partenaires et chantiers."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner, Contact, PartnerAddress
from app.modules.crm.models.site import Site
from app.modules.crm.schemas import PartnerCreate, PartnerUpdate, SiteCreate

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class CrmService:
    """Service du module CRM."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Partenaires
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_partner(
        self, data: PartnerCreate, company_id: int | None = None
    ) -> Partner:
        partner = Partner()
        for field in ("name", "code", "role", "entity_type", "gender",
                      "phone", "email", "website", "tax_number",
                      "registration_number", "credit_limit",
                      "payment_terms_days", "default_discount"):
            if getattr(data, field, None) is not None:
                setattr(partner, field, getattr(data, field))

        # Héritage du tenant multi-entreprise
        if company_id:
            partner.company_id = company_id
            for contact_data in data.contacts:
                contact = Contact(**contact_data.model_dump())
                contact.company_id = company_id
                partner.contacts.append(contact)
            for addr_data in data.addresses:
                addr = PartnerAddress(**addr_data.model_dump())
                addr.company_id = company_id
                partner.addresses.append(addr)
        else:
            for contact_data in data.contacts:
                partner.contacts.append(Contact(**contact_data.model_dump()))
            for addr_data in data.addresses:
                partner.addresses.append(PartnerAddress(**addr_data.model_dump()))

        self.session.add(partner)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(partner)
        return partner

    async def get_partner(self, partner_id: int) -> Partner | None:
        return await self.session.get(Partner, partner_id)

    async def list_partners(
        self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, role: str | None = None,
        search: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[Partner]:
        stmt = select(Partner).offset(skip).limit(limit).order_by(Partner.id)
        if role:
            stmt = stmt.where(Partner.role == role)
        if search:
            like = f"%{search}%"
            stmt = stmt.where(
                (Partner.name.ilike(like))
                | (Partner.phone.ilike(like))
                | (Partner.email.ilike(like))
            )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def update_partner(self, partner_id: int, data: PartnerUpdate) -> Partner | None:
        partner = await self.session.get(Partner, partner_id)
        if partner is None:
            return None
        for field, value in data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
            if value is not None:
                setattr(partner, field, value)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(partner)
        return partner

    async def delete_partner(self, partner_id: int) -> bool:
        partner = await self.session.get(Partner, partner_id)
        if partner is None:
            return False
        await self.session.delete(partner)
        await self.session.commit()
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Chantiers (sites)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_site(self, partner_id: int, data: SiteCreate) -> Site:
        site = Site(**data.model_dump(), partner_id=partner_id)
        self.session.add(site)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(site)
        return site

    async def list_sites(self, partner_id: int | None = None) -> list[Site]:
        stmt = select(Site).order_by(Site.id)
        if partner_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(Site.partner_id == partner_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_site(self, site_id: int) -> Site | None:
        return await self.session.get(Site, site_id)

    async def delete_site(self, site_id: int) -> bool:
        site = await self.session.get(Site, site_id)
        if site is None:
            return False
        await self.session.delete(site)
        await self.session.commit()
        return True
````

## File: backend/app/modules/crm/services/export_service.py
````python
"""Export en masse des partenaires (clients / fournisseurs).

Miroir de ``CrmImportService`` : les colonnes produites sont exactement
celles que l'import attend, ce qui rend le fichier exporté réimportable
tel quel (aller‑retour « export → transfert → import »).

- ``role`` : ``client`` / ``fournisseur`` / ``both`` (valeurs lisibles,
  reconnues par ``_ROLE_MAP``) ;
- ``type_entite`` : ``particulier`` / ``entreprise`` / ``professionnel`` ;
- ``adresse`` / ``ville`` : adresse principale du partenaire.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner

PARTNER_HEADERS = [
    "nom",
    "code",
    "role",
    "type_entite",
    "telephone",
    "email",
    "site_web",
    "numero_fiscal",
    "numero_registre",
    "limite_credit",
    "delai_paiement",
    "adresse",
    "ville",
]

# Valeur stockée (modèle) → valeur écrite dans le fichier (importable)
_ROLE_LABELS = {"client": "client", "supplier": "fournisseur", "both": "both"}
_ENTITY_LABELS = {
    "individual": "particulier",
    "company": "entreprise",
    "professional": "professionnel",
}


def _primary_address(partner: Partner):
    addresses = partner.addresses or []
    if not addresses:
        return None
    return next((a for a in addresses if a.is_primary), addresses[0])


class CrmExportService:
    """Export des partenaires vers un tableau (en‑têtes + lignes)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    async def partners(
        self, include_rows: bool = True, role: str | None = None
    ) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[Any]]]:
        stmt = select(Partner).order_by(Partner.id)
        if role:
            # Reprend le filtre de l'écran (onglets Clients / Fournisseurs)
            stmt = stmt.where(Partner.role == role)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        partners = list(result.scalars().all())
        if not include_rows:
            return PARTNER_HEADERS, []
        return PARTNER_HEADERS, [self._row(p) for p in partners]

    @staticmethod
    def _row(partner: Partner) -> list[Any]:
        address = _primary_address(partner)
        return [
            partner.name,
            partner.code,
            _ROLE_LABELS.get(partner.role, partner.role),
            _ENTITY_LABELS.get(partner.entity_type, partner.entity_type),
            partner.phone,
            partner.email,
            partner.website,
            partner.tax_number,
            partner.registration_number,
            float(partner.credit_limit) if partner.credit_limit is not None else None,
            partner.payment_terms_days,
            address.line_1 if address else None,
            address.city if address else None,
        ]
````

## File: backend/app/modules/crm/services/import_service.py
````python
"""Import en masse des partenaires (clients / fournisseurs).

Colonnes attendues (en-têtes normalisés) ::
    nom (obligatoire), code, role (client|fournisseur|both),
    type_entite (particulier|entreprise|professionnel), telephone, email,
    site_web, numero_fiscal (ncc), numero_registre (rccm),
    limite_credit, delai_paiement (jours), adresse, ville

Comportement : upsert par nom (insensible à la casse) — si le partenaire
existe, ses coordonnées sont mises à jour ; sinon il est créé.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Contact, Partner, PartnerAddress
from app.shared.enums import EntityType
from app.shared.file_import import clean_str, to_float, to_int

_ROLE_MAP = {
    "client": "client",
    "customers": "client",
    "customer": "client",
    "fournisseur": "supplier",
    "supplier": "supplier",
    "vendors": "supplier",
    "vendor": "supplier",
    "both": "both",
    "les_deux": "both",
    "client_fournisseur": "both",
}

_ENTITY_MAP = {
    "particulier": EntityType.INDIVIDUAL.value,
    "individual": EntityType.INDIVIDUAL.value,
    "entreprise": EntityType.COMPANY.value,
    "company": EntityType.COMPANY.value,
    "professionnel": EntityType.PROFESSIONAL.value,
    "professional": EntityType.PROFESSIONAL.value,
}


def _map_row(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    mapped: dict[str, Any] = {"__line__": row.get("__line__")}
    direct = {
        "nom": "name", "name": "name", "raison_sociale": "name",
        "code": "code", "role": "role", "type": "entity_type",
        "type_entite": "entity_type", "entity_type": "entity_type",
        "telephone": "phone", "tel": "phone", "phone": "phone",
        "mobile": "phone", "email": "email", "mail": "email",
        "site_web": "website", "website": "website", "web": "website",
        "numero_fiscal": "tax_number", "ncc": "tax_number",
        "tax_number": "tax_number", "numero_registre": "registration_number",
        "rccm": "registration_number", "registration_number": "registration_number",
        "limite_credit": "credit_limit", "credit_limit": "credit_limit",
        "delai_paiement": "payment_terms_days",
        "payment_terms_days": "payment_terms_days",
        "adresse": "address", "address": "address",
        "ville": "city", "city": "city",
        "contact_nom": "contact_name", "contact_prenom": "contact_first_name",
        "contact_tel": "contact_phone",
    }
    for key, value in row.items():
        if key.startswith("__"):
            continue
        field = direct.get(key)
        if field and field not in mapped:
            mapped[field] = value
    return mapped


class CrmImportService:
    """Import des partenaires depuis un fichier Excel / CSV."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession, company_id: int | None = None):
        self.session = session
        self.company_id = company_id

    async def import_partners(self, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        created, updated, errors = 0, 0, []

        for row in rows:
            data = _map_row(row)
            line_no = data.get("__line__")
            try:
                name = clean_str(data.get("name"), 200)
                if not name:
                    raise ValueError("Colonne « nom » obligatoire")

                role_raw = (clean_str(data.get("role"), 20) or "").lower()
                role = _ROLE_MAP.get(role_raw, "client")
                entity_raw = (clean_str(data.get("entity_type"), 20) or "").lower()
                entity_type = _ENTITY_MAP.get(entity_raw, EntityType.INDIVIDUAL.value)

                stmt = select(Partner).where(Partner.name.ilike(name))
                if self.company_id:
                    stmt = stmt.where(Partner.company_id == self.company_id)
                partner = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().first()

                if partner is None:
                    partner = Partner(company_id=self.company_id)
                    self.session.add(partner)
                    created += 1
                else:
                    updated += 1

                partner.name = name
                if self.company_id:
                    partner.company_id = self.company_id
                partner.code = clean_str(data.get("code"), 30)
                partner.role = role
                partner.entity_type = entity_type
                partner.phone = clean_str(data.get("phone"), 50)
                partner.email = clean_str(data.get("email"), 200)
                partner.website = clean_str(data.get("website"), 200)
                partner.tax_number = clean_str(data.get("tax_number"), 50)
                partner.registration_number = clean_str(
                    data.get("registration_number"), 50
                )
                partner.credit_limit = to_float(data.get("credit_limit"))
                partner.payment_terms_days = to_int(data.get("payment_terms_days"))

                address = clean_str(data.get("address"), 200)
                city = clean_str(data.get("city"), 100)
                if (address or city) and not partner.addresses:
                    partner.addresses.append(PartnerAddress(
                        address_type="billing", line_1=address, city=city,
                        is_primary=True, company_id=self.company_id,
                    ))
                elif partner.addresses:
                    if address:
                        partner.addresses[0].line_1 = address
                    if city:
                        partner.addresses[0].city = city

                contact_first = clean_str(data.get("contact_first_name"), 100)
                contact_last = clean_str(data.get("contact_name"), 100)
                if contact_last and not partner.contacts:
                    partner.contacts.append(Contact(
                        first_name=contact_first or "—",
                        last_name=contact_last,
                        phone=clean_str(data.get("contact_phone"), 50),
                        is_primary=True, company_id=self.company_id,
                    ))

                await self.session.flush()
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — ligne isolée
                await self.session.rollback()
                errors.append({"line": line_no, "error": str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__})

        if created or updated:
            await self.session.commit()
        return {
            "created": created,
            "updated": updated,
            "errors": errors,
            "total": created + updated + len(errors),
        }
````

````python
    template: bool = False,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "view")),
):
    """Export Excel / CSV des bons de livraison — une ligne par article.

    ``format`` : ``xlsx`` (défaut) ou ``csv`` ; ``template=1`` : en‑têtes seuls.
    """
    headers, rows = await DeliveryExportService(session).deliveries(
        include_rows=not template
    )
    return export_response(format, "Livraisons", headers, rows)


@router.get("/notes/{delivery_id}", response_model=DeliveryRead)
async def get_delivery(
    delivery_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "view")),
):
    service = DeliveryService(session)
    delivery = await service.get_delivery(delivery_id)
    if delivery is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bon de livraison introuvable")
    return delivery


@router.post(
    "/notes/from-order",
    response_model=DeliveryRead,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
async def create_delivery_from_order(
    body: DeliveryFromOrder,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "create")),
):
    service = DeliveryService(session)
    try:
        return await service.create_from_order(
            body.order_id, expected_date=body.expected_date, notes=body.notes
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/notes/{delivery_id}/status", response_model=DeliveryRead)
async def update_delivery_status(
    delivery_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    status_update: dict,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "edit")),
):
    service = DeliveryService(session)
    try:
        delivery = await service.update_status(
            delivery_id, status_update.get("status", "")
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    if delivery is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bon de livraison introuvable")
    return delivery


@router.post("/notes/{delivery_id}/back-to-draft", response_model=DeliveryRead)
async def back_to_draft_delivery(
    delivery_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "edit")),
):
    """Remet un bon de livraison au brouillon (préalable à la suppression)."""
    service = DeliveryService(session)
    if await service.get_delivery(delivery_id) is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bon de livraison introuvable")
    try:
        return await service.back_to_draft(delivery_id, user_id=user.id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.delete("/notes/{delivery_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_delivery(
    delivery_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "delete")),
):
    """Supprime un BL — brouillon uniquement, paiements déjà supprimés."""
    service = DeliveryService(session)
    if await service.get_delivery(delivery_id) is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bon de livraison introuvable")
    try:
        await service.delete_delivery(delivery_id, user_id=user.id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/notes/{delivery_id}/print")
async def print_delivery(
    delivery_id: int,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("delivery", "view")),
):
    """Bon de livraison — format A4 (compatible matricielle)."""
    import io

    from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

    from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder
    from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine
    from app.core.documents.naming import content_disposition

    try:
        context = await ContextBuilder().load_delivery(delivery_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Bon de livraison introuvable")
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    path = await engine.arender_delivery(delivery_id)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    return StreamingResponse(
        io.BytesIO(data),
        media_type="application/pdf",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": content_disposition(
                context.get("doc_filename") or "document.pdf"
            )
        },
    )
````

````python
"""
Modèles Livraison — DeliveryNote / DeliveryLine / DeliveryLineCut.

Un bon de livraison est généré depuis une commande confirmée. Il présente
la commande de référence et les quantités à livrer, avec les listes de
longueurs à découper (coupes BAC) pour la préparation.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Date,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.shared.enums import DeliveryStatus


class DeliveryNote(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Bon de livraison attaché à une commande client."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    order_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("sales_orders.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )

    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=DeliveryStatus.PENDING.value, index=True
    )
    delivery_date: Mapped[date | None] = MappedColumn(Date)
    expected_date: Mapped[date | None] = MappedColumn(Date)

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(2000))
    shipping_address: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))

    lines: Mapped[list["DeliveryLine"]] = relationship(
        "DeliveryLine", back_populates="delivery",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner")
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship("Company")
    order: Mapped["SalesOrder"] = relationship("SalesOrder")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<DeliveryNote {self.reference} [{self.status}]>"


class DeliveryLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne de bon de livraison — quantité commandée vs livrée."""

    delivery_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("delivery_notes.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=True)
    # Variante du produit (optionnelle) — ``variant_name`` est un instantané
    # du libellé (réimpression fidèle des documents).
    variant_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("product_variants.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )
    variant_name: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(300))

    description: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_ordered: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    unit: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(20))

    sell_by_length: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False)
    total_length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    delivery: Mapped["DeliveryNote"] = relationship("DeliveryNote", back_populates="lines")
    product: Mapped["Product"] = relationship("Product", lazy="selectin")
    variant: Mapped["ProductVariant | None"] = relationship(
        "ProductVariant", lazy="selectin"
    )
    cuts: Mapped[list["DeliveryLineCut"]] = relationship(
        "DeliveryLineCut", back_populates="line",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )


class DeliveryLineCut(Base):
    """Sous-ligne de coupe BAC d'un bon de livraison."""

    __tablename__ = "delivery_line_cuts"

    id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    line_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("delivery_lines.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(12, 4), nullable=False)

    line: Mapped["DeliveryLine"] = relationship("DeliveryLine", back_populates="cuts")
````

## File: backend/app/modules/delivery/services/delivery_service.py
````python
"""Service Livraison — bons de livraison depuis les commandes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.delivery.models.delivery import (
    DeliveryLine,
    DeliveryLineCut,
    DeliveryNote,
)
from app.shared.enums import DeliveryStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class DeliveryService:
    """Service des bons de livraison."""

    #: Transitions autorisées entre statuts (un bon complété n'est plus modifiable).
    _NEXT_STATUS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
        DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value: (
            DeliveryStatus.PENDING.value,
            DeliveryStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
            DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED.value,
        ),
        DeliveryStatus.PENDING.value: (
            DeliveryStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
            DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED.value,
            DeliveryStatus.COMPLETED.value,
            DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED.value,
        ),
        DeliveryStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value: (
            DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED.value,
            DeliveryStatus.COMPLETED.value,
            DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED.value,
        ),
        DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED.value: (
            DeliveryStatus.COMPLETED.value,
        ),
        DeliveryStatus.COMPLETED.value: (),
        DeliveryStatus.CANCELLED.value: (),
    }

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    async def get_delivery(self, delivery_id: int) -> DeliveryNote | None:
        return await self.session.get(DeliveryNote, delivery_id)

    async def list_deliveries(
        self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, order_id: int | None = None
    ) -> list[DeliveryNote]:
        """Bons de livraison (plus récents d'abord), filtrables par commande."""
        stmt = select(DeliveryNote)
        if order_id is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(DeliveryNote.order_id == order_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            stmt.options(
                selectinload(DeliveryNote.lines).selectinload(DeliveryLine.cuts),
            )
            .order_by(DeliveryNote.id.desc())
            .offset(skip)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def update_status(self, delivery_id: int, status: str) -> DeliveryNote | None:
        """Fait avancer un bon de livraison selon les transitions autorisées.

        ``pending → in_progress → delivered → completed`` (ou ``cancelled``
        avant complétion).  La date de livraison est horodatée dès la
        livraison (ou à la complétion si livrée directement).
        Lève ``ValueError`` si la transition demandée est interdite.
        """
        delivery = await self.session.get(DeliveryNote, delivery_id)
        if delivery is None:
            return None
        current = delivery.status or DeliveryStatus.PENDING.value
        if status == current:
            return delivery
        allowed = self._NEXT_STATUS.get(current, ())
        if status not in allowed:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Transition « {current} » → « {status} » impossible "
                f"(statut attendu : {', '.join(allowed) or 'aucun'})."
            )
        delivery.status = status
        if (
            status
            in (DeliveryStatus.DELIVERED.value, DeliveryStatus.COMPLETED.value)
            and delivery.delivery_date is None
        ):
            delivery.delivery_date = date.today()
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(delivery)
        return delivery

    async def create_from_order(
        self, order_id: int, expected_date=None, notes: str | None = None
    ) -> DeliveryNote:
        """Crée un bon de livraison depuis une commande (coupes préservées)."""
        from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts),
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order_id)
        )
        order = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")

        reference = await self.sequences.next_value("delivery", "BL")

        delivery = DeliveryNote(
            reference=reference,
            order_id=order.id,
            partner_id=order.partner_id,
            status=DeliveryStatus.PENDING.value,
            expected_date=expected_date or order.delivery_date_planned,
            notes=notes,
            company_id=order.company_id,
        )

        for oline in order.lines:
            line = DeliveryLine(
                product_id=oline.product_id,
                variant_id=oline.variant_id,
                variant_name=oline.variant_name,
                description=oline.description,
                quantity=float(oline.quantity_ordered or 0),
                quantity_ordered=float(oline.quantity_ordered or 0),
                unit=oline.unit,
                sell_by_length=oline.sell_by_length,
                total_length=float(oline.total_length or 0),
                company_id=order.company_id,
            )
            if oline.cuts:
                for cut in oline.cuts:
                    line.cuts.append(
                        DeliveryLineCut(
                            quantity=float(cut.quantity),
                            length=float(cut.length),
                        )
                    )
            delivery.lines.append(line)

        self.session.add(delivery)
        await self.session.commit()

        # Recharge avec les relations (lazy-load interdit hors session sync)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(DeliveryNote)
            .options(
                selectinload(DeliveryNote.lines).selectinload(DeliveryLine.cuts),
            )
            .where(DeliveryNote.id == delivery.id)
        )
        loaded = result.scalar_one()
        return loaded

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Reprise du document — retour en brouillon / suppression (cascade)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def back_to_draft(
        self, delivery_id: int, user_id: int | None = None
    ) -> DeliveryNote:
        """Remet un bon de livraison au brouillon (tout statut → draft).

        Étape préalable à la suppression (les BL naissent en ``pending``).
        Aucun impact stock : le module livraison ne déclenche aucun
        mouvement — seule l'horodatage ``delivery_date`` est révoqué.
        """
        delivery = await self.session.get(DeliveryNote, delivery_id)
        if delivery is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Bon de livraison {delivery_id} introuvable")
        if delivery.status == DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Ce bon de livraison est déjà en brouillon.")

        old_status = delivery.status
        delivery.status = DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value
        delivery.delivery_date = None

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "delivery.back_to_draft",
            "delivery",
            delivery.id,
            company_id=delivery.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={"status": old_status},
            new_values={"status": DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value},
        )
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(delivery)
        logger.info("Bon de livraison %s remis en brouillon", delivery.reference)
        return delivery

    async def delete_delivery(
        self, delivery_id: int, user_id: int | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Supprime un bon de livraison — brouillon uniquement (cascade).

        Garde-fous : statut ``draft`` (donc remise au brouillon préalable)
        et aucun paiement restant sur la facture de sa commande.
        """
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(DeliveryNote)
            .where(DeliveryNote.id == delivery_id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
        delivery = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if delivery is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Bon de livraison {delivery_id} introuvable")
        if delivery.status != DeliveryStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError(
                "Seul un bon de livraison au statut « brouillon » peut être "
                "supprimé — remettez-le d'abord au brouillon "
                f"(statut actuel : {delivery.status})."
            )

        # Cascade : les paiements de la facture de cette commande doivent
        # avoir été supprimés avant le BL.
        if delivery.order_id:
            from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
            from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

            rows = (await self.session.execute(
                select(Payment.reference)
                .join(Invoice, Payment.invoice_id == Invoice.id)
                .where(Invoice.order_id == delivery.order_id)
                .limit(5)
            )).scalars().all()
            if rows:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : des paiements sont encore rattachés à la "
                    "facture de cette vente ("
                    + ", ".join(rows)
                    + ") — supprimez-les d'abord."
                )

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "delivery.deleted",
            "delivery",
            delivery.id,
            company_id=delivery.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={
                "reference": delivery.reference,
                "status": delivery.status,
                "order_id": delivery.order_id,
                "partner_id": delivery.partner_id,
            },
        )
        await self.session.delete(delivery)  # cascade lines + cuts
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Bon de livraison %s supprimé", delivery.reference)
````

## File: backend/app/modules/delivery/services/export_service.py
````python
"""Export des bons de livraison.

Format « une ligne par article ». Le BL ne porte pas de montants : les
quantités sont livrées (``quantite``) et commandées (``quantite_commandee``),
la référence de commande étant reprise pour le rapprochement.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.modules.delivery.models.delivery import DeliveryNote

DELIVERY_HEADERS = [
    "reference",
    "client",
    "commande",
    "date",
    "statut",
    "produit",
    "variante",
    "quantite",
    "quantite_commandee",
    "unite",
    "description",
]


class DeliveryExportService:
    """Export des bons de livraison vers un tableau (en‑têtes + lignes)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    async def deliveries(self, include_rows: bool = True) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[Any]]]:
        stmt = (
            select(DeliveryNote)
            .options(
                selectinload(DeliveryNote.partner),
                selectinload(DeliveryNote.order),
            )
            .order_by(DeliveryNote.id.desc())
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        deliveries = list(result.scalars().all())
        if not include_rows:
            return DELIVERY_HEADERS, []
        return DELIVERY_HEADERS, self._rows(deliveries)

    @staticmethod
    def _rows(deliveries: list[DeliveryNote]) -> list[list[Any]]:
        rows: list[list[Any]] = []
        for delivery in deliveries:
            base = [
                delivery.reference,
                delivery.partner.name if delivery.partner else None,
                delivery.order.reference if delivery.order else None,
                delivery.delivery_date or delivery.expected_date,
                delivery.status,
            ]
            # DeliveryLine ne porte pas de « position » : tri par ordre de création
            lines = sorted(delivery.lines, key=lambda line: line.id)
            if not lines:
                rows.append(base + [None] * 6)
                continue
            for line in lines:
                product = line.product
                rows.append(
                    base
                    + [
                        product.reference if product else None,
                        line.variant_name,
                        float(line.quantity or 0),
                        float(line.quantity_ordered or 0),
                        line.unit,
                        line.description or (product.name if product else None),
                    ]
                )
        return rows
````

````python
"""
API Finance — tresorerie et rapprochement bancaire (Phase 2 PRD).

Comptes de tresorerie (banque / caisse / mobile money), releves bancaires,
lignes a rapprocher et rapport de rapprochement.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Response, status

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_company_id
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.finance.schemas.treasury import (
    BankStatementCreate,
    BankStatementLineCreate,
    BankStatementLineRead,
    BankStatementRead,
    ReconciliationReport,
    ReconcilePayload,
    ReconcileResult,
    TreasuryAccountCreate,
    TreasuryAccountRead,
    TreasuryAccountUpdate,
)
from app.modules.finance.services.treasury_service import TreasuryService

router = APIRouter()


def _http_error(exc: ValueError) -> HTTPException:
    """Mappe les erreurs metier vers HTTP (404 si introuvable, 400 sinon)."""
    code = (
        status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
        if "introuvable" in str(exc)
        else status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
    )
````

````python
"""
Modèle Expense — dépense enregistrable (mini-Finance).

Une dépense peut être liée à un fournisseur (Partner) et catégorisée.
C'est l'action rapide « Enregistrer une dépense » du tableau de bord.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import Date, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin


class Expense(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Dépense simple."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    label: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(200), nullable=False)
    category: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(50), default="general")
    amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    expense_date: Mapped[date | None] = MappedColumn(Date, default=date.today)
    payment_method: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="cash")

    supplier_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("partners.id"), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Expense {self.reference} {self.amount}>"
````

## File: backend/app/modules/finance/models/treasury.py
````python
"""
Modeles Tresorerie — comptes, releves bancaires et rapprochement.

Phase 2 du PRD (integration Tresorerie + rapprochement bancaire) :

- ``TreasuryAccount`` — compte de tresorerie (banque, caisse, mobile money)
  rattache a un compte du plan comptable (511, 512, 531...).
- ``BankStatement`` — releve bancaire (solde d'ouverture / cloture).
- ``BankStatementLine`` — ligne du releve a rapprocher avec une ecriture
  comptable (ligne du journal sur le compte de tresorerie).

Convention de montant signe :
- releve : positif = encaissement, negatif = decaissement ;
- ecriture : ``debit - credit`` (meme signe que le releve).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Date,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin


class TreasuryAccount(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Compte de tresorerie (banque / caisse / mobile money)."""

    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("company_id", "code", name="uq_treasury_account_company_code"),
    )

    #: Code interne court (ex. ``BQ1``, ``CAI1``, ``OM1``).
    code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(120))
    #: Compte du plan comptable OHADA ratache (ex. ``511`` Banque, ``531`` Caisse).
    account_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), index=True)
    bank_name: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(120))
    account_number: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(64))
    currency: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(3), default="XOF")
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=True)

    statements: Mapped[list["BankStatement"]] = relationship(
        "BankStatement",
        back_populates="account",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        lazy="selectin",
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<TreasuryAccount {self.code} ({self.account_code})>"


class BankStatement(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Releve bancaire / etat de caisse."""

    account_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("treasury_accounts.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    label: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(120))
    statement_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, nullable=False)
    opening_balance: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 2), default=0)
    closing_balance: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 2), default=0)
    #: ``open`` | ``closed`` — un releve cloture n'accepte plus de modification.
    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), default="open", index=True)

    account: Mapped["TreasuryAccount"] = relationship(
        "TreasuryAccount", back_populates="statements"
    )
    lines: Mapped[list["BankStatementLine"]] = relationship(
        "BankStatementLine",
        back_populates="statement",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan",
        lazy="selectin",
        order_by="BankStatementLine.line_date",
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<BankStatement {self.label} ({self.status})>"


class BankStatementLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne de releve — montant signe, rapprochable avec une ecriture."""

    statement_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("bank_statements.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    line_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, nullable=False)
    label: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(255))
    #: Positif = encaissement, negatif = decaissement.
    amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 2), nullable=False)
    #: Ligne du journal rapprochee (NULL = non rapprochee).
    entry_line_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("journal_entry_lines.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )
    reconciled_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = MappedColumn(DateTime)
    reconciled_by: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )

    statement: Mapped["BankStatement"] = relationship(
        "BankStatement", back_populates="lines"
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<BankStatementLine {self.line_date} {self.amount} {self.label[:20]!r}>"


__all__ = ["TreasuryAccount", "BankStatement", "BankStatementLine"]
````

## File: backend/app/modules/finance/services/expense_service.py
````python
"""Service Finance (mini) — dépenses."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.finance.models.expense import Expense
from app.modules.finance.schemas import ExpenseCreate

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ExpenseService:
    """Service des dépenses."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    async def create_expense(self, data: ExpenseCreate) -> Expense:
        from app.core.tenant import get_current_company

        company_id = get_current_company()
        if company_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Entreprise courante introuvable")
        if data.supplier_id:
            from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner

            supplier = await self.session.get(Partner, data.supplier_id)
            company_id = supplier.company_id if supplier else company_id

        reference = await self.sequences.next_value("expense", "DEP")

        expense = Expense(
            reference=reference,
            label=data.label,
            category=data.category,
            amount=float(data.amount),
            expense_date=data.expense_date or date.today(),
            payment_method=data.payment_method,
            supplier_id=data.supplier_id,
            notes=data.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(expense)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(expense)

        # Comptabilisation automatique (idempotente) — défensive
        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            await PostingService(self.session).post_expense(expense)
            await self.session.commit()
            await self.session.refresh(expense)
        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — défensif
            logger.exception(
                "Comptabilisation automatique impossible pour la dépense %s",
                expense.reference,
            )
            await self.session.rollback()

        return expense

    async def list_expenses(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100) -> list[Expense]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Expense).order_by(Expense.id.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())
````

## File: backend/app/modules/finance/services/treasury_service.py
````python
"""
Service Tresorerie — comptes, releves et rapprochement bancaire.

Phase 2 du PRD : rapprochement des lignes de releve avec les ecritures
publiees sur le compte comptable de tresorerie rattache (511, 512, 531...).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Optional

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.modules.accounting.models.journal_entry import JournalEntry, JournalEntryLine
from app.modules.finance.models.treasury import (
    BankStatement,
    BankStatementLine,
    TreasuryAccount,
)
from app.modules.finance.schemas.treasury import (
    BankStatementCreate,
    BankStatementLineCreate,
    ReconciliationReport,
    ReconcileResult,
    TreasuryAccountCreate,
    TreasuryAccountUpdate,
    UnreconciledEntryLine,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

#: Toleree de comparaison des montants (FCFA).
_AMOUNT_TOLERANCE = Decimal("0.01")
#: Fenetre de date pour le rapprochement automatique (jours +|-).
_AUTO_MATCH_DAYS = 5


class TreasuryService:
    """Service metier tresorerie et rapprochement bancaire."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Comptes de tresorerie
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_accounts(
        self, company_id: int, active_only: bool = True
    ) -> list[TreasuryAccount]:
        stmt = select(TreasuryAccount).where(TreasuryAccount.company_id == company_id)
        if active_only:
            stmt = stmt.where(TreasuryAccount.is_active.is_(True))
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt.order_by(TreasuryAccount.code))
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_account(self, company_id: int, account_id: int) -> TreasuryAccount:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(TreasuryAccount).where(
                TreasuryAccount.company_id == company_id,
                TreasuryAccount.id == account_id,
            )
        )
        account = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if account is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Compte de tresorerie {account_id} introuvable.")
        return account

    async def create_account(
        self, company_id: int, data: TreasuryAccountCreate
    ) -> TreasuryAccount:
        existing = await self.session.execute(
            select(TreasuryAccount).where(
                TreasuryAccount.company_id == company_id,
                TreasuryAccount.code == data.code,
            )
        )
        if existing.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"Le code tresorerie {data.code} existe deja.")
        account = TreasuryAccount(company_id=company_id, **data.model_dump())
        self.session.add(account)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(account)
        return account

    async def update_account(
        self, company_id: int, account_id: int, data: TreasuryAccountUpdate
    ) -> TreasuryAccount:
        account = await self.get_account(company_id, account_id)
        for key, value in data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True).items():
            setattr(account, key, value)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(account)
        return account

    async def delete_account(self, company_id: int, account_id: int) -> None:
        account = await self.get_account(company_id, account_id)
        await self.session.delete(account)
        await self.session.commit()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Releves bancaires
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_statements(
        self, company_id: int, account_id: int
    ) -> list[BankStatement]:
        await self.get_account(company_id, account_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(BankStatement)
            .where(
                BankStatement.company_id == company_id,
                BankStatement.account_id == account_id,
            )
            .order_by(BankStatement.statement_date.desc())
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_statement(
        self, company_id: int, statement_id: int
    ) -> BankStatement:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(BankStatement)
            .options(selectinload(BankStatement.lines))
            .where(
                BankStatement.company_id == company_id,
                BankStatement.id == statement_id,
            )
        )
        statement = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if statement is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Releve {statement_id} introuvable.")
        return statement

    async def create_statement(
        self, company_id: int, account_id: int, data: BankStatementCreate
    ) -> BankStatement:
        await self.get_account(company_id, account_id)
        statement = BankStatement(
            company_id=company_id,
            account_id=account_id,
            **data.model_dump(),
        )
        self.session.add(statement)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(statement)
        return statement

    async def add_line(
        self, company_id: int, statement_id: int, data: BankStatementLineCreate
    ) -> BankStatementLine:
        statement = await self.get_statement(company_id, statement_id)
        if statement.status != "open":
            raise ValueError("Le releve est cloture : ajoutez un nouveau releve.")
        line = BankStatementLine(
            company_id=company_id,
            statement_id=statement_id,
            **data.model_dump(),
        )
        self.session.add(line)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(line)
        return line

    async def delete_line(self, company_id: int, line_id: int) -> None:
        line = await self._get_line(company_id, line_id)
        if line.entry_line_id is not None:
            raise ValueError("Ligne deja rapprochee : retirez d'abord le rapprochement.")
        statement = await self.get_statement(company_id, line.statement_id)
        if statement.status != "open":
            raise ValueError("Le releve est cloture : ligne verrouillee.")
        await self.session.delete(line)
        await self.session.commit()

    async def close_statement(self, company_id: int, statement_id: int) -> BankStatement:
        statement = await self.get_statement(company_id, statement_id)
        if statement.status == "closed":
            raise ValueError("Le releve est deja cloture.")
        statement.status = "closed"
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(statement)
        return statement

    async def _get_line(self, company_id: int, line_id: int) -> BankStatementLine:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(BankStatementLine).where(
                BankStatementLine.company_id == company_id,
                BankStatementLine.id == line_id,
            )
        )
        line = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if line is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Ligne de releve {line_id} introuvable.")
        return line

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Rapprochement
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def reconcile(
        self,
        company_id: int,
        line_id: int,
        entry_line_id: int,
        user_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> BankStatementLine:
        """Rapproche manuellement une ligne de releve et une ecriture."""
        line = await self._get_line(company_id, line_id)
        if line.entry_line_id is not None:
            raise ValueError("Cette ligne est deja rapprochee.")

        statement = await self.get_statement(company_id, line.statement_id)
        if statement.status != "open":
            raise ValueError("Le releve est cloture : rapprochement impossible.")

        account = await self.get_account(company_id, statement.account_id)
        entry_line = await self._get_posted_entry_line(
            company_id, entry_line_id, account.account_code
        )
        if entry_line is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Ligne d'ecriture {entry_line_id} introuvable ou non rattachable "
                f"au compte {account.account_code}."
            )

        amount_line = Decimal(str(line.amount))
        amount_entry = Decimal(str(entry_line.debit or 0)) - Decimal(
            str(entry_line.credit or 0)
        )
        if abs(amount_line - amount_entry) > _AMOUNT_TOLERANCE:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Montants incoherents : releve {amount_line} vs ecriture {amount_entry}."
            )

        line.entry_line_id = entry_line.id
        line.reconciled_at = datetime.utcnow()
        line.reconciled_by = user_id
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(line)
        return line

    async def unreconcile(self, company_id: int, line_id: int) -> BankStatementLine:
        """Retire le rapprochement d'une ligne de releve."""
        line = await self._get_line(company_id, line_id)
        if line.entry_line_id is None:
            raise ValueError("Cette ligne n'est pas rapprochee.")
        statement = await self.get_statement(company_id, line.statement_id)
        if statement.status != "open":
            raise ValueError("Le releve est cloture : operation impossible.")
        line.entry_line_id = None
        line.reconciled_at = None
        line.reconciled_by = None
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(line)
        return line

    async def auto_reconcile(
        self, company_id: int, statement_id: int
    ) -> ReconcileResult:
        """
        Rapprochement automatique : montant identique + date +|- fenetre.

        Chaque ligne de releve non rapprochee est appariee avec la premiere
        ligne d'ecriture publiee disponible respectant les criteres.
        """
        statement = await self.get_statement(company_id, statement_id)
        if statement.status != "open":
            raise ValueError("Le releve est cloture : rapprochement impossible.")
        account = await self.get_account(company_id, statement.account_id)

        lines = [l for l in statement.lines if l.entry_line_id is None]
        candidates = await self._unreconciled_entry_lines(
            company_id, account.account_code
        )

        matched = 0
        used: set[int] = set()
        for line in lines:
            amount_line = Decimal(str(line.amount))
            for candidate in list(candidates):
                if candidate["id"] in used:
                    continue
                if abs(amount_line - candidate["amount"]) > _AMOUNT_TOLERANCE:
                    continue
                delta = abs(line.line_date - candidate["entry_date"])
                if delta > timedelta(days=_AUTO_MATCH_DAYS):
                    continue
                line.entry_line_id = candidate["id"]
                line.reconciled_at = datetime.utcnow()
                used.add(candidate["id"])
                matched += 1
                break

        await self.session.commit()
        unmatched = len(lines) - matched
        return ReconcileResult(
            matched=matched,
            unmatched=unmatched,
            message=(
                f"{matched} ligne(s) rapprochee(s) automatiquement, "
                f"{unmatched} restante(s)."
            ),
        )

    async def reconciliation_report(
        self, company_id: int, account_id: int
    ) -> ReconciliationReport:
        """Etat de rapprochement : soldes comptable / releve + lignes en attente."""
        account = await self.get_account(company_id, account_id)

        # Solde comptable (ecritures publiees sur le compte rattache)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(JournalEntryLine)
            .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntryLine.entry_id == JournalEntry.id)
            .where(
                JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                JournalEntry.status == "posted",
                JournalEntryLine.account_code == account.account_code,
            )
        )
        entry_lines = list(result.scalars().all())
        accounting_balance = sum(
            (Decimal(str(l.debit or 0)) - Decimal(str(l.credit or 0)) for l in entry_lines),
            Decimal("0"),
        )
        rapproched_ids = {
            l.entry_line_id
            for l in await self._all_statement_lines(company_id, account_id)
            if l.entry_line_id is not None
        }
        unreconciled_entry = [
            UnreconciledEntryLine(
                entry_line_id=l.id,
                entry_id=l.entry_id,
                reference=(await self._entry_reference(l.entry_id)) or "",
                entry_date=(await self._entry_date(l.entry_id)),
                label=l.label,
                amount=float(Decimal(str(l.debit or 0)) - Decimal(str(l.credit or 0))),
            )
            for l in entry_lines
            if l.id not in rapproched_ids
        ]

        # Releves : solde de cloture du dernier releve + lignes non rapprochees
        statements = await self.list_statements(company_id, account_id)
        last_closing = (
            Decimal(str(statements[0].closing_balance)) if statements else Decimal("0")
        )
        all_lines = await self._all_statement_lines(company_id, account_id)
        unreconciled_lines = [l for l in all_lines if l.entry_line_id is None]
        reconciled_amount = sum(
            (Decimal(str(l.amount)) for l in all_lines if l.entry_line_id is not None),
            Decimal("0"),
        )

        return ReconciliationReport(
            account_id=account.id,
            account_code=account.account_code,
            accounting_balance=float(accounting_balance),
            statement_balance=float(last_closing),
            reconciled_amount=float(reconciled_amount),
            unreconciled_lines=unreconciled_lines,
            unreconciled_entry_lines=unreconciled_entry,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Methodes privees
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _get_posted_entry_line(
        self, company_id: int, entry_line_id: int, account_code: str
    ) -> Optional[JournalEntryLine]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(JournalEntryLine)
            .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntryLine.entry_id == JournalEntry.id)
            .where(
                JournalEntryLine.id == entry_line_id,
                JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                JournalEntry.status == "posted",
                JournalEntryLine.account_code == account_code,
            )
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def _unreconciled_entry_lines(
        self, company_id: int, account_code: str
    ) -> list[dict]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(JournalEntryLine, JournalEntry)
            .join(JournalEntry, JournalEntryLine.entry_id == JournalEntry.id)
            .where(
                JournalEntry.company_id == company_id,
                JournalEntry.status == "posted",
                JournalEntryLine.account_code == account_code,
            )
        )
        rows = result.all()
        already = {
            r[0]
            for r in (
                await self.session.execute(
                    select(BankStatementLine.entry_line_id).where(
                        BankStatementLine.company_id == company_id,
                        BankStatementLine.entry_line_id.is_not(None),
                    )
                )
            ).all()
        }
        out: list[dict] = []
        for line, entry in rows:
            if line.id in already:
                continue
            out.append(
                {
                    "id": line.id,
                    "entry_id": line.entry_id,
                    "entry_date": entry.entry_date,
                    "amount": Decimal(str(line.debit or 0))
                    - Decimal(str(line.credit or 0)),
                }
            )
        return out

    async def _all_statement_lines(
        self, company_id: int, account_id: int
    ) -> list[BankStatementLine]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(BankStatementLine)
            .join(BankStatement, BankStatementLine.statement_id == BankStatement.id)
            .where(
                BankStatementLine.company_id == company_id,
                BankStatement.account_id == account_id,
            )
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def _entry_reference(self, entry_id: int) -> Optional[str]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(JournalEntry.reference).where(JournalEntry.id == entry_id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def _entry_date(self, entry_id: int):
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(JournalEntry.entry_date).where(JournalEntry.id == entry_id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()
````

````python
"""API Facturation — invoices + impression PDF."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_active_user
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.invoicing.schemas import InvoiceFromOrder, InvoiceRead
# noqa: F401  (import enregistre les modèles)
from app.modules.invoicing.services.export_service import InvoiceExportService
from app.modules.invoicing.services.invoice_service import InvoiceService
from app.shared.file_export import export_response

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/invoices", response_model=list[InvoiceRead])
async def list_invoices(
    session: SessionDep,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
    order_id: int | None = None,
    include_pos: bool = False,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "view")),
):
    """Factures (ventes comptoir exclues par défaut)."""
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    if order_id is not None:
        invoices = await service.list_invoices(skip=skip, limit=limit, include_pos=include_pos)
        return [i for i in invoices if i.order_id == order_id]
    return await service.list_invoices(skip=skip, limit=limit, include_pos=include_pos)


# Déclaré AVANT /invoices/{invoice_id} : sinon « export » serait capturé
# comme identifiant et renverrait 422.
@router.get("/invoices/export")
async def export_invoices(
    session: SessionDep,
    format: str = "xlsx",
    template: bool = False,
    include_pos: bool = False,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "view")),
):
    """Export Excel / CSV des factures — une ligne par article.

    ``format`` : ``xlsx`` (défaut) ou ``csv`` ; ``template=1`` : en‑têtes seuls.
    """
    headers, rows = await InvoiceExportService(session).invoices(
        include_rows=not template, include_pos=include_pos
    )
    return export_response(format, "Factures", headers, rows)


@router.get("/invoices/{invoice_id}", response_model=InvoiceRead)
async def get_invoice(
    invoice_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "view")),
):
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    invoice = await service.get_invoice(invoice_id)
    if invoice is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Facture introuvable")
    return invoice


@router.post(
    "/invoices/from-order",
    response_model=InvoiceRead,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
async def create_invoice_from_order(
    body: InvoiceFromOrder,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "create")),
):
    """Crée une facture depuis une commande (totale, solde ou acompte)."""
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    try:
        return await service.create_from_order(
            body.order_id,
            due_days=body.due_days,
            mode=body.mode,
            value=body.value,
            post=body.post,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/invoices/{invoice_id}/post", response_model=InvoiceRead)
async def post_invoice(
    invoice_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "edit")),
):
    """Confirme une facture brouillon (→ comptabilisée)."""
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    try:
        return await service.post_invoice(invoice_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/invoices/{invoice_id}/reset-to-draft", response_model=InvoiceRead)
async def reset_invoice_to_draft(
    invoice_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "edit")),
):
    """Remet une facture confirmée en brouillon (refusé si un paiement existe)."""
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    try:
        return await service.reset_to_draft(invoice_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/invoices/{invoice_id}/cancel", response_model=InvoiceRead)
async def cancel_invoice(
    invoice_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "cancel")),
):
    """Annule une facture non payée et libère la commande pour re-facturation."""
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    try:
        return await service.cancel(invoice_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.delete("/invoices/{invoice_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_invoice(
    invoice_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "delete")),
):
    """Supprime une facture — brouillon uniquement, aucun paiement rattaché."""
    service = InvoiceService(session)
    if await service.get_invoice(invoice_id) is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Facture introuvable")
    try:
        await service.delete_invoice(invoice_id, user_id=user.id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/invoices/{invoice_id}/print")
async def print_invoice(
    invoice_id: int,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "view")),
):
    """Génère le PDF de la facture (format A4)."""
    import io

    from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

    from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder
    from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine
    from app.core.documents.naming import content_disposition

    try:
        context = await ContextBuilder().load_invoice(invoice_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Facture introuvable")
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    path = await engine.arender_invoice(invoice_id)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    return StreamingResponse(
        io.BytesIO(data),
        media_type="application/pdf",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": content_disposition(
                context.get("doc_filename") or "document.pdf"
            )
        },
    )
````
