## File: backend/app/modules/invoicing/models/invoice.py
````python
"""
Modèles Facturation — Invoice / InvoiceLine / InvoiceLineCut.

Une facture est générée depuis une commande client, en préservant les
sous-lignes de coupes BAC (listes de longueurs à découper).

Formule ligne BAC ::
    Montant = Σ(quantité × longueur × prix unitaire)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Date,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.shared.enums import InvoiceStatus


class Invoice(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Facture client (pro forma / émise / payée)."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    order_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("sales_orders.id"), nullable=True)
    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )

    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value, index=True
    )
    invoice_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, default=date.today)
    due_date: Mapped[date | None] = MappedColumn(Date)

    currency_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(3), default="XOF")

    # Contact commercial hérité de la commande (pas de saisie sur la facture).
    salesperson_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )

    amount_untaxed: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    amount_total: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    paid_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(2000))
    payment_communication: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(200))

    lines: Mapped[list["InvoiceLine"]] = relationship(
        "InvoiceLine", back_populates="invoice",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner")
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship("Company")
    salesperson: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        "User", foreign_keys=[salesperson_id], lazy="selectin"
    )

    @property
    def amount_due(self) -> float:
        return max(float(self.amount_total) - float(self.paid_amount), 0.0)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Invoice {self.reference} [{self.status}]>"


class InvoiceLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne de facture — standard ou BAC (cuts)."""

    invoice_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("invoices.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=True)
    # Variante du produit (optionnelle) — ``variant_name`` est un instantané
    # du libellé (réimpression fidèle des documents).
    variant_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("product_variants.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )
    variant_name: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(300))

    description: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    unit: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(20))

    sell_by_length: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False)
    unit_price: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    discount_percent: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(6, 2), default=0)

    total_length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    subtotal: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    position: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, default=0)

    invoice: Mapped["Invoice"] = relationship("Invoice", back_populates="lines")
    product: Mapped["Product"] = relationship("Product", lazy="selectin")
    variant: Mapped["ProductVariant | None"] = relationship(
        "ProductVariant", lazy="selectin"
    )
    cuts: Mapped[list["InvoiceLineCut"]] = relationship(
        "InvoiceLineCut", back_populates="line",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )


class InvoiceLineCut(Base):
    """Sous-ligne de coupe BAC d'une facture (quantité × longueur)."""

    __tablename__ = "invoice_line_cuts"

    id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    line_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("invoice_lines.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(12, 4), nullable=False)
    unit_price: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))

    line: Mapped["InvoiceLine"] = relationship("InvoiceLine", back_populates="cuts")
````

## File: backend/app/modules/invoicing/services/export_service.py
````python
"""Export des factures clients.

Format « une ligne par article » (même trame que les devis/commandes) :
l'en‑tête de la facture — montant HT / TVA / total / reste à payer — est
répété sur chaque ligne, à ne pas additionner lors d'un agrégat.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

INVOICE_HEADERS = [
    "reference",
    "client",
    "date",
    "echeance",
    "statut",
    "produit",
    "variante",
    "quantite",
    "unite",
    "prix_unitaire",
    "remise",
    "sous_total",
    "montant_ht",
    "tva",
    "montant_document",
    "montant_paye",
    "devise",
    "description",
]


class InvoiceExportService:
    """Export des factures vers un tableau (en‑têtes + lignes)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    async def invoices(
        self, include_rows: bool = True, include_pos: bool = False
    ) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[Any]]]:
        from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder

        stmt = select(Invoice).options(selectinload(Invoice.partner)).order_by(Invoice.id.desc())
        if not include_pos:
            stmt = stmt.outerjoin(SalesOrder, SalesOrder.id == Invoice.order_id).where(
                (Invoice.order_id.is_(None)) | (SalesOrder.fulfillment_mode != "pos")
            )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        invoices = list(result.scalars().all())
        if not include_rows:
            return INVOICE_HEADERS, []
        return INVOICE_HEADERS, self._rows(invoices)

    @staticmethod
    def _rows(invoices: list[Invoice]) -> list[list[Any]]:
        rows: list[list[Any]] = []
        for invoice in invoices:
            base = [
                invoice.reference,
                invoice.partner.name if invoice.partner else None,
                invoice.invoice_date,
                invoice.due_date,
                invoice.status,
            ]
            untaxed = float(invoice.amount_untaxed or 0)
            tax = float(invoice.tax_amount or 0)
            total = float(invoice.amount_total or 0)
            paid = float(invoice.paid_amount or 0)
            currency = invoice.currency_code
            lines = sorted(invoice.lines, key=lambda line: (line.position or 0, line.id))
            if not lines:
                rows.append(base + [None] * 7 + [untaxed, tax, total, paid, currency, None])
                continue
            for line in lines:
                product = line.product
                rows.append(
                    base
                    + [
                        product.reference if product else None,
                        line.variant_name,
                        float(line.quantity or 0),
                        line.unit,
                        float(line.unit_price or 0),
                        float(line.discount_percent or 0),
                        float(line.subtotal or 0),
                        untaxed,
                        tax,
                        total,
                        paid,
                        currency,
                        line.description or (product.name if product else None),
                    ]
                )
        return rows
````

## File: backend/app/modules/invoicing/services/invoice_service.py
````python
"""Service Facturation — création de factures depuis les commandes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import (
    Invoice,
    InvoiceLine,
    InvoiceLineCut,
)
from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine
from app.shared.enums import InvoiceStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class InvoiceService:
    """Service des factures."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Helpers — reste à facturer
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def get_order_invoiced_total(self, order_id: int) -> float:
        """Total déjà facturé pour une commande (hors avoirs/annulées)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice.status, Invoice.amount_total).where(
                Invoice.order_id == order_id
            )
        )
        excluded = {
            InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value,
            InvoiceStatus.CREDIT.value,
        }
        return float(
            sum(amount for status, amount in result.all()
                if status not in excluded)
        )

    async def get_invoice(self, invoice_id: int) -> Invoice | None:
        return await self.session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)

    async def list_invoices(
        self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, include_pos: bool = False
    ) -> list[Invoice]:
        """Factures, plus récentes d'abord.

        Les factures issues des ventes comptoir (commande
        ``fulfillment_mode="pos"``) sont exclues par défaut : elles vivent
        uniquement dans l'historique du Point de Vente.
        """
        stmt = (
            select(Invoice)
            .options(
                selectinload(Invoice.lines).selectinload(InvoiceLine.cuts),
            )
            .order_by(Invoice.id.desc())
            .offset(skip)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        if not include_pos:
            stmt = (
                stmt.outerjoin(SalesOrder, SalesOrder.id == Invoice.order_id).where(
                    (Invoice.order_id.is_(None))
                    | (SalesOrder.fulfillment_mode != "pos")
                )
            )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def create_from_order(
        self,
        order_id: int,
        due_days: int = 0,
        mode: str = "full",
        value: float | None = None,
        post: bool = False,
    ) -> Invoice:
        """Génère une facture depuis une commande.

        - ``mode="full"`` : toutes les lignes (coupes préservées) ; si des
          acomptes existent déjà, facture de **solde** du reste à facturer.
        - ``mode="down_payment_percent"`` : acompte de ``value`` % du total.
        - ``mode="down_payment_fixed"`` : acompte de ``value`` (montant fixe).
        - ``post=False`` → brouillon (défaut, façon Odoo) ; ``post=True`` →
          comptabilisée immédiatement.

        Lève ``ValueError`` si la commande est introuvable, entièrement
        facturée, ou si le montant d'acompte est invalide.
        """
        from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts),
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order_id)
        )
        order = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")

        order_total = float(order.amount_total or 0)
        invoiced = await self.get_order_invoiced_total(order.id)
        remaining = round(max(order_total - invoiced, 0.0), 2)
        if remaining <= 0.005:
            raise ValueError("Cette commande est déjà entièrement facturée")

        order_ref = getattr(order, "reference", None) or f"#{order.id}"
        # Ratio TVA proportionnel (0 si commande sans taxe)
        untaxed = float(order.amount_untaxed or 0)
        tax_ratio = float(order.tax_amount or 0) / untaxed if untaxed > 0 else 0.0

        reference = await self.sequences.next_value("invoice", "INV")

        invoice = Invoice(
            reference=reference,
            order_id=order.id,
            salesperson_id=getattr(order, "salesperson_id", None),
            partner_id=order.partner_id,
            status=InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value if post else InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value,
            invoice_date=date.today(),
            due_date=(date.today() + timedelta(days=due_days)) if due_days else None,
            currency_code=order.currency_code,
            notes=order.notes,
            payment_communication=f"INV/{reference}",
            company_id=order.company_id,
        )

        if mode == "down_payment_percent":
            if value is None or value <= 0 or value > 100:
                raise ValueError("Pourcentage d'acompte invalide (attendu 0–100)")
            amount = round(min(order_total * value / 100, remaining), 2)
            if amount <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Le montant de l'acompte serait nul")
            invoice.lines.append(
                InvoiceLine(
                    description=f"Acompte {value:g} % — {order_ref}",
                    quantity=1,
                    unit="forfait",
                    unit_price=amount,
                    subtotal=amount,
                    company_id=order.company_id,
                )
            )
        elif mode == "down_payment_fixed":
            if value is None or value <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Montant d'acompte invalide")
            if value > remaining + 0.005:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Le montant de l'acompte ({value:,.2f}) dépasse le reste "
                    f"à facturer ({remaining:,.2f})"
                )
            amount = round(value, 2)
            invoice.lines.append(
                InvoiceLine(
                    description=f"Acompte fixe — {order_ref}",
                    quantity=1,
                    unit="forfait",
                    unit_price=amount,
                    subtotal=amount,
                    company_id=order.company_id,
                )
            )
        elif invoiced > 0.005:
            # mode="full" avec acomptes existants → facture de solde
            invoice.lines.append(
                InvoiceLine(
                    description=f"Solde — {order_ref}",
                    quantity=1,
                    unit="forfait",
                    unit_price=remaining,
                    subtotal=remaining,
                    company_id=order.company_id,
                )
            )

        else:
            for oline in order.lines:
                line = InvoiceLine(
                    product_id=oline.product_id,
                    variant_id=oline.variant_id,
                    variant_name=oline.variant_name,
                    description=oline.description,
                    quantity=float(oline.quantity_ordered or 0),
                    unit=oline.unit,
                    sell_by_length=oline.sell_by_length,
                    unit_price=float(oline.unit_price or 0),
                    discount_percent=float(oline.discount_percent or 0),
                    total_length=float(oline.total_length or 0),
                    subtotal=float(oline.subtotal or 0),
                    position=oline.position or 0,
                    company_id=order.company_id,
                )
                if oline.cuts:
                    for cut in oline.cuts:
                        line.cuts.append(
                            InvoiceLineCut(
                                quantity=float(cut.quantity),
                                length=float(cut.length),
                                unit_price=(
                                    float(cut.unit_price) if cut.unit_price else None
                                ),
                            )
                        )
                invoice.lines.append(line)

        # Totaux — lignes HT + TVA proportionnelle (source de vérité : lignes)
        invoice.amount_untaxed = round(
            sum(float(l.subtotal or 0) for l in invoice.lines), 4
        )
        invoice.tax_amount = round(invoice.amount_untaxed * tax_ratio, 4)
        invoice.amount_total = round(invoice.amount_untaxed + invoice.tax_amount, 4)

        self.session.add(invoice)
        await self.session.commit()

        # Recharge avec les relations (lazy-load interdit hors session sync)
        loaded = await self._reload_invoice(invoice.id)

        if post:
            await self._post(loaded)

        return loaded

    async def post_invoice(self, invoice_id: int) -> Invoice:
        """Confirme une facture brouillon → POSTED (+ comptabilisation)."""
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Facture {invoice_id} introuvable")
        if invoice.status != InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une facture en brouillon peut être confirmée "
                f"(statut actuel : {invoice.status})"
            )
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value
        await self.session.commit()
        loaded = await self._reload_invoice(invoice_id)
        await self._post(loaded)
        return loaded

    async def _reload_invoice(self, invoice_id: int) -> Invoice:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice)
            .options(
                selectinload(Invoice.lines).selectinload(InvoiceLine.cuts),
            )
            .where(Invoice.id == invoice_id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def _post(self, invoice: Invoice) -> None:
        """Comptabilisation automatique (idempotente) — ne bloque pas le flux
        métier si la comptabilité échoue (module inactif, compte absent…)."""
        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            await PostingService(self.session).post_invoice(invoice)
            await self.session.commit()
        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — défensif
            logger.exception(
                "Comptabilisation automatique impossible pour la facture %s",
                invoice.reference,
            )
            await self.session.rollback()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Reprise du document — retour en brouillon / annulation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _drop_posting(self, invoice: Invoice) -> bool:
        """Supprime l'écriture comptable générée pour cette facture.

        ``post_invoice`` comptabilise en une passe (écriture créée d'emblée au
        statut ``posted``).  La remise en brouillon / l'annulation étant une
        reprise du document avant tout paiement, l'écriture est retirée pour
        qu'une confirmation ultérieure comptabilise à nouveau sans doublon
        (``PostingService`` est idempotent par ``source_type``/``source_id``).

        Échec non bloquant : le module comptable peut être inactif.
        """
        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            entry = await PostingService(self.session).find_by_source(
                invoice.company_id, "invoice", invoice.id
            )
            if entry is None:
                return False
            reference = entry.reference
            await self.session.delete(entry)  # lignes en cascade
            await self.session.commit()
            logger.info(
                "Écriture %s supprimée — facture %s reprise en amont",
                reference,
                invoice.reference,
            )
            return True
        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — défensif
            logger.exception(
                "Écriture comptable non supprimée pour la facture %s",
                invoice.reference,
            )
            await self.session.rollback()
            return False

    async def _assert_not_paid(self, invoice: Invoice) -> None:
        """Refuse la reprise d'une facture déjà encaissée (même partiellement)."""
        if float(invoice.paid_amount or 0) > 0:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : un paiement est déjà enregistré sur cette facture."
            )
        from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Payment.id).where(Payment.invoice_id == invoice.id).limit(1)
        )
        if result.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : des paiements sont rattachés à cette facture."
            )

    async def reset_to_draft(self, invoice_id: int) -> Invoice:
        """Remet une facture confirmée en brouillon (aucun paiement requis).

        Débloque le parcours de vente : une facture confirmée par erreur peut
        être corrigée puis re-confirmée.  Refusé dès qu'un encaissement existe.
        """
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Facture {invoice_id} introuvable")
        if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Cette facture est déjà en brouillon.")
        if invoice.status not in (
            InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value,
            InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une facture confirmée ou annulée peut être remise en "
                f"brouillon (statut actuel : {invoice.status})."
            )
        await self._assert_not_paid(invoice)
        await self._drop_posting(invoice)
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Facture %s remise en brouillon", invoice.reference)
        return await self._reload_invoice(invoice_id)

    async def cancel(self, invoice_id: int) -> Invoice:
        """Annule une facture non payée (brouillon ou confirmée).

        Libère la commande : une facture annulée ne compte plus dans le total
        déjà facturé (``get_order_invoiced_total``), un devis bloqué par une
        facture peut donc être repris.
        """
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Facture {invoice_id} introuvable")
        if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value:
            raise ValueError("Cette facture est déjà annulée.")
        if invoice.status not in (
            InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value,
            InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Une facture ne peut être annulée qu'en brouillon ou confirmée "
                f"(statut actuel : {invoice.status})."
            )
        await self._assert_not_paid(invoice)
        await self._drop_posting(invoice)
        invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value
        # Détachement de la commande : la facture annulée ne doit plus
        # bloquer la remise en brouillon / la suppression de la commande
        # ni de son devis (sinon FK sales_orders.id → IntegrityError 500),
        # et la commande redevient intégralement facturable.
        invoice.order_id = None
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Facture %s annulée", invoice.reference)
        return await self._reload_invoice(invoice_id)

    async def delete_invoice(
        self, invoice_id: int, user_id: int | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Supprime une facture — brouillon uniquement (cascade).

        Garde-fous : statut ``draft`` (donc remise en brouillon préalable)
        et aucun paiement rattaché (``_assert_not_paid``).
        """
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice).where(Invoice.id == invoice_id).with_for_update()
        )
        invoice = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if invoice is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Facture {invoice_id} introuvable")
        if invoice.status != InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une facture en brouillon peut être supprimée — "
                "remettez-la d'abord en brouillon "
                f"(statut actuel : {invoice.status})."
            )
        await self._assert_not_paid(invoice)

        # Défense : une facture brouillon ne doit plus avoir d'écriture,
        # mais si subsiste, elle doit pouvoir être retirée (sinon refus).
        from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

        if invoice.company_id is not None:
            entry = await PostingService(self.session).find_by_source(
                invoice.company_id, "invoice", invoice.id
            )
            if entry is not None and not await self._drop_posting(invoice):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : l'écriture comptable de cette facture "
                    "n'a pas pu être retirée."
                )

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "invoice.deleted",
            "invoice",
            invoice.id,
            company_id=invoice.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={
                "reference": invoice.reference,
                "status": invoice.status,
                "order_id": invoice.order_id,
                "partner_id": invoice.partner_id,
                "amount_total": float(invoice.amount_total or 0),
            },
        )
        await self.session.delete(invoice)  # cascade lines + cuts
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Facture %s supprimée", invoice.reference)
````

````python
"""API Paiements + reçus PDF."""
from __future__ import annotations

import io

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_active_user
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.payments.schemas import PaymentCreate, PaymentRead
from app.modules.payments.services.payment_service import PaymentService

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/payments", response_model=list[PaymentRead])
async def list_payments(
    session: SessionDep,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
    invoice_id: int | None = None,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("payment", "view")),
):
    """Paiements récents ; ``invoice_id`` filtre sur une facture."""
    service = PaymentService(session)
    return await service.list_payments(skip=skip, limit=limit, invoice_id=invoice_id)


@router.post("/payments", response_model=PaymentRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_payment(
    body: PaymentCreate,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("payment", "create")),
):
    service = PaymentService(session)
    try:
        return await service.create_payment(body)
    except ValueError as exc:
        # Contrôles métier : sur-paiement, facture brouillon/annulée, montant <= 0
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc))


@router.get("/payments/{payment_id}/receipt")
async def print_receipt(
    payment_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("payment", "view")),
):
    """Reçu de paiement — format modèle GEA (A4 léger).

    Refusé pour un paiement en brouillon : un encaissement révoqué ne doit
    pas pouvoir être imprimé (durcissement de la cascade de suppression).
    """
    from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder
    from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine
    from app.core.documents.naming import content_disposition
    from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

    payment = await session.get(Payment, payment_id)
    if payment is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Reçu introuvable")
    if payment.status == "draft":
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail="Reçu indisponible : ce paiement est en brouillon.",
        )

    try:
        context = await ContextBuilder().load_payment(payment_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Reçu introuvable")
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    path = await engine.arender_payment(payment_id)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    return StreamingResponse(
        io.BytesIO(data),
        media_type="application/pdf",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": content_disposition(
                context.get("doc_filename") or "document.pdf"
            )
        },
    )


@router.post("/payments/{payment_id}/back-to-draft", response_model=PaymentRead)
async def back_to_draft_payment(
    payment_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("payment", "edit")),
):
    """Remet un paiement en brouillon (révocation : facture + écriture)."""
    service = PaymentService(session)
    if await service.get_payment(payment_id) is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Paiement introuvable")
    try:
        return await service.back_to_draft(payment_id, user_id=user.id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/payments/{payment_id}/confirm", response_model=PaymentRead)
async def confirm_payment(
    payment_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("payment", "edit")),
):
    """Re-confirme un paiement brouillon (recrédite la facture + écriture).

    Symétrique de ``back-to-draft`` : permet de revalider le même paiement
    après une remise au brouillon, avec re-jeu des contrôles métier.
    """
    service = PaymentService(session)
    if await service.get_payment(payment_id) is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Paiement introuvable")
    try:
        return await service.confirm(payment_id, user_id=user.id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.delete("/payments/{payment_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_payment(
    payment_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("payment", "delete")),
):
    """Supprime un paiement — brouillon uniquement (cascade de suppression)."""
    service = PaymentService(session)
    if await service.get_payment(payment_id) is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Paiement introuvable")
    try:
        await service.delete_payment(payment_id, user_id=user.id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
````

````python
"""
Modèle Payment — encaissements et décaissements.

Un paiement est lié à une facture (client → reçu REC-…) ou à un
fournisseur (→ reçu de paiement). Suit ``payment_type`` (receipt/payment)
et expose un ``reference`` numérotée par séquence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import Date, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.shared.enums import PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus


class Payment(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Paiement reçu (client) ou émis (fournisseur)."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    payment_type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="receipt")  # receipt | payment
    direction: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="in")  # in | out

    partner_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("partners.id"), nullable=True)
    invoice_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("invoices.id"), nullable=True)

    method: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=PaymentMethod.CASH.value
    )
    # Journal comptable explicite (CAI, BAN, ...) — NULL = journal déduit du
    # mode d'encaissement par le service de comptabilisation.
    journal_code: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(10))
    amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    # Monnaie rendue au client (encaissement comptoir > total) — 0 sinon.
    change_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    payment_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, default=date.today)
    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=PaymentStatus.PAID.value
    )

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner")
    invoice: Mapped["Invoice"] = relationship("Invoice")
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship("Company")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Payment {self.reference} {self.amount}>"
````

## File: backend/app/modules/payments/services/payment_service.py
````python
"""Service Paiements — encaissements/décaissements et suivi facture."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment
from app.modules.payments.schemas import PaymentCreate
from app.shared.enums import InvoiceStatus, PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class PaymentService:
    """Service des paiements."""

    # Tolérance d'arrondi (unités monétaires) acceptée au-delà du reste dû —
    # absorbe les erreurs de flottants sur les montants à décimales.
    OVERPAYMENT_TOLERANCE = 1.0

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    async def list_payments(
        self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, invoice_id: int | None = None
    ) -> list[Payment]:
        """Paiements (plus récents d'abord), filtrables par facture."""
        stmt = select(Payment)
        if invoice_id is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(Payment.invoice_id == invoice_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            stmt.order_by(Payment.id.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_payment(self, payment_id: int) -> Payment | None:
        return await self.session.get(Payment, payment_id)

    async def create_payment(self, data: PaymentCreate) -> Payment:
        method = data.method or PaymentMethod.CASH.value
        direction = data.direction or "in"
        is_receipt = direction == "in"
        prefix = "REC" if is_receipt else "PAY"

        # Contrôles serveur (S-7) — montant positif et pas de sur-paiement
        amount = float(data.amount)
        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Le montant du paiement doit être strictement positif")

        reference = await self.sequences.next_value("payment", prefix)

        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner

        partner = await self.session.get(Partner, data.partner_id)
        if partner is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Client {data.partner_id} introuvable")
        company_id = partner.company_id

        # Journal comptable explicite (facultatif) — validé avant toute écriture
        journal_code = (data.journal_code or "").strip() or None
        if journal_code:
            from app.modules.accounting.models.journal import Journal

            known = await self.session.execute(
                select(Journal).where(
                    Journal.company_id == company_id,
                    Journal.code == journal_code,
                )
            )
            if known.scalar_one_or_none() is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Journal comptable inconnu : {journal_code}")

        # Contrôle de cohérence avec la facture liée (avant toute écriture)
        if data.invoice_id and is_receipt:
            from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

            invoice = await self.session.get(Invoice, data.invoice_id)
            if invoice is not None:
                if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Impossible d'encaisser une facture annulée"
                    )
                if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Impossible d'encaisser une facture en brouillon — "
                        "confirmez-la d'abord"
                    )
                due = float(invoice.amount_total or 0) - float(
                    invoice.paid_amount or 0
                )
                if amount > due + self.OVERPAYMENT_TOLERANCE:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Sur-paiement refusé : reste dû = {due:.2f}, "
                        f"paiement demandé = {amount:.2f}"
                    )

        payment = Payment(
            reference=reference,
            payment_type="receipt" if is_receipt else "payment",
            direction=direction,
            partner_id=data.partner_id,
            invoice_id=data.invoice_id,
            method=method,
            journal_code=journal_code,
            amount=float(data.amount),
            change_amount=max(0.0, float(data.change_amount or 0)),
            payment_date=data.payment_date or date.today(),
            status=PaymentStatus.PAID.value,
            notes=data.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(payment)

        # Met à jour le montant payé de la facture + son statut
        if data.invoice_id:
            from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

            invoice = await self.session.get(Invoice, data.invoice_id)
            if invoice:
                invoice.paid_amount = float(invoice.paid_amount or 0) + float(data.amount)
                if float(invoice.amount_due) <= 0:
                    invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.PAID.value
                else:
                    invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID.value
                if invoice.company_id:
                    payment.company_id = invoice.company_id

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(payment)

        # Comptabilisation automatique (idempotente) — défensive
        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            await PostingService(self.session).post_payment(payment)
            await self.session.commit()
            await self.session.refresh(payment)
        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — défensif
            logger.exception(
                "Comptabilisation automatique impossible pour le paiement %s",
                payment.reference,
            )
            await self.session.rollback()

        return payment

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Reprise du document — retour en brouillon / suppression
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _assert_posting_reversible(self, payment: Payment) -> None:
        """Refuse la révocation si l'écriture appartient à un exercice clôturé.

        Supprimer l'écriture d'un exercice clôturé fausserait les soldes
        OHADA : le refus est bloquant (400) et laisse le paiement intact.
        """
        from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

        if payment.company_id is None:
            return
        entry = await PostingService(self.session).find_by_source(
            payment.company_id, "payment", payment.id
        )
        if entry is None:
            return

        from app.modules.accounting.models.fiscal_year import FiscalYear

        if entry.fiscal_year_id:
            fy = await self.session.get(FiscalYear, entry.fiscal_year_id)
            closed = fy is not None and fy.status == "closed"
        else:
            covering = await self.session.execute(
                select(FiscalYear).where(
                    FiscalYear.start_date <= entry.entry_date,
                    FiscalYear.end_date >= entry.entry_date,
                )
            )
            closed = any(f.status == "closed" for f in covering.scalars().all())
        if closed:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : l'écriture comptable de ce paiement appartient "
                "à un exercice clôturé."
            )

    async def _drop_posting(self, payment: Payment) -> None:
        """Supprime l'écriture comptable du paiement (après vérification)."""
        from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

        if payment.company_id is None:
            return
        entry = await PostingService(self.session).find_by_source(
            payment.company_id, "payment", payment.id
        )
        if entry is None:
            return
        reference = entry.reference
        await self.session.delete(entry)  # lignes en cascade
        logger.info(
            "Écriture %s supprimée — paiement %s remis en brouillon",
            reference,
            payment.reference,
        )

    async def back_to_draft(
        self, payment_id: int, user_id: int | None = None
    ) -> Payment:
        """Remet un paiement au brouillon — étape préalable à sa suppression.

        Révoque les effets du paiement dans l'ordre :
        1. retrait de l'écriture comptable (refusé si exercice clôturé) ;
        2. recalcul de ``invoice.paid_amount`` et du statut de la facture
           liée (symétrique de ``create_payment``) ;
        3. statut ``draft`` — seule condition de suppression autorisée.
        """
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Payment).where(Payment.id == payment_id).with_for_update()
        )
        payment = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if payment is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Paiement {payment_id} introuvable")
        if payment.status == PaymentStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Ce paiement est déjà en brouillon.")

        # 1. Vérification puis retrait de l'écriture (gardiens AVANT mutation)
        await self._assert_posting_reversible(payment)
        await self._drop_posting(payment)

        # 2. Recalcul de la facture liée
        if payment.invoice_id:
            from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

            invoice = await self.session.get(Invoice, payment.invoice_id)
            if invoice is not None:
                new_paid = max(
                    float(invoice.paid_amount or 0) - float(payment.amount or 0),
                    0.0,
                )
                invoice.paid_amount = new_paid
                if invoice.status not in (
                    InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value,
                    InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value,
                ):
                    invoice.status = (
                        InvoiceStatus.POSTED.value
                        if new_paid <= 0
                        else InvoiceStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID.value
                    )

        # 3. Statut
        old_status = payment.status
        payment.status = PaymentStatus.DRAFT.value

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "payment.back_to_draft",
            "payment",
            payment.id,
            company_id=payment.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={"status": old_status},
            new_values={"status": PaymentStatus.DRAFT.value},
        )
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(payment)
        logger.info("Paiement %s remis en brouillon", payment.reference)
        return payment

    async def confirm(self, payment_id: int, user_id: int | None = None) -> Payment:
        """Re-confirme un paiement en brouillon — symétrique de ``back_to_draft``.

        1. re-jeu des contrôles métier (facture liée : existence, statut,
           sur-paiement — la facture a pu changer depuis la révocation) ;
        2. statut ``paid`` + recrédit de ``invoice.paid_amount`` ;
        3. recréation de l'écriture comptable (``post_payment`` idempotent) ;
        4. trace d'audit.
        """
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Payment).where(Payment.id == payment_id).with_for_update()
        )
        payment = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if payment is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Paiement {payment_id} introuvable")
        if payment.status != PaymentStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Ce paiement n'est pas en brouillon — rien à confirmer.")

        amount = float(payment.amount or 0)
        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Le montant du paiement doit être strictement positif")

        # 1. Contrôles sur la facture liée (uniquement pour un encaissement)
        is_receipt = payment.direction == "in"
        invoice = None
        if payment.invoice_id and is_receipt:
            from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

            invoice = await self.session.get(Invoice, payment.invoice_id)
            if invoice is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Facture liée introuvable — elle a été supprimée. "
                    "Supprimez ce paiement pour lever l'incohérence."
                )
            if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value:
                raise ValueError("Impossible d'encaisser une facture annulée")
            if invoice.status == InvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible d'encaisser une facture en brouillon — "
                    "confirmez-la d'abord"
                )
            due = float(invoice.amount_total or 0) - float(invoice.paid_amount or 0)
            if amount > due + self.OVERPAYMENT_TOLERANCE:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Sur-paiement refusé : reste dû = {due:.2f}, "
                    f"paiement demandé = {amount:.2f}"
                )
        elif payment.invoice_id:
            from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

            invoice = await self.session.get(Invoice, payment.invoice_id)

        # 2. Statut + effet sur la facture (symétrique de back_to_draft)
        old_status = payment.status
        payment.status = PaymentStatus.PAID.value
        if invoice is not None:
            invoice.paid_amount = float(invoice.paid_amount or 0) + amount
            if float(invoice.amount_due) <= 0:
                invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.PAID.value
            else:
                invoice.status = InvoiceStatus.PARTIALLY_PAID.value
            if invoice.company_id:
                payment.company_id = invoice.company_id

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "payment.confirm",
            "payment",
            payment.id,
            company_id=payment.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={"status": old_status},
            new_values={"status": PaymentStatus.PAID.value},
        )
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(payment)

        # 3. Comptabilisation (idempotente) — défensive, même garde que create
        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            await PostingService(self.session).post_payment(payment)
            await self.session.commit()
            await self.session.refresh(payment)
        except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — défensif
            logger.exception(
                "Comptabilisation automatique impossible pour le paiement %s",
                payment.reference,
            )
            await self.session.rollback()

        logger.info("Paiement %s re-confirmé", payment.reference)
        return payment

    async def delete_payment(
        self, payment_id: int, user_id: int | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Supprime un paiement — brouillon uniquement.

        Garde-fous (cascade) : statut ``draft`` obligatoire (donc remise au
        brouillon préalable) et plus aucune écriture comptable rattachée.
        """
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Payment).where(Payment.id == payment_id).with_for_update()
        )
        payment = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if payment is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Paiement {payment_id} introuvable")
        if payment.status != PaymentStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError(
                "Seul un paiement au statut « brouillon » peut être supprimé "
                "— remettez-le d'abord au brouillon "
                f"(statut actuel : {payment.status})."
            )

        # Défense en profondeur : l'écriture a été retirée à la remise au brouillon
        from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

        if payment.company_id is not None:
            entry = await PostingService(self.session).find_by_source(
                payment.company_id, "payment", payment.id
            )
            if entry is not None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : une écriture comptable est encore rattachée "
                    "à ce paiement."
                )

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "payment.deleted",
            "payment",
            payment.id,
            company_id=payment.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={
                "reference": payment.reference,
                "status": payment.status,
                "amount": float(payment.amount or 0),
                "payment_date": str(payment.payment_date),
                "invoice_id": payment.invoice_id,
                "partner_id": payment.partner_id,
            },
        )
        await self.session.delete(payment)
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Paiement %s supprimé", payment.reference)
````

````python
"""
API Routes du module Achats (fournisseurs) — Endpoints publics.

   /purchases
   - Fournisseurs  : GET/POST /suppliers, /{id}, /{id}/category, /{id}/ratings
   - Demandes      : GET/POST /requests, /{id}, /{id}/{action}
   - Commandes     : GET/POST /orders, /{id}, /{id}/lines, /{id}/convert-from-request
   - Réceptions    : GET/POST /receptions, /{id}, /{id}/validate
   - Factures      : GET/POST /invoices, /{id}, /{id}/match, /{id}/post, /{id}/pay
   - Suggestions   : GET /suggestions?query=&product_id=&warehouse_id=
   - Rapprochement : GET /reconciliation?order_id=&invoice_id=

Paramètres : ``skip``/``limit`` pour la pagination, ``transaction_date``
pour filtrer les documents dont la date est comprise dans une plage.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter

from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_invoices import router as invoices_router
from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_orders import router as orders_router
from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_receptions import router as receptions_router
from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_reconciliation import (
    router as reconciliation_router,
)
from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_requests import router as requests_router
from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_suggestions import router as suggestions_router
from app.modules.purchases.api.routes_suppliers import router as suppliers_router

router = APIRouter()

router.include_router(suppliers_router)
router.include_router(requests_router)
router.include_router(orders_router)
router.include_router(receptions_router)
router.include_router(invoices_router)
router.include_router(suggestions_router)
router.include_router(reconciliation_router)

routers = [router]

__all__ = [
    "router",
    "routers",
    "suppliers_router",
    "requests_router",
    "orders_router",
````

````python
    "/orders/{order_id}/pdf",
    response_class=StreamingResponse,
)
async def download_order_pdf(
    order_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: None = Depends(require_view),
):
    """PDF du bon de commande fournisseur — téléchargement direct (WeasyPrint)."""
    import io

    from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

    from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder
    from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine
    from app.core.documents.naming import content_disposition

    try:
        context = await ContextBuilder().build_purchase_order_context(order_id)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Bon de commande introuvable."
        )
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    path = await engine.arender_purchase_order(order_id)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    return StreamingResponse(
        io.BytesIO(data),
        media_type="application/pdf",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": content_disposition(
                context.get("doc_filename") or "document.pdf"
            )
        },
    )
````

````python
"""
API Routes Rapprochement 3 voies (BC × BR × facture).

    GET /purchases/reconciliation?order_id=&invoice_id=
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.modules.purchases.services.supplier_invoice_service import SupplierInvoiceService

router = APIRouter()

require_view = require_permission("purchase_invoice", "view")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Rapprochement
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@router.get("/reconciliation")
async def reconciliation(
    session: SessionDep,
    order_id: int | None = None,
    invoice_id: int | None = None,
    _: None = Depends(require_view),
):
    """Calcule le rapprochement BC × BR × facture.

    On fournit soit ``invoice_id`` (le rapprochement est calculé pour cette
    facture), soit ``order_id`` (on regroupe les factures liées à la
    commande, si plusieurs factures existent).
    """
    if invoice_id is None and order_id is None:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=400,
            detail="Paramètres requis : ``invoice_id`` ou ``order_id``.",
        )

    service = SupplierInvoiceService(session)

    if invoice_id is not None:
        return await service.matching(invoice_id)

    # Regroupement par commande : on récupère les factures liées à la BC,
    # puis on fait le rapprochement pour chacune d'elles.
    invoices = await service.list_invoices(supplier_id=None)
    matching_invoices = [
        inv for inv in invoices if inv.order_id == order_id and inv.status in ("draft", "posted")
    ]
    if not matching_invoices:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=404,
            detail="Aucune facture liée à cette commande.",
        )

    results = []
    for invoice in matching_invoices:
        result = await service.matching(invoice.id)
        results.append(
            {
                "invoice_id": invoice.id,
                "invoice_number": invoice.reference,
                "status": result.status,
                "ordered_total": result.ordered_total,
                "invoiced_total": result.invoiced_total,
                "lines": result.lines,
            }
        )

    return {
        "order_id": order_id,
        "items": results,
    }
````

## File: backend/app/modules/purchases/api/routes_suggestions.py
````python
"""
API Routes Suggestions — recherche/fournisseurs pour la saisie.

    GET /purchases/suggestions?query=&category_id=&product_id=&warehouse_id=
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.modules.purchases.schemas import PriceHistoryEntry, SupplierSuggest
from app.modules.purchases.services.supplier_service import SupplierService

router = APIRouter()

require_view = require_permission("purchase", "view")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Suggestions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@router.get("/suggestions", response_model=list[SupplierSuggest])
async def suggest_products(
    session: SessionDep,
    query: str | None = None,
    category_id: int | None = None,
    product_id: int | None = None,
    warehouse_id: int | None = None,
    _: None = Depends(require_view),
):
    """Retourne une liste de fournisseurs/tendance de prix.

    Si ``category_id`` est fourni, on utilise le tri par note de la
    suggestion de catégorie (``suggest_for_category``). Sinon, un simple
    rattachement par recherche textuelle (``query``) est proposé.
    ``warehouse_id`` est retenu pour la compatibilité avec la couche
    frontend (il n'influence pas la sélection des fournisseurs).
    """
    service = SupplierService(session)

    if category_id is not None:
        return await service.suggest_for_category(
            category_id=category_id, product_id=product_id
        )

    if not query:
        # Aucun critère : retour vide (frontend peut afficher une zone
        # de recherche vide).
        return []

    suppliers = await service.list_suppliers(search=query, limit=100)

    # Derniers prix connus par fournisseur pour le produit demandé.
    last_prices: dict[int, float] = {}
    if product_id is not None:
        history = await service.price_history(product_id=product_id)
        for entry in history:
            if entry.supplier_id is not None and entry.supplier_id not in last_prices:
                last_prices[entry.supplier_id] = float(entry.unit_price)

    return [
        SupplierSuggest(
            id=s.id,
            name=s.name,
            rating=s.rating,
            delivery_days=s.delivery_days,
            last_price=last_prices.get(s.id),
        )
        for s in suppliers
    ]
````

````python
"""
API Routes Fournisseurs — annuaire, catégories, notation et suggestions.

   GET    /purchases/suppliers
   GET    /purchases/suppliers/{supplier_id}
   PUT    /purchases/suppliers/{supplier_id}
   DELETE /purchases/suppliers/{supplier_id}
   GET    /purchases/suppliers/{supplier_id}/rating
   POST   /purchases/suppliers/{supplier_id}/rating
   GET    /purchases/suggestions?category_id=&product_id=
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_active_user
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.purchases.schemas import (
    SupplierCreate,
    SupplierRead,
    SupplierSuggest,
    SupplierUpdate,
)
from app.modules.purchases.services.supplier_service import SupplierService

router = APIRouter()


def _require_view() -> None:
    return Depends(require_permission("purchase", "view"))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Annuaire
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@router.get("/suppliers", response_model=list[SupplierRead])
async def list_suppliers(
    session: SessionDep,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
    search: str | None = None,
    category_id: int | None = None,
    is_active: bool | None = None,
    _: None = _require_view(),
):
    service = SupplierService(session)
    return await service.list_suppliers(
        skip=skip, limit=limit, search=search, category_id=category_id, is_active=is_active
    )


@router.get("/suppliers/{supplier_id}", response_model=SupplierRead)
async def get_supplier(
    supplier_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: None = _require_view(),
):
    service = SupplierService(session)
    supplier = await service.get_supplier(supplier_id)
    if supplier is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fournisseur introuvable.")
    return supplier


@router.post(
    "/suppliers",
    response_model=SupplierRead,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
)
async def create_supplier(
    body: SupplierCreate,
    session: SessionDep,
    user = Depends(require_permission("purchase", "create")),
):
    service = SupplierService(session)
    supplier = await service.create_supplier(body, company_id=user.company_id)
    return supplier


@router.put("/suppliers/{supplier_id}", response_model=SupplierRead)
async def update_supplier(
    supplier_id: int,
    body: SupplierUpdate,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: None = Depends(require_permission("purchase", "edit")),
):
    service = SupplierService(session)
    try:
        supplier = await service.update_supplier(supplier_id, body)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    if supplier is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fournisseur introuvable.")
    return supplier


@router.delete("/suppliers/{supplier_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_supplier(
    supplier_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: None = Depends(require_permission("purchase", "delete")),
):
    service = SupplierService(session)
    try:
        await service.delete_supplier(supplier_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Évaluation
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@router.get("/suppliers/{supplier_id}/rating")
async def get_supplier_rating(
    supplier_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: None = _require_view(),
) -> dict[str, float | None]:
    service = SupplierService(session)
    supplier = await service.get_supplier(supplier_id)
    if supplier is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fournisseur introuvable.")
    return {"supplier_id": supplier.id, "rating": supplier.rating}


@router.post("/suppliers/{supplier_id}/rating", response_model=SupplierRead)
async def set_supplier_rating(
    supplier_id: int,
    body: dict[str, float],
    session: SessionDep,
    _: None = Depends(require_permission("purchase", "edit")),
):
    if "rating" not in body:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Champ 'rating' manquant (1-5).")
    rating = float(body["rating"])
    if not (1.0 <= rating <= 5.0):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="La note doit être entre 1 et 5.")
    service = SupplierService(session)
    try:
        supplier = await service.set_rating(supplier_id, rating)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    if supplier is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Fournisseur introuvable.")
    return supplier


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Suggestions BC (saisie intelligente)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@router.get("/suppliers/suggestions", response_model=list[SupplierSuggest])
async def suggest_suppliers(
    session: SessionDep,
    category_id: int | None = None,
    product_id: int | None = None,
    _: None = _require_view(),
):
    """Fournisseurs d'une catégorie, triés par note, avec dernier prix connu.

    ``product_id`` (optionnel) restreint les suggestions au produit demandé.
    """
    service = SupplierService(session)
    return await service.suggest_for_category(category_id=category_id, product_id=product_id)
````

## File: backend/app/modules/purchases/models/__init__.py
````python
"""
Modèles du module Achats — demandes d'achat, bons de commande,
réceptions et factures fournisseur.

Workflow (PRD Module Achats V1) :
    DA  : draft → submitted → approved/rejected → converted (→ BC)
    BC  : draft → pending → confirmed → partially_received → received/done
    BR  : draft → validated (→ mouvement de stock INBOUND)
    FA  : draft → posted (→ écriture comptable) → paid
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy import JSON, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, Numeric, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, mapped_column, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import Product
from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import Warehouse
from app.shared.enums import (
    PurchaseOrderStatus,
    PurchaseReceptionStatus,
    PurchaseRequestStatus,
    SupplierInvoiceStatus,
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Demande d'Achat (DA)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
class PurchaseRequest(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Demande d'achat soumise par un demandeur, validée par un acheteur."""

    number: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    requester_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )
    validator_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )
    supplier_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("partners.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )

    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=PurchaseRequestStatus.DRAFT.value, index=True
    )
    priority: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(10), default="normal")

    request_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, default=date.today)
    needed_by: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date)
    submitted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime)
    validated_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime)
    rejection_reason: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

    # Montant estimé (re-calculé depuis les lignes)
    estimated_total: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

    lines: Mapped[list["PurchaseRequestLine"]] = relationship(
        "PurchaseRequestLine", back_populates="request",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    requester: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        User, foreign_keys=[requester_id], lazy="selectin"
    )
    validator: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        User, foreign_keys=[validator_id], lazy="selectin"
    )
    supplier: Mapped["Partner | None"] = relationship(Partner, lazy="selectin")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PurchaseRequest {self.number} [{self.status}]>"


class PurchaseRequestLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne d'une demande d'achat."""

    request_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_requests.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("products.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(500))
    quantity: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    unit: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(30))
    estimated_unit_price: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    request: Mapped["PurchaseRequest"] = relationship("PurchaseRequest", back_populates="lines")
    product: Mapped["Product | None"] = relationship(Product, lazy="selectin")

    @property
    def subtotal(self) -> float:
        return float(self.quantity) * float(self.estimated_unit_price)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PurchaseRequestLine req={self.request_id} qty={self.quantity}>"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Bon de Commande (BC)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
class PurchaseOrder(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Bon de commande fournisseur."""

    number: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    supplier_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("partners.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    origin_request_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_requests.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )

    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(30), default=PurchaseOrderStatus.DRAFT.value, index=True
    )
    order_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, default=date.today)
    expected_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date)

    currency_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), default="XOF")

    # Totaux recalculés depuis les lignes
    amount_untaxed: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_amount: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    amount_total: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    payment_terms_days: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)
    confirmed_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime)
    cancelled_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime)

    lines: Mapped[list["PurchaseOrderLine"]] = relationship(
        "PurchaseOrderLine", back_populates="order",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    supplier: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship(Partner, lazy="selectin")
    receptions: Mapped[list["PurchaseReception"]] = relationship(
        "PurchaseReception", back_populates="order", lazy="selectin"
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PurchaseOrder {self.number} [{self.status}]>"


class PurchaseOrderLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne d'un bon de commande fournisseur."""

    order_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_orders.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("products.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(500))
    quantity: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    quantity_received: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    unit: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(30))
    unit_price: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_rate: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 2), default=0)  # %
    discount_percent: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(6, 2), default=0)

    order: Mapped["PurchaseOrder"] = relationship("PurchaseOrder", back_populates="lines")
    product: Mapped["Product | None"] = relationship(Product, lazy="selectin")

    @property
    def subtotal(self) -> float:
        base = float(self.quantity) * float(self.unit_price)
        if self.discount_percent:
            base *= 1 - float(self.discount_percent) / 100
        return base

    @property
    def tax_amount(self) -> float:
        return self.subtotal * float(self.tax_rate) / 100

    @property
    def total(self) -> float:
        return self.subtotal + self.tax_amount

    @property
    def quantity_remaining(self) -> float:
        return max(float(self.quantity) - float(self.quantity_received), 0.0)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PurchaseOrderLine order={self.order_id} qty={self.quantity}>"


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Bon de Réception (BR)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
class PurchaseReception(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Bon de réception fournisseur — alimente le stock à la validation."""

    number: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    order_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_orders.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    warehouse_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("warehouses.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"), nullable=False
    )
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(20), default=PurchaseReceptionStatus.DRAFT.value, index=True
    )
    reception_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, default=date.today)
    validated_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime)
    received_by: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

    lines: Mapped[list["PurchaseReceptionLine"]] = relationship(
        "PurchaseReceptionLine", back_populates="reception",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    order: Mapped["PurchaseOrder"] = relationship("PurchaseOrder", back_populates="receptions")
    warehouse: Mapped["Warehouse"] = relationship(Warehouse, lazy="selectin")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PurchaseReception {self.number} [{self.status}]>"


class PurchaseReceptionLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne d'un bon de réception — référencée à la ligne de BC."""

    reception_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_receptions.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    order_line_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_order_lines.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("products.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(500))
    quantity: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    unit_cost: Mapped[float | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4))

    reception: Mapped["PurchaseReception"] = relationship(
        "PurchaseReception", back_populates="lines"
    )
    order_line: Mapped["PurchaseOrderLine | None"] = relationship(
        "PurchaseOrderLine", lazy="selectin"
    )
    product: Mapped["Product | None"] = relationship(Product, lazy="selectin")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<PurchaseReceptionLine reception={self.reception_id} qty={self.quantity}>"




# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Facture fournisseur
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
class SupplierInvoice(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Facture fournisseur — rapprochée avec BC et BR (3 voies)."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    supplier_invoice_number: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(50))  # n° éditeur
    supplier_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("partners.id", ondelete="RESTRICT"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    order_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_orders.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )
    reception_id: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("purchase_receptions.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True
    )

    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        String(20), default=SupplierInvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value, index=True
    )
    invoice_date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, default=date.today)
    due_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date)
    currency_code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(3), default="XOF")

    amount_untaxed: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_amount: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    amount_total: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    paid_amount: Mapped[float] = mapped_column(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    # Rapprochement 3 voies — résultat du dernier contrôle
    matching_status: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(20))
    matching_details: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSON)

    posted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text)

    lines: Mapped[list["SupplierInvoiceLine"]] = relationship(
        "SupplierInvoiceLine", back_populates="invoice",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )
    supplier: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship(Partner, lazy="selectin")
    order: Mapped["PurchaseOrder | None"] = relationship("PurchaseOrder", lazy="selectin")

    @property
    def amount_due(self) -> float:
        return max(float(self.amount_total) - float(self.paid_amount), 0.0)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<SupplierInvoice {self.reference} [{self.status}]>"


class SupplierInvoiceLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne d'une facture fournisseur."""
````
