## File: backend/app/modules/purchases/services/order_service.py
````python
"""
Service Bon de Commande (BC) — CRUD, workflow, conversion depuis DA.

Workflow (enum ``PurchaseOrderStatus``) :
    draft → pending → confirmed → partially_received → received → done
    draft / pending → cancelled

La conversion d'une demande approuvée crée un BC brouillon pré-rempli
(``origin_request_id`` tracé), sans consommer de stock.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.purchases.models import (
    PurchaseOrder,
    PurchaseOrderLine,
    PurchaseRequest,
)
from app.modules.purchases.schemas import (
    PurchaseOrderCreate,
    PurchaseOrderUpdate,
)
from app.shared.enums import PurchaseOrderStatus, PurchaseRequestStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _recompute_totals(order: PurchaseOrder) -> None:
    """Recalcule les totaux de l'en-tête depuis les lignes."""
    untaxed = sum(line.subtotal for line in order.lines)
    tax = sum(line.tax_amount for line in order.lines)
    order.amount_untaxed = untaxed
    order.amount_total = untaxed + tax
    order.tax_amount = tax


class OrderService:
    """Gestion des bons de commande fournisseur."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_orders(
        self,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 100,
        status: str | None = None,
        supplier_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[PurchaseOrder]:
        stmt = select(PurchaseOrder).options(
            selectinload(PurchaseOrder.lines),
            selectinload(PurchaseOrder.supplier),
        )
        if status:
            stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseOrder.status == status)
        if supplier_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseOrder.supplier_id == supplier_id)
        stmt = stmt.order_by(PurchaseOrder.id.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_order(self, order_id: int) -> PurchaseOrder | None:
        stmt = (
            select(PurchaseOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(PurchaseOrder.lines).selectinload(PurchaseOrderLine.product),
                selectinload(PurchaseOrder.supplier),
                selectinload(PurchaseOrder.receptions),
            )
            .where(PurchaseOrder.id == order_id)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalars().first()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Écriture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_order(
        self, data: PurchaseOrderCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> PurchaseOrder:
        if not data.lines:
            raise ValueError("Le bon de commande doit comporter au moins une ligne.")

        number = await self.sequences.next_value("purchase_order", "BC")
        order = PurchaseOrder(
            number=number,
            supplier_id=data.supplier_id,
            origin_request_id=data.origin_request_id,
            status=PurchaseOrderStatus.DRAFT.value,
            order_date=data.order_date,
            expected_date=data.expected_date,
            currency_code=data.currency_code,
            payment_terms_days=data.payment_terms_days,
            notes=data.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(order)

        # Lignes rattachées via la collection (`lines.append`) : un `session.add`
        # avec `order_id=` laisserait `order.lines` non chargée → lazy-load async
        # (MissingGreenlet) dans `_recompute_totals` et la sérialisation réponse.
        for line_data in data.lines:
            tax_rate = line_data.tax_rate or data.tax_percent
            order.lines.append(
                PurchaseOrderLine(
                    product_id=line_data.product_id,
                    description=line_data.description,
                    quantity=line_data.quantity,
                    unit=line_data.unit,
                    unit_price=line_data.unit_price,
                    tax_rate=tax_rate,
                    discount_percent=line_data.discount_percent,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )

        _recompute_totals(order)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(order)
        logger.info("BC %s créée (%s)", number, order.status)
        return order


    async def update_order(
        self, order_id: int, data: PurchaseOrderUpdate
    ) -> PurchaseOrder | None:
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            return None
        if order.status != PurchaseOrderStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Seul un bon de commande brouillon peut être modifié.")

        for field in ("supplier_id", "order_date", "expected_date",
                      "currency_code", "payment_terms_days", "notes"):
            value = getattr(data, field, None)
            if value is not None:
                setattr(order, field, value)

        if data.lines is not None:
            if not data.lines:
                raise ValueError("Le bon de commande doit comporter au moins une ligne.")
            order.lines.clear()
            await self.session.flush()
            for line_data in data.lines:
                order.lines.append(
                    PurchaseOrderLine(
                        product_id=line_data.product_id,
                        description=line_data.description,
                        quantity=line_data.quantity,
                        unit=line_data.unit,
                        unit_price=line_data.unit_price,
                        tax_rate=line_data.tax_rate,
                        discount_percent=line_data.discount_percent,
                        company_id=order.company_id,
                    )
                )

        _recompute_totals(order)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(order)
        return order

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Workflow
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def submit(self, order_id: int) -> PurchaseOrder | None:
        """Brouillon → en attente de confirmation."""
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            return None
        if order.status != PurchaseOrderStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Seul un brouillon peut être soumis.")
        order.status = PurchaseOrderStatus.PENDING.value
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(order)
        return order

    async def confirm(self, order_id: int) -> PurchaseOrder | None:
        """Confirmation — la BC est validée et peut être réceptionnée."""
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            return None
        if order.status not in (
            PurchaseOrderStatus.DRAFT.value,
            PurchaseOrderStatus.PENDING.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError("Seul un brouillon ou une demande en attente peut être confirmée.")
        order.status = PurchaseOrderStatus.CONFIRMED.value
        order.confirmed_at = datetime.utcnow()
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(order)
        logger.info("BC %s confirmée", order.number)
        return order

    async def cancel(self, order_id: int) -> PurchaseOrder | None:
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            return None
        if order.status in (
            PurchaseOrderStatus.RECEIVED.value,
            PurchaseOrderStatus.DONE.value,
            PurchaseOrderStatus.CANCELLED.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError("Cette commande ne peut plus être annulée.")
        order.status = PurchaseOrderStatus.CANCELLED.value
        order.cancelled_at = datetime.utcnow()
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(order)
        logger.info("BC %s annulée", order.number)
        return order



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Conversion depuis une demande approuvée
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def convert_from_request(
        self, request_id: int, company_id: int
    ) -> PurchaseOrder:
        """Crée un BC brouillon à partir d'une DA approuvée."""
        request = await self.session.get(PurchaseRequest, request_id)
        if request is None:
            raise ValueError("Demande d'achat introuvable.")
        if request.status != PurchaseRequestStatus.APPROVED.value:
            raise ValueError("Seule une demande approuvée peut être convertie.")

        supplier_id = request.supplier_id
        if supplier_id is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "La demande n'a pas de fournisseur — choisissez-en un avant conversion."
            )

        number = await self.sequences.next_value("purchase_order", "BC")
        order = PurchaseOrder(
            number=number,
            supplier_id=supplier_id,
            origin_request_id=request.id,
            status=PurchaseOrderStatus.DRAFT.value,
            order_date=request.needed_by or request.request_date,
            expected_date=request.needed_by,
            notes=request.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )

        for req_line in request.lines:
            order.lines.append(
                PurchaseOrderLine(
                    product_id=req_line.product_id,
                    description=req_line.description,
                    quantity=req_line.quantity,
                    unit=req_line.unit,
                    unit_price=req_line.estimated_unit_price,
                    tax_rate=0,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )

        self.session.add(order)
        _recompute_totals(order)
        request.status = PurchaseRequestStatus.CONVERTED.value
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(order)
        logger.info("Demande %s convertie en BC %s", request.number, number)
        return order

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Réception (appelé par ReceptionService)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def refresh_receipt_status(self, order_id: int) -> None:
        """Recalcule le statut BC d'après les quantités reçues."""
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            return
        if order.status not in (
            PurchaseOrderStatus.CONFIRMED.value,
            PurchaseOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_RECEIVED.value,
            PurchaseOrderStatus.RECEIVED.value,
        ):
            return
        if not order.lines:
            return
        all_received = all(
            float(l.quantity_received) >= float(l.quantity) for l in order.lines
        )
        any_received = any(float(l.quantity_received) > 0 for l in order.lines)
        if all_received:
            order.status = PurchaseOrderStatus.RECEIVED.value
        elif any_received:
            order.status = PurchaseOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_RECEIVED.value
        await self.session.commit()
````

## File: backend/app/modules/purchases/services/reception_service.py
````python
"""
Service Bon de Réception (BR) — création depuis un BC, validation → stock.

À la validation :
- création des mouvements de stock ``inbound`` (StockService) ;
- mise à jour de ``quantity_received`` sur les lignes de BC ;
- recalcul du statut BC (partiellement/totalement reçu).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.modules.purchases.models import (
    PurchaseOrder,
    PurchaseOrderLine,
    PurchaseReception,
    PurchaseReceptionLine,
)
from app.modules.purchases.schemas import PurchaseReceptionCreate
from app.modules.stock.services.stock_service import StockService
from app.shared.enums import PurchaseOrderStatus, PurchaseReceptionStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ReceptionService:
    """Gestion des réceptions fournisseur."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_receptions(
        self,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 100,
        order_id: int | None = None,
        status: str | None = None,
    ) -> list[PurchaseReception]:
        stmt = select(PurchaseReception).options(
            selectinload(PurchaseReception.lines),
            selectinload(PurchaseReception.order),
            selectinload(PurchaseReception.warehouse),
        )
        if order_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseReception.order_id == order_id)
        if status:
            stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseReception.status == status)
        stmt = stmt.order_by(PurchaseReception.id.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_reception(self, reception_id: int) -> PurchaseReception | None:
        stmt = (
            select(PurchaseReception)
            .options(
                selectinload(PurchaseReception.lines),
                selectinload(PurchaseReception.order),
                selectinload(PurchaseReception.warehouse),
            )
            .where(PurchaseReception.id == reception_id)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalars().first()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Écriture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_reception(
        self, data: PurchaseReceptionCreate, company_id: int, user_id: int
    ) -> PurchaseReception:
        """Crée un BR brouillon depuis un BC confirmé."""
        order = await self.session.get(PurchaseOrder, data.order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("Bon de commande introuvable.")
        if order.status not in (
            PurchaseOrderStatus.CONFIRMED.value,
            PurchaseOrderStatus.PARTIALLY_RECEIVED.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une commande confirmée peut être réceptionnée."
            )
        if not data.lines:
            raise ValueError("Le bon de réception doit comporter au moins une ligne.")

        # Contrôle : quantité ≤ restante à réceptionner
        remaining: dict[int, float] = {}
        for line in order.lines:
            remaining[line.id] = line.quantity_remaining
        for line_data in data.lines:
            if line_data.order_line_id is not None:
                rest = remaining.get(line_data.order_line_id)
                if rest is None:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Ligne de commande {line_data.order_line_id} inconnue "
                        "pour cette commande."
                    )
                if float(line_data.quantity) > rest + 1e-9:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Quantité {line_data.quantity} supérieure au reste "
                        f"à réceptionner ({rest})."
                    )

        number = await self.sequences.next_value("purchase_reception", "BR")
        reception = PurchaseReception(
            number=number,
            order_id=order.id,
            warehouse_id=data.warehouse_id,
            status=PurchaseReceptionStatus.DRAFT.value,
            reception_date=data.reception_date,
            received_by=user_id,
            notes=data.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        for line_data in data.lines:
            reception.lines.append(
                PurchaseReceptionLine(
                    order_line_id=line_data.order_line_id,
                    product_id=line_data.product_id,
                    description=line_data.description,
                    quantity=line_data.quantity,
                    unit_cost=line_data.unit_cost,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )

        self.session.add(reception)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(reception)
        logger.info("BR %s créée (BC %s)", number, order.number)
        return reception


    async def validate(self, reception_id: int) -> PurchaseReception | None:
        """Validation → mouvements de stock + mise à jour de la BC."""
        reception = await self.get_reception(reception_id)
        if reception is None:
            return None
        if reception.status != PurchaseReceptionStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Seul un brouillon peut être validé.")
        if not reception.lines:
            raise ValueError("Le bon de réception est vide.")

        order = await self.session.get(PurchaseOrder, reception.order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError("Bon de commande introuvable.")

        stock = StockService(self.session)

        for line in reception.lines:
            # 1. Mouvement de stock entrant
            if line.product_id is not None:
                await stock.record_movement(
                    movement_type="inbound",
                    warehouse_id=reception.warehouse_id,
                    product_id=line.product_id,
                    quantity=float(line.quantity),
                    unit_cost=float(line.unit_cost) if line.unit_cost else None,
                    reference_document="purchase_reception",
                    reference_id=reception.id,
                    notes=f"Réception {reception.number} — BC {order.number}",
                )
            # 2. Mise à jour de la ligne de BC
            if line.order_line_id is not None:
                po_line = await self.session.get(
                    PurchaseOrderLine, line.order_line_id
                )
                if po_line is not None:
                    po_line.quantity_received = float(
                        po_line.quantity_received
                    ) + float(line.quantity)

        reception.status = PurchaseReceptionStatus.VALIDATED.value
        reception.validated_at = datetime.utcnow()
        await self.session.commit()

        # 3. Recalcul du statut de la commande
        from app.modules.purchases.services.order_service import OrderService

        await OrderService(self.session).refresh_receipt_status(order.id)
        await self.session.refresh(reception)
        logger.info("BR %s validée — stock incrémenté", reception.number)
        return reception
````

## File: backend/app/modules/purchases/services/request_service.py
````python
"""
Service Demande d'Achat (DA) — workflow de validation.

Règles (PRD Module Achats V1) :
- création par tout utilisateur ``purchase:create`` ;
- ``submitted`` → ``approved`` / ``rejected`` (permission ``purchase:approve``) ;
- le montant estimé au-dessus du seuil ``purchase_approval_threshold``
  (paramètre réglable, défaut 500 000 FCFA) est signalé ``above_threshold``
  pour les circuits de validation hiérarchique ;
- ``approved`` → convertible en Bon de commande.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.core.services.setting_service import SettingService
from app.modules.purchases.models import (
    PurchaseRequest,
    PurchaseRequestLine,
)
from app.modules.purchases.schemas import (
    PurchaseRequestCreate,
    PurchaseRequestUpdate,
)
from app.shared.enums import PurchaseRequestStatus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

DEFAULT_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = 500_000  # FCFA


class RequestService:
    """Workflow des demandes d'achat."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Paramètres
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def approval_threshold(self) -> int:
        """Seuil de validation hiérarchique (réglable dans Settings)."""
        raw = await SettingService(self.session).get(
            "purchase_approval_threshold", None
        )
        try:
            return int(raw) if raw is not None else DEFAULT_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return DEFAULT_APPROVAL_THRESHOLD

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_requests(
        self,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 100,
        status: str | None = None,
        requester_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[PurchaseRequest]:
        stmt = select(PurchaseRequest).options(
            selectinload(PurchaseRequest.lines),
            selectinload(PurchaseRequest.supplier),
            selectinload(PurchaseRequest.requester),
        )
        if status:
            stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseRequest.status == status)
        if requester_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(PurchaseRequest.requester_id == requester_id)
        stmt = stmt.order_by(PurchaseRequest.id.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)

        stmt = (

            .options(

                selectinload(PurchaseRequest.requester),
                selectinload(PurchaseRequest.validator),
            )
            .where(PurchaseRequest.id == request_id)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalars().first()

    # Écriture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_request(
        self, data: PurchaseRequestCreate, company_id: int, user_id: int
    ) -> PurchaseRequest:
        if not data.lines:
            raise ValueError("La demande d'achat doit comporter au moins une ligne.")

        number = await self.sequences.next_value("purchase_request", "DA")
        request = PurchaseRequest(
            number=number,
            requester_id=user_id,
            supplier_id=data.supplier_id,
            status=PurchaseRequestStatus.DRAFT.value,
            priority=data.priority,
            request_date=data.request_date,
            needed_by=data.needed_by,
            notes=data.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(request)

        for line_data in data.lines:
            request.lines.append(
                PurchaseRequestLine(
                    product_id=line_data.product_id,
                    description=line_data.description,
                    quantity=line_data.quantity,
                    unit=line_data.unit,
                    estimated_unit_price=line_data.estimated_unit_price,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )

        await self._refresh_totals(request)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(request)
        logger.info("Demande d'achat %s créée (%s)", number, request.status)
        return request


    async def update_request(
        self, request_id: int, data: PurchaseRequestUpdate
    ) -> PurchaseRequest | None:
        request = await self.get_request(request_id)
        if request is None:
            return None
        if request.status not in (
            PurchaseRequestStatus.DRAFT.value,
            PurchaseRequestStatus.SUBMITTED.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une demande brouillon ou soumise peut être modifiée."
            )

        for field in ("supplier_id", "priority", "needed_by", "notes"):
            value = getattr(data, field, None)
            if value is not None:
                setattr(request, field, value)

        if data.lines is not None:
            if not data.lines:
                raise ValueError("La demande d'achat doit comporter au moins une ligne.")
            request.lines.clear()
            await self.session.flush()
            for line_data in data.lines:
                request.lines.append(
                    PurchaseRequestLine(
                        product_id=line_data.product_id,
                        description=line_data.description,
                        quantity=line_data.quantity,
                        unit=line_data.unit,
                        estimated_unit_price=line_data.estimated_unit_price,
                        company_id=request.company_id,
                    )
                )

        await self._refresh_totals(request)
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(request)
        return request

    async def submit(self, request_id: int) -> PurchaseRequest | None:
        """Brouillon → soumise (en attente de validation)."""
        request = await self.get_request(request_id)
        if request is None:
            return None
        if request.status != PurchaseRequestStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Seule une demande brouillon peut être soumise.")
        request.status = PurchaseRequestStatus.SUBMITTED.value
        request.submitted_at = datetime.utcnow()
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(request)
        logger.info("Demande %s soumise", request.number)
        return request

    async def approve(
        self, request_id: int, validator_id: int
    ) -> PurchaseRequest | None:
        request = await self.get_request(request_id)
        if request is None:
            return None
        if request.status != PurchaseRequestStatus.SUBMITTED.value:
            raise ValueError("Seule une demande soumise peut être validée.")
        request.status = PurchaseRequestStatus.APPROVED.value
        request.validator_id = validator_id
        request.validated_at = datetime.utcnow()
        request.rejection_reason = None
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(request)
        logger.info("Demande %s validée", request.number)
        return request

    async def reject(
        self, request_id: int, validator_id: int, reason: str | None = None
    ) -> PurchaseRequest | None:
        request = await self.get_request(request_id)
        if request is None:
            return None
        if request.status != PurchaseRequestStatus.SUBMITTED.value:
            raise ValueError("Seule une demande soumise peut être rejetée.")
        request.status = PurchaseRequestStatus.REJECTED.value
        request.validator_id = validator_id
        request.validated_at = datetime.utcnow()
        request.rejection_reason = reason
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(request)
        logger.info("Demande %s rejetée", request.number)
        return request

    async def delete_request(self, request_id: int) -> bool:
        """Suppression — brouillon ou rejetée uniquement."""
        request = await self.get_request(request_id)
        if request is None:
            return False
        if request.status not in (
            PurchaseRequestStatus.DRAFT.value,
            PurchaseRequestStatus.REJECTED.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une demande brouillon ou rejetée peut être supprimée."
            )
        await self.session.delete(request)
        await self.session.commit()
        return True

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Internes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _refresh_totals(self, request: PurchaseRequest) -> None:
        await self.session.flush()
        total = sum(
            float(line.quantity) * float(line.estimated_unit_price)
            for line in request.lines
        )
        request.estimated_total = total

"""
Service Facture fournisseur — saisie, rapprochement 3 voies, comptabilité.

Rapprochement (BC × BR × facture) :
- ``match_ok``      : quantités et prix cohérents ;
- ``qty_diff``      : quantité facturée ≠ commandée / reçue ;
- ``price_diff``    : prix unitaire facturé ≠ prix BC ;
- ``no_reference``  : facture saisie sans BC liée.

Comptabilisation (module Accounting) :
- à ``posted`` : D 601 (achats marchandises) + D 4452 (TVA déductible)
  / C 401 (fournisseurs) — journal ACH.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.core.services.setting_service import SettingService
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.purchases.models import (

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _recompute_totals(invoice: SupplierInvoice) -> None:
    """Recalcule les totaux de la facture depuis ses lignes."""
    untaxed = sum(line.subtotal for line in invoice.lines)
    tax = sum(line.tax_amount for line in invoice.lines)
    invoice.amount_untaxed = untaxed
    invoice.tax_amount = tax
    invoice.amount_total = untaxed + tax


class SupplierInvoiceService:
    """Gestion des factures fournisseur."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Alerte régime fiscal (TEE/RME → TVA non applicable)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def tva_regime_warning(
        self, company_id: int | None, tax_amount: float | None
    ) -> str | None:
        """Alerte si le régime fiscal interdit la TVA (TEE / RME) alors qu'une
        TVA est présente sur la facture.

        Règle Phase 2 : ALERTE UNIQUEMENT — ne bloque ni la saisie ni la
        comptabilisation, ne bascule jamais de régime automatiquement.
        """
        try:
            amount = float(tax_amount or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None
        if amount <= 0 or company_id is None:
            return None

        from app.core.models.company import Company
        from app.modules.accounting.services.fiscal_regime import TaxRegimeService

        company = await self.session.get(Company, company_id)
        if company is None:
            return None
        regime = getattr(company, "tax_regime", None)
        if not TaxRegimeService.is_tva_blocked(regime):
            return None
        regime_label = regime.value if hasattr(regime, "value") else regime
        return (
            f"Régime fiscal {regime_label} : la TVA n'est pas applicable "
            f"(montant TVA saisi : {amount:.2f} FCFA). Vérifiez le régime "
            "dans Paramètres > Régime fiscal."
        )

    async def attach_tva_warning(self, invoice: SupplierInvoice) -> None:
        """Pose l'attribut non persisté `tva_regime_warning` sur la facture
        (repris par le schéma SupplierInvoiceRead)."""
        invoice.tva_regime_warning = await self.tva_regime_warning(
            invoice.company_id, invoice.tax_amount
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_invoices(
        self,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 100,
        status: str | None = None,
        supplier_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[SupplierInvoice]:
        stmt = select(SupplierInvoice).options(
            selectinload(SupplierInvoice.lines),
            selectinload(SupplierInvoice.supplier),
        )
        if status:
            stmt = stmt.where(SupplierInvoice.status == status)
        if supplier_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(SupplierInvoice.supplier_id == supplier_id)
        stmt = stmt.order_by(SupplierInvoice.id.desc()).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        invoices = list(result.scalars().all())
        for inv in invoices:
            await self.attach_tva_warning(inv)
        return invoices

    async def get_invoice(self, invoice_id: int) -> SupplierInvoice | None:
        stmt = (
            select(SupplierInvoice)
            .options(
                selectinload(SupplierInvoice.lines),
                selectinload(SupplierInvoice.supplier),
                selectinload(SupplierInvoice.order).selectinload(
                    PurchaseOrder.lines
                ),
            )
            .where(SupplierInvoice.id == invoice_id)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        invoice = result.scalars().first()
        if invoice is not None:
            await self.attach_tva_warning(invoice)
        return invoice


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Écriture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_invoice(
        self, data: SupplierInvoiceCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> SupplierInvoice:
        if not data.lines:
            raise ValueError("La facture fournisseur doit comporter au moins une ligne.")

        reference = await self.sequences.next_value("supplier_invoice", "FAF")

        # Échéance : date facture + conditions de paiement du fournisseur
        due_date = data.due_date
        if due_date is None and data.invoice_date is not None:
            supplier = await self.session.get(Partner, data.supplier_id)
            terms = getattr(supplier, "payment_terms_days", None) if supplier else None
            if terms:
                due_date = data.invoice_date + timedelta(days=terms)

        invoice = SupplierInvoice(
            reference=reference,
            supplier_invoice_number=data.supplier_invoice_number,
            supplier_id=data.supplier_id,
            order_id=data.order_id,
            reception_id=data.reception_id,
            status=SupplierInvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value,
            invoice_date=data.invoice_date or date.today(),
            due_date=due_date,
            currency_code=data.currency_code,
            notes=data.notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(invoice)

        for line_data in data.lines:
            invoice.lines.append(
                SupplierInvoiceLine(
                    order_line_id=line_data.order_line_id,
                    product_id=line_data.product_id,
                    description=line_data.description,
                    quantity=line_data.quantity,
                    unit_price=line_data.unit_price,
                    tax_rate=line_data.tax_rate,
                    company_id=company_id,
                )
            )

        _recompute_totals(invoice)
        # Rapprochement automatique si BC liée
        if data.order_id is not None:
            matching = await self._compute_matching(invoice)
            invoice.matching_status = matching.status
            invoice.matching_details = matching.model_dump()

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(invoice)
        logger.info("Facture fournisseur %s créée", reference)
        # Alerte régime fiscal TEE/RME — informative, jamais bloquante
        await self.attach_tva_warning(invoice)
        if invoice.tva_regime_warning:
            logger.warning(
                "Facture fournisseur %s : %s", reference, invoice.tva_regime_warning
            )
        return invoice

    async def update_invoice(
        self, invoice_id: int, data: SupplierInvoiceUpdate
    ) -> SupplierInvoice | None:
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            return None
        if invoice.status != SupplierInvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Seule une facture brouillon peut être modifiée.")

        for field in ("supplier_invoice_number", "invoice_date", "due_date", "notes"):
            value = getattr(data, field, None)
            if value is not None:
                setattr(invoice, field, value)

        if data.lines is not None:
            if not data.lines:
                raise ValueError("La facture fournisseur doit comporter au moins une ligne.")
            invoice.lines.clear()
            await self.session.flush()
            for line_data in data.lines:
                invoice.lines.append(
                    SupplierInvoiceLine(
                        order_line_id=line_data.order_line_id,
                        product_id=line_data.product_id,
                        description=line_data.description,
                        quantity=line_data.quantity,
                        unit_price=line_data.unit_price,
                        tax_rate=line_data.tax_rate,
                        company_id=invoice.company_id,
                    )
                )

        _recompute_totals(invoice)
        if invoice.order_id is not None:
            matching = await self._compute_matching(invoice)
            invoice.matching_status = matching.status
            invoice.matching_details = matching.model_dump()

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(invoice)
        await self.attach_tva_warning(invoice)
        return invoice



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Workflow — comptabilisation / paiement
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def post(self, invoice_id: int) -> SupplierInvoice | None:
        """Enregistre la facture et génère l'écriture comptable ACH."""
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            return None
        if invoice.status != SupplierInvoiceStatus.DRAFT.value:
            raise ValueError("Seule une facture brouillon peut être enregistrée.")

        invoice.status = SupplierInvoiceStatus.POSTED.value
        invoice.posted_at = datetime.utcnow()
        await self.session.commit()

        # Écriture comptable (idempotente — gérée par PostingService)
        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            await PostingService(self.session).post_supplier_invoice(invoice)
            await self.session.commit()
        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "Écriture comptable non générée pour la facture %s",
                invoice.reference,
            )
            await self.session.rollback()

        await self.session.refresh(invoice)
        # Alerte régime fiscal : informatif, la comptabilisation n'est JAMAIS bloquée
        await self.attach_tva_warning(invoice)
        if invoice.tva_regime_warning:
            logger.warning(
                "Comptabilisation facture %s : %s",
                invoice.reference,
                invoice.tva_regime_warning,
            )
        logger.info("Facture fournisseur %s enregistrée + comptabilisée", invoice.reference)
        return invoice

    async def pay(
        self, invoice_id: int, amount: float, payment_date: date | None = None
    ) -> SupplierInvoice | None:
        """Enregistre un règlement fournisseur (décaissement)."""
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            return None
        if invoice.status not in (
            SupplierInvoiceStatus.POSTED.value,
            SupplierInvoiceStatus.PAID.value,
        ):
            raise ValueError("Seule une facture enregistrée peut être réglée.")
        if amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Le montant du règlement doit être positif.")
        if amount > float(invoice.amount_due) + 1e-9:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Montant supérieur au reste dû ({float(invoice.amount_due):.2f})."
            )

        invoice.paid_amount = float(invoice.paid_amount) + amount
        if float(invoice.paid_amount) >= float(invoice.amount_total) - 1e-9:
            invoice.status = SupplierInvoiceStatus.PAID.value
        await self.session.commit()

        try:
            from app.modules.accounting.services.posting_service import PostingService

            await PostingService(self.session).post_supplier_payment(
                invoice, amount, payment_date or date.today()
            )
            await self.session.commit()
        except Exception:
            logger.exception(
                "Écriture de règlement non générée pour %s", invoice.reference
            )
            await self.session.rollback()

        await self.session.refresh(invoice)
        await self.attach_tva_warning(invoice)
        logger.info("Règlement %.2f enregistré sur %s", amount, invoice.reference)
        return invoice

    async def cancel(self, invoice_id: int) -> SupplierInvoice | None:
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            return None
        if invoice.status == SupplierInvoiceStatus.PAID.value:
            raise ValueError("Une facture payée ne peut pas être annulée.")
        invoice.status = SupplierInvoiceStatus.CANCELLED.value
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(invoice)
        return invoice



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Rapprochement 3 voies (BC × BR × facture)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def matching(self, invoice_id: int) -> MatchingResult:
        """Calcule le rapprochement pour la facture demandée."""
        invoice = await self.get_invoice(invoice_id)
        if invoice is None:
            raise ValueError("Facture introuvable.")
        return await self._compute_matching(invoice)

    async def _compute_matching(self, invoice: SupplierInvoice) -> MatchingResult:
        """Compare facture × BC (quantités + prix) × BR (reçu)."""
        if invoice.order_id is None:
            return MatchingResult(status="no_reference")

        # `session.get` eager-charge `lines`/`receptions` (lazy="selectin") ;
        # `invoice.order` peut être non chargé sur une facture créée en mémoire.
        order = await self.session.get(PurchaseOrder, invoice.order_id)
        if order is None:
            return MatchingResult(status="no_reference")

        po_by_id = {l.id: l for l in order.lines}
        received_by_po_line: dict[int, float] = {}
        for reception in order.receptions:
            for rline in reception.lines:
                if rline.order_line_id is not None:
                    received_by_po_line[rline.order_line_id] = (
                        received_by_po_line.get(rline.order_line_id, 0)
                        + float(rline.quantity)
                    )

        details: list[MatchingLineDetail] = []
        has_qty_diff = False
        has_price_diff = False

        for iline in invoice.lines:
            po_line = po_by_id.get(iline.order_line_id) if iline.order_line_id else None
            detail = MatchingLineDetail(
                product_id=iline.product_id,
                description=iline.description,
                invoiced_qty=float(iline.quantity),
            )
            if po_line is not None:
                detail.ordered_qty = float(po_line.quantity)
                detail.received_qty = received_by_po_line.get(po_line.id, 0.0)
                detail.po_unit_price = float(po_line.unit_price)
                detail.invoice_unit_price = float(iline.unit_price)

                if abs(float(iline.quantity) - float(po_line.quantity)) > 1e-6:
                    detail.issues.append("qty_vs_ordered")
                    has_qty_diff = True
                if abs(float(iline.quantity) - detail.received_qty) > 1e-6:
                    detail.issues.append("qty_vs_received")
                    has_qty_diff = True
                if abs(float(iline.unit_price) - float(po_line.unit_price)) > 1e-6:
                    detail.issues.append("price_diff")
                    has_price_diff = True
            else:
                detail.issues.append("no_po_line")
            details.append(detail)

        status = "match_ok"
        if has_qty_diff:
            status = "qty_diff"
        elif has_price_diff:
            status = "price_diff"

        return MatchingResult(
            status=status,
            lines=details,
            ordered_total=float(order.amount_total),
            invoiced_total=float(invoice.amount_total),
        )
````

"""
Service Fournisseurs — annuaire, classification par catégories,
évaluation et suggestions pour la saisie des BC.

Les fournisseurs sont des ``Partner`` (``role`` = supplier / both) ;
la classification catégories et l'évaluation vivent dans le module Achats.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import Product, ProductSupplier
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner, PartnerCategory
from app.modules.purchases.schemas import (
    PriceHistoryEntry,
    SupplierCreate,
    SupplierSuggest,
    SupplierUpdate,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

ROLES_WITH_SUPPLIER = ("supplier", "both")


class SupplierService:
    """Gestion des fournisseurs (partenaires de type fournisseur)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def list_suppliers(
        self,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 100,
        search: str | None = None,
        category_id: int | None = None,
        is_active: bool | None = True,
    ) -> list[Partner]:
        """Liste des fournisseurs, filtrable par recherche / catégorie."""
        stmt = select(Partner).options(selectinload(Partner.category_links)).where(
            Partner.role.in_(ROLES_WITH_SUPPLIER)
        )
        if search:
            like = f"%{search}%"
            stmt = stmt.where(Partner.name.ilike(like) | Partner.code.ilike(like))
        if is_active is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(Partner.is_active.is_(is_active))
        if category_id is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(
                Partner.id.in_(
                    select(PartnerCategory.partner_id).where(
                        PartnerCategory.category_id == category_id
                    )
                )
            )
        stmt = stmt.order_by(Partner.name).offset(skip).limit(limit)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def get_supplier(self, supplier_id: int) -> Partner | None:
        stmt = (
            select(Partner)
            .options(selectinload(Partner.category_links))
            .where(Partner.id == supplier_id)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return result.scalars().first()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Écriture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def create_supplier(
        self, data: SupplierCreate, company_id: int
    ) -> Partner:
        supplier = Partner(
            name=data.name,
            code=data.code,
            role="supplier",
            phone=data.phone,
            email=data.email,
            website=data.website,
            tax_number=data.tax_number,
            registration_number=data.registration_number,
            payment_terms_days=data.payment_terms_days,
            is_active=data.is_active,
            rating=data.rating,
            delivery_days=data.delivery_days,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(supplier)
        await self.session.flush()

        for category_id in data.category_ids:
            link = PartnerCategory(
                partner_id=supplier.id,
                category_id=category_id,
                company_id=company_id,
            )
            self.session.add(link)

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(supplier)
        return supplier

    async def update_supplier(
        self, supplier_id: int, data: SupplierUpdate
    ) -> Partner | None:
        supplier = await self.get_supplier(supplier_id)
        if supplier is None:
            return None

        for field in (
            "name", "code", "phone", "email", "website", "tax_number",
            "registration_number", "payment_terms_days", "is_active",
            "rating", "delivery_days",
        ):
            value = getattr(data, field, None)
            if value is not None:
                setattr(supplier, field, value)

        if data.category_ids is not None:
            # Remplacement intégral de la classification
            supplier.category_links.clear()
            await self.session.flush()
            for category_id in data.category_ids:
                self.session.add(
                    PartnerCategory(
                        partner_id=supplier.id,
                        category_id=category_id,
                        company_id=supplier.company_id,
                    )
                )

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(supplier)
        return supplier

    async def set_rating(self, supplier_id: int, rating: float) -> Partner | None:
        """Évaluation rapide 1-5 (endpoint dédié du PRD)."""
        supplier = await self.get_supplier(supplier_id)
        if supplier is None:
            return None
        supplier.rating = rating
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(supplier)
        return supplier


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Suggestions BC (saisie intelligente)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def suggest_for_category(
        self, category_id: int, product_id: int | None = None
    ) -> list[SupplierSuggest]:
        """Fournisseurs d'une catégorie, triés par note, avec dernier prix."""
        suppliers = await self.list_suppliers(category_id=category_id, limit=200)

        last_prices: dict[int, float] = {}
        if product_id is not None:
            last_prices = await self._last_prices_by_supplier(product_id)

        suggestions: list[SupplierSuggest] = []
        for s in suppliers:
            suggestions.append(
                SupplierSuggest(
                    id=s.id,
                    name=s.name,
                    rating=float(s.rating) if s.rating is not None else None,
                    delivery_days=s.delivery_days,
                    last_price=last_prices.get(s.id),
                )
            )
        # Tri : note décroissante d'abord, puis prix connu croissant
        suggestions.sort(
            key=lambda x: (
                -(x.rating or 0),
                x.last_price if x.last_price is not None else float("inf"),
            ),
        )
        return suggestions

    async def delete_supplier(self, supplier_id: int) -> Partner | None:
        """Suppression logique du fournisseur (``is_active = False``)."""
        supplier = await self.get_supplier(supplier_id)
        if supplier is None:
            return None
        supplier.is_active = False
        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(supplier)
        return supplier

    async def price_history(
        self, product_id: int, limit: int = 10
    ) -> list[PriceHistoryEntry]:
        """Derniers prix d'achat connus pour un produit.

        Sources : lignes de BC historiques (du plus récent au plus ancien),
        complétées par le prix d'achat du catalogue et les liens fournisseur.
        """
        from app.modules.purchases.models import PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine

        entries: list[PriceHistoryEntry] = []

        # 1. Historique BC (le plus récent d'abord)
        stmt = (
            select(PurchaseOrderLine, PurchaseOrder)
            .join(PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine.order_id == PurchaseOrder.id)
            .where(
                PurchaseOrderLine.product_id == product_id,
                PurchaseOrder.status.notin_(("draft", "cancelled")),
            )
            .order_by(PurchaseOrder.order_date.desc(), PurchaseOrderLine.id.desc())
            .limit(limit)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        for line, order in result.all():
            entries.append(
                PriceHistoryEntry(
                    supplier_id=order.supplier_id,
                    supplier_name=order.supplier.name if order.supplier else None,
                    unit_price=float(line.unit_price),
                    order_date=order.order_date,
                    source="po",
                )
            )

        # 2. Repli : prix catalogue (produit + liens fournisseur)
        if not entries:
            product = await self.session.get(Product, product_id)
            if product is not None and product.purchase_price:
                entries.append(
                    PriceHistoryEntry(
                        unit_price=float(product.purchase_price),
                        source="catalogue",
                    )
                )
            links = (
                await self.session.execute(
                    select(ProductSupplier).where(
                        ProductSupplier.product_id == product_id,
                        ProductSupplier.is_active.is_(True),
                        ProductSupplier.purchase_price.is_not(None),
                    )
                )
            ).scalars().all()
            for link in links:
                entries.append(
                    PriceHistoryEntry(
                        supplier_id=link.supplier_id,
                        supplier_name=link.supplier.name if link.supplier else None,
                        unit_price=float(link.purchase_price),
                        source="catalogue",
                    )
                )

        return entries

    async def _last_prices_by_supplier(self, product_id: int) -> dict[int, float]:
        """Dernier prix payé par produit et par fournisseur (via les BC)."""
        from app.modules.purchases.models import PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine

        stmt = (
            select(PurchaseOrderLine, PurchaseOrder)
            .join(PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderLine.order_id == PurchaseOrder.id)
            .where(
                PurchaseOrderLine.product_id == product_id,
                PurchaseOrder.status.notin_(("draft", "cancelled")),
            )
            .order_by(PurchaseOrder.order_date.desc(), PurchaseOrderLine.id.desc())
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        prices: dict[int, float] = {}
        for line, order in result.all():
            if order.supplier_id not in prices:
                prices[order.supplier_id] = float(line.unit_price)
        return prices

## File: backend/app/modules/reporting/services/analytics.py
````python
"""Service d'analytique BI — agrégats pour le module Reporting.

Agrégations calculées côté application (Python) pour rester
indépendant du moteur de base (SQLite / PostgreSQL), conformément
à la philosophie du projet. Les volumes traités (documents de
l'entreprise courante) restent modestes.

Les métriques excluent les factures brouillon/proforma/annulées :
CA facturé = statuts ``posted | paid | partially_paid``.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import Product, ProductCategory
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.finance.models.expense import Expense
from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice, InvoiceLine
from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment
from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder

# Statuts comptabilisés dans le chiffre d'affaires facturé
_REVENUE_STATUSES = ("posted", "paid", "partially_paid")


def _month_key(d: date) -> str:
    return f"{d.year:04d}-{d.month:02d}"


def _last_months(n: int) -> list[str]:
    """Clés ``YYYY-MM`` des n derniers mois (le mois courant en dernier)."""
    today = date.today().replace(day=1)
    keys: list[str] = []
    y, m = today.year, today.month
    for _ in range(n):
        keys.append(f"{y:04d}-{m:02d}")
        m -= 1
        if m == 0:
            m = 12
            y -= 1
    return list(reversed(keys))


class AnalyticsService:
    """Agrégats BI de l'entreprise courante (filtrage tenant automatique)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Sources brutes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def _revenue_invoices(self) -> list[Invoice]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice).where(Invoice.status.in_(_REVENUE_STATUSES))
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def _all_invoices(self) -> list[Invoice]:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(Invoice))
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def _payments_in(self) -> list[Payment]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Payment).where(Payment.direction == "in")
        )
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def _expenses(self) -> list[Expense]:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(Expense))
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def _orders(self) -> list[SalesOrder]:
        result = await self.session.execute(select(SalesOrder))
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # KPIs consolidés
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def kpis(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        invoices = await self._revenue_invoices()
        payments = await self._payments_in()
        expenses = await self._expenses()
        orders = await self._orders()

        total_invoiced = sum(float(i.amount_total or 0) for i in invoices)
        total_collected = sum(float(p.amount or 0) for p in payments)
        total_expenses = sum(float(e.amount or 0) for e in expenses)
        outstanding = max(total_invoiced - total_collected, 0.0)

        confirmed_orders = [o for o in orders if o.status == "confirmed"]
        draft_orders = [o for o in orders if o.status == "draft"]

        # Reste à livrer (commandes confirmées non livrées)
        pending_delivery = sum(
            max(
                sum(float(l.quantity_ordered or 0) for l in o.lines)
                - sum(float(l.quantity_delivered or 0) for l in o.lines),
                0.0,
            )
            for o in confirmed_orders
        )

        return {
            "total_invoiced": total_invoiced,
            "total_collected": total_collected,
            "total_expenses": total_expenses,
            "cash_flow": total_collected - total_expenses,
            "outstanding": outstanding,
            "invoice_count": len(invoices),
            "orders_total": len(orders),
            "orders_confirmed": len(confirmed_orders),
            "orders_draft": len(draft_orders),
            "pending_delivery_qty": pending_delivery,
            "gross_margin": total_invoiced - total_expenses,
        }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Tendance mensuelle (CA facturé / encaissé / dépenses)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def sales_trend(self, months: int = 6) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        months = max(1, min(months, 24))
        keys = _last_months(months)
        start = date.fromisoformat(f"{keys[0]}-01")

        invoices = [
            i for i in await self._revenue_invoices()
            if i.invoice_date and i.invoice_date >= start
        ]
        payments = [
            p for p in await self._payments_in()
            if p.payment_date and p.payment_date >= start
        ]
        expenses = [
            e for e in await self._expenses()
            if e.expense_date and e.expense_date >= start
        ]

        buckets = {
            k: {"month": k, "invoiced": 0.0, "collected": 0.0, "expenses": 0.0}
            for k in keys
        }
        for i in invoices:
            buckets[_month_key(i.invoice_date)]["invoiced"] += float(i.amount_total or 0)
        for p in payments:
            buckets[_month_key(p.payment_date)]["collected"] += float(p.amount or 0)
        for e in expenses:
            if e.expense_date:
                buckets[_month_key(e.expense_date)]["expenses"] += float(e.amount or 0)
        return [buckets[k] for k in keys]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Top produits (par CA facturé)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def top_products(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        limit = max(1, min(limit, 50))
        invoice_ids = (await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice.id).where(Invoice.status.in_(_REVENUE_STATUSES))
        )).scalars().all()
        if not invoice_ids:
            return []

        lines = (await self.session.execute(
            select(InvoiceLine, Product.name, ProductCategory.name)
            .join(Product, Product.id == InvoiceLine.product_id, isouter=True)
            .join(ProductCategory, ProductCategory.id == Product.category_id, isouter=True)
            .where(InvoiceLine.invoice_id.in_(invoice_ids))
        )).all()

        agg: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for line, product_name, category_name in lines:
            label = product_name or line.description or "Non catégorisé"
            item = agg.setdefault(
                label,
                {"product": label, "category": category_name or "—",
                 "revenue": 0.0, "quantity": 0.0},
            )
            item["revenue"] += float(line.subtotal or 0)
            item["quantity"] += float(line.quantity or 0)

        return sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda x: -x["revenue"])[:limit]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Top clients
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def top_partners(self, limit: int = 10) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        limit = max(1, min(limit, 50))
        invoices = await self._revenue_invoices()
        if not invoices:
            return []

        partner_ids = {i.partner_id for i in invoices}
        names: dict[int, str] = {}
        if partner_ids:
            rows = (await self.session.execute(
                select(Partner.id, Partner.name).where(Partner.id.in_(partner_ids))
            )).all()
            names = {pid: name for pid, name in rows}

        agg: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for i in invoices:
            item = agg.setdefault(i.partner_id, {
                "partner": names.get(i.partner_id, f"#{i.partner_id}"),
                "revenue": 0.0,
                "invoice_count": 0,
            })
            item["revenue"] += float(i.amount_total or 0)
            item["invoice_count"] += 1

        return sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda x: -x["revenue"])[:limit]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Répartition par statut de facture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def invoice_status(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        invoices = await self._all_invoices()
        agg: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for i in invoices:
            item = agg.setdefault(
                i.status, {"status": i.status, "count": 0, "amount": 0.0}
            )
            item["count"] += 1
            item["amount"] += float(i.amount_total or 0)
        return sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda x: -x["amount"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Encaissements par mode de paiement
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def payments_by_method(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        payments = await self._payments_in()
        agg: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for p in payments:
            item = agg.setdefault(
                p.method, {"method": p.method, "amount": 0.0, "count": 0}
            )
            item["amount"] += float(p.amount or 0)
            item["count"] += 1
        return sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda x: -x["amount"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Dépenses par catégorie
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def expenses_by_category(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        expenses = await self._expenses()
        agg: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for e in expenses:
            item = agg.setdefault(
                e.category, {"category": e.category, "amount": 0.0, "count": 0}
            )
            item["amount"] += float(e.amount or 0)
            item["count"] += 1
        return sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda x: -x["amount"])
````

"""

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, UploadFile, status

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_active_user
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission

    PosSaleCreate,

from app.shared.file_export import export_response
from app.shared.file_import import read_rows_from_bytes

):
    """Export Excel / CSV des devis — une ligne par article.

    )

@router.post("/quotes", response_model=QuoteRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    current_user: User = Depends(require_permission("quote", "create")),

    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))

async def delete_quote(

):
    """Remet un devis confirmé au brouillon (annule la commande générée)."""
    service = QuoteService(session)
    try:
        return await service.back_to_draft(quote_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))


@router.post("/quotes/{quote_id}/invoice", response_model=QuoteInvoiceRead)
async def create_quote_invoice(
    quote_id: int,
    body: QuoteInvoiceCreate,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("invoice", "create")),
):
    """Parcours de vente — « Créer facture » depuis un devis confirmé.

    Enchaîne les étapes sans changer de module :

    1. confirmation du devis si nécessaire (commande créée ou réutilisée) ;
    2. facturation de la commande liée (totale, acompte % ou acompte fixe).

    **Idempotent** : si la commande est déjà entièrement facturée, la facture
    existante est renvoyée avec ``created=False`` — le bouton « Créer facture »
    fait alors office de « Voir la facture ».
    """
    from sqlalchemy import select as _select

    from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
    from app.modules.invoicing.services.invoice_service import InvoiceService

    quote_service = QuoteService(session)
    try:
        order = await quote_service.confirm_quote(quote_id)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc))

    invoice_service = InvoiceService(session)
    created = True
    try:
        invoice = await invoice_service.create_from_order(
            order.id,
            due_days=body.due_days,
            mode=body.mode,
            value=body.value,
            post=body.post,
        )
    except ValueError as exc:
        # Commande déjà facturée : on renvoie la facture existante au lieu
        # d'échouer — le parcours reste ainsi re-jouable.
        if "entièrement facturée" not in str(exc):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
        result = await session.execute(
            _select(Invoice)
            .where(Invoice.order_id == order.id)
            .order_by(Invoice.id.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )
        invoice = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if invoice is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
        created = False

    quote = await quote_service.get_quote(quote_id)
    return QuoteInvoiceRead(
        quote_id=quote_id,
        quote_reference=getattr(quote, "reference", "") or "",
        order_id=order.id,
        order_reference=order.reference,
        invoice_id=invoice.id,
        invoice_reference=invoice.reference,
        invoice_status=invoice.status,
        created=created,
    )

@router.get("/orders/{order_id}/print")
async def print_order(
    order_id: int,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("order", "view")),
):
    """PDF d'une commande.

    - vente comptoir (``pos``)  → ticket de caisse 80 mm
    - autre commande            → facture (auto-générée si absente)
    """
    import io

    from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
    from sqlalchemy import select as _select

    from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder
    from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine
    from app.core.documents.naming import content_disposition
    from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
    from app.modules.invoicing.services.invoice_service import InvoiceService
    from app.modules.sales.services.order_service import OrderService

    engine = DocumentEngine()
    builder = ContextBuilder()

    service = OrderService(session)
    order = await service.get_order(order_id)
    if order is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Commande introuvable")

    if order.fulfillment_mode == "pos":
        try:
            context = await builder.load_pos(order_id)
            path = await engine.arender_pos_ticket(order_id)
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Vente introuvable")
    else:
        # Facture liée existante ? Sinon génération automatique.
        result = await session.execute(
            _select(Invoice).where(Invoice.order_id == order_id).limit(1)
        )
        invoice = result.scalar_one_or_none()
        if invoice is None:
            try:
                invoice = await InvoiceService(session).create_from_order(order_id)
            except ValueError as exc:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
        context = await builder.load_invoice(invoice.id)
        path = await engine.arender_invoice(invoice.id)

    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    return StreamingResponse(
        io.BytesIO(data),
        media_type="application/pdf",
        headers={
            "Content-Disposition": content_disposition(
                context.get("doc_filename") or "document.pdf"
            )
        },
    )

@router.post("/orders/import")
async def import_orders(
    file: UploadFile,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("order", "create")),
):
    """Import de commandes depuis un fichier .xlsx ou .csv (une ligne = un article).

    Colonnes attendues (première ligne d'en-têtes) ::
        client | produit | quantite | prix_unitaire | remise | date
        | reference_commande (facultative : regroupe les lignes)

    Les commandes sont créées en brouillon ; clients et produits inconnus
    sont créés à la volée, le prix unitaire absent reprend le prix catalogue.
    """
    content = await file.read()
    rows = read_rows_from_bytes(file.filename or "import.csv", content)
    service = SalesImportService(session, company_id=user.company_id)
    return await service.import_orders(rows)

"""
Modèles Commande Client (SalesOrder) — modes stock, direct et hybride.

Chaque ligne suit l'approvisionnement :
- quantité commandée / réservée / à acheter / achetée / livrée
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import (
    Boolean,
    Date,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.shared.enums import SalesOrderStatus


class SalesOrder(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Commande client.

    Modes de fulfillment :
    - ``FROM_STOCK`` : satisfaction depuis le stock interne
    - ``DIRECT``     : livraison directe fournisseur → client
    - ``HYBRID``     : partie stock + partie achat fournisseur
    """

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    site_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("sites.id"), nullable=True)
    quote_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("quotes.id"), nullable=True)
    fulfillment_mode: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="stock")

    # Contact commercial hérité du devis (pas de saisie sur la commande).
    salesperson_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )

    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=SalesOrderStatus.DRAFT.value, index=True
    )
    order_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, default=date.today)
    delivery_date_planned: Mapped[date | None] = MappedColumn(Date)

    currency_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(3), default="XOF")

    amount_untaxed: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    discount_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    shipping_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    amount_total: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    paid_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(2000))

    # Archivage caisse : masque la vente de l'historique du Point de Vente
    # sans toucher à la comptabilité (facture + paiement conservés).
    archived: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)

    lines: Mapped[list["SalesOrderLine"]] = relationship(
        "SalesOrderLine", back_populates="order",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner")
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship("Company")
    salesperson: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        "User", foreign_keys=[salesperson_id], lazy="selectin"
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<SalesOrder {self.reference} [{self.status}]>"


class SalesOrderLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Ligne de commande avec suivi d'approvisionnement détaillé."""

    order_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("sales_orders.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=True
    )
    # Variante du produit (optionnelle) — ``variant_name`` est un instantané
    # du libellé (réimpression fidèle des documents).
    variant_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("product_variants.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )
    variant_name: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(300))

    description: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))
    quantity_ordered: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    quantity_reserved: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_available: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_to_purchase: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_purchased: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_delivered: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    unit: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(20))
    sell_by_length: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False)
    unit_price: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    purchase_price: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))
    discount_percent: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(6, 2), default=0)

    total_length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    subtotal: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    position: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, default=0)

    order: Mapped["SalesOrder"] = relationship("SalesOrder", back_populates="lines")
    product: Mapped["Product"] = relationship("Product", lazy="selectin")
    variant: Mapped["ProductVariant | None"] = relationship(
        "ProductVariant", lazy="selectin"
    )
    cuts: Mapped[list["OrderLineCut"]] = relationship(
        "OrderLineCut", back_populates="line",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    @property
    def remaining_to_supply(self) -> float:
        return max(
            float(self.quantity_ordered)
            - float(self.quantity_reserved)
            - float(self.quantity_purchased),
            0.0,
        )


class OrderLineCut(Base):
    """Sous-ligne de coupe BAC d'une ligne de commande (jamais perdue)."""

    __tablename__ = "sales_order_line_cuts"

    id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    line_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("sales_order_lines.id", ondelete="CASCADE"),
        nullable=False,
        index=True,
    )
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(12, 4), nullable=False)
    unit_price: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))

    line: Mapped["SalesOrderLine"] = relationship("SalesOrderLine", back_populates="cuts")
