````python
"""
Modèles Devis (Quote) — avec lignes multi-longueurs pour tôles BAC.

Formule ligne BAC ::
    Montant = Σ(quantité × longueur × prix unitaire)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import (
    JSON,
    Boolean,
    Date,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin


class Quote(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Devis client."""

    reference: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(30), unique=True, index=True)
    partner_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("partners.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    site_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(ForeignKey("sites.id"), nullable=True)

    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="draft", index=True)
    quote_date: Mapped[date] = MappedColumn(Date, default=date.today)
    valid_until: Mapped[date | None] = MappedColumn(Date)

    currency_code: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(3), default="XOF")

    # Contact commercial (vendeur) : utilisateur avec privilèges commerciaux.
    # - choisi à la création du devis (si admin), sinon = créateur (commercial)
    # - hérité par la commande puis la facture (facture : pas de saisie)
    salesperson_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="SET NULL"), nullable=True, index=True
    )

    amount_untaxed: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    discount_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    tax_amount: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    amount_total: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    # Marge prévisionnelle
    expected_cost: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))
    expected_margin: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))

    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(2000))
    terms: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(2000))
    metadata_json: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = MappedColumn(JSON, default=dict)

    lines: Mapped[list["QuoteLine"]] = relationship(
        "QuoteLine", back_populates="quote",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    partner: Mapped["Partner"] = relationship("Partner")
    company: Mapped["Company"] = relationship("Company")
    salesperson: Mapped["User | None"] = relationship(
        "User", foreign_keys=[salesperson_id], lazy="selectin"
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Quote {self.reference} [{self.status}]>"


class QuoteLine(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Ligne de devis.

    - Standard : ``quantity × unit_price``
    - Tôle BAC : ``sell_by_length=True`` → ``cuts`` (multi-longueurs)
    """

    quote_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("quotes.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=True
    )
    # Variante du produit (optionnelle) — ``variant_name`` est un instantané du
    # libellé, conservé même si la variante est renommée ou supprimée
    # (réimpression fidèle des documents).
    variant_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("product_variants.id", ondelete="SET NULL"),
        nullable=True,
        index=True,
    )
    variant_name: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(300))

    description: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(500))
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    unit: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(20))

    sell_by_length: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=False)
    unit_price: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    discount_percent: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(6, 2), default=0)

    total_length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    subtotal: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    position: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, default=0)

    quote: Mapped["Quote"] = relationship("Quote", back_populates="lines")
    product: Mapped["Product"] = relationship("Product", lazy="selectin")
    variant: Mapped["ProductVariant | None"] = relationship(
        "ProductVariant", lazy="selectin"
    )
    cuts: Mapped[list["QuoteLineCut"]] = relationship(
        "QuoteLineCut", back_populates="line",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    def compute_totals(self) -> None:
        """Calcule les totaux de la ligne (standard ou BAC multi-longueurs)."""
        price = float(self.unit_price or 0)
        if self.sell_by_length and self.cuts:
            total_len = sum(float(c.quantity) * float(c.length) for c in self.cuts)
            self.total_length = total_len
            raw = sum(
                float(c.quantity) * float(c.length) * float(c.unit_price or price)
                for c in self.cuts
            )
            self.subtotal = raw
        else:
            qty = float(self.quantity or 0)
            self.total_length = qty
            raw = qty * price
            self.subtotal = raw
        if self.discount_percent:
            self.subtotal = float(self.subtotal) * (
                1 - float(self.discount_percent) / 100
            )


class QuoteLineCut(Base):
    """Sous-ligne de coupe BAC d'une ligne de devis (quantité × longueur)."""

    __tablename__ = "quote_line_cuts"

    id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    line_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("quote_lines.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=1)
    length: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(12, 4), nullable=False)
    unit_price: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4))

    line: Mapped["QuoteLine"] = relationship("QuoteLine", back_populates="cuts")
````

## File: backend/app/modules/sales/services/export_service.py
````python
"""Export des documents commerciaux (devis + commandes clients).

Format « **une ligne par article** » — l'en‑tête du document est répété
sur chaque ligne, ce qui convient au transfert comme à l'analyse (BI).

Les colonnes ``reference_commande``, ``client``, ``date``, ``produit``,
``quantite``, ``prix_unitaire``, ``remise``, ``description`` et ``devise``
sont **exactement** celles lues par ``SalesImportService`` : un export de
commandes se réimporte tel quel. ``statut``, ``variante`` et
``montant_document`` sont ignorés à la réimportation (colonnes inconnues).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder
from app.modules.sales.models.quote import Quote

DOCUMENT_HEADERS = [
    "reference",
    "client",
    "date",
    "statut",
    "produit",
    "variante",
    "quantite",
    "unite",
    "prix_unitaire",
    "remise",
    "sous_total",
    "montant_document",
    "devise",
    "description",
]


class SalesExportService:
    """Export des devis et des commandes vers un tableau (en‑têtes + lignes)."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    async def quotes(self, include_rows: bool = True) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[Any]]]:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Quote)
            .options(selectinload(Quote.partner))
            .order_by(Quote.id.desc())
        )
        quotes = list(result.scalars().all())
        if not include_rows:
            return DOCUMENT_HEADERS, []
        return DOCUMENT_HEADERS, self._rows(
            quotes, partner_name=lambda q: q.partner.name if q.partner else None,
            doc_date=lambda q: q.quote_date,
            quantity_of=lambda line: line.quantity,
        )

    async def orders(
        self, include_rows: bool = True, include_pos: bool = False
    ) -> tuple[list[str], list[list[Any]]]:
        stmt = (
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(selectinload(SalesOrder.partner))
            .order_by(SalesOrder.id.desc())
        )
        if not include_pos:
            stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.fulfillment_mode != "pos")
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        orders = list(result.scalars().all())
        if not include_rows:
            return DOCUMENT_HEADERS, []
        return DOCUMENT_HEADERS, self._rows(
            orders, partner_name=lambda o: o.partner.name if o.partner else None,
            doc_date=lambda o: o.order_date,
            # La ligne de commande porte « quantity_ordered » (pas « quantity »)
            quantity_of=lambda line: line.quantity_ordered,
        )

    # -- mise en forme -------------------------------------------------- #
    @classmethod
    def _rows(
        cls, documents, *, partner_name, doc_date, quantity_of
    ) -> list[list[Any]]:
        rows: list[list[Any]] = []
        for document in documents:
            base = [
                document.reference,
                partner_name(document),
                doc_date(document),
                document.status,
            ]
            amount = float(document.amount_total or 0)
            currency = document.currency_code
            lines = sorted(document.lines, key=lambda line: (line.position or 0, line.id))
            if not lines:
                # Document sans ligne : conserve la ligne d'en‑tête
                rows.append(base + [None] * 7 + [amount, currency, None])
                continue
            for line in lines:
                product = line.product
                rows.append(
                    base
                    + [
                        product.reference if product else None,
                        line.variant_name,
                        float(quantity_of(line) or 0),
                        line.unit,
                        float(line.unit_price or 0),
                        float(line.discount_percent or 0),
                        float(line.subtotal or 0),
                        amount,
                        currency,
                        line.description or (product.name if product else None),
                    ]
                )
        return rows
````

## File: backend/app/modules/sales/services/import_service.py
````python
"""Import en masse des commandes clients (Excel / CSV).

Format « une ligne par article », regroupées en commandes ::
    client (obligatoire), produit (réf. ou nom), quantite, prix_unitaire,
    remise (%), date (JJ/MM/AAAA ou AAAA-MM-JJ), reference_commande,
    description, devise

Regroupement :
- colonne ``reference_commande`` présente → même référence = même commande
- sinon → regroupement par (client, date)

Résolution tolérante : produits et clients inconnus sont retrouvés par
nom/référence ; le prix unitaire absent reprend le prix de vente du
produit (ou le prix/ml). Les commandes sont créées en brouillon via
``OrderService`` (numérotation, totaux, tenant hérité du client).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import Product
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.sales.schemas import OrderLineCreate, SalesOrderCreate
from app.modules.sales.services.order_service import OrderService
from app.shared.enums import EntityType
from app.shared.file_import import clean_str, to_date, to_float

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_LINE_ALIASES = {
    "client": "partner", "clients": "partner", "customer": "partner",
    "partenaire": "partner", "partner": "partner",
    "produit": "product", "product": "product", "article": "product",
    "quantite": "quantity", "quantity": "quantity", "qty": "quantity",
    "qte": "quantity",
    "prix_unitaire": "unit_price", "prix": "unit_price",
    "unit_price": "unit_price", "pu": "unit_price",
    "remise": "discount_percent", "discount": "discount_percent",
    "discount_percent": "discount_percent",
    "date": "date", "date_commande": "date", "order_date": "date",
    "reference_commande": "order_ref", "ref_commande": "order_ref",
    "order_ref": "order_ref", "commande": "order_ref",
    "description": "description", "libelle": "description",
    "devise": "currency", "currency": "currency", "monnaie": "currency",
}


def _map_line(row: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    mapped: dict[str, Any] = {"__line__": row.get("__line__")}
    for key, value in row.items():
        if key.startswith("__"):
            continue
        field = _LINE_ALIASES.get(key)
        if field and field not in mapped:
            mapped[field] = value
    return mapped


class SalesImportService:
    """Import des commandes clients depuis un fichier Excel / CSV."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession, company_id: int | None = None):
        self.session = session
        self.company_id = company_id

    # -- résolutions -------------------------------------------------- #
    async def _resolve_partner(self, raw: Any) -> Partner:
        name = clean_str(raw, 200)
        if not name:
            raise ValueError("Colonne « client » obligatoire")
        stmt = select(Partner).where(Partner.name.ilike(name))
        if self.company_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(Partner.company_id == self.company_id)
        partner = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().first()
        if partner is None:
            partner = Partner(
                name=name, role="client",
                entity_type=EntityType.COMPANY.value,
                company_id=self.company_id,
            )
            self.session.add(partner)
            await self.session.flush()
        return partner

    async def _resolve_product(self, raw: Any) -> Product | None:
        text = clean_str(raw, 200)
        if not text:
            return None
        product = (await self.session.execute(
            select(Product)
            .where(
                (Product.reference.ilike(text)) | (Product.name.ilike(text))
            )
            .order_by(Product.id)
        )).scalars().first()
        return product

    # -- import ------------------------------------------------------- #
    async def import_orders(self, rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        # 1) Normalise et regroupe les lignes par commande
        groups: OrderedDict[tuple, dict[str, Any]] = OrderedDict()
        parse_errors: list[dict] = []

        for row in rows:
            data = _map_line(row)
            line_no = data.get("__line__")
            try:
                partner_name = clean_str(data.get("partner"), 200)
                if not partner_name:
                    raise ValueError("Colonne « client » obligatoire")
                order_date = to_date(data.get("date"))
                quantity = to_float(data.get("quantity"), 1.0) or 1.0
                if quantity <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Quantité invalide")
                discount = to_float(data.get("discount_percent"), 0.0) or 0.0
                if not 0 <= discount <= 100:
                    raise ValueError("Remise invalide (0-100 %)")
                order_ref = clean_str(data.get("order_ref"), 30)
                currency = (clean_str(data.get("currency"), 3) or "XOF").upper()
                key = ("ref", order_ref) if order_ref else (
                    "pd", partner_name.lower(),
                    order_date.isoformat() if order_date else "",
                )
                group = groups.setdefault(key, {
                    "order_ref": order_ref,
                    "partner": partner_name,
                    "date": order_date,
                    "currency": currency,
                    "lines": [],
                })
                group["lines"].append({
                    "product": clean_str(data.get("product"), 200),
                    "description": clean_str(data.get("description"), 500),
                    "quantity": quantity,
                    "unit_price": to_float(data.get("unit_price")),
                    "discount_percent": discount,
                    "__line__": line_no,
                })
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                parse_errors.append({
                    "line": line_no, "error": str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__,
                })

        # 2) Création des commandes (OrderService = numérotation + totaux)
        service = OrderService(self.session)
        orders_created = 0
        lines_created = 0
        errors: list[dict] = list(parse_errors)

        for group in groups.values():
            try:
                partner = await self._resolve_partner(group["partner"])

                line_schemas: list[OrderLineCreate] = []
                for line in group["lines"]:
                    product = await self._resolve_product(line["product"])
                    unit_price = line["unit_price"]
                    sell_by_length = False
                    if product is not None:
                        sell_by_length = product.sell_by_length
                        if unit_price is None:
                            unit_price = (
                                product.price_per_meter
                                if sell_by_length
                                else product.selling_price
                            ) or 0
                    line_schemas.append(OrderLineCreate(
                        product_id=product.id if product else None,
                        description=line["description"],
                        quantity_ordered=line["quantity"],
                        sell_by_length=sell_by_length,
                        unit_price=unit_price or 0,
                        discount_percent=line["discount_percent"],
                    ))

                order = await service.create_order(SalesOrderCreate(
                    partner_id=partner.id,
                    currency_code=group["currency"],
                    lines=line_schemas,
                ))
                if group["date"]:
                    order.order_date = group["date"]
                await self.session.commit()
                orders_created += 1
                lines_created += len(line_schemas)
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                await self.session.rollback()
                logger.warning("Import commande échoué : %s", exc)
                errors.append({
                    "line": ",".join(
                        str(l["__line__"]) for l in group["lines"]
                    ) or "?",
                    "error": str(exc) or exc.__class__.__name__,
                })

        return {
            "orders_created": orders_created,
            "lines_created": lines_created,
            "errors": errors,
            "total": orders_created + len(errors),
        }
````

## File: backend/app/modules/sales/services/order_service.py
````python
"""
Service Ventes — commandes client.

Modes de fulfillment :
- ``stock``  : réservation depuis le stock interne
- ``direct`` : livraison directe fournisseur → client (sans stock)
- ``hybrid`` : partie stock + partie achat fournisseur
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.shared.events import event_bus
from app.modules.catalogue.models.variant import ProductVariant
from app.modules.sales.models.order import OrderLineCut, SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine
from app.modules.sales.schemas import (
    OrderLineCreate,
    SalesOrderCreate,
    SalesOrderUpdate,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class OrderService:
    """Service des commandes clients."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    async def _build_line(self, data: OrderLineCreate) -> SalesOrderLine:
        # Variante (optionnelle) : libellé résolu depuis la base.
        variant_name: str | None = None
        if data.variant_id is not None:
            variant = await self.session.get(ProductVariant, data.variant_id)
            if variant is not None:
                variant_name = variant.name_suffix
        line = SalesOrderLine(
            product_id=data.product_id,
            variant_id=data.variant_id,
            variant_name=variant_name,
            description=data.description,
            quantity_ordered=data.quantity_ordered,
            unit=data.unit,
            sell_by_length=data.sell_by_length,
            unit_price=data.unit_price,
            purchase_price=data.purchase_price,
            discount_percent=data.discount_percent,
        )
        if data.sell_by_length and data.cuts:
            total_len = 0.0
            raw = 0.0
            for cut in data.cuts:
                line.cuts.append(
                    OrderLineCut(
                        quantity=cut.quantity,
                        length=cut.length,
                        unit_price=cut.unit_price,
                    )
                )
                total_len += cut.quantity * cut.length
                price = cut.unit_price if cut.unit_price is not None else data.unit_price
                raw += cut.quantity * cut.length * float(price)
            line.total_length = total_len
            line.subtotal = raw * (1 - data.discount_percent / 100)
        else:
            line.total_length = data.quantity_ordered
            line.subtotal = (
                data.quantity_ordered * data.unit_price
                * (1 - data.discount_percent / 100)
            )
        return line

    async def create_order(self, data: SalesOrderCreate) -> SalesOrder:
        order = SalesOrder(
            reference=await self.sequences.next_value("order", "COM"),
            partner_id=data.partner_id,
            site_id=data.site_id,
            quote_id=data.quote_id,
            fulfillment_mode=data.fulfillment_mode,
            delivery_date_planned=data.delivery_date_planned,
            currency_code=data.currency_code,
            notes=data.notes,
        )
        for line_data in data.lines:
            order.lines.append(await self._build_line(line_data))
        order.amount_untaxed = sum(float(l.subtotal or 0) for l in order.lines)
        order.tax_amount = float(order.tax_amount or 0)
        order.shipping_amount = float(order.shipping_amount or 0)
        order.amount_total = (
            float(order.amount_untaxed)
            + order.tax_amount
            + order.shipping_amount
        )

        # Le document hérite du tenant de son partenaire
        if order.company_id is None:
            from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner

            partner = await self.session.get(Partner, data.partner_id)
            if partner is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Client {data.partner_id} introuvable")
            order.company_id = partner.company_id
        for line in order.lines:
            line.company_id = order.company_id

        self.session.add(order)
        await self.session.commit()

        # Recharge avec lignes + coupes (évite les lazy-loads async non awaités)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts)
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order.id)
        )
        order = result.scalar_one()

        await event_bus.emit(
            "sales.order.created",
            {"order_id": order.id, "reference": order.reference},
        )
        return order

    async def get_order(self, order_id: int) -> SalesOrder | None:
        return await self.session.get(SalesOrder, order_id)

    async def list_orders(
        self,
        skip: int = 0,
        limit: int = 100,
        partner_id: int | None = None,
        include_pos: bool = False,
    ) -> list[SalesOrder]:
        """Liste les commandes, plus récentes d'abord.

        Les ventes comptoir (``fulfillment_mode="pos"``) sont exclues par
        défaut : elles vivent uniquement dans l'historique du Point de Vente
        pour ne pas surcharger la facturation globale.
        """
        stmt = select(SalesOrder).offset(skip).limit(limit).order_by(SalesOrder.id.desc())
        if partner_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.partner_id == partner_id)
        if not include_pos:
            stmt = stmt.where(SalesOrder.fulfillment_mode != "pos")
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def update_order(self, order_id: int, data: SalesOrderUpdate) -> SalesOrder:
        """Met à jour une commande — autorisé uniquement au statut brouillon.

        Si ``data.lines`` est fourni, toutes les lignes existantes sont
        remplacées (coupes BAC comprises) et les totaux recalculés.
        """
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")
        if order.status != "draft":
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une commande au statut « brouillon » peut être modifiée."
            )

        if data.partner_id is not None:
            order.partner_id = data.partner_id
        if data.site_id is not None:
            order.site_id = data.site_id
        if data.delivery_date_planned is not None:
            order.delivery_date_planned = data.delivery_date_planned
        if data.currency_code is not None:
            order.currency_code = data.currency_code
        if data.notes is not None:
            order.notes = data.notes

        if data.lines is not None:
            order.lines.clear()  # cascade delete-orphan (coupes incluses)
            await self.session.flush()
            for line_data in data.lines:
                line = await self._build_line(line_data)
                line.company_id = order.company_id
                order.lines.append(line)
            order.amount_untaxed = sum(float(l.subtotal or 0) for l in order.lines)
            order.amount_total = (
                float(order.amount_untaxed)
                + float(order.tax_amount or 0)
                + float(order.shipping_amount or 0)
            )

        await self.session.commit()

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts)
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order.id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def delete_order(self, order_id: int) -> None:
        """Supprime une commande — brouillon uniquement (aucune réservation)."""
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")
        if order.status != "draft":
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une commande au statut « brouillon » peut être supprimée. "
                "Une commande confirmée a déjà des réservations de stock."
            )

        # Garde-fous FK (cascade de suppression) : ni facture ni BL rattachés.
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
        from app.modules.delivery.models.delivery import DeliveryNote

        inv = await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice.reference).where(Invoice.order_id == order.id).limit(5)
        )
        refs = list(inv.scalars().all())
        if refs:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : une facture est rattachée à cette commande ("
                + ", ".join(refs)
                + ") — supprimez-la ou annulez-la d'abord."
            )
        dlv = await self.session.execute(
            select(DeliveryNote.reference)
            .where(DeliveryNote.order_id == order.id)
            .limit(5)
        )
        bl_refs = list(dlv.scalars().all())
        if bl_refs:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : un bon de livraison est rattaché à cette "
                "commande (" + ", ".join(bl_refs) + ") — supprimez-le d'abord."
            )

        await self.session.delete(order)  # cascade lines + cuts
        await self.session.commit()

    async def back_to_draft(self, order_id: int) -> SalesOrder:
        """Remet une commande confirmée au statut brouillon.

        - libère les réservations de stock
        - refuse si une facture ou un bon de livraison est déjà lié
        """
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")
        if order.status != "confirmed":
            raise ValueError(
                "Seule une commande confirmée peut être remise au brouillon."
            )

        # Refus si des documents sont déjà liés
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
        from app.modules.delivery.models.delivery import DeliveryNote

        inv = await self.session.execute(
            select(Invoice).where(Invoice.order_id == order.id).limit(1)
        )
        if inv.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : une facture est liée à cette commande. "
                "Annulez d'abord la facture."
            )
        dlv = await self.session.execute(
            select(DeliveryNote).where(DeliveryNote.order_id == order.id).limit(1)
        )
        if dlv.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : un bon de livraison est lié à cette commande. "
                "Annulez d'abord le bon de livraison."
            )

        # Libère les réservations de stock
        from app.modules.stock.services.stock_service import StockService

        stock_service = StockService(self.session)
        for line in order.lines:
            reserved = float(line.quantity_reserved or 0)
            if reserved > 0 and line.product_id:
                await stock_service.release(line.product_id, reserved, order_id=order.id)
            line.quantity_reserved = 0
            line.quantity_available = 0
            line.quantity_to_purchase = 0

        order.status = "draft"
        await self.session.commit()

        await event_bus.emit("sales.order.back_to_draft", {"order_id": order.id})

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts)
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order.id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def close_order(self, order_id: int) -> SalesOrder:
        """Clôture la vente — dernière étape du parcours de vente.

        Conditions : commande non annulée ni déjà clôturée, au moins une
        facture active **entièrement soldée**, et chaque bon de livraison
        éventuel au statut ``delivered`` ou ``completed`` (la vente peut se
        clôturer dès la livraison physique).  La commande passe à ``delivered``.

        La commande peut encore être au brouillon : dans le parcours de vente
        elle sert de conteneur technique (le devis confirmé la crée), et sa
        confirmation (réservation de stock) n'est pas une condition de vente.
        """
        from app.modules.delivery.models.delivery import DeliveryNote
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")
        if order.status == "delivered":
            raise ValueError("Cette vente est déjà clôturée.")
        if order.status == "cancelled":
            raise ValueError("Une commande annulée ne peut pas être clôturée.")

        invoices = list(
            (
                await self.session.execute(
                    select(Invoice).where(Invoice.order_id == order.id)
                )
            ).scalars().all()
        )
        active = [i for i in invoices if i.status not in ("cancelled", "credit")]
        if not active:
            raise ValueError(
                "Aucune facture active : facturez la vente avant de clôturer."
            )
        total = float(order.amount_total or 0)
        paid = sum(float(i.paid_amount or 0) for i in active)
        if paid + 0.005 < total:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Reste à encaisser {total - paid:.2f} — la vente doit être "
                "entièrement réglée avant clôture."
            )

        deliveries = list(
            (
                await self.session.execute(
                    select(DeliveryNote).where(DeliveryNote.order_id == order.id)
                )
            ).scalars().all()
        )
        unfinished = [
            d
            for d in deliveries
            if (d.status or "") not in ("delivered", "completed")
        ]
        if unfinished:
            raise ValueError(
                "Bon(s) de livraison non terminé(s) : "
                + ", ".join(d.reference for d in unfinished)
            )

        order.status = "delivered"
        await self.session.commit()
        logger.info("Vente %s clôturée (commande livrée)", order.reference)

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts))
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order.id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def confirm_order(self, order_id: int) -> dict:
        """
        Confirme une commande et lance l'analyse de fulfillment.

        - réserve le stock disponible
        - crée les besoins d'achat pour le solde
        Émet ``sales.order.confirmed``.
        """
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")

        analysis = await self.analyze_fulfillment(order_id)
        order.status = "confirmed"
        await self.session.commit()

        await event_bus.emit(
            "sales.order.confirmed",
            {"order_id": order.id, "analysis": analysis},
        )
        return analysis

    async def analyze_fulfillment(self, order_id: int) -> dict:
        """
        Analyse hybride : répartit stock disponible vs besoin d'achat.

        Pour chaque ligne :
        - quantité commandée par le client
        - quantité disponible en stock
        - quantité réservée
        - quantité à acheter
        Émet ``inventory.stock.reserved`` et/ou ``purchase.need.created``.
        """
        order = await self.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Commande {order_id} introuvable")

        from app.modules.stock.services.stock_service import StockService

        stock_service = StockService(self.session)
        needs: list[dict] = []
        reservations: list[dict] = []

        for line in order.lines:
            available = 0.0
            # Type de produit : on_demand (production) ne touche jamais au stock
            stype = "stockable"
            if line.product_id and line.product is not None:
                stype = str(getattr(line.product, "storage_type", "") or "stockable")
            on_demand = stype == "on_demand"
            if line.product_id and not line.sell_by_length and not on_demand:
                available = await stock_service.get_available_stock(line.product_id)

            to_purchase = max(float(line.quantity_ordered) - available, 0.0)

            line.quantity_available = available
            line.quantity_to_purchase = to_purchase

            # Réservation réelle du stock disponible
            if available > 0 and line.product_id:
                reserved = await stock_service.reserve_across_warehouses(
                    line.product_id,
                    min(float(line.quantity_ordered), available),
                    order_id=order.id,
                )
                line.quantity_reserved = reserved
                if reserved > 0:
                    reservations.append({
                        "product_id": line.product_id,
                        "quantity": reserved,
                    })
            else:
                line.quantity_reserved = 0

            if to_purchase > 0:
                needs.append({
                    "product_id": line.product_id,
                    "description": line.description,
                    "quantity": to_purchase,
                    "unit": line.unit,
                    "sell_by_length": line.sell_by_length,
                })

        await self.session.commit()

        result = {
            "order_id": order.id,
            "reservations": reservations,
            "purchase_needs": needs,
        }
        if reservations:
            await event_bus.emit("inventory.stock.reserved", {"order_id": order.id})
        if needs:
            await event_bus.emit(
                "purchase.need.created", {"order_id": order.id, "needs": needs}
            )
        return result
````

````python
"""Service Point de Vente — vente comptoir simple (panier → ticket).

Flux du pipeline cœur :
    panier → commande (fulfillment_mode="pos") → sortie de stock
            → facture → paiement (reçu) → ticket de caisse
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.modules.invoicing.services.invoice_service import InvoiceService
from app.modules.payments.services.payment_service import PaymentService
from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder
from app.modules.sales.schemas import PosSaleCreate
from app.modules.sales.services.order_service import OrderService

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

#: Partenaire walk-in utilisé quand la vente comptoir n'a pas de client.
WALK_IN_PARTNER_NAME = "Client de passage"


class PosService:
    """Ventes comptoir."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.orders_ = OrderService(session)

    async def _resolve_partner_id(
        self, data: PosSaleCreate, company_id: int | None
    ) -> int:
        """Client choisi, sinon partenaire walk-in « Client de passage ».

        Le partenaire walk-in est créé à la volée (une seule fois par
        entreprise) pour que la caisse puisse encaisser sans client imposé.
        """
        if data.partner_id:
            return data.partner_id

        from sqlalchemy import select

        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner

        stmt = select(Partner).where(Partner.name == WALK_IN_PARTNER_NAME)
        if company_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(Partner.company_id == company_id)
        partner = (await self.session.execute(stmt)).scalars().first()
        if partner is None:
            if company_id is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible de créer le client de passage : entreprise absente"
                )
            partner = Partner(
                name=WALK_IN_PARTNER_NAME,
                code="WALKIN",
                role="client",
                company_id=company_id,
            )
            self.session.add(partner)
            await self.session.flush()
        return partner.id

    async def create_pos_sale(
        self, data: PosSaleCreate, company_id: int | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Crée la commande comptoir + sortie stock + facture + paiement."""
        # 0) Client : choisi ou walk-in « Client de passage »
        partner_id = await self._resolve_partner_id(data, company_id)

        # 1) Commande client (mode pos)
        order = await self.orders_.create_order(
            data.to_sales_order_create(partner_id)
        )

        # 2) Sortie de stock immédiate (produits non gérés au ml)
        from app.modules.stock.services.stock_service import StockService

        stock_service = StockService(self.session)
        from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import Warehouse
        from sqlalchemy import select

        warehouse_id = data.warehouse_id
        if not warehouse_id:
            result = await self.session.execute(
                select(Warehouse).order_by(Warehouse.id).limit(1)
            )
            wh = result.scalar_one_or_none()
            warehouse_id = wh.id if wh else None

        if warehouse_id:
            from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import StockMovement  # noqa: F401

            for line in order.lines:
                if line.product_id and not line.sell_by_length:
                    await stock_service.record_movement(
                        movement_type="outbound",
                        warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
                        product_id=line.product_id,
                        quantity=float(line.quantity_ordered),
                        reference_document="POS",
                        reference_id=order.id,
                        notes=f"Vente comptoir {order.reference}",
                    )

        order.status = "confirmed"
        await self.session.commit()

        # 3) Facture (comptabilisée immédiatement — vente au comptoir finalisée)
        #    + paiement (le contrôle sur-paiement S-7 s'applique normalement).
        invoice = await InvoiceService(self.session).create_from_order(
            order.id, post=True
        )
        payment = None
        total = float(order.amount_total or 0)
        received = float(data.amount or 0)
        change = 0.0
        if received > 0:
            # Caisse : le client doit couvrir le total — aucun sous-paiement.
            if received + 1e-6 < total:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Montant reçu insuffisant : reçu {received:.2f} "
                    f"< total {total:.2f}"
                )
            # Monnaie rendue = reçu − total (toujours ≥ 0 après le contrôle).
            change = max(0.0, received - total)
            from app.modules.payments.schemas import PaymentCreate
            from app.modules.payments.services.payment_service import PaymentService

            payment_data = PaymentCreate(
                partner_id=partner_id,
                invoice_id=invoice.id,
                amount=total,  # appliqué = total (contrôle S-7 au montant exact)
                change_amount=change,
                method=data.method or "cash",
                direction="in",
                notes=f"Vente comptoir {order.reference}",
            )
            payment = await PaymentService(self.session).create_payment(payment_data)

        return {
            "order_id": order.id,
            "order_reference": order.reference,
            "invoice_id": invoice.id,
            "invoice_reference": invoice.reference,
            "payment_id": payment.id if payment else None,
            "payment_reference": payment.reference if payment else None,
            "total": total,
            "amount_received": received if received > 0 else total,
            "change_amount": change,
            "method": data.method or "cash",
        }

    async def list_pos_sales(
        self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 15, include_archived: bool = False
    ) -> dict:
        """Historique des ventes comptoir — plus récent d'abord, paginé.

        Les ventes archivées sont exclues par défaut : elles ont été
        masquées de l'historique (comptabilité conservée).
        """
        from sqlalchemy import func, select

        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
        from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

        cond = SalesOrder.fulfillment_mode == "pos"
        if not include_archived:
            cond = cond & (SalesOrder.archived == False)  # noqa: E712
        total = (
            await self.session.execute(
                select(func.count()).select_from(SalesOrder).where(cond)
            )
        ).scalar_one()

        res = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .where(cond)
            .order_by(SalesOrder.id.desc())
            .offset(skip)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        orders = list(res.scalars().all())

        # Noms des clients
        partner_names: dict[int, str] = {}
        partner_ids = {o.partner_id for o in orders}
        if partner_ids:
            rows = await self.session.execute(
                select(Partner.id, Partner.name).where(Partner.id.in_(partner_ids))
            )
            partner_names = dict(rows.all())

        # Mode de paiement (via facture → paiement)
        methods: dict[int, str] = {}
        order_ids = [o.id for o in orders]
        if order_ids:
            rows = await self.session.execute(
                select(Invoice.order_id, Payment.method)
                .join(Payment, Payment.invoice_id == Invoice.id)
                .where(Invoice.order_id.in_(order_ids))
            )
            methods = {oid: m for oid, m in rows.all() if oid is not None}

        items = [
            {
                "id": o.id,
                "reference": o.reference,
                "created_at": o.created_at,
                "partner_name": partner_names.get(o.partner_id),
                "items_count": len(o.lines),
                "amount_total": float(o.amount_total or 0),
                "currency_code": o.currency_code,
                "status": o.status,
                "payment_method": methods.get(o.id),
            }
            for o in orders
        ]
        return {"items": items, "total": total}

    async def get_pos_sale(self, order_id: int) -> dict:
        """Détail d'une vente comptoir : commande + lignes + facture + paiement.

        Utilisé par la vue détail de l'historique (consultation seule —
        sortir de la vente la clôture de fait, sans aucun effet de bord).
        """
        from sqlalchemy import select

        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice
        from app.modules.payments.models.payment import Payment

        order = await self.orders_.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None or order.fulfillment_mode != "pos":
            raise ValueError(f"Vente comptoir {order_id} introuvable")

        partner = (
            await self.session.get(Partner, order.partner_id)
            if order.partner_id
            else None
        )
        invoice = (
            await self.session.execute(
                select(Invoice).where(Invoice.order_id == order.id)
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        payment = None
        if invoice is not None:
            payment = (
                await self.session.execute(
                    select(Payment).where(Payment.invoice_id == invoice.id)
                )
            ).scalar_one_or_none()

        return {
            "id": order.id,
            "reference": order.reference,
            "created_at": order.created_at,
            "order_date": order.order_date,
            "status": order.status,
            "currency_code": order.currency_code,
            "amount_untaxed": float(order.amount_untaxed or 0),
            "amount_total": float(order.amount_total or 0),
            "archived": bool(order.archived),
            "partner": (
                {"id": partner.id, "name": partner.name} if partner else None
            ),
            "lines": [
                {
                    "product_id": line.product_id,
                    "description": line.description
                    or (line.product.name if line.product else None),
                    "variant_name": line.variant_name,
                    "quantity": float(line.quantity_ordered or 0),
                    "unit": line.unit,
                    "unit_price": float(line.unit_price or 0),
                    "discount_percent": float(line.discount_percent or 0),
                    "subtotal": float(line.subtotal or 0),
                }
                for line in sorted(
                    order.lines, key=lambda ln: (ln.position or 0, ln.id)
                )
            ],
            "invoice": (
                {
                    "id": invoice.id,
                    "reference": invoice.reference,
                    "status": invoice.status,
                }
                if invoice
                else None
            ),
            "payment": (
                {
                    "id": payment.id,
                    "reference": payment.reference,
                    "method": payment.method,
                    "amount": float(payment.amount or 0),
                    "change_amount": float(payment.change_amount or 0),
                }
                if payment
                else None
            ),
        }

    async def archive_pos_sale(self, order_id: int) -> dict:
        """Archive une vente comptoir (masquage d'historique uniquement).

        La facture et le paiement sont conservés : aucun impact comptable.
        """
        order = await self.orders_.get_order(order_id)
        if order is None or order.fulfillment_mode != "pos":
            raise ValueError(f"Vente comptoir {order_id} introuvable")
        if not order.archived:
            order.archived = True
            await self.session.commit()
        return {"id": order.id, "reference": order.reference, "archived": True}
````

## File: backend/app/modules/sales/services/quote_service.py
````python
"""
Service Ventes — devis.

Logique clé :
- lignes standard et lignes tôle BAC multi-longueurs (sous-lignes longueur + qté)
- vente à la pièce standard (mode dual) convertie en coupe de longueur standard,
  facturée au prorata du ml : montant = qty × unit_length × prix/ml
- validation croisée ligne ↔ produit (mode de vente dérivé de la catégorie)
- conversion devis → commande (coupes BAC préservées)
- événements : sales.quote.created / sales.quote.confirmed
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import calendar
import logging
from datetime import date
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

from app.core.services.sequence_service import SequenceService
from app.shared.events import event_bus
from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import Product
from app.modules.catalogue.models.variant import ProductVariant
from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
from app.modules.sales.models.order import OrderLineCut, SalesOrder, SalesOrderLine
from app.modules.sales.models.quote import Quote, QuoteLine, QuoteLineCut
from app.modules.sales.schemas import QuoteCreate, QuoteLineCreate, QuoteUpdate

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Contact commercial (vendeur)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
_COMMERCIAL_ROLE_CODES = {"vendeur", "commercial", "sales", "salesperson"}


def _user_role_codes(user: Any) -> set[str]:
    """Codes des rôles de l'utilisateur (insensible à la casse)."""
    codes: set[str] = set()
    for ur in getattr(user, "user_roles", None) or []:
        role = getattr(ur, "role", None)
        code = (getattr(role, "code", None) or "").strip().lower()
        if code:
            codes.add(code)
    return codes


def _is_privileged_seller_chooser(user: Any) -> bool:
    """True si l'utilisateur peut choisir le commercial (admin/manager)."""
    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False):
        return True
    codes = _user_role_codes(user)
    return bool(codes & {"admin", "manager", "administrateur"})


def _is_commercial(user: Any) -> bool:
    """True si l'utilisateur a des privilèges de commercial."""
    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False):
        return True
    codes = _user_role_codes(user)
    if codes & {"admin", "manager", "administrateur"}:
        return True
    return bool(codes & _COMMERCIAL_ROLE_CODES)


async def _resolve_salesperson_id(
    session: AsyncSession, requested_id: int | None, current_user: Any | None
) -> int | None:
    """Résout le commercial du devis.

    - compte commercial → commercial = créateur (valeur fournie ignorée)
    - admin/manager → utilise ``requested_id`` si fourni, sinon créateur
    - le user désigné doit exister, être actif et avoir un rôle commercial
    """
    from app.core.models.user import User, UserRole

    if current_user is None:
        target_id = requested_id
    elif _is_privileged_seller_chooser(current_user):
        target_id = requested_id if requested_id is not None else current_user.id
    else:
        target_id = current_user.id

    if target_id is None:
        return None
    # Eager : _is_commercial() lit user_roles[].role — lazy-load interdit en async.
    user = await session.get(
        User,
        target_id,
        options=(selectinload(User.user_roles).selectinload(UserRole.role),),
    )
    if user is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Commercial {target_id} introuvable")
    if not user.is_active:
        raise ValueError("Le commercial désigné est inactif")
    if not _is_commercial(user):
        raise ValueError("L'utilisateur désigné n'a pas de privilèges commerciaux")
    return user.id


def _plus_one_month(d: date) -> date:
    """Date + 1 mois (jour clampé à la fin du mois cible : 31/01 → 28/02)."""
    y, m = (d.year + 1, 1) if d.month == 12 else (d.year, d.month + 1)
    return date(y, m, min(d.day, calendar.monthrange(y, m)[1]))


async def prepare_line_data(
    session: AsyncSession, data: QuoteLineCreate
) -> QuoteLineCreate:
    """Valide la cohérence ligne ↔ produit et normalise la ligne.

    Règles (mode de vente dérivé de la catégorie du produit) :
    - produit ``unit``  : vente à l'unité uniquement — coupes refusées
    - produit ``length``: vente au ml uniquement — ``sell_by_length`` forcé,
      sous-lignes (qty pièces × longueur) attendues (ou qty en mètres)
    - produit ``dual``  : au ml (coupes) OU à la pièce standard → convertie
      en coupe ``{quantity: qty, length: unit_length}`` (facturation au
      prorata du ml)
    - prix par défaut repris du produit si non fourni
    """
    if data.product_id is None:
        return data  # ligne libre (description seule)

    product = await session.get(Product, data.product_id)
    if product is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Produit {data.product_id} introuvable")

    sells_length = bool(product.sell_by_length)
    payload = data.model_dump()

    # Variante (optionnelle) : doit appartenir au produit et être active.
    variant: ProductVariant | None = None
    if data.variant_id is not None:
        variant = await session.get(ProductVariant, data.variant_id)
        if variant is None or variant.product_id != product.id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"La variante {data.variant_id} n'appartient pas au produit "
                f"« {product.name} »."
            )
        if not variant.is_active:
            raise ValueError(f"La variante « {variant.name_suffix} » est inactive.")
    # Le libellé de variante est toujours recalculé côté serveur.
    payload["variant_name"] = variant.name_suffix if variant else None

    if data.sell_by_length and not sells_length:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Le produit « {product.name} » ne se vend pas au mètre linéaire."
        )
    if sells_length and not data.sell_by_length:
        if product.sale_mode != "dual":
            raise ValueError(
                f"Le produit « {product.name} » se vend au mètre linéaire : "
                "fournissez les longueurs (sous-lignes quantité × longueur)."
            )
        # Vente à la pièce standard (dual) → coupe de longueur standard,
        # facturée au prorata du ml.
        if not product.unit_length:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Le produit « {product.name} » n'a pas de longueur standard "
                "(unit_length) définie : vente à la pièce impossible."
            )
        payload["sell_by_length"] = True
        payload["cuts"] = [
            {"quantity": float(data.quantity or 1), "length": float(product.unit_length)}
        ]

    # Prix par défaut : la variante prime sur le produit de base.
    if not payload.get("unit_price"):
        if payload["sell_by_length"]:
            payload["unit_price"] = float(
                (variant.price_per_meter if variant else None)
                or product.price_per_meter
                or 0
            )
        else:
            payload["unit_price"] = float(
                (variant.selling_price if variant else None)
                or product.selling_price
                or 0
            )

    # Validations des sous-lignes de coupe
    if payload["sell_by_length"]:
        for cut in payload.get("cuts", []):
            if float(cut.get("length", 0)) <= 0:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Longueur invalide pour « {product.name} » : "
                    "chaque sous-ligne doit avoir une longueur > 0."
                )
            if float(cut.get("quantity", 0)) < 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Quantité invalide pour « {product.name} » : "
                    "au moins 1 pièce par longueur."
                )

    return QuoteLineCreate(**payload)


def build_quote_line(data: QuoteLineCreate) -> QuoteLine:
    """Construit une ligne de devis (standard ou BAC) avec totaux calculés."""
    line = QuoteLine(
        product_id=data.product_id,
        variant_id=data.variant_id,
        variant_name=data.variant_name,
        description=data.description,
        quantity=data.quantity,
        unit=data.unit,
        sell_by_length=data.sell_by_length,
        unit_price=data.unit_price,
        discount_percent=data.discount_percent,
    )
    if data.sell_by_length and data.cuts:
        for cut in data.cuts:
            line.cuts.append(
                QuoteLineCut(
                    quantity=cut.quantity,
                    length=cut.length,
                    unit_price=cut.unit_price,
                )
            )
    line.compute_totals()
    return line


def build_order_line_from_quote(ql: QuoteLine) -> SalesOrderLine:
    """Devis → commande : le détail des longueurs n'est jamais perdu."""
    ol = SalesOrderLine(
        product_id=ql.product_id,
        variant_id=ql.variant_id,
        variant_name=ql.variant_name,
        description=ql.description,
        quantity_ordered=float(ql.total_length or ql.quantity),
        unit=ql.unit,
        sell_by_length=ql.sell_by_length,
        unit_price=ql.unit_price,
        discount_percent=ql.discount_percent,
        total_length=ql.total_length,
        subtotal=ql.subtotal,
    )
    for cut in ql.cuts:
        ol.cuts.append(
            OrderLineCut(
                quantity=cut.quantity,
                length=cut.length,
                unit_price=cut.unit_price,
            )
        )
    return ol


class QuoteService:
    """Service des devis."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session
        self.sequences = SequenceService(session)

    def _recompute_totals(
        self,
        quote: Quote,
        tax_percent: float = 0,
        global_discount: float | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Calcule les totaux du devis.

        - ``amount_untaxed`` : somme des sous-totaux de lignes (après
          remises par ligne)
        - ``discount_amount`` : remise globale (montant fixe)
        - ``tax_amount``     : TVA appliquée sur (HT − remise globale)
        - ``amount_total``   : HT − remise globale + TVA
        """
        untaxed = sum(float(l.subtotal or 0) for l in quote.lines)
        discount = max(float(global_discount or 0), 0)
        base = max(untaxed - discount, 0)
        tax = base * float(tax_percent or 0) / 100

        quote.amount_untaxed = untaxed
        quote.discount_amount = discount
        quote.tax_amount = tax
        quote.amount_total = base + tax

    @staticmethod
    def _merge_metadata(
        quote: Quote,
        payment_term: str | None,
        customer_reference: str | None,
    ) -> None:
        """Stocke payment_term / customer_reference dans metadata_json."""
        meta = dict(quote.metadata_json or {})
        if payment_term is not None:
            meta["payment_term"] = payment_term
        if customer_reference is not None:
            meta["customer_reference"] = customer_reference
        quote.metadata_json = meta

    async def create_quote(
        self, data: QuoteCreate, current_user: Any | None = None
    ) -> Quote:
        reference = await self.sequences.next_value("quote", "DEV")
        quote_date = data.quote_date or date.today()
        valid_until = data.valid_until
        if valid_until is None:
            # Validité par défaut : 1 mois après la date d'émission.
            valid_until = _plus_one_month(quote_date)
        quote = Quote(
            reference=reference,
            partner_id=data.partner_id,
            site_id=data.site_id,
            salesperson_id=await _resolve_salesperson_id(
                self.session, data.salesperson_id, current_user
            ),
            quote_date=quote_date,
            valid_until=valid_until,
            currency_code=data.currency_code,
            notes=data.notes,
            terms=data.terms,
        )
        for line_data in data.lines:
            prepared = await prepare_line_data(self.session, line_data)
            quote.lines.append(build_quote_line(prepared))
        self._merge_metadata(quote, data.payment_term, data.customer_reference)
        self._recompute_totals(quote, data.tax_percent, data.discount_amount)

        # Le document hérite du tenant de son partenaire
        if quote.company_id is None:
            partner = await self.session.get(Partner, data.partner_id)
            if partner is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Client {data.partner_id} introuvable")
            quote.company_id = partner.company_id
        for line in quote.lines:
            line.company_id = quote.company_id

        self.session.add(quote)
        await self.session.commit()

        # Recharge avec lignes + coupes (évite les lazy-loads async non awaités)
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Quote)
            .options(
                selectinload(Quote.lines).selectinload(QuoteLine.cuts)
            )
            .where(Quote.id == quote.id)
        )
        quote = result.scalar_one()

        await event_bus.emit(
            "sales.quote.created", {"quote_id": quote.id, "reference": reference}
        )
        return quote

    async def get_quote(self, quote_id: int) -> Quote | None:
        return await self.session.get(Quote, quote_id)

    async def update_quote(
        self, quote_id: int, data: QuoteUpdate, current_user: Any | None = None
    ) -> Quote:
        """Met à jour un devis — autorisé uniquement au statut brouillon.

        Si ``data.lines`` est fourni, toutes les lignes existantes sont
        remplacées (coupes BAC comprises) et les totaux recalculés.
        """
        quote = await self.session.get(Quote, quote_id)
        if quote is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Devis {quote_id} introuvable")
        if quote.status != "draft":
            raise ValueError(
                "Seul un devis au statut « brouillon » peut être modifié."
            )

        if data.partner_id is not None:
            quote.partner_id = data.partner_id
        if data.site_id is not None:
            quote.site_id = data.site_id
        if data.quote_date is not None:
            quote.quote_date = data.quote_date
        if data.valid_until is not None:
            quote.valid_until = data.valid_until
        if data.currency_code is not None:
            quote.currency_code = data.currency_code
        if data.notes is not None:
            quote.notes = data.notes
        if data.terms is not None:
            quote.terms = data.terms
        if data.salesperson_id is not None:
            quote.salesperson_id = await _resolve_salesperson_id(
                self.session, data.salesperson_id, current_user
            )
        if data.payment_term is not None or data.customer_reference is not None:
            self._merge_metadata(
                quote, data.payment_term, data.customer_reference
            )

        recompute = False
        if data.lines is not None:
            # Remplace l'ensemble des lignes (cascade delete-orphan sur coupes)
            quote.lines.clear()
            await self.session.flush()
            for line_data in data.lines:
                prepared = await prepare_line_data(self.session, line_data)
                line = build_quote_line(prepared)
                line.company_id = quote.company_id
                quote.lines.append(line)
            recompute = True

        # Remise globale / TVA modifiables seules
        if (
            data.discount_amount is not None
            or data.tax_percent is not None
            or recompute
        ):
            self._recompute_totals(
                quote,
                data.tax_percent
                if data.tax_percent is not None
                else (quote.metadata_json or {}).get("tax_percent", 0),
                data.discount_amount
                if data.discount_amount is not None
                else float(quote.discount_amount or 0),
            )
            if data.tax_percent is not None:
                meta = dict(quote.metadata_json or {})
                meta["tax_percent"] = data.tax_percent
                quote.metadata_json = meta

        await self.session.commit()

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Quote)
            .options(selectinload(Quote.lines).selectinload(QuoteLine.cuts))
            .where(Quote.id == quote.id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one()

    async def delete_quote(
        self, quote_id: int, user_id: int | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Supprime un devis — brouillon uniquement (cascade).

        Garde-fous :
        - statut ``draft`` (après retour en brouillon du devis confirmé) ;
        - aucune commande rattachée (FK ``sales_orders.quote_id``) ;
        - donc, si confirmé, facture annulée/détachée ou supprimée et
          bons de livraison supprimés avant (vérification active ici).
        """
        quote = await self.session.get(Quote, quote_id)
        if quote is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Devis {quote_id} introuvable")
        if quote.status != "draft":
            raise ValueError(
                "Seul un devis au statut « brouillon » peut être supprimé."
            )

        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

        orders = list((await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder).where(SalesOrder.quote_id == quote.id)
        )).scalars().all())
        if orders:
            active = (await self.session.execute(
                select(Invoice.reference)
                .where(
                    Invoice.order_id.in_([o.id for o in orders]),
                    Invoice.status.notin_(["cancelled", "credit"]),
                )
                .limit(5)
            )).scalars().all()
            if active:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : une facture active est rattachée à ce "
                    "devis (" + ", ".join(active) + ") — annulez-la d'abord."
                )
            raise ValueError(
                "Impossible : des commandes sont encore rattachées à ce "
                "devis — supprimez-les d'abord."
            )

        from app.core.services.audit_service import AuditService

        await AuditService(self.session).log(
            "quote.deleted",
            "quote",
            quote.id,
            company_id=quote.company_id,
            user_id=user_id,
            old_values={
                "reference": quote.reference,
                "status": quote.status,
                "partner_id": quote.partner_id,
                "amount_total": float(quote.amount_total or 0),
            },
        )
        await self.session.delete(quote)  # cascade lines + cuts
        await self.session.commit()

    async def back_to_draft(self, quote_id: int) -> Quote:
        """Remet un devis confirmé au statut brouillon.

        - annule la commande générée à la confirmation si elle est encore
          au brouillon (aucune réservation de stock à cette étape)
        - refuse si la commande liée est elle-même confirmée, ou si une
          facture / un bon de livraison y est déjà rattaché
        """
        quote = await self.session.get(Quote, quote_id)
        if quote is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Devis {quote_id} introuvable")
        if quote.status != "confirmed":
            raise ValueError(
                "Seul un devis confirmé peut être remis au brouillon."
            )

        from app.modules.delivery.models.delivery import DeliveryNote
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

        # Commandes générées depuis ce devis
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder).where(SalesOrder.quote_id == quote.id)
        )
        orders = list(result.scalars().all())

        for order in orders:
            if order.status != "draft":
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : la commande liée à ce devis est confirmée. "
                    "Remettez d'abord la commande au brouillon."
                )
            inv = await self.session.execute(
                select(Invoice).where(Invoice.order_id == order.id).limit(1)
            )
            if inv.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : une facture est liée à ce devis. "
                    "Annulez d'abord la facture."
                )
            dlv = await self.session.execute(
                select(DeliveryNote).where(DeliveryNote.order_id == order.id).limit(1)
            )
            if dlv.scalar_one_or_none() is not None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Impossible : un bon de livraison est lié à ce devis. "
                    "Annulez d'abord le bon de livraison."
                )

        # Supprime la (ou les) commande(s) encore au brouillon (cascade lines+cuts)
        for order in orders:
            if order.status == "draft":
                await self.session.delete(order)

        quote.status = "draft"
        await self.session.commit()

        await event_bus.emit("sales.quote.back_to_draft", {"quote_id": quote.id})

        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(Quote)
            .options(selectinload(Quote.lines).selectinload(QuoteLine.cuts))
            .where(Quote.id == quote.id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one()


    async def list_quotes(
        self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, partner_id: int | None = None
    ) -> list[Quote]:
        stmt = select(Quote).offset(skip).limit(limit).order_by(Quote.id.desc())
        if partner_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(Quote.partner_id == partner_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        return list(result.scalars().all())

    async def _find_order_for_quote(self, quote_id: int) -> SalesOrder | None:
        """Commande déjà générée par ce devis (la plus récente, hors annulée)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts)
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.quote_id == quote_id, SalesOrder.status != "cancelled")
            .order_by(SalesOrder.id.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def confirm_quote(self, quote_id: int) -> SalesOrder:
        """Convertit un devis confirmé en commande client.

        **Idempotent** : un devis déjà confirmé conserve sa commande — un
        second appel renvoie la commande existante au lieu d'en créer une
        nouvelle.  Le bouton « Confirmer » peut donc être recliqué sans risque
        et le parcours « Créer facture » réutilise toujours la même commande.
        """
        quote = await self.session.get(Quote, quote_id)
        if quote is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Devis {quote_id} introuvable")

        if quote.status != "draft":
            existing = await self._find_order_for_quote(quote.id)
            if existing is not None:
                return existing

        order = SalesOrder(
            reference=await self.sequences.next_value("order", "COM"),
            partner_id=quote.partner_id,
            site_id=quote.site_id,
            quote_id=quote.id,
            currency_code=quote.currency_code,
            salesperson_id=quote.salesperson_id,
        )
        for ql in quote.lines:
            order.lines.append(build_order_line_from_quote(ql))

        order.amount_untaxed = quote.amount_untaxed
        order.tax_amount = quote.tax_amount
        order.amount_total = quote.amount_total
        # La commande hérite du tenant du devis
        order.company_id = quote.company_id
        for line in order.lines:
            line.company_id = order.company_id

        quote.status = "confirmed"
        self.session.add(order)
        await self.session.commit()

        # Recharge la commande avec lignes + coupes
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(SalesOrder)
            .options(
                selectinload(SalesOrder.lines).selectinload(SalesOrderLine.cuts)
            )
            .where(SalesOrder.id == order.id)
        )
        order = result.scalar_one()

        await event_bus.emit(
            "sales.quote.confirmed", {"quote_id": quote.id}
        )
        await event_bus.emit(
            "sales.order.created",
            {"order_id": order.id, "reference": order.reference},
        )
        return order
````

````python
"""
Endpoints API du module Stock — entrepôts, niveaux, mouvements.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import select

from app.api.deps import SessionDep
from app.core.dependencies.auth import get_current_active_user
from app.core.dependencies.permissions import require_permission
from app.core.models.user import User
from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import (
    Warehouse,
    StockLevel,
    StockMovement,
)
from app.modules.stock.schemas import (
    MovementCreate,
    MovementRead,
    StockLevelRead,
    WarehouseCreate,
    WarehouseRead,
)
from app.modules.stock.services.stock_service import StockService

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/warehouses", response_model=list[WarehouseRead])
async def list_warehouses(
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("warehouse", "view")),
):
    result = await session.execute(select(Warehouse).order_by(Warehouse.id))
    return list(result.scalars().all())


@router.post("/warehouses", response_model=WarehouseRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_warehouse(
    body: WarehouseCreate,
    session: SessionDep,
    user: User = Depends(require_permission("warehouse", "create")),
):
    # company_id est NOT NULL (TenantMixin) et doit venir de l'utilisateur.
    warehouse = Warehouse(**body.model_dump(), company_id=user.company_id)
    session.add(warehouse)
    await session.commit()
    await session.refresh(warehouse)
    return warehouse


@router.get("/levels", response_model=list[StockLevelRead])
async def list_stock_levels(
    session: SessionDep,
    product_id: int | None = None,
    warehouse_id: int | None = None,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("stock_level", "view")),
):
    stmt = select(StockLevel).order_by(StockLevel.id)
    if product_id:
        stmt = stmt.where(StockLevel.product_id == product_id)
    if warehouse_id:
        stmt = stmt.where(StockLevel.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    return list(result.scalars().all())


@router.get("/levels/available")
async def get_available(
    session: SessionDep,
    product_id: int,
    warehouse_id: int | None = None,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("stock_level", "view")),
):
    service = StockService(session)
    available = await service.get_available_stock(product_id, warehouse_id)
    return {"product_id": product_id, "available": available}


@router.get("/movements", response_model=list[MovementRead])
async def list_movements(
    session: SessionDep,
    skip: int = 0,
    limit: int = 100,
    product_id: int | None = None,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("stock_movement", "view")),
):
    stmt = select(StockMovement).offset(skip).limit(limit).order_by(StockMovement.id.desc())
    if product_id:
        stmt = stmt.where(StockMovement.product_id == product_id)
    result = await session.execute(stmt)
    return list(result.scalars().all())


@router.post("/movements", response_model=MovementRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_movement(
    body: MovementCreate,
    session: SessionDep,
    _: User = Depends(require_permission("stock_movement", "create")),
):
    """Enregistre un mouvement de stock (entrée, sortie, transfert...)."""
    service = StockService(session)
    return await service.record_movement(**body.model_dump())
````
