````python
"""
Modèles Stock — entrepôts, niveaux de stock et mouvements.

- ``StockLevel`` : stock réel / réservé / disponible par produit et entrepôt
- ``StockMovement`` : entrées, sorties, transferts, ajustements, pertes
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import (
    JSON,
    Boolean,
    DateTime,
    ForeignKey,
    Integer,
    Numeric,
    String,
    UniqueConstraint,
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, MappedColumn, relationship

from app.core.database import Base, TenantMixin
from app.shared.enums import StockMovementType


class Warehouse(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Entrepôt / magasin / emplacement."""

    name: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(200), nullable=False)
    code: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(30), index=True)
    warehouse_type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="warehouse")
    address: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = MappedColumn(JSON, default=dict)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = MappedColumn(Boolean, default=True)

    levels: Mapped[list["StockLevel"]] = relationship(
        "StockLevel", back_populates="warehouse",
        cascade="all, delete-orphan", lazy="selectin",
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<Warehouse {self.code or self.name}>"


class StockLevel(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Niveau de stock d'un produit dans un entrepôt.

    - ``quantity_on_hand``  : stock réel (physique)
    - ``quantity_reserved`` : stock réservé pour des commandes
    - ``quantity_incoming`` : stock attendu (commandes fournisseurs)
    """

    __tablename__ = "stock_levels"
    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint("company_id", "warehouse_id", "product_id",
                         name="uq_stock_level"),
    )

    warehouse_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("warehouses.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    product_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("products.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    location: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(100))

    quantity_on_hand: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_reserved: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)
    quantity_incoming: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), default=0)

    # Valorisation
    unit_cost: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 6))

    warehouse: Mapped["Warehouse"] = relationship(
        "Warehouse", back_populates="levels"
    )

    @property
    def available(self) -> float:
        return float(self.quantity_on_hand) - float(self.quantity_reserved)

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<StockLevel wh={self.warehouse_id} p={self.product_id} qoh={self.quantity_on_hand}>"


class StockMovement(Base, TenantMixin):
    """
    Mouvement de stock.

    Types : entrée, sortie, transfert, ajustement, retour, perte, casse.
    """

    movement_type: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(
        String(20), default=StockMovementType.INBOUND.value, index=True
    )
    warehouse_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("warehouses.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    target_warehouse_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("warehouses.id"), nullable=True
    )  # pour les transferts

    product_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=False, index=True
    )
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), nullable=False)
    unit_cost: Mapped[float | None] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 6))

    reference_document: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(50))
    reference_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = MappedColumn(String(1000))
    metadata_json: Mapped[dict[str, Any]] = MappedColumn(JSON, default=dict)

    warehouse: Mapped["Warehouse"] = relationship(
        "Warehouse", foreign_keys=[warehouse_id]
    )

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<StockMovement {self.movement_type} p={self.product_id} q={self.quantity}>"


class StockReservation(Base, TenantMixin):
    """Réservation de stock pour une commande client."""

    level_id: Mapped[int] = MappedColumn(
        ForeignKey("stock_levels.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), nullable=False
    )
    order_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer, index=True)
    order_line_id: Mapped[int | None] = MappedColumn(Integer)
    quantity: Mapped[float] = MappedColumn(Numeric(14, 4), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = MappedColumn(String(20), default="active")

    level: Mapped["StockLevel"] = relationship("StockLevel")

    def __repr__(self) -> str:
        return f"<StockReservation level={self.level_id} q={self.quantity} [{self.status}]>"
````

## File: backend/app/modules/stock/services/stock_service.py
````python
"""
Service Stock — niveaux, réservations et mouvements.

- ``get_available_stock`` : stock disponible par produit
- ``reserve`` / ``release`` : réservation pour commande
- ``record_movement`` : entrée / sortie / transfert / ajustement
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.shared.events import event_bus
from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import (
    StockLevel,
    StockMovement,
    StockReservation,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class StockService:
    """Service du module Stock."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession):
        self.session = session

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Lecture
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def get_available_stock(
        self, product_id: int, warehouse_id: int | None = None
    ) -> float:
        """Stock disponible = réel − réservé, tous entrepôts ou un seul."""
        stmt = select(StockLevel).where(StockLevel.product_id == product_id)
        if warehouse_id:
            stmt = stmt.where(StockLevel.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        levels = result.scalars().all()
        return sum(level.available for level in levels)

    async def get_or_create_level(
        self, warehouse_id: int, product_id: int
    ) -> StockLevel:
        """Récupère ou crée la ligne de niveau de stock (tenant hérité)."""
        result = await self.session.execute(
            select(StockLevel).where(
                StockLevel.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
                StockLevel.product_id == product_id,
            )
        )
        level = result.scalars().first()
        if level is None:
            from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import Warehouse

            warehouse = await self.session.get(Warehouse, warehouse_id)
            if warehouse is None:
                raise ValueError(f"Entrepôt {warehouse_id} introuvable")
            level = StockLevel(
                warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
                product_id=product_id,
                company_id=warehouse.company_id,
            )
            self.session.add(level)
            await self.session.flush()
        return level

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Réservations
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def reserve(
        self,
        product_id: int,
        quantity: float,
        warehouse_id: int,
        order_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> float:
        """
        Réserve du stock pour une commande. Retourne la quantité réservée.

        Ne réserve jamais plus que le disponible.
        Émet ``inventory.stock.reserved``.
        """
        level = await self.get_or_create_level(warehouse_id, product_id)
        to_reserve = min(quantity, level.available)
        if to_reserve <= 0:
            return 0.0

        level.quantity_reserved = float(level.quantity_reserved) + to_reserve
        reservation = StockReservation(
            level_id=level.id,
            order_id=order_id,
            quantity=to_reserve,
            status="active",
            company_id=level.company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(reservation)
        await self.session.commit()

        await event_bus.emit("inventory.stock.reserved", {
            "product_id": product_id,
            "quantity": to_reserve,
            "order_id": order_id,
        })
        return to_reserve

    async def release(
        self, product_id: int, quantity: float, order_id: int | None = None
    ) -> float:
        """Libère une réservation. Émet ``inventory.stock.released``."""
        stmt = select(StockReservation).where(
            StockReservation.status == "active",
            StockReservation.order_id == order_id,
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        remaining = quantity
        released = 0.0
        for res in result.scalars().all():
            take = min(float(res.quantity), remaining)
            if take <= 0:
                break
            res.quantity = float(res.quantity) - take
            if float(res.quantity) <= 0:
                res.status = "released"
            level = await self.session.get(StockLevel, res.level_id)
            if level and level.product_id == product_id:
                level.quantity_reserved = max(
                    float(level.quantity_reserved) - take, 0.0
                )
            released += take
            remaining -= take
        await self.session.commit()

        if released > 0:
            await event_bus.emit("inventory.stock.released", {
                "product_id": product_id,
                "quantity": released,
                "order_id": order_id,
            })
        return released

    async def reserve_across_warehouses(
        self,
        product_id: int,
        quantity: float,
        order_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> float:
        """
        Réserve ``quantity`` en parcourant les entrepôts disposant de stock.

        Retourne la quantité effectivement réservée.
        """
        stmt = (
            select(StockLevel)
            .where(StockLevel.product_id == product_id)
            .order_by(StockLevel.id)
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(stmt)
        remaining = quantity
        reserved_total = 0.0
        for level in result.scalars().all():
            if remaining <= 0:
                break
            take = min(level.available, remaining)
            if take <= 0:
                continue
            level.quantity_reserved = float(level.quantity_reserved) + take
            self.session.add(StockReservation(
                level_id=level.id,
                order_id=order_id,
                quantity=take,
                status="active",
                company_id=level.company_id,
            ))
            reserved_total += take
            remaining -= take
        if reserved_total > 0:
            await self.session.commit()
            await event_bus.emit("inventory.stock.reserved", {
                "product_id": product_id,
                "quantity": reserved_total,
                "order_id": order_id,
            })
        return reserved_total

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Mouvements
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async def record_movement(
        self,
        movement_type: str,
        warehouse_id: int,
        product_id: int,
        quantity: float,
        target_warehouse_id: int | None = None,
        unit_cost: float | None = None,
        reference_document: str | None = None,
        reference_id: int | None = None,
        notes: str | None = None,
    ) -> StockMovement:
        """
        Enregistre un mouvement et met à jour les niveaux de stock.

        - ``inbound``    : +quantité
        - ``outbound``   : −quantité
        - ``transfer``   : −source / +cible
        - ``adjustment`` : fixe le niveau réel à ``quantity``
        - ``loss`` / ``damage`` / ``return``
        """
        from app.shared.enums import StockMovementType
        from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import Warehouse

        # Le mouvement hérite du tenant de l'entrepôt
        warehouse = await self.session.get(Warehouse, warehouse_id)
        if warehouse is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Entrepôt {warehouse_id} introuvable")
        company_id = warehouse.company_id

        movement = StockMovement(
            movement_type=movement_type,
            warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
            target_warehouse_id=target_warehouse_id,
            product_id=product_id,
            quantity=quantity,
            unit_cost=unit_cost,
            reference_document=reference_document,
            reference_id=reference_id,
            notes=notes,
            company_id=company_id,
        )
        self.session.add(movement)

        if movement_type == StockMovementType.INBOUND.value:
            level = await self._get_level(warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            level.quantity_on_hand = float(level.quantity_on_hand) + quantity
            if unit_cost:
                level.unit_cost = unit_cost
        elif movement_type == StockMovementType.OUTBOUND.value:
            level = await self._get_level(warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            level.quantity_on_hand = float(level.quantity_on_hand) - quantity
        elif (
            movement_type == StockMovementType.TRANSFER.value
            and target_warehouse_id
        ):
            src = await self._get_level(warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            src.quantity_on_hand = float(src.quantity_on_hand) - quantity
            dst = await self._get_level(target_warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            dst.quantity_on_hand = float(dst.quantity_on_hand) + quantity
        elif movement_type == StockMovementType.ADJUSTMENT.value:
            level = await self._get_level(warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            level.quantity_on_hand = quantity
        elif movement_type in (
            StockMovementType.LOSS.value,
            StockMovementType.DAMAGE.value,
        ):
            level = await self._get_level(warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            level.quantity_on_hand = float(level.quantity_on_hand) - abs(quantity)
        elif movement_type == StockMovementType.RETURN.value:
            level = await self._get_level(warehouse_id, product_id, company_id)
            level.quantity_on_hand = float(level.quantity_on_hand) + abs(quantity)

        await self.session.commit()
        await self.session.refresh(movement)
        return movement

    async def _get_level(
        self, warehouse_id: int, product_id: int, company_id: int
    ) -> StockLevel:
        """Récupère ou crée le niveau de stock avec le bon tenant."""
        level = await self.get_or_create_level(warehouse_id, product_id)
        if level.company_id is None:
            level.company_id = company_id
        return level
````

````python
"""
Énumérations partagées entre les modules métier.

Centraliser les enums évite les duplications et garantit la cohérence
des valeurs stockées en base de données.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import enum


class Gender(str, enum.Enum):
    MALE = "male"
    FEMALE = "female"
    OTHER = "other"
    UNSET = "unset"


class EntityType(str, enum.Enum):
    """Type d'entité client."""
    INDIVIDUAL = "individual"
    COMPANY = "company"
    PROFESSIONAL = "professional"


class AddressType(str, enum.Enum):
    BILLING = "billing"
    DELIVERY = "delivery"
    SITE = "site"


class ProductType(str, enum.Enum):
    """Type de produit selon la gestion de stock."""
    STOCKABLE = "stockable"      # Produit physiquement géré en stock
    ON_DEMAND = "on_demand"      # Sur commande (pas de stock)
    HYBRID = "hybrid"            # Peut être partiellement en stock
    SERVICE = "service"          # Service (pas de stock)


class SaleMode(str, enum.Enum):
    """
    Mode de vente d'une catégorie de produits (hérité par les produits).

    - UNIT   : vendu à l'unité (sac, pièce, pot...) → prix ``selling_price``
    - LENGTH : vendu au mètre linéaire, coupes à la demande (tôles BAC)
               → prix ``price_per_meter``, sous-lignes (qty × longueur)
    - DUAL   : les deux — au ml sur mesure OU à la pièce de longueur
               standard facturée au prorata (qty × unit_length × prix/ml)
               (ex. solin de rive : au ml ou pièce de 2,50 m)
    """
    UNIT = "unit"
    LENGTH = "length"
    DUAL = "dual"

    @property
    def sells_by_length(self) -> bool:
        """Vrai si le mode implique une vente au mètre linéaire possible."""
        return self in (SaleMode.LENGTH, SaleMode.DUAL)


class UnitOfMeasureCategory(str, enum.Enum):
    LENGTH = "length"
    WEIGHT = "weight"
    VOLUME = "volume"
    COUNT = "count"
    AREA = "area"


class PurchaseRequestStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    """Workflow de la Demande d'Achat (DA)."""

    DRAFT = "draft"
    SUBMITTED = "submitted"    # soumise — en attente de validation
    APPROVED = "approved"      # validée → convertible en BC
    REJECTED = "rejected"
    CONVERTED = "converted"    # convertie en bon de commande
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class PurchaseOrderStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PENDING = "pending"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    PARTIALLY_RECEIVED = "partially_received"
    RECEIVED = "received"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    DONE = "done"


class PurchaseReceptionStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    """Bon de réception fournisseur."""

    DRAFT = "draft"
    VALIDATED = "validated"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class SupplierInvoiceStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    """Facture fournisseur (rapprochée avec BC / BR)."""

    DRAFT = "draft"
    POSTED = "posted"          # enregistrée + comptabilisée
    PAID = "paid"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"


class SalesOrderStatus(str, enum.Enum):
    DRAFT = "draft"
    PROFORMA = "proforma"
    CONFIRMED = "confirmed"
    RESERVED = "reserved"
    SHIPPED = "shipped"
    DELIVERED = "delivered"
    CANCELLED = "cancelled"
    RETURNED = "returned"


class DeliveryStatus(str, enum.Enum):
````

## File: backend/app/shared/events.py
````python
"""
Système d'événements internes — EventBus découplé inter-modules.

Un module émet un événement sans connaître les modules qui l'écoutent.

Usage ::

    # Émission
    from app.shared.events import event_bus
    event_bus.publish("sales.order.confirmed", {"order_id": 42})

    # Écoute
    @event_bus.subscribe("sales.order.confirmed")
    async def handle_order_confirmed(event: Event):
        ...
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import logging
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Awaitable, Callable

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EventHandler = Callable[[str, dict[str, Any]], Awaitable[None]]


@dataclass
class Event:
    """Un événement métier."""
    name: str
    payload: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class EventBus:
    """
    Bus d'événements in-process.

    Supporte :
    - ``publish`` / ``emit`` — émettre un événement (sync/async)
    - ``subscribe`` — enregistrer un handler async
    - ``wait_for`` — attendre qu'un événement soit publié (test)
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._handlers: dict[str, list[EventHandler]] = {}

    def subscribe(self, event_name: str) -> Callable[[EventHandler], EventHandler]:
        """Décorateur pour enregistrer un handler."""
        def decorator(handler: EventHandler) -> EventHandler:
            self._handlers.setdefault(event_name, []).append(handler)
            logger.debug("Handler inscrit : %s -> %s", event_name, handler.__name__)
            return handler
        return decorator

    def unsubscribe(self, event_name: str, handler: EventHandler) -> None:
        """Désinscrit un handler."""
        if event_name in self._handlers:
            self._handlers[event_name] = [
                h for h in self._handlers[event_name] if h is not handler
            ]

    def publish(self, event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Event:
        """
        Publie un événement de manière synchrone.

        Les handlers async sont planifiés via ``asyncio.create_task``
        si on est dans un event loop, sinon exécutés via ``asyncio.run``.
        """
        event = Event(name=event_name, payload=payload or {})
        self._dispatch_sync(event)
        return event

    async def emit(self, event_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Event:
        """
        Publie un événement de manière asynchrone.

        Tous les handlers sont exécutés de manière concurrente.
        """
        event = Event(name=event_name, payload=payload or {})
        await self._dispatch_async(event)
        return event

    def _dispatch_sync(self, event: Event) -> None:
        handlers = self._handlers.get(event.name, [])
        for handler in handlers:
            try:
                if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(handler):
                    # Planifie la tâche async
                    try:
                        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
                        loop.create_task(handler(event.name, event.payload))
                    except RuntimeError:
                        # Pas de event loop — on ne peut pas exécuter async
                        logger.warning(
                            "Handler async pour '%s' non exécuté (pas de event loop)",
                            event.name,
                        )
                else:
                    handler(event.name, event.payload)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("Erreur dans le handler pour '%s'", event.name)

    async def _dispatch_async(self, event: Event) -> None:
        handlers = self._handlers.get(event.name, [])
        tasks = []
        for handler in handlers:
            if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(handler):
                tasks.append(handler(event.name, event.payload))
            else:
                handler(event.name, event.payload)
        if tasks:
            results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
            for r in results:
                if isinstance(r, Exception):
                    logger.exception("Erreur dans handler async: %s", r)

    def list_handlers(self) -> dict[str, int]:
        """Retourne le nombre de handlers par événement."""
        return {name: len(hs) for name, hs in self._handlers.items()}


# Instance globale singleton
event_bus = EventBus()
````

## File: backend/app/shared/file_export.py
````python
"""
Génération de fichiers d'export (Excel / CSV) — miroir de ``file_import``.

L'objectif est le **transfert de données** : un export doit pouvoir être
réimporté tel quel. Les conventions sont donc identiques à la lecture :

- en‑têtes en français, redescendus au même format normalisé à la
  réimportation (« Prix d'achat » → ``prix_d_achat``) ;
- dates au format ISO ``AAAA-MM-JJ`` (accepté par ``to_date``) ;
- booléens en « oui » / « non » (acceptés par ``to_bool``) ;
- nombres sans zéro parasite (``1500`` et non ``1500.0000``).

Formats :
- ``.csv`` : séparateur ``;`` (Excel francophone) + BOM UTF‑8, lisible par
  Excel comme par l'import ;
- ``.xlsx`` : openpyxl (en‑tête mis en forme, volette figée, filtre),
  repli CSV automatique si la librairie n'est pas installée.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import codecs
import csv
import io
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any, Sequence

from fastapi import HTTPException, Response

from app.core.documents.naming import content_disposition

EXPORT_FORMATS = ("xlsx", "csv")
DEFAULT_FORMAT = "xlsx"

_MEDIA_TYPES = {
    "csv": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
    "xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
}


def normalize_format(fmt: str | None) -> str:
    """``"XLSX"`` / ``".csv"`` → ``"xlsx"`` / ``"csv"`` (ou 400 si inconnu)."""
    value = (fmt or DEFAULT_FORMAT).strip().lower().lstrip(".")
    if value not in EXPORT_FORMATS:
        raise HTTPException(
            400, "Format d'export non supporté — utilisez « xlsx » ou « csv »"
        )
    return value


def to_csv_cell(value: Any) -> str:
    """Cellule destinée au CSV (chaîne, séparateur ``;``)."""
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "oui" if value else "non"
    if isinstance(value, Enum):
        return str(value.value)
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return _number_str(float(value))
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return _number_str(value)
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date().isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()
    return str(value)


def to_xlsx_cell(value: Any) -> Any:
    """Cellule destinée à Excel (types natifs, dates en ISO comme en CSV)."""
    if value is None or isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "oui" if value else "non"
    if isinstance(value, Enum):
        return str(value.value)
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        return float(value)
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date().isoformat()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value.isoformat()
    return value


def _number_str(value: float) -> str:
    """``1500.0 → "1500"``, ``0.5 → "0.5"`` (CSV : reste lisible/parsable)."""
    text = f"{value:.4f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return text if text not in ("", "-") else "0"


def export_response(
    fmt: str | None,
    filename_base: str,
    headers: Sequence[str],
    rows: Sequence[Sequence[Any]],
) -> Response:
    """Réponse de téléchargement (``Content-Disposition: attachment``).

    ``filename_base`` : nom sans extension (« Contacts ») → le fichier est
    daté du jour (« Contacts_2026-10-02.xlsx ») pour classer les exports.
    """
    export_format = normalize_format(fmt)
    filename = f"{filename_base}_{date.today().isoformat()}"

    if export_format == "xlsx":
        try:
            import openpyxl  # noqa: F401
        except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover — repli si librairie absente
            export_format = "csv"
        else:
            content = _xlsx_bytes(headers, rows)

    if export_format == "csv":
        content = _csv_bytes(headers, rows)

    filename = f"{filename}.{export_format}"
    return Response(
        content=content,
        media_type=_MEDIA_TYPES[export_format],
        headers={"Content-Disposition": content_disposition(filename, inline=False)},
    )


def _csv_bytes(
    headers: Sequence[str], rows: Sequence[Sequence[Any]]
) -> bytes:
    buffer = io.StringIO(newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(
        buffer, delimiter=";", quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL, lineterminator="\r\n"
    )
    writer.writerow(list(headers))
    for row in rows:
        writer.writerow([to_csv_cell(cell) for cell in row])
    # BOM : Excel (Windows) détecte alors l'UTF‑8 au lieu de casser les accents
    return (codecs.BOM_UTF8 + buffer.getvalue().encode("utf-8"))


def _xlsx_bytes(
    headers: Sequence[str], rows: Sequence[Sequence[Any]]
) -> bytes:
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill
    from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

    workbook = Workbook()
    sheet = workbook.active
    sheet.title = "Export"
    sheet.append(list(headers))

    header_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="0A2A6B")
    for column in range(1, len(headers) + 1):
        cell = sheet.cell(row=1, column=column)
        cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="center")

    for row in rows:
        sheet.append([to_xlsx_cell(cell) for cell in row])

    sheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
    if headers:
        last = get_column_letter(len(headers))
        sheet.auto_filter.ref = f"A1:{last}{max(len(rows) + 1, 1)}"

    # Largeurs : contenu de la colonne, plafonnées pour rester lisibles
    for index, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
        longest = len(str(header))
        for row in rows[:500]:
            if index - 1 < len(row):
                longest = max(longest, len(str(to_csv_cell(row[index - 1]))))
        sheet.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(index)].width = min(
            max(longest + 2, 10), 48
        )

    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    workbook.save(buffer)
    workbook.close()
    return buffer.getvalue()
````

## File: backend/app/shared/file_import.py
````python
"""
Lecture de fichiers Excel / CSV pour les imports en masse.

- ``.xlsx`` / ``.xlsm`` : lu avec openpyxl (première feuille, valeurs
  calculées), sans dépendance à pandas.
- ``.csv`` : encodage détecté (utf-8-sig, puis cp1252), séparateur
  détecté parmi ``;  ,  tab``.

Les en-têtes sont normalisés (minuscules, accents retirés, espaces et
tirets remplacés par ``_``) pour tolerer « Prix d'achat », « prix_achat »...
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import io
import re
import unicodedata
from typing import Any

from fastapi import HTTPException, UploadFile

ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".csv"}


def normalize_header(raw: Any) -> str:
    """« Prix d'achat HT » → ``prix_d_achat_ht``."""
    text = str(raw or "").strip().lower()
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text)
    text = "".join(c for c in text if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    text = re.sub(r"[\s\-]+", "_", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]", "", text)
    return text.strip("_")


def read_rows_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Retourne les lignes du fichier sous forme de dictionnaires
    (clé = en-tête normalisé, valeur = cellule brute)."""
    suffix = filename.lower().rsplit(".", 1)[-1] if "." in filename else ""
    if suffix not in {"xlsx", "xlsm", "csv"}:
        raise HTTPException(
            400, "Format non supporté — utilisez un fichier .xlsx ou .csv"
        )

    if suffix == "csv":
        rows = _read_csv(content)
    else:
        rows = _read_xlsx(content)

    if not rows:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Fichier vide (aucune ligne d'en-tête trouvée).")

    headers = [normalize_header(h) for h in rows[0]]
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for line_no, raw in enumerate(rows[1:], start=2):
        if all(v is None or str(v).strip() == "" for v in raw):
            continue  # ligne vide
        rec: dict[str, Any] = {"__line__": line_no}
        for i, key in enumerate(headers):
            if key:
                rec[key] = raw[i] if i < len(raw) else None
        records.append(rec)
    return records


def _read_csv(content: bytes) -> list[list[str]]:
    for encoding in ("utf-8-sig", "cp1252"):
        try:
            text = content.decode(encoding)
            break
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            continue
    else:
        text = content.decode("latin-1", errors="replace")

    sample = text[:4096]
    delimiter = max(
        (";", ",", "\t", "|"), key=lambda d: sample.count(d)
    ) if sample else ";"
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter=delimiter)
    return [row for row in reader]


def _read_xlsx(content: bytes) -> list[list[Any]]:
    try:
        from openpyxl import load_workbook
    except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover
        raise HTTPException(
            500, "Lecture Excel indisponible (openpyxl manquant sur le serveur)"
        ) from exc

    try:
        wb = load_workbook(io.BytesIO(content), data_only=True, read_only=True)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        raise HTTPException(400, f"Fichier Excel illisible : {exc}") from exc

    ws = wb.worksheets[0]
    rows: list[list[Any]] = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows(values_only=True):
        rows.append(list(row))
        if len(rows) > 5000:
            break  # garde-fou anti-fichier géant
    wb.close()
    return rows


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Convertisseurs tolérants
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
def to_float(value: Any, default: float | None = None) -> float | None:
    if value is None or str(value).strip() == "":
        return default
    try:
        text = str(value).strip().replace(" ", "").replace(",", ".")
        return float(text)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return default


def to_int(value: Any, default: int | None = None) -> int | None:
    f = to_float(value)
    return int(f) if f is not None else default


def to_date(value: Any):
    """Accepte ISO (2024-05-31), JJ/MM/AAAA et datetime Excel (openpyxl)."""
    if value is None or str(value).strip() == "":
        return None
    if hasattr(value, "year") and hasattr(value, "month"):
        from datetime import date as _date

        if hasattr(value, "date"):
            return value.date()
        return _date(value.year, value.month, value.day)
    text = str(value).strip()
    from datetime import date, datetime

    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).date()
        except ValueError:
            continue
    try:
        return date.fromisoformat(text[:10])
    except ValueError:
        return None


def to_bool(value: Any, default: bool = False) -> bool:
    if value is None:
        return default
    return str(value).strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "oui", "yes", "vrai", "o", "y")


def clean_str(value: Any, max_len: int | None = None) -> str | None:
    text = str(value).strip() if value is not None else None
    if text == "":
        return None
    if max_len and text and len(text) > max_len:
        text = text[:max_len]
    return text
````

## File: backend/app/shared/utils.py
````python
"""
Utilitaires partagés.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone


def now_utc() -> datetime:
    """Retourne la date/heure UTC actuelle."""
    return datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc)


def generate_uuid() -> str:
    """Génère un UUID4 sous forme de chaîne."""
    return str(uuid.uuid4())


def to_snake_case(name: str) -> str:
    """Convertit un nom CamelCase en snake_case."""
    s1 = re.sub("(.)([A-Z][a-z]+)", r"\1_\2", name)
    return re.sub("([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", s1).lower()


def to_camel_case(name: str) -> str:
    """Convertit un nom snake_case en camelCase."""
    components = name.split("_")
    return components[0] + "".join(x.title() for x in components[1:])


def format_phone(phone: str) -> str:
    """Normalise un numéro de téléphone."""
    return re.sub(r"[^\d\+\#]", "", phone)
````

````python
"""
Tâches Celery pour la génération de documents PDF.

Utilise WeasyPrint pour convertir un template HTML+Jinja2 en PDF.

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from celery import shared_task

from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@shared_task(bind=True, name="pdf.generate")
def generate_pdf(self, template_name: str, context: dict) -> str:
    """
    Génère un PDF à partir d'un template et d'un contexte de données.

    Retourne le chemin relatif du fichier PDF généré.
    """
    logger.info("Génération PDF — template=%s task_id=%s", template_name, self.request.id)
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    pdf_path = engine.render_to_pdf(template_name=template_name, context=context)
    return pdf_path


@shared_task(bind=True, name="pdf.generate_invoice")
def generate_invoice_pdf(self, invoice_id: int) -> str:
    """Génère le PDF d'une facture à partir de son ID."""
    logger.info("Génération facture PDF — invoice_id=%s", invoice_id)
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    pdf_path = engine.render_invoice(invoice_id=invoice_id)
    return pdf_path


@shared_task(bind=True, name="pdf.generate_quote")
def generate_quote_pdf(self, quote_id: int) -> str:
    """Génère le PDF d'un devis à partir de son ID."""
    logger.info("Génération devis PDF — quote_id=%s", quote_id)
    engine = DocumentEngine()
    pdf_path = engine.render_quote(quote_id=quote_id)
````

````python
"""
Point d'entrée de l'application FastAPI.

Configure :
- le routeur API (`/api/v1`)
- l'authentification / ouverture de session
- Sentry
- Prometheus
- l'événement de démarrage / arrêt (init DB, modules)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

import sentry_sdk
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from app.api.api import api_router, include_module_routers
from app.core.config import settings
from app.core.database import close_db, init_db
from app.core.modules import ModuleRegistry

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO if settings.debug else logging.WARNING,
    format="%(asctime)s | %(name)s | %(levelname)s | %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Lifespan — initialise les composants au démarrage
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    logger.info("🚀 Démarrage de %s v%s", settings.app_name, settings.app_version)
    logger.info("Environnement : %s", settings.environment)

    # Initialise la base de données (création des tables en dev)
    if settings.debug:
        logger.info("Création des tables — mode développement")
        await init_db()
        # Bootstrap du premier compte admin (idempotent, dev)
        from app.core.services.seed_service import run_bootstrap_if_needed

        await run_bootstrap_if_needed()

    # Synchronisation add-only des permissions système : le bootstrap ne
    # tourne que sur une base vide, toute permission ajoutée après coup
    # (ex. les actions « delete » de la cascade de suppression) serait
    # absente des bases existantes. Idempotent, sans effet de bord.
    try:
        from app.core.services.seed_service import sync_system_permissions

        await sync_system_permissions()
    except Exception:  # pragma: no cover — défensif (DB indisponible)
        logger.exception("Synchronisation des permissions système impossible")

    # Charge les modules activés
    registry = ModuleRegistry()
    await registry.load_modules()
    app.state.module_registry = registry
    logger.info("Modules chargés : %s", registry.list_active_modules())

    # Inclusion des routeurs des modules (purchases)
    include_module_routers(registry.list_active_modules())

    yield

    # Cleanup
    await close_db()
    await registry.shutdown()
    logger.info("👋 Arrêt de l'application")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
# Application
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
if settings.sentry_dsn:
    sentry_sdk.init(
        dsn=settings.sentry_dsn,
        traces_sample_rate=0.2,
        profiles_sample_rate=0.1,
    )

app = FastAPI(
    title=settings.app_name,
    version=settings.app_version,
    debug=settings.debug,
    # Sécurité : la doc interactive est TOUJOURS désactivée en production,
    # même si DOCS_ENABLED=true (protection défensive S-2).
    docs_url="/docs" if (settings.docs_enabled and settings.environment != "production") else None,
    redoc_url="/redoc" if (settings.docs_enabled and settings.environment != "production") else None,
    # Le schéma OpenAPI n'est pas exposé si la doc est désactivée
    openapi_url=(
        f"{settings.api_v1_prefix}/openapi.json"
        if (settings.docs_enabled and settings.environment != "production")
        else None
    ),
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

# CORS — origines explicites (jamais `*` avec allow_credentials)
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=settings.cors_origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
    # Le frontend lit le nom du rapport (« Devis - DEV-000019.pdf ») pour
    # nommer le fichier enregistré : en-tête exposé au JS en cross-origin.
    expose_headers=["Content-Disposition"],
)

# Routes
app.include_router(api_router, prefix=settings.api_v1_prefix)


@app.get("/health")
async def health_check() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Endpoint de santé."""
    return {"status": "healthy", "app": settings.app_name}


@app.get("/")
async def root() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Point d'accueil."""
    return {
        "app": settings.app_name,
        "version": settings.app_version,
        "docs": "/docs",
        "health": "/health",
    }
````

## File: backend/resources/templates/_doc_base.html
````html
/* ==========================================================================
   Socle commun des documents A4 (devis, facture, bon de livraison, reçu).
   Transposition du modèle validé — compatible xhtml2pdf :
   aplats de couleur uniquement (pas de coins arrondis / ombres / dégradés),
   tableaux de mise en page (pas de flex/grid), Helvetica uniquement.

   Palette : bleu marine #0a2a6b (charte), accent jaune #f5c044 (total),
   fond secondaire #edf2fb, filets #d7def0, texte #111 / #444 / #8a8fa3.
   ========================================================================== */
@page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 0; }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111; font-size: 10px; }
.page { width: 210mm; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 0 8mm; background: #fff; }

/* ---- Bandeau « dossier » (façon Odoo external_layout_folder) ---- */
table.band { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #0a2a6b; color: #fff; }
table.band td { vertical-align: middle; padding: 5mm 8mm; }
table.band p, table.band div { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
table.band .doc-title { font-size: 22px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; line-height: 1.1; }
table.band .doc-ref { font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #f5c044; margin-top: 2px; }
table.band-meta { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 9px; }
table.band-meta td { padding: 1px 0; }
table.band-meta td.lbl { color: #c9d4f2; padding-right: 8px; text-align: right; }
table.band-meta td.val { font-weight: bold; color: #fff; }
img.angle { display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: 8mm; }

/* ---- Infos société sous le bandeau (logo + slogan / adresse + NCC) ---- */
table.co-info { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; }
table.co-info td { vertical-align: top; padding: 3mm 8mm 1mm; }
table.co-info p, table.co-info div { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
table.co-info .slogan { font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #0a2a6b; margin-top: 2px; }
table.co-info .addr { color: #444; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: right; }
table.co-info .ncc { color: #0a2a6b; font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; text-align: right; margin-top: 2px; }
.status { display: inline-block; margin: 0; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; background: #fff; color: #0a2a6b; }

/* ---- Bloc destinataire ---- */
.billto { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0; background: #edf2fb; }
.billto td { vertical-align: top; padding: 3.5mm 8mm; }
.billto div { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.billto .party-label { margin-bottom: 2px; color: #0a2a6b; font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 0.8px; text-transform: uppercase; }
.billto .party-name { margin: 0 0 2px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; }
.billto .party-details { color: #444; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 2px; }

/* ---- Tableau des lignes ---- */
.items-zone { padding: 6mm 8mm 0; }
.items-title { margin: 0 0 3mm; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #0a2a6b; }
table.items { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
table.items thead td { padding: 7px 8px; background: #0a2a6b; color: #fff; font-size: 8.5px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
table.items td { padding: 6px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7def0; font-size: 9px; vertical-align: top; }
table.items tbody tr.alt td { background: #f4f6fd; }
table.items td.num, table.items thead td.num { text-align: right; }
table.items td.ctr, table.items thead td.ctr { text-align: center; }
.product-name { font-weight: bold; margin: 0; }
.product-desc { margin: 0; color: #666; font-size: 7.5px; line-height: 1.3; }

/* ---- Double bloc : infos + totaux ---- */
table.bottom-wrap { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 5mm; }
table.bottom-wrap > tr > td { vertical-align: top; padding: 0; }
.pay-box { padding-right: 8mm; }
.section-title { margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #0a2a6b; }
table.pay-info { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 9px; }
table.pay-info td { padding: 2px 0; color: #444; }
table.pay-info td.k { padding-right: 6px; color: #8a8fa3; }
table.summary-box { width: 72mm; border-collapse: collapse; margin-left: auto; }
table.summary-box td { padding: 3px 2px; color: #444; font-size: 9px; }
table.summary-box td.num { text-align: right; font-weight: bold; color: #111; }
table.summary-box tr.disc td { color: #c62828; }
table.summary-box tr.grand td { background: #f5c044; padding: 7px 6px; color: #111; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; }
.amount-words { margin-top: 4px; color: #666; font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: right; }

/* ---- Notes / CGV texte ---- */
.note { margin: 5mm 8mm 0; padding: 8px 10px; background: #edf2fb; }
.note-title { margin-bottom: 3px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0a2a6b; }
.note-content { color: #444; font-size: 8.5px; line-height: 1.6; }
.cgv-page { margin: 5mm 8mm 0; }
.cgv-page h2 { font-size: 12px; color: #0a2a6b; margin: 0 0 3mm; }
.cgv-body { font-size: 8.5px; line-height: 1.7; color: #333; }

/* ---- Cartouche signatures ---- */
table.sign-zone { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 6mm 8mm 0; width: auto; }
table.sign-zone td.sig { width: 50%; vertical-align: top; padding-right: 10mm; }
.sig-title { font-size: 8px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: #0a2a6b; margin-bottom: 12mm; }
.sig-line { border-top: 1px solid #8a8fa3; padding-top: 2px; font-size: 8px; color: #8a8fa3; }

/* ---- Pied de page (façon Odoo : mentions à gauche, doc + pagination à droite) ---- */
.doc-footer-wrap { margin: 7mm 8mm 0; border-top: 1px solid #8a8fa3; }
table.doc-footer { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
table.doc-footer td { padding: 2mm 0 0; font-size: 8px; color: #666; line-height: 1.6; vertical-align: top; }
table.doc-footer td.right { text-align: right; color: #8a8fa3; font-weight: bold; }
````

## File: backend/resources/templates/_model_base.html
````html
/*__OPEN_SANS_FACES__*/
/* ==========================================================================
   Socle « modèle » — transposition du modèle validé (facture type).
   Requiert un moteur Chrome (Playwright/Chromium) : coins arrondis,
   flex, thead répété ; la pagination « Page X / Y » est estampillée par
   le moteur dans la bande basse réservée (voir @page ci-dessous).

   Palette (charte GEA — logo Groupe Entreprise AKA) :
   bleu #1f7fc1 (titres, en-tête tableau, pastilles),
   orange #f39c12 (titre document, total),
   fond carte #edf2fb, filets #d7def0, texte #1a1a1a / #444.
   ========================================================================== */
/* Bande de pied de page réservée à la pagination « Page X / Y ».
   Chromium implémente @page et @page :first.
   On définit une marge haute sur les pages 2+ (16mm) et 0 sur la 1ère page,
   avec une marge basse de 12 mm alignée sur ``_PAGE_FOOTER_BAND_MM``. */
@page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 16mm 0 12mm 0; }
@page :first { margin-top: 0; }
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
/* Corps en flex column, hauteur minimale = zone utile A4 (297 − 12 mm de
   bande basse) : la carte s'étire et ``.model-footer`` est ancré en bas
   de page (margin-top: auto) au lieu de suivre le contenu. */
body {
  margin: 0; padding: 0 0 14mm;
  font-family: 'Open Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; color: #1a1a1a;
  font-size: 13.5px; background: #fff;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 285mm;
}

/* ---- En-tête bleu ----
   Ligne du haut (logo + nom société) : fond blanc, nom en bleu charte.
   Le reste de l'en-tête (titre document, références, client) reste bleu. */
.model-head { background: #1f7fc1; color: #fff; padding: 0 8mm 20mm; }
.model-head-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin: 0 -8mm 5mm; padding: 4mm 8mm; background: #ffffff; }
.model-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3mm; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #1f7fc1; }
.model-brand img { height: 20mm; }
.model-dots { display: flex; gap: 2mm; }
.model-dots span { width: 3.2mm; height: 3.2mm; border-radius: 50%; background: #f39c12; display: inline-block; }
.model-head-main { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8mm; }
.model-title { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1.15; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; margin: 0; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.model-ref { margin-top: 3mm; font-size: 13.5px; color: #fff; }
.model-ref b { font-weight: bold; }
.model-meta { font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.6; min-width: 62mm; }
/* Contact commercial (devis/facture) — sous le N° de document. */
.model-salesperson { margin-top: 3mm; padding: 2.5mm 3.5mm; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-left: 1mm solid #f39c12; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: #fff; max-width: 80mm; }
.model-salesperson .sp-label { font-size: 12.5px; color: #fff; }
.model-salesperson .sp-name { font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; }
.model-salesperson .sp-contact { font-size: 12px; color: #fff; }
.model-meta .lbl { color: #f39c12; font-weight: bold; margin: 2mm 0 0; }
.model-meta .val { color: #fff; margin: 0; }
/* Dates du document : titres côte à côte, valeurs en dessous de chaque titre. */
/* Colonnes fixes : titres et valeurs alignés sur les mêmes verticales. */
.model-dates { display: flex; gap: 5mm; }
.model-dates .model-date { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.model-dates .model-date:first-child { width: 31mm; }
.model-dates .model-date:last-child { width: 24mm; }
.model-dates .lbl { white-space: nowrap; }

/* ---- Carte blanche chevauchante ----
   flex-grow : la carte occupe toute la hauteur restante de la page pour
   repousser le pied de page au ras de la bande basse. */
.model-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 5mm 5mm 0 0; margin: -14mm 6mm 0; padding: 6mm 7mm 0; flex: 1 0 auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.model-section-title { margin: 0 0 3mm; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: bold; color: #1f7fc1; }

/* ---- Tableau ---- */
table.model-items { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
table.model-items thead { display: table-header-group; }
table.model-items thead td { padding: 7px 8px; background: #1f7fc1; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
table.model-items tbody td { padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 12.5px; vertical-align: top; border-bottom: 1px solid #d7def0; }
table.model-items tbody tr.alt td { background: #edf2fb; }
table.model-items tbody tr { page-break-inside: avoid; }
table.model-items td.num, table.model-items thead td.num { text-align: right; }
table.model-items td.ctr, table.model-items thead td.ctr { text-align: center; }
/* Quantité + unité : deux lignes centrées et alignées (colonne Qté). */
.qty-val { font-weight: bold; white-space: nowrap; }
.qty-unit { font-size: 11px; color: #1f7fc1; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.product-name { font-weight: bold; margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; }
.product-desc { margin: 0; color: #666; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.3; }

/* Variante du produit (ex. « Rouleau 25 m ») affichée à côté du libellé. */
.variant-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 6px;
  padding: 1px 6px;
  background: #eaf3fb;
  border: 1px solid #b8d7f0;
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: #1f7fc1;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ---- Double bloc : infos + totaux ---- */
.model-pay-total { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8mm; margin-top: 5mm; }
.model-pay { flex: 1; font-size: 12.5px; color: #444; line-height: 1.8; }
.model-pay .k { color: #1f7fc1; font-weight: bold; }
.model-totals { width: 68mm; font-size: 12.5px; }
.model-totals .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 0; color: #444; }
.model-totals .row b { color: #1a1a1a; }
.model-totals .grand { background: #f39c12; border-radius: 2mm; padding: 3mm 3mm; margin-top: 2mm; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; }
.model-totals .grand span, .model-totals .grand span:last-child { color: #ffffff; }
.amount-words { margin-top: 3mm; color: #666; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: right; }

/* ---- Notes / CGV texte ---- */
.model-note { margin-top: 5mm; padding: 8px 10px; background: #edf2fb; border-radius: 2mm; }
.model-note-title { margin-bottom: 3px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1f7fc1; }
.model-note-content { color: #444; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }

/* ---- Bande CGV + signature ----
    Mono-page : marge basse dédiée pour ne jamais toucher le pied de page
    ancré (margin-top: auto). Multi-pages : bloc insécable. */
.model-terms { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 6mm; background: #edf2fb; margin: 6mm -7mm 5mm; padding: 5mm 7mm; page-break-inside: avoid; }
.model-terms-cgv { flex: 1.2; font-size: 12px; color: #444; line-height: 1.6; }
.model-terms-cgv ol { margin: 2mm 0 0; padding-left: 5mm; }
.model-terms-sign { flex: 1; border-left: 1px solid #1f7fc1; padding-left: 6mm; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; text-align: center; font-size: 12.5px; color: #444; min-height: 45mm; }
.model-terms-sign img { max-height: 14mm; }

/* ---- Signatures seules (sans CGV) ---- */
.model-sign-only { margin-top: 8mm; font-size: 11.5px; color: #8a8fa3; page-break-inside: avoid; }
.model-sign-only .sig-title { font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: #1f7fc1; margin-bottom: 12mm; }
.model-sign-only .sig-line { border-top: 1px solid #8a8fa3; padding-top: 2px; }

/* ---- Pied de page : position fixe = bas absolu sur chaque page ----
   (mono-page comme multipages ; Chromium répète les éléments fixed).
   Le padding bas du body (14mm) empêche tout recouvrement du contenu. */
.model-footer { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; margin: 0 7mm; padding-top: 3mm; border-top: 1px solid #d7def0; font-size: 12px; color: #444; background: #fff; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4mm; }
.model-footer .contact { white-space: nowrap; }
.model-footer .legal { text-align: right; color: #8a8fa3; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }
````

## File: backend/resources/templates/delivery.html
````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{{ doc_title }}</title><style>
{% include "_model_base.html" %}
</style></head>
<body>
<div class="model-head">
  <div class="model-head-top">
    <div class="model-brand">
      {% if company and company.logo %}<img src="{{ company.logo }}" alt=""/>{% endif %}
      <span>{{ company.name if company }}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="model-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="model-head-main">
    <div>
      <p class="model-title">Bon de<br>Livraison</p>
      <div class="model-ref"><b>N° BL</b> &nbsp; : &nbsp; {{ delivery.reference }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="model-meta">
      <p class="lbl">Date de livraison :</p>
      <p class="val">{{ fmt_date(delivery.delivery_date) or '—' }}</p>
      {% if order and order.reference %}<p class="lbl">Commande :</p><p class="val">{{ order.reference }}</p>{% endif %}
      <p class="lbl">Livrer à :</p>
      <p class="val"><b>{{ partner.name if partner }}</b><br>
      {% if partner and partner.address %}{{ fmt_addr(partner) }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if partner and partner.phone %}Tél. : {{ partner.phone }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if partner and partner.email %}{{ partner.email }}{% endif %}</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="model-card">
  <p class="model-section-title">Marchandises livrées</p>
  <table class="model-items">
    <thead><tr>
      <td style="width:9%" class="ctr">N°</td>
      <td>Désignation</td>
      <td style="width:13%" class="ctr">Commandé</td>
      <td style="width:13%" class="ctr">Livré</td>
      <td style="width:12%" class="ctr">Unité</td>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody>
    {% for line in lines %}
      <tr class="{% if loop.index0 % 2 == 1 %}alt{% endif %}">
        <td class="ctr">{{ '%03d' % loop.index }}</td>
        <td>
          <div class="product-name">{{ line.description or (line.product.name if line.product else 'Produit') }}{% if line.variant_name %} <span class="variant-tag">{{ line.variant_name }}</span>{% endif %}</div>
          {% if line.cuts %}
            {% for c in line.cuts %}<div class="product-desc">{{ cut_label(c) }}</div>{% endfor %}
          {% endif %}
        </td>
        <td class="ctr">{{ fmt_num(line.quantity_ordered, 2) }}</td>
        <td class="ctr">{{ line_qty(line) }}</td>
        <td class="ctr">{{ line.unit or 'Unité' }}</td>
      </tr>
    {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  {% if delivery.notes %}
  <div class="model-note">
    <div class="model-note-title">Note</div>
    <div class="model-note-content">{{ delivery.notes }}</div>
  </div>
  {% endif %}

  <div class="model-terms">
    <div class="model-terms-cgv">
      <p class="model-section-title">Réception client</p>
      <div>Nom, date et signature</div>
    </div>
    <div class="model-terms-sign">
      <div><b>{{ company.name if company }}</b><br>Nom, fonction et signature</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="model-footer">
    <div class="contact">
      {% if company %}{{ fmt_addr(company) }}{% if company.phone %} &nbsp; Tél : {{ company.phone }}{% endif %}{% if company.email %} &nbsp; {{ company.email }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="legal">
      {% if company %}
      {% set fparts = [] %}
      {% if company.rccm %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['RCCM : ' ~ company.rccm] %}{% endif %}
      {% if company.ncc %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['NCC : ' ~ company.ncc] %}{% endif %}
      {% if company.share_capital %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['Capital : ' ~ company.share_capital] %}{% endif %}
      {{ fparts | join(' | ') }} &nbsp; {{ delivery.reference }}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</body></html>
````

## File: backend/resources/templates/invoice.html
````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{{ doc_title }}</title><style>
{% include "_model_base.html" %}
</style></head>
<body>
<div class="model-head">
  <div class="model-head-top">
    <div class="model-brand">
      {% if company and company.logo %}<img src="{{ company.logo }}" alt=""/>{% endif %}
      <span>{{ company.name if company }}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="model-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="model-head-main">
    <div>
      <p class="model-title">Facture<br>Matériaux de<br>Construction</p>
      <div class="model-ref"><b>N° Facture</b> &nbsp; : &nbsp; {{ invoice.reference }}</div>
      {% if salesperson %}
      <div class="model-salesperson">
        <div class="sp-label">Votre contact commercial</div>
        <div class="sp-name">{{ salesperson.full_name or ((salesperson.first_name or '') ~ ' ' ~ (salesperson.last_name or '')) }}</div>
        {% if salesperson.phone %}<div class="sp-contact">{{ salesperson.phone }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if salesperson.email %}<div class="sp-contact">{{ salesperson.email }}</div>{% endif %}
      </div>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="model-meta">
      <p class="lbl">Date d'émission :</p>
      <p class="val">{{ fmt_date(invoice.invoice_date) or '—' }}</p>
      <p class="lbl">Date d'échéance :</p>
      <p class="val">{{ invoice.due_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y') if invoice.due_date else '—' }}</p>
      <p class="lbl">Facturé à :</p>
      <p class="val"><b>{{ invoice.partner.name if invoice.partner }}</b><br>
      {% if invoice.partner and invoice.partner.address %}{{ fmt_addr(invoice.partner) }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if invoice.partner and invoice.partner.phone %}Tél. : {{ invoice.partner.phone }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if invoice.partner and invoice.partner.email %}{{ invoice.partner.email }}{% endif %}</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="model-card">
  <p class="model-section-title">Désignation des travaux et fournitures</p>
  <table class="model-items">
    <thead><tr>
      <td style="width:9%" class="ctr">N°</td>
      <td>Désignation</td>
      <td style="width:13%" class="ctr">Qté</td>
      <td style="width:17%" class="num">PU ({{ currency }})</td>
      <td style="width:17%" class="num">Total</td>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody>
    {% for line in lines %}
      <tr class="{% if loop.index0 % 2 == 1 %}alt{% endif %}">
        <td class="ctr">{{ '%03d' % loop.index }}</td>
        <td>
          <div class="product-name">{{ line.description or (line.product.name if line.product else 'Produit') }}{% if line.variant_name %} <span class="variant-tag">{{ line.variant_name }}</span>{% endif %}</div>
          {% if line.cuts %}
            {% for c in line.cuts %}<div class="product-desc">{{ cut_label(c) }}</div>{% endfor %}
          {% endif %}
        </td>
        {% set _qty, _unit = line_qty_parts(line) %}
        <td class="ctr"><div class="qty-val">{{ _qty }}</div>{% if _unit %}<div class="qty-unit">{{ _unit }}</div>{% endif %}</td>
        <td class="num">{{ fmt_num(line.unit_price) }}</td>
        <td class="num"><b>{{ fmt_num(line.subtotal) }}</b></td>
      </tr>
    {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="model-pay-total">
    <div class="model-pay">
      <p class="model-section-title">Informations de paiement</p>
      {% if invoice.payment_communication %}{{ invoice.payment_communication }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if company %}
      {% if company.phone %}<span class="k">Tél :</span> {{ company.phone }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if company.email %}<span class="k">Email :</span> {{ company.email }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if company.ncc %}<span class="k">NCC :</span> {{ company.ncc }}{% endif %}
      {% endif %}
      {% if invoice.notes %}<br><br><span class="k">Note :</span> {{ invoice.notes }}{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="model-totals">
      <div class="row"><span>Sous-total HT</span><b>{{ fmt_num(invoice.amount_untaxed if invoice.amount_untaxed is not none else invoice.amount_total) }}</b></div>
      {% if invoice.discount_amount %}<div class="row"><span>Remise</span><b>- {{ fmt_num(invoice.discount_amount) }}</b></div>{% endif %}
      {% if invoice.tax_amount %}<div class="row"><span>TVA</span><b>{{ fmt_num(invoice.tax_amount) }}</b></div>{% endif %}
      <div class="grand"><span>Total</span><span style="float:right">{{ fmt_num(invoice.amount_total) }} {{ currency }}</span></div>
      <div class="amount-words">
        Arrêtée la présente facture à la somme de :<br>
        <b>{{ amount_in_words(invoice.amount_total, currency) }}</b>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="model-terms">
    <div class="model-terms-cgv">
      <p class="model-section-title">Conditions Générales de Vente</p>
      {% if cgv %}<div>{{ cgv | nl2br }}</div>{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="model-terms-sign">
      <div>Azaguié, le {{ fmt_date(invoice.invoice_date) or '—' }}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:16mm"><b>{{ company.name if company }}</b><br>Signature &amp; cachet</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="model-footer">
    <div class="contact">
      {% if company %}{{ fmt_addr(company) }}{% if company.phone %} &nbsp; Tél : {{ company.phone }}{% endif %}{% if company.email %} &nbsp; {{ company.email }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="legal">
      {% if company %}
      {% set fparts = [] %}
      {% if company.rccm %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['RCCM : ' ~ company.rccm] %}{% endif %}
      {% if company.ncc %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['NCC : ' ~ company.ncc] %}{% endif %}
      {% if company.share_capital %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['Capital : ' ~ company.share_capital] %}{% endif %}
      {{ fparts | join(' | ') }} &nbsp; {{ invoice.reference }}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</body></html>
````

## File: backend/resources/templates/pos_ticket.html
````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{{ doc_title }}</title><style>
@page { size: 80mm auto; margin: 3mm 4mm 4mm; }
body { font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; color:#000; width:72mm; margin:0 auto; }
/* En-tête centré */
.tape { text-align:center; }
.tape img.logo { height:44px; max-width:60px; margin-bottom:2px; }
.tape h1 { font-size:15px; margin:2px 0; }
.tape .estab { font-size:10px; font-weight:bold; margin:1px 0; }
.tape .slogan { font-size:9px; font-style:italic; margin:1px 0; }
.tape .tax { font-size:10px; margin:1px 0; }
.tape .addr { font-size:10px; line-height:1.4; }
/* Filets pointillés homogènes */
.rule { border:none; border-top:1px dashed #000; margin:5px 0; }
.big-title { text-align:center; font-size:13px; font-weight:bold; margin:6px 0 4px; letter-spacing:0.3px; }
.meta { font-size:10px; line-height:1.5; margin:2px 0; }
.meta .box { display:inline-block; border:1px solid #000; padding:2px 6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:bold; }
/* Tableau à colonnes fixes : plus d'enchevêtrement */
table.items { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; table-layout:fixed; }
table.items col.c-item { width:42%; }
table.items col.c-qty { width:16%; }
table.items col.c-pu { width:20%; }
table.items col.c-total { width:22%; }
table.items th, table.items td { padding:2px 1px; font-size:10.5px; line-height:1.35; vertical-align:top; overflow-wrap:break-word; word-break:break-word; }
table.items thead th { font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; border-top:1px dashed #000; border-bottom:1px dashed #000; padding:3px 1px; }
table.items thead th.r, table.items thead th.c { white-space:nowrap; }
table.items td.l { text-align:left; }
table.items td.c { text-align:center; }
table.items td.r { text-align:right; white-space:nowrap; }
table.items tr.cut td { font-size:9px; color:#000; padding:0 0 2px 3mm; word-break:break-word; white-space:normal; }
table.items tr.total td { border-top:1px dashed #000; padding-top:4px; font-weight:bold; font-size:11.5px; }
table.items tr.total td.r { white-space:nowrap; }
.section { text-align:center; font-weight:bold; margin:6px 0 2px; font-size:11px; }
.qr { text-align:center; margin-top:8px; }
.qr img { width:70px; height:70px; }
.thanks { text-align:center; font-size:11px; margin-top:6px; font-weight:bold; }
.footer { text-align:center; font-size:9px; border-top:1px dashed #000; margin-top:6px; padding-top:4px; line-height:1.5; }
</style></head>
<body>
<div class="tape">
  {% if company and company.logo %}<img src="{{ company.logo }}" class="logo" alt=""/>{% endif %}
  <h1>{{ company.name }}</h1>
  {% if company and company.establishment %}<div class="estab">{{ company.establishment }}</div>{% endif %}
  {% if company and company.slogan %}<div class="slogan">{{ company.slogan }}</div>{% endif %}
  {% if company and company.ncc %}<div class="tax">N° Compte Contribuable (NCC) : {{ company.ncc }}</div>{% endif %}
  {% if company %}<div class="addr">{{ fmt_addr(company) }}</div>{% if company.phone %}<div class="addr">Tel : {{ company.phone }}</div>{% endif %}{% endif %}
</div>
<hr class="rule"/>
<div class="meta">{{ order.reference }}</div>
<div class="meta"><span class="box">DATE : {{ order.order_date.strftime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M') if order.order_date }}</span></div>
<div class="section">-- VOTRE VENTE COMPTOIR --</div>
<table class="items">
  <colgroup><col class="c-item"/><col class="c-qty"/><col class="c-pu"/><col class="c-total"/></colgroup>
  <thead><tr><th class="l">Item</th><th class="c">Qté</th><th class="r">PU</th><th class="r">Montant</th></tr></thead>
  <tbody>
  {% for line in lines %}
  <tr><td class="l">{{ line.description or 'Produit' }}{% if line.variant_name %} — {{ line.variant_name }}{% endif %}</td><td class="c">{{ line_qty(line) }}</td><td class="r">{{ fmt_num(line.unit_price) }}</td><td class="r">{{ fmt_num(line.subtotal) }}</td></tr>
  {% if line.cuts %}{% for c in line.cuts %}
  <tr class="cut"><td colspan="4">↳ {{ cut_label(c) }}</td></tr>
  {% endfor %}{% endif %}
  {% endfor %}
  <tr class="total"><td colspan="3" style="text-align:right">TOTAL ({{ currency }})</td><td class="r">{{ fmt_num(total) }}</td></tr>
  {% if change_amount and change_amount > 0 %}
  <tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:right">MONTANT REÇU</td><td class="r">{{ fmt_num(amount_received) }}</td></tr>
  <tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:right;font-weight:bold">MONNAIE RENDUE</td><td class="r" style="font-weight:bold">{{ fmt_num(change_amount) }}</td></tr>
  {% endif %}
  </tbody>
</table>
<hr class="rule"/>
{% if qr_data_uri %}
<div class="qr"><img src="{{ qr_data_uri }}" alt="QR"/></div>
{% if pos_url %}<div style="text-align:center;font-size:9px">{{ pos_url }}</div>{% endif %}
{% endif %}
<div class="thanks">Merci de votre confiance</div>
<div class="footer">
{% if company %}
{% set fparts = [] %}
{% if company.rccm %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['RCCM : ' ~ company.rccm] %}{% endif %}
{% if company.ncc %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['NCC : ' ~ company.ncc] %}{% endif %}
{% if company.share_capital %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['Capital : ' ~ company.share_capital] %}{% endif %}
{% if fparts %}{{ fparts | join(' | ') }}{% endif %}
{% endif %}
</div>
</body></html>
````

````html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>{{ doc_title }}</title><style>
{% include "_model_base.html" %}
</style></head>
<body>
<div class="model-head">
  <div class="model-head-top">

      {% if company and company.logo %}<img src="{{ company.logo }}" alt=""/>{% endif %}

  </div>
  <div class="model-head-main">
````

````html
      <p class="model-title">Devis</p>
      <div class="model-ref"><b>N° Devis</b> &nbsp; : &nbsp; {{ quote.reference }}</div>
      {% if salesperson %}
      <div class="model-salesperson">
        <div class="sp-label">Votre contact commercial</div>

        {% if salesperson.phone %}<div class="sp-contact">{{ salesperson.phone }}</div>{% endif %}
        {% if salesperson.email %}<div class="sp-contact">{{ salesperson.email }}</div>{% endif %}
      </div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if partner and partner.email %}{{ partner.email }}{% endif %}</p>

</div>

<div class="model-card">
  <p class="model-section-title">Désignation des travaux et fournitures</p>
  <table class="model-items">
    <thead><tr>
      <td style="width:9%" class="ctr">N°</td>
      <td>Désignation</td>
      <td style="width:13%" class="ctr">Qté</td>
      <td style="width:17%" class="num">PU ({{ currency }})</td>
      <td style="width:17%" class="num">Total</td>
    </tr></thead>
    <tbody>
    {% for line in lines %}
      <tr class="{% if loop.index0 % 2 == 1 %}alt{% endif %}">

            {% for c in line.cuts %}<div class="product-desc">{{ cut_label(c) }}</div>{% endfor %}
          {% endif %}
        </td>
        {% set _qty, _unit = line_qty_parts(line) %}
        <td class="ctr"><div class="qty-val">{{ _qty }}</div>{% if _unit %}<div class="qty-unit">{{ _unit }}</div>{% endif %}</td>
        <td class="num">{{ fmt_num(line.unit_price) }}</td>
        <td class="num"><b>{{ fmt_num(line.subtotal) }}</b></td>
      </tr>
    {% endfor %}
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="model-pay-total">
    <div class="model-pay">
      <p class="model-section-title">Informations de paiement</p>
      {% if quote.terms %}{{ quote.terms }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if company %}
      {% if company.phone %}<span class="k">Tél :</span> {{ company.phone }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if company.email %}<span class="k">Email :</span> {{ company.email }}<br>{% endif %}
      {% if company.ncc %}<span class="k">NCC :</span> {{ company.ncc }}{% endif %}
      {% endif %}
      {% if quote.notes %}<br><br><span class="k">Note :</span> {{ quote.notes }}{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="model-totals">
      <div class="row"><span>Sous-total HT</span><b>{{ fmt_num(quote.amount_untaxed if quote.amount_untaxed is not none else quote.amount_total) }}</b></div>
      {% if quote.discount_amount %}<div class="row"><span>Remise</span><b>- {{ fmt_num(quote.discount_amount) }}</b></div>{% endif %}
      {% if quote.tax_amount %}<div class="row"><span>TVA</span><b>{{ fmt_num(quote.tax_amount) }}</b></div>{% endif %}
      <div class="grand"><span>Total</span><span style="float:right">{{ fmt_num(quote.amount_total) }} {{ currency }}</span></div>
      <div class="amount-words">
        Arrêté le présent devis à la somme de :<br>
        <b>{{ amount_in_words(quote.amount_total, currency) }}</b>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="model-terms">
    <div class="model-terms-cgv">
      <p class="model-section-title">Conditions Générales de Vente</p>
      {% if cgv %}<div>{{ cgv | nl2br }}</div>{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="model-terms-sign">
      <div>Azaguié, le {{ fmt_date(quote.quote_date) or '—' }}</div>
      <div style="margin-top:16mm"><b>{{ company.name if company }}</b><br>Signature &amp; cachet</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="model-footer">
    <div class="contact">
      {% if company %}{{ fmt_addr(company) }}{% if company.phone %} &nbsp; Tél : {{ company.phone }}{% endif %}{% if company.email %} &nbsp; {{ company.email }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
    </div>
    <div class="legal">
      {% if company %}
      {% set fparts = [] %}
      {% if company.rccm %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['RCCM : ' ~ company.rccm] %}{% endif %}
      {% if company.ncc %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['NCC : ' ~ company.ncc] %}{% endif %}
      {% if company.share_capital %}{% set fparts = fparts + ['Capital : ' ~ company.share_capital] %}{% endif %}
      {{ fparts | join(' | ') }} &nbsp; {{ quote.reference }}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
</body></html>
````
