````python
"""
Test de bout en bout du parcours Devis → Commande → Facture → Encaissement.

Vérifie :
- la mise à jour des CGV (paramètre `cgv_content`),
- la création d'un devis avec lignes + coupes BAC,
- l'aperçu HTML du devis (présence de la page CGV),
- l'impression PDF du devis,
- la confirmation du devis en commande,
- la création d'une facture depuis la commande,
- l'encaissement partiel puis total (statuts de facture),
- le reçu PDF du paiement,
- l'impression PDF de la facture.

Usage (depuis le dossier backend) :
    python scripts/e2e_documents.py [--base http://localhost:8001]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

# Console Windows : force l'UTF-8 pour les accents/flèches
if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND_DIR))

EMAIL = "admin@abc.com"
PASSWORD = "HRM14kxpovYL_B3t"
COMPANY_CODE = "GEA"

CGV_TEST = (
    "CONDITIONS GENERALES DE VENTE — TEST E2E\n"
    "1. Prix : nets, en francs CFA, hors transport.\n"
    "2. Paiement : 50% à la commande, solde à la livraison.\n"
    "3. Retards : pénalité de 1% par mois de retard.\n"
    "4. Litiges : tribunaux d'Abidjan compétents."
)

_results: list[tuple[str, bool, str]] = []


def check(label: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    _results.append((label, ok, detail))
    status = "OK  " if ok else "FAIL"
    print(f"[{status}] {label}" + (f" — {detail}" if detail else ""))


def call(method: str, path: str, token: str | None = None,
         payload: dict | None = None, base: str = "") -> tuple[int, bytes]:
    """Appel HTTP simple (stdlib). Retourne (status, body)."""
    url = base + path
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8") if payload is not None else None
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, data=data, timeout=60) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        return exc.code, exc.read()


def jload(body: bytes) -> dict | list:
    try:
        return json.loads(body.decode("utf-8"))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return {}


# === SUITE DU SCÉNARIO (insérée ci-dessous) ===


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--base", default="http://localhost:8001")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    base = args.base.rstrip("/") + "/api/v1"

    # 1. Login -----------------------------------------------------------------
    code, body = call("POST", "/core/auth/login", payload={
        "email": EMAIL, "password": PASSWORD, "company_code": COMPANY_CODE,
    }, base=base)
    check("Login", code == 200, f"HTTP {code}")
    if code != 200:
        print(body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:500])
        return 1
    token = jload(body).get("access_token")
    check("Token reçu", bool(token))

    # 2. CGV — mise à jour du paramètre ---------------------------------------
    code, body = call("GET", "/core/settings/cgv_content", token, base=base)
    before = jload(body).get("value")
    code, body = call("PUT", "/core/settings/cgv_content", token, {
        "value": CGV_TEST, "type": "string", "is_public": True,
    }, base=base)
    if code == 404:
        # Le paramètre n'existe pas encore en base → upsert via POST
        code, body = call("POST", "/core/settings", token, {
            "key": "cgv_content", "value": CGV_TEST,
            "type": "string", "is_public": True,
        }, base=base)
    check("Mise à jour CGV", code in (200, 201), f"HTTP {code}")
    code, body = call("GET", "/core/settings/cgv_content", token, base=base)
    check("CGV persistée", jload(body).get("value") == CGV_TEST,
          f"avant={str(before)[:40]!r}")

    # 3. Client -----------------------------------------------------------------
    code, body = call("GET", "/crm/partners", token, base=base)
    partners = jload(body) if code == 200 else []
    if isinstance(partners, list) and partners:
        partner_id = partners[0]["id"]
        partner_name = partners[0].get("name", "?")
    else:
        code, body = call("POST", "/crm/partners", token, {
            "name": "Client Test E2E SARL", "role": "client",
            "entity_type": "company", "phone": "+225 07 00 00 00 00",
        }, base=base)
        created = jload(body)
        check("Création client", code in (200, 201), f"HTTP {code}")
        partner_id, partner_name = created.get("id"), created.get("name", "?")
    check("Client disponible", bool(partner_id), f"id={partner_id} ({partner_name})")

    # === SUITE (devis, facture, encaissements) ===
    return _run_sales_flow(base, token, partner_id)


def _run_sales_flow(base: str, token: str, partner_id: int) -> int:
    """Devis → HTML/PDF → commande → facture → encaissements → PDF."""
    # 4. Devis ------------------------------------------------------------------
    quote_payload = {
        "partner_id": partner_id,
        "currency_code": "XOF",
        "notes": "Test E2E devis → facture",
        "tax_percent": 0,
        "lines": [
            {
                "description": "Ciment CIMAF 42.5 — sac 50 kg",
                "quantity": 100,
                "unit": "sac",
                "unit_price": 5500,
            },
            {
                "description": "Fer à béton HA12 — coupe sur mesure",
                "quantity": 12,
                "unit": "barre",
                "sell_by_length": True,
                "unit_price": 4500,
                "cuts": [
                    {"quantity": 6, "length": 6.0},
                    {"quantity": 6, "length": 4.5},
                ],
            },
        ],
    }
    code, body = call("POST", "/sales/quotes", token, quote_payload, base=base)
    quote = jload(body)
    check("Création devis", code == 201 and bool(quote.get("id")),
          f"HTTP {code} ref={quote.get('reference')} total={quote.get('amount_total')}")
    quote_id = quote.get("id")
    if not quote_id:
        print(body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:800])
        return 1

    # 5. Aperçu HTML + CGV -------------------------------------------------------
    code, html = call("GET", f"/sales/quotes/{quote_id}/preview-html", token, base=base)
    html_text = html.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    check("Aperçu HTML devis", code == 200, f"HTTP {code}")
    check("Page CGV présente (devis)",
          "cgv-page" in html_text or "model-terms-cgv" in html_text
          or "Conditions Générales de Vente" in html_text)
    check("Contenu CGV affiché (devis)", "TEST E2E" in html_text)
    check("Coupes BAC affichées (devis)", "6 feuilles de 6,00 m" in html_text)

    # 6. PDF devis ---------------------------------------------------------------
    code, pdf = call("GET", f"/sales/quotes/{quote_id}/print", token, base=base)
    check("PDF devis", code == 200 and pdf[:5] == b"%PDF-",
          f"HTTP {code} {len(pdf)} octets")

    # === SUITE (commande, facture, paiements) ===
    return _run_billing_flow(base, token, partner_id, quote_id)


def _run_billing_flow(base: str, token: str, partner_id: int, quote_id: int) -> int:
    """Commande → facture → encaissements → reçus/PDF → vérif contexte CGV."""
    # 7. Confirmation → commande -------------------------------------------------
    code, body = call("POST", f"/sales/quotes/{quote_id}/confirm", token, {}, base=base)
    order = jload(body)
    check("Confirmation devis → commande", code == 200 and bool(order.get("id")),
          f"HTTP {code} ref={order.get('reference')}")
    order_id = order.get("id")
    if not order_id:
        print(body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:800])
        return 1

    # 8. Facture depuis la commande ----------------------------------------------
    code, body = call("POST", "/invoicing/invoices/from-order", token,
                      {"order_id": order_id, "due_days": 30}, base=base)
    invoice = jload(body)
    check("Création facture depuis commande",
          code == 201 and bool(invoice.get("id")),
          f"HTTP {code} ref={invoice.get('reference')} "
          f"total={invoice.get('amount_total')}")
    invoice_id = invoice.get("id")
    if not invoice_id:
        print(body.decode("utf-8", "replace")[:800])
        return 1
    total = float(invoice.get("amount_total") or 0)

    # 8ter. S-7 : encaissement d'un brouillon refusé (contrôle serveur) ------------
    code, body = call("POST", "/payments/payments", token, {
        "partner_id": partner_id, "invoice_id": invoice_id,
        "method": "cash", "amount": 1000, "direction": "in",
    }, base=base)
    check("S-7 : paiement sur brouillon refusé", code == 400, f"HTTP {code}")

    # 8bis. Confirmation du brouillon (flux Odoo : brouillon → posté) ------------
    # Depuis P0, from-order crée un brouillon par défaut ; le contrôle S-7
    # refuse l'encaissement d'une facture non confirmée.
    code, body = call("POST", f"/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}/post", token, {}, base=base)
    check("Confirmation facture (brouillon → posted)", code == 200, f"HTTP {code}")

    # 9. Encaissement partiel → statut PARTIALLY_PAID -----------------------------
    acompte = round(total * 0.4, 2)
    code, body = call("POST", "/payments/payments", token, {
        "partner_id": partner_id, "invoice_id": invoice_id,
        "method": "cash", "amount": acompte, "direction": "in",
        "notes": "Acompte 40%",
    }, base=base)
    payment_1 = jload(body)
    check("Acompte enregistré", code == 201 and bool(payment_1.get("id")),
          f"HTTP {code} ref={payment_1.get('reference')}")

    code, body = call("GET", f"/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}", token, base=base)
    inv = jload(body)
    check("Statut facture = partially_paid",
          inv.get("status") == "partially_paid", f"status={inv.get('status')}")
    check("Montant payé à jour", abs(float(inv.get("paid_amount") or 0) - acompte) < 0.01,
          f"paid={inv.get('paid_amount')} due={inv.get('amount_due')}")

    # 10. Solde → statut PAID ------------------------------------------------------
    due = float(inv.get("amount_due") or 0)
    code, body = call("POST", "/payments/payments", token, {
        "partner_id": partner_id, "invoice_id": invoice_id,
        "method": "mobile_money", "amount": due, "direction": "in",
        "notes": "Solde",
    }, base=base)
    payment_2 = jload(body)
    check("Solde encaissé", code == 201 and bool(payment_2.get("id")),
          f"HTTP {code} ref={payment_2.get('reference')}")

    code, body = call("GET", f"/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}", token, base=base)
    inv = jload(body)
    check("Statut facture = paid", inv.get("status") == "paid",
          f"status={inv.get('status')}")

    # 11. Reçu PDF du paiement -------------------------------------------------------
    code, pdf = call("GET", f"/payments/payments/{payment_2.get('id')}/receipt", token, base=base)
    check("Reçu PDF paiement", code == 200 and pdf[:5] == b"%PDF-",
          f"HTTP {code} {len(pdf)} octets")

    # 12. PDF facture -----------------------------------------------------------------
    code, pdf = call("GET", f"/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}/print", token, base=base)
    check("PDF facture", code == 200 and pdf[:5] == b"%PDF-",
          f"HTTP {code} {len(pdf)} octets")

    # 13. Contexte async : CGV chargée par load_quote / load_invoice ----------------
    try:
        import asyncio

        # Enregistre tous les modèles dans le registre SQLAlchemy
        # (hors process uvicorn, les relations ne se résolvent que si
        # toutes les classes sont importées).
        import app.main  # noqa: F401  (charge tous les modules + modèles)
        import app.core.models  # noqa: F401
        import app.modules.catalogue.models  # noqa: F401  (Product)
        import app.modules.crm.models  # noqa: F401
        import app.modules.invoicing.models  # noqa: F401
        import app.modules.sales.models  # noqa: F401

        from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder

        ctx_q = asyncio.run(ContextBuilder().load_quote(quote_id))
        check("Contexte devis contient les CGV", ctx_q.get("cgv") == CGV_TEST,
              f"cgv={str(ctx_q.get('cgv'))[:40]!r}")
        ctx_i = asyncio.run(ContextBuilder().load_invoice(invoice_id))
        check("Contexte facture contient les CGV", ctx_i.get("cgv") == CGV_TEST)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        check("Contexte async contient les CGV", False, f"exception: {exc}")

    # 14. Scénario acomptes : devis → commande → acompte 40 % → solde ----------
    try:
        code, body = call("POST", "/sales/quotes", token, {
            "partner_id": partner_id,
            "currency_code": "XOF",
            "notes": "Test E2E acomptes",
            "lines": [
                {
                    "description": "Carreaux 60×60 — palette",
                    "quantity": 50,
                    "unit": "m²",
                    "unit_price": 8000,
                },
            ],
        }, base=base)
        q2 = jload(body)
        check("Devis acompte créé", code == 201 and bool(q2.get("id")),
              f"HTTP {code} ref={q2.get('reference')}")
        code, body = call("POST", f"/sales/quotes/{q2.get('id')}/confirm", token,
                          {}, base=base)
        o2 = jload(body)
        check("Commande acompte confirmée", code == 200 and bool(o2.get("id")),
              f"HTTP {code} ref={o2.get('reference')}")
        o2_id, o2_total = o2.get("id"), float(o2.get("amount_total") or 0)

        # Acompte 40 % — brouillon
        code, body = call("POST", "/invoicing/invoices/from-order", token, {
            "order_id": o2_id, "mode": "down_payment_percent",
            "value": 40, "post": False,
        }, base=base)
        dp = jload(body)
        expected_dp = round(o2_total * 0.4, 2)
        check("Acompte 40 % créé (brouillon)",
              code == 201 and dp.get("status") == "draft"
              and abs(float(dp.get("amount_total") or 0) - expected_dp) < 0.01,
              f"HTTP {code} status={dp.get('status')} "
              f"total={dp.get('amount_total')} attendu={expected_dp}")

        # Sur-facturation refusée (acompte fixe > reste à facturer)
        code, body = call("POST", "/invoicing/invoices/from-order", token, {
            "order_id": o2_id, "mode": "down_payment_fixed",
            "value": o2_total * 2,
        }, base=base)
        check("Sur-facturation refusée (HTTP 400)", code == 400, f"HTTP {code}")

        # Confirmation de la facture brouillon
        code, body = call("POST", f"/invoicing/invoices/{dp.get('id')}/post",
                          token, {}, base=base)
        check("Acompte confirmé (posted)", code == 200
              and jload(body).get("status") == "posted", f"HTTP {code}")

        # Encaissement de l'acompte → facture partiellement payée
        code, body = call("POST", "/payments/payments", token, {
            "partner_id": partner_id, "invoice_id": dp.get("id"),
            "method": "cash", "amount": expected_dp, "direction": "in",
        }, base=base)
        check("Acompte encaissé", code == 201, f"HTTP {code}")

        # Facture de solde (mode full) → 60 % restant
        code, body = call("POST", "/invoicing/invoices/from-order", token, {
            "order_id": o2_id, "mode": "full", "post": True,
        }, base=base)
        solde = jload(body)
        expected_solde = round(o2_total - expected_dp, 2)
        check("Facture de solde créée (total = reste)",
              code == 201 and abs(float(solde.get("amount_total") or 0)
                                  - expected_solde) < 0.01,
              f"HTTP {code} total={solde.get('amount_total')} "
              f"attendu={expected_solde}")

        # Encaissement du solde → paid
        code, body = call("POST", "/payments/payments", token, {
            "partner_id": partner_id, "invoice_id": solde.get("id"),
            "method": "mobile_money", "amount": expected_solde, "direction": "in",
        }, base=base)
        code2, body = call("GET", f"/invoicing/invoices/{solde.get('id')}",
                           token, base=base)
        check("Solde payé (facture paid)", code == 201
              and jload(body).get("status") == "paid", f"HTTP {code}/{code2}")

        # Nouvelle facture refusée : commande entièrement facturée
        code, body = call("POST", "/invoicing/invoices/from-order", token, {
            "order_id": o2_id, "mode": "full",
        }, base=base)
        check("Re-facturation refusée (HTTP 400)", code == 400, f"HTTP {code}")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        check("Scénario acomptes", False, f"exception: {exc}")

    # 15. Re-confirmation — round-trips brouillon → confirmé --------------------
    # a) Paiement : remise au brouillon puis re-confirmation --------------------
    p2_id = payment_2.get("id")
    code, body = call("POST", f"/payments/payments/{p2_id}/back-to-draft",
                      token, {}, base=base)
    pay = jload(body)
    check("Paiement remis au brouillon", code == 200
          and pay.get("status") == "draft",
          f"HTTP {code} status={pay.get('status')}")

    code, body = call("GET", f"/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}", token, base=base)
    inv = jload(body)
    check("Facture décréditée après révocation du solde",
          abs(float(inv.get("paid_amount") or 0) - acompte) < 0.01
          and inv.get("status") == "partially_paid",
          f"paid={inv.get('paid_amount')} status={inv.get('status')}")

    code, body = call("POST", f"/payments/payments/{p2_id}/confirm", token, {},
                      base=base)
    pay = jload(body)
    check("Paiement re-confirmé (statut paid)",
          code == 200 and pay.get("status") == "paid",
          f"HTTP {code} status={pay.get('status')}")

    code, body = call("GET", f"/invoicing/invoices/{invoice_id}", token, base=base)
    inv = jload(body)
    check("Facture re-créditée après re-confirmation",
          abs(float(inv.get("paid_amount") or 0) - total) < 0.01
          and inv.get("status") == "paid",
          f"paid={inv.get('paid_amount')} status={inv.get('status')}")

    # b) Facture : confirmée → brouillon → re-confirmée (aucun paiement) --------
    try:
        code, body = call("POST", "/sales/quotes", token, {
            "partner_id": partner_id,
            "currency_code": "XOF",
            "notes": "Test E2E re-confirmation facture",
            "tax_percent": 0,
            "lines": [{
                "description": "Sac de ciment — test re-confirmation",
                "quantity": 5, "unit": "sac", "unit_price": 5000,
            }],
        }, base=base)
        q3 = jload(body)
        check("Devis de re-confirmation créé",
              code == 201 and bool(q3.get("id")),
              f"HTTP {code} ref={q3.get('reference')}")
        code, body = call("POST", f"/sales/quotes/{q3.get('id')}/confirm",
                          token, {}, base=base)
        o3 = jload(body)
        check("Commande de re-confirmation créée",
              code == 200 and bool(o3.get("id")), f"HTTP {code}")
        code, body = call("POST", "/invoicing/invoices/from-order", token,
                          {"order_id": o3.get("id"), "post": False}, base=base)
        inv3 = jload(body)
        inv3_id = inv3.get("id")
        check("Facture brouillon créée (re-confirmation)",
              code == 201 and inv3.get("status") == "draft",
              f"HTTP {code} status={inv3.get('status')}")
        code, body = call("POST", f"/invoicing/invoices/{inv3_id}/post",
                          token, {}, base=base)
        check("Facture confirmée (1re passe)",
              code == 200 and jload(body).get("status") == "posted",
              f"HTTP {code}")
        code, body = call("POST",
                          f"/invoicing/invoices/{inv3_id}/reset-to-draft",
                          token, {}, base=base)
        check("Facture remise au brouillon",
              code == 200 and jload(body).get("status") == "draft",
              f"HTTP {code}")
        code, body = call("POST", f"/invoicing/invoices/{inv3_id}/post",
                          token, {}, base=base)
        check("Facture re-confirmée (brouillon → posted)",
              code == 200 and jload(body).get("status") == "posted",
              f"HTTP {code}")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        check("Round-trip re-confirmation facture", False, f"exception: {exc}")

    # c) Livraison : BL (pending) → brouillon → re-confirmé (pending) -----------
    try:
        code, body = call("POST", "/delivery/notes/from-order", token,
                          {"order_id": order_id,
                           "notes": "Test E2E re-confirmation BL"},
                          base=base)
        bl = jload(body)
        check("BL créé (statut pending)",

        code, body = call("POST",
                          f"/delivery/notes/{bl.get('id')}/back-to-draft",
                          token, {}, base=base)
        check("BL remis au brouillon",
              code == 200 and jload(body).get("status") == "draft",
              f"HTTP {code} status={jload(body).get('status')}")
        code, body = call("POST", f"/delivery/notes/{bl.get('id')}/status",
                          token, {"status": "pending"}, base=base)
        check("BL re-confirmé (draft → pending)",
              code == 200 and jload(body).get("status") == "pending",
              f"HTTP {code} status={jload(body).get('status')}")
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        check("Round-trip re-confirmation livraison", False, f"exception: {exc}")

    # Résumé --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    failed = [r for r in _results if not r[1]]
    print("\n===== RÉSUMÉ =====")
    print(f"Total : {len(_results)} | OK : {len(_results) - len(failed)} | "
          f"ÉCHECS : {len(failed)}")
    for label, _ok, detail in failed:
        print(f"  ✗ {label} — {detail}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

## File: backend/scripts/reset_data.py
````python
"""
Réinitialisation des données métier — environnement vierge.

Supprime TOUTES les données métier (devis, commandes, factures, paiements,
produits, clients, mouvements de stock, écritures, dépenses, audit...)
en conservant les référentiels :
- utilisateurs, rôles, permissions
- entreprises, agences
- devises, taxes, paramètres, modules
- catégories et unités de produits, plan comptable OHADA + journaux

Les séquences de numérotation sont remises à zéro (prochain document = 0001)
et `cgv_content` est réinitialisé.

Usage :
    python scripts/reset_data.py [--db CHEMIN] [--yes]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BACKEND_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND_DIR))

# Tables conservées (référentiels)
KEEP: set[str] = {
    # Socle
    "alembic_version",
    "users", "companies", "agencies",
    "roles", "permissions", "roles_permissions", "users_roles",
    "currencies", "company_currencies", "taxes",
    "settings", "sequences", "module_info",
    # Référentiels catalogue
    "product_categories", "product_units", "unit_conversions",
    # Comptabilité : plan OHADA + journaux (référentiels)
    "accounts", "journals", "fiscal_years",
}

# Colonnes de séquence remises à zéro
RESET_SETTINGS = {"cgv_content": ""}


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--db", default=str(BACKEND_DIR / "erp_dev.db"))
    parser.add_argument("--yes", action="store_true", help="Sans confirmation")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    db_path = Path(args.db)
    if not db_path.exists():
        print(f"Base introuvable : {db_path}")
        return 1

    # Import des modèles pour connaître toutes les tables du projet
    import app.core.models  # noqa: F401  (référentiels du core)
    from app.core.database import Base

    try:  # modules métier — import tolerant
        import app.core.modules  # noqa: F401  (registre des modules)
        from app.main import app  # noqa: F401  (charge tous les routeurs/modèles)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"(Import partiel : {exc!r} — on continue avec les modèles chargés)")

    all_tables = {t for t in Base.metadata.tables}
    # Vérifie que les tables du KEEP existent bien
    to_delete = sorted(all_tables - KEEP)

    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_path))
    existing = {
        row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'"
        )
    }
    targets = [t for t in to_delete if t in existing]

    if not args.yes:
        print(f"Base : {db_path}")
        print(f"Tables conservées : {len(KEEP & existing)}")
        print(f"Tables à vider    : {len(targets)}")
        for t in targets:
            n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [{t}]").fetchone()[0]
            if n:
                print(f"  - {t}: {n} ligne(s)")
        if input("Confirmer la purge ? [oui/N] ").strip().lower() not in (
            "oui", "o", "y",
        ):
            print("Annulé.")
            return 1

    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
    total = 0
    for t in targets:
        n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM [{t}]").fetchone()[0]
        if n:
            conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM [{t}]")
            total += n
    # Séquences → prochaine numérotation à 1
    if "sequences" in existing:
        conn.execute("UPDATE sequences SET last_number = 0")
    # Paramètres de test réinitialisés
    if "settings" in existing:
        for key, value in RESET_SETTINGS.items():
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE settings SET value = ? WHERE key = ?", (value, key)
            )
    conn.commit()
    conn.execute("VACUUM")
    conn.close()
    print(f"✅ Purge terminée : {total} ligne(s) supprimée(s).")
    print("Les comptes utilisateurs, rôles, devises, taxes et le plan "
          "comptable sont conservés.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

## File: backend/scripts/restart_servers.py
````python
"""Redémarre les serveurs uvicorn (8001/8002) de façon détachée."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

BACKEND = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LOGS = BACKEND / "logs"
LOGS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
PORTS = (8001, 8002)


def kill_listeners(ports: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
    """Tue les processus qui écoutent déjà sur les ports donnés."""
    out = subprocess.run(["netstat", "-ano"], capture_output=True).stdout
    out = out.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    pids: set[int] = set()
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if "LISTENING" not in line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) >= 5 and any(parts[1].endswith(f":{p}") for p in ports):
            try:
                pids.add(int(parts[-1]))
            except ValueError:
                pass
    for pid in pids:
        subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(pid), "/F"], capture_output=True)
        print(f"Processus {pid} arrêté")
    if pids:
        time.sleep(2)  # laisse le temps au port de se libérer


CREATE_FLAGS = getattr(subprocess, "DETACHED_PROCESS", 0) | getattr(
    subprocess, "CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP", 0
)


def run_migrations() -> None:
    """Aligne le schéma SQLite sur les modèles ORM avant de démarrer l'API.

    `Base.metadata.create_all()` (utilisé au démarrage en mode debug) ne crée
    que les tables *manquantes* : il n'ajoute jamais une colonne à une table
    existante. Sans cette étape, une nouvelle révision de modèle produit des
    500 « no such column: ... » sur toutes les lignes concernées. Le
    Dockerfile fait de même (`alembic upgrade head` dans son CMD).
    """
    res = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "alembic", "upgrade", "head"],
        cwd=str(BACKEND), capture_output=True,
    )
    if res.returncode == 0:
        print("Migrations Alembic appliquees (upgrade head)")
    else:
        out = res.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        print("!! echec des migrations Alembic :")
        print(out[-1500:])


kill_listeners(PORTS)
run_migrations()

for port in PORTS:
    out = open(LOGS / f"uvicorn_{port}.out.log", "w", encoding="utf-8")
    err = open(LOGS / f"uvicorn_{port}.err.log", "w", encoding="utf-8")
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app",
         "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", str(port)],
        cwd=str(BACKEND),
        stdout=out, stderr=err,
        creationflags=CREATE_FLAGS,
        close_fds=True,
    )
    print(f"Port {port} : PID {proc.pid}")

# Attente / health check
for _ in range(30):
    time.sleep(2)
    alive = []
    for port in (8001, 8002):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(
                f"http://localhost:{port}/docs", timeout=3
            ) as r:
                alive.append(f"Port {port}: HTTP {r.status}")
        except Exception:
            alive.append(f"Port {port}: pas encore prêt")
    if all("HTTP" in a for a in alive):
        print("\n".join(alive))
        break
else:
    print("\n".join(alive))
    print("--- stderr 8001 ---")
    print((LOGS / "uvicorn_8001.err.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8",
                                                   errors="replace")[-2000:])
````

## File: backend/scripts/seed_admin.py
````python
"""
Script CLI — crée les données de démarrage manuellement.

Usage :
    cd backend
    python -m scripts.seed_admin            # utilise la config .env
    python -m scripts.seed_admin --reset-password admin@abc.com NouveauMdp123

Idempotent : ne crée rien si les données existent déjà.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import os
import sys

# Console Windows : force l'UTF-8 pour les caractères spéciaux
if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

# Permet l'exécution directe depuis backend/
BACKEND = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, BACKEND)
os.chdir(BACKEND)


async def reset_password(email: str, new_password: str) -> int:
    """Réinitialise le mot de passe d'un utilisateur."""
    from sqlalchemy import select

    from app.core.database import AsyncSessionLocal
    from app.core.models.user import User
    from app.core.security import hash_password

    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        user = (await session.execute(
            select(User).where(User.email == email.lower())
        )).scalar_one_or_none()
        if user is None:
            print(f"✗ Utilisateur introuvable : {email}")
            return 1
        user.password_hash = hash_password(new_password)
        await session.commit()
        print(f"✓ Mot de passe réinitialisé pour {email}")
        return 0


async def run_seed() -> int:
    """Exécute le bootstrap des données de démarrage."""
    # Importe TOUS les modèles pour résoudre les relations inter-modules
    import app.core.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.catalogue.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.crm.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.sales.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.stock.models  # noqa: F401

    from app.core.services.seed_service import bootstrap_defaults
    from app.core.database import AsyncSessionLocal

    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        created = await bootstrap_defaults(session)

        if not any(created.values()):
            print("ℹ Rien à créer — les données de démarrage existent déjà.")
            return 0

        print("✓ Données créées :")
        if created["currencies"]:
            print(f"  Devises      : {', '.join(created['currencies'])}")
        if created["companies"]:
            print(f"  Entreprises  : {', '.join(created['companies'])}")
        if created["agencies"]:
            print(f"  Agences      : {', '.join(created['agencies'])}")
        if created["perms"]:
            print(f"  Permissions  : {len(created['perms'])} créées")
        if created["roles"]:
            print(f"  Rôles        : {', '.join(created['roles'])}")
        if created["users"]:
            print(f"  Admin        : {', '.join(created['users'])}")
        return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Seed / administration du ERP")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command")

    sub.add_parser("seed", help="Crée les données de démarrage (défaut)")

    rp = sub.add_parser("reset-password", help="Réinitialise un mot de passe")
    rp.add_argument("email", help="Email de l'utilisateur")
    rp.add_argument("password", help="Nouveau mot de passe (min. 8 caractères)")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.command == "reset-password":
        if len(args.password) < 8:
            print("✗ Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 8 caractères.")
            return 1
        return asyncio.run(reset_password(args.email, args.password))

    # Défaut : seed
    return asyncio.run(run_seed())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
````

## File: backend/scripts/stop_servers.py
````python
"""Arrête les serveurs ERP (frontend 3000 + backends 8001/8002)."""
import subprocess
import time

PORTS = (3000, 8001, 8002)


def kill_listeners(ports: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
    out = subprocess.run(["netstat", "-ano"], capture_output=True).stdout
    out = out.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    pids: set[int] = set()
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if "LISTENING" not in line:
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) >= 5 and any(parts[1].endswith(f":{p}") for p in ports):
            try:
                pids.add(int(parts[-1]))
            except ValueError:
                pass
    if not pids:
        print("Aucun serveur en cours.")
        return
    for pid in sorted(pids):
        res = subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(pid), "/F"],
                             capture_output=True)
        status = "arrêté" if res.returncode == 0 else "échec d'arrêt"
        print(f"Processus {pid} : {status}")
    time.sleep(2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    kill_listeners(PORTS)
````

````
# --- Application ---
DEBUG=false

# --- Sécurité (OBLIGATOIRE : changer en prod !) ---

# OBLIGATOIRE : remplacer par un mot de passe fort avant tout déploiement

# --- Redis / Celery ---

CELERY_BROKER_URL=redis://redis:6379/1

# --- Monitoring (optionnel) ---

# --- CORS (P1/S-4) ---
# Origines autorisées à appeler l'API. Uniquement utile quand le frontend
# est servi depuis un domaine DIFFÉRENT de l'API (pas le cas derrière nginx).
# En prod derrière nginx, laisser vide (même origine = pas de CORS).
# Exemple multi-domaines : CORS_ORIGINS=https://app.mondomaine.ci,https://admin.mondomaine.ci
CORS_ORIGINS=

# --- Stockage fichiers ---
# Utilisé UNIQUEMENT si aucun credential S3 n'est renseigné.
# Chemin relatif -> résolu depuis la racine du backend.
# Chemin absolu -> utilisé tel quel (volume monté hors dépôt, ex. Docker).
LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH=resources/uploads

# NOTE :
# - En production (DEBUG=false), le CORS est désactivé si CORS_ORIGINS est
#   vide : l'application doit être servie en même origine via nginx
#   (/api → backend).
# - L'URL du QR code du ticket de caisse est un paramètre applicatif
#   (« pos_ticket_url ») modifiable dans Paramètres de l'application.
````

````ini
# Alembic configuration for ERP Matériaux de Construction

[alembic]

sqlalchemy.url = postgresql+psycopg://erp_user:erp_pass@localhost:5432/erp_db

[formatters]
keys = generic, test

[logger_root]

handlers = console
qualname =

[logger_sqlalchemy]

handlers =
qualname = sqlalchemy.engine

[logger_alembic]

handlers =
qualname = alembic

[handler_console]

args = (sys.stderr,)
level = NOTSET
formatter = generic

[formatter_test]
````

## File: backend/celery_worker.py
````python
"""
Configuration de l'application Celery pour les tâches asynchrones.

Broker : Redis (configuré dans app/core/config.py).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from celery import Celery

from app.core.config import settings

celery_app = Celery(
    "erp",
    broker=settings.celery_broker_url,
    backend=settings.celery_result_backend,
    include=[
        "app.tasks.pdf_tasks",
        "app.tasks.backup_tasks",
        "app.tasks.report_tasks",
    ],
)

celery_app.conf.update(
    task_track_started=True,
    task_serializer="json",
    result_serializer="json",
    accept_content=["json"],
    timezone="UTC",
    enable_utc=True,
    task_acks_late=True,
    worker_prefetch_multiplier=1,
)


@celery_app.on_after_configure.connect
def setup_periodic_tasks(sender: Celery, **kwargs) -> None:
    """Tâches périodiques programmées."""
    from celery.schedules import crontab

    sender.conf.beat_schedule = {
        "backup-daily": {
            "task": "app.tasks.backup_tasks.daily_backup",
            "schedule": crontab(hour=2, minute=0),  # tous les jours à 02h00
        },
        "reports-morning": {
            "task": "app.tasks.report_tasks.generate_daily_reports",
            "schedule": crontab(hour=6, minute=0),  # tous les jours à 06h00
        },
    }
````

````dockerfile
FROM python:3.12-slim

# System dependencies for PDF rendering (Chromium/Playwright) + Postgres client
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    libpq-dev \
    gcc \
    git \
    curl \
    libnss3 \
    libnspr4 \
    libatk1.0-0 \
    libatk-bridge2.0-0 \
    libcups2 \
    libdrm2 \
    libxkbcommon0 \
    libxcomposite1 \
    libxdamage1 \
    libxfixes3 \
    libxrandr2 \
    libgbm1 \
    libpango-1.0-0 \
    libcairo2 \
    libasound2 \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Install Python dependencies
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && playwright install --with-deps chromium

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Create non-root user
RUN useradd -m -u 1000 appuser
USER appuser

# Run — applique les migrations puis démarre l'API
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["sh", "-c", "python -m alembic upgrade head && uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"]
````

## File: backend/test_bootstrap_e2e.py
````python
"""
Test end-to-end du bootstrap : login du premier admin via l'API réelle.

Surcharge DATABASE_URL → SQLite avant tout import, puis :
1. crée les tables (comme init_db en dev)
2. exécute le bootstrap (comme run_bootstrap_if_needed au démarrage)
3. teste POST /api/v1/core/auth/login + GET /me
"""
import asyncio
import os
import sys

os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = "sqlite+aiosqlite:///./test_bootstrap.db"
os.environ["BOOTSTRAP_ON_STARTUP"] = "true"
os.environ["FIRST_COMPANY_CODE"] = "ABC"
os.environ["FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL"] = "admin@abc.com"
os.environ["FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD"] = "Admin@12345"

BACKEND = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, BACKEND)
os.chdir(BACKEND)

import logging

logging.disable(logging.INFO)  # réduit le bruit des logs SQL pendant le test


async def main() -> int:
    from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient

    # Imports du canal : engine créé avec l'URL sqlite définie ci-dessus
    from app.core.database import Base, engine
    from app.core.services.seed_service import run_bootstrap_if_needed
    from app.main import app as fastapi_app

    import app.core.models  # noqa: F401  (enregistre les tables)
    import app.modules.catalogue.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.crm.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.sales.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.stock.models  # noqa: F401

    # 1. Tables
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)

    # 2. Bootstrap
    result = await run_bootstrap_if_needed()
    print("Bootstrap:", result)

    # 3. Login via l'API (sans lifespan — ASGITransport ne l'exécute pas)
    transport = ASGITransport(app=fastapi_app)
    async with AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
        health = await client.get("/health")
        print("Health:", health.status_code, health.json())

        login = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/core/auth/login",
            json={"email": "admin@abc.com", "password": "Admin@12345"},
        )
        print("Login status:", login.status_code)
        if login.status_code != 200:
            print("Login body:", login.json())
            return 1
        token = login.json().get("access_token")
        print("Token reçu:", bool(token))

        me = await client.get(
            "/api/v1/core/auth/me",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        )
        print("Me status:", me.status_code)
        me_body = me.json()
        print(
            "Me:", me_body.get("email"),
            "| roles:", [r["code"] for r in me_body.get("roles", [])],
        )

    await engine.dispose()
    p = os.path.join(BACKEND, "test_bootstrap.db")
    if os.path.exists(p):
        os.remove(p)

    print("E2E bootstrap+login OK")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
````

## File: backend/test_export_flow.py
````python
"""
Test E2E — export Excel / CSV des modules créant des données.

Parcours : bootstrap (admin) → fixtures → login → export des 6 endpoints.

Valide :
- ``GET …/export`` (CSV + XLSX) : statut 200, ``Content-Disposition``
  d'un téléchargement, en‑têtes identiques à ceux de l'import, lignes ;
- ``?template=1`` : modèle vierge (en‑têtes seuls) ;
- ``?format=…`` invalide → 400 ;
- aller‑retour **export → import** : le CSV des contacts se réimporte
  (upsert, 0 création) et celui des commandes recrée 1 commande.

Usage : ``python test_export_flow.py`` (crée puis supprime sa base SQLite).
"""
import asyncio
import csv
import io
import os
import sys

if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

BACKEND = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, BACKEND)
os.chdir(BACKEND)

DB_FILE = "test_export_flow.db"
DB_URL = f"sqlite+aiosqlite:///./{DB_FILE}"
# À définir AVANT tout import de app.* (le moteur doit pointer sur la base
# de test) — puis bootstrap de l'admin pour obtenir un vrai token.
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = DB_URL
os.environ["BOOTSTRAP_ON_STARTUP"] = "true"
os.environ["FIRST_COMPANY_CODE"] = "EXPO"
os.environ["FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL"] = "admin@export.test"
os.environ["FIRST_ADMIN_PASSWORD"] = "Admin@12345"

import logging

logging.disable(logging.INFO)  # réduit le bruit des logs SQL pendant le test

failures: list[str] = []


def check(label: str, cond: bool, extra: object = "") -> None:
    status = "OK " if cond else "FAIL"
    suffix = f"  → {extra}" if (not cond and extra) else ""
    print(f"[{status}] {label}{suffix}")
    if not cond:
        failures.append(label)


def parse_csv(content: bytes) -> list[list[str]]:
    text = content.decode("utf-8-sig")
    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text), delimiter=";"))


# En‑têtes attendus par endpoint (miroir exact des imports / services)
EXPECTED_HEADERS: dict[str, list[str]] = {
    "/crm/partners/export": [
        "nom", "code", "role", "type_entite", "telephone", "email", "site_web",
        "numero_fiscal", "numero_registre", "limite_credit", "delai_paiement",
        "adresse", "ville",
    ],
    "/catalogue/products/export": [
        "reference", "nom", "categorie", "marque", "description", "prix_achat",
        "prix_vente", "prix_ml", "unite", "longueur_std", "vente_au_metre",
        "code_barre", "mode_vente", "type",
    ],
    "/sales/quotes/export": [
        "reference", "client", "date", "statut", "produit", "variante",
        "quantite", "unite", "prix_unitaire", "remise", "sous_total",
        "montant_document", "devise", "description",
    ],
    "/sales/orders/export": [
        "reference", "client", "date", "statut", "produit", "variante",
        "quantite", "unite", "prix_unitaire", "remise", "sous_total",
        "montant_document", "devise", "description",
    ],
    "/invoicing/invoices/export": [
        "reference", "client", "date", "echeance", "statut", "produit",
        "variante", "quantite", "unite", "prix_unitaire", "remise",
        "sous_total", "montant_ht", "tva", "montant_document", "montant_paye",
        "devise", "description",
    ],
    "/delivery/notes/export": [
        "reference", "client", "commande", "date", "statut", "produit",
        "variante", "quantite", "quantite_commandee", "unite", "description",
    ],
}


async def main() -> int:
    from httpx import ASGITransport, AsyncClient
    from sqlalchemy import select

    from app.core.database import AsyncSessionLocal, Base, engine
    from app.core.services.seed_service import run_bootstrap_if_needed
    from app.main import app as fastapi_app

    import app.core.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.catalogue.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.crm.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.sales.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.stock.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.invoicing.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.delivery.models  # noqa: F401

    db_path = os.path.join(BACKEND, DB_FILE)
    if os.path.exists(db_path):
        os.remove(db_path)
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # 1. Bootstrap (entreprise + admin) puis fixtures dans SON entreprise
    #    (le filtre multi‑tenant automatique masque les autres sociétés)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    print("Bootstrap :", await run_bootstrap_if_needed())

    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        from app.core.models.company import Company
        from app.core.models.user import User
        from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import (
            Product,
            ProductCategory,
            ProductUnit,
        )
        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner, PartnerAddress
        from app.modules.delivery.services.delivery_service import DeliveryService
        from app.modules.invoicing.services.invoice_service import InvoiceService
        from app.modules.sales.schemas import (
            OrderLineCreate,
            QuoteCreate,
            QuoteLineCreate,
            SalesOrderCreate,
        )
        from app.modules.sales.services.order_service import OrderService
        from app.modules.sales.services.quote_service import QuoteService

        company = (await session.execute(
            select(Company).order_by(Company.id)
        )).scalars().first()
        admin = (await session.execute(
            select(User).where(User.email == "admin@export.test")
        )).scalars().first()
        check("Fixtures : entreprise bootstrap récupérée", company is not None)
        check("Fixtures : admin récupéré", admin is not None)

        partner = Partner(
            name="Client Export", code="EXP-C1", role="client",
            entity_type="company", phone="+225 01 02 03 04",
            email="client@export.test", company_id=company.id,
        )
        session.add(partner)
        await session.flush()
        session.add(PartnerAddress(
            partner_id=partner.id, line_1="Boulevard Export 12",
            city="Abidjan", is_primary=True, company_id=company.id,
        ))

        category = ProductCategory(
            name="Catégorie Export", sale_mode="unit", company_id=company.id,
        )
        unit = ProductUnit(name="Pièce", code="pz", company_id=company.id)
        session.add_all([category, unit])
        await session.flush()

        product = Product(
            reference="EXP-001", name="Produit Export", sale_mode="unit",
            selling_price=1000, category_id=category.id,
            sale_unit_id=unit.id, company_id=company.id,
        )
        session.add(product)
        await session.flush()

        quote = await QuoteService(session).create_quote(QuoteCreate(
            partner_id=partner.id,
            lines=[QuoteLineCreate(product_id=product.id, quantity=2,
                                   unit_price=1000)],
        ), admin)
        order = await OrderService(session).create_order(SalesOrderCreate(
            partner_id=partner.id,
            lines=[OrderLineCreate(product_id=product.id, quantity_ordered=3,
                                   unit_price=1000)],
        ))
        invoice = await InvoiceService(session).create_from_order(order.id)
        delivery = await DeliveryService(session).create_from_order(order.id)
        check("Fixtures : devis / commande / facture / BL créés",
              all(x is not None for x in (quote, order, invoice, delivery)))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # 2. Login + exports (CSV, XLSX, modèle vierge, format invalide)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    transport = ASGITransport(app=fastapi_app)
    async with AsyncClient(transport=transport, base_url="http://test") as client:
        login = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/core/auth/login",
            json={"email": "admin@export.test", "password": "Admin@12345"},
        )
        check("Login admin", login.status_code == 200, login.text[:300])
        if login.status_code != 200:
            return 1
        auth = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {login.json()['access_token']}"}
        bodies: dict[str, bytes] = {}

        for path, headers in EXPECTED_HEADERS.items():
            url = f"/api/v1{path}"

            # --- CSV ---
            res = await client.get(f"{url}?format=csv", headers=auth)
            check(f"{path} → CSV 200", res.status_code == 200,
                  res.status_code != 200 and res.text[:300])
            if res.status_code != 200:
                continue
            disposition = res.headers.get("content-disposition", "")
            check(f"{path} → téléchargement nommé (.csv)",
                  "attachment" in disposition and ".csv" in disposition,
                  disposition)
            check(f"{path} → type text/csv",
                  "text/csv" in res.headers.get("content-type", ""),
                  res.headers.get("content-type"))
            rows = parse_csv(res.content)
            check(f"{path} → en‑têtes conformes", bool(rows) and rows[0] == headers,
                  rows[:1])
            check(f"{path} → au moins 1 ligne de données", len(rows) >= 2, len(rows))
            bodies[path] = res.content

            # --- XLSX ---
            res_x = await client.get(f"{url}?format=xlsx", headers=auth)
            check(f"{path} → XLSX 200", res_x.status_code == 200,
                  res_x.status_code != 200 and res_x.text[:300])
            if res_x.status_code == 200:
                from openpyxl import load_workbook

                wb = load_workbook(io.BytesIO(res_x.content), read_only=True)
                sheet = wb.worksheets[0]
                xlsx_rows = list(sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True))
                wb.close()
                check(f"{path} → en‑têtes XLSX conformes",
                      list(xlsx_rows[0]) == headers, xlsx_rows[:1])
                check(f"{path} → au moins 1 ligne XLSX",
                      len(xlsx_rows) >= 2, len(xlsx_rows))
                check(f"{path} → disposition .xlsx",
                      ".xlsx" in res_x.headers.get("content-disposition", ""),
                      res_x.headers.get("content-disposition"))

            # --- Modèle vierge (en‑têtes seuls) ---
            res_t = await client.get(f"{url}?format=csv&template=1", headers=auth)
            check(f"{path} → modèle vierge 200", res_t.status_code == 200)
            if res_t.status_code == 200:
                template_rows = parse_csv(res_t.content)
                check(f"{path} → modèle = en‑têtes seuls",
                      template_rows == [headers], template_rows)

        # Format inconnu → 400
        res_bad = await client.get(
            "/api/v1/crm/partners/export?format=pdf", headers=auth
        )
        check("Format inconnu → 400", res_bad.status_code == 400,
              res_bad.status_code)

        # Filtre d'écran repris (onglets Clients / Fournisseurs)
        res_client = await client.get(
            "/api/v1/crm/partners/export?format=csv&role=client", headers=auth
        )
        check("Filtre role=client → lignes exportées",
````

````python
"""
Test E2E — parcours devis :
créer → confirmer → remettre au brouillon → modifier → supprimer.

Valide aussi le refus de back-to-draft si une facture est liée.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import sys

if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

BACKEND = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, BACKEND)
os.chdir(BACKEND)

DB_FILE = "test_quote_btd.db"
DB_URL = f"sqlite+aiosqlite:///./{DB_FILE}"

failures = []


def check(label, cond):
    status = "OK " if cond else "FAIL"
    print(f"[{status}] {label}")
    if not cond:
        failures.append(label)


async def main() -> int:
    from sqlalchemy import select
    from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

    from app.core.database import Base
    from app.core.models.company import Company

    import app.core.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.catalogue.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.crm.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.sales.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.stock.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.invoicing.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.delivery.models  # noqa: F401

    engine = create_async_engine(DB_URL)
    db_path = os.path.join(BACKEND, DB_FILE)
    if os.path.exists(db_path):
        os.remove(db_path)
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    SessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)

    async with SessionLocal() as session:
        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
        from app.modules.sales.services.quote_service import QuoteService
        from app.modules.sales.schemas import QuoteCreate, QuoteLineCreate, QuoteUpdate
        from app.modules.sales.models.order import SalesOrder
        from app.modules.invoicing.models.invoice import Invoice

        company = Company(name="Test BTB SARL", code="BTB", currency_code="XOF")
        session.add(company)
        await session.flush()
        cid = company.id

        partner = Partner(name="Client A", company_id=cid)
        session.add(partner)
        await session.flush()

        svc = QuoteService(session)

        quote = await svc.create_quote(QuoteCreate(
            partner_id=partner.id,
            lines=[QuoteLineCreate(description="Ligne test", quantity=2, unit_price=100)],
        ))
        check("Devis créé au statut brouillon", quote.status == "draft")

        order = await svc.confirm_quote(quote.id)
        check("Confirmation → statut confirmed", quote.status == "confirmed")
        check("Confirmation → une commande générée", order is not None)

        # back-to-draft refuse si une facture est liée à la commande
        inv = Invoice(
            reference="INV-BTD", order_id=order.id,
            partner_id=partner.id, company_id=cid,
            amount_total=200, status="draft",
        )
        session.add(inv)
        await session.commit()
        try:
            await svc.back_to_draft(quote.id)
            check("Back-to-draft refusé si facture liée", False)
        except ValueError:
            check("Back-to-draft refusé si facture liée", True)
        await session.delete(inv)
        await session.commit()

        # Retour au brouillon une fois la facture retirée
        restored = await svc.back_to_draft(quote.id)
        check("Back-to-draft → statut brouillon", restored.status == "draft")

        # La commande liée est supprimée
        order_ids = (await session.execute(select(SalesOrder.id))).scalars().all()
        check("Commande liée supprimée", order.id not in order_ids)

        # Back-to-draft interdit sur un devis déjà brouillon
        try:
            await svc.back_to_draft(quote.id)
            check("Double back-to-draft (brouillon) refusé", False)
        except ValueError:
            check("Double back-to-draft (brouillon) refusé", True)

        # Re-modification possible après retour au brouillon
        updated = await svc.update_quote(quote.id, QuoteUpdate(notes="re-modifié"))
        check("Modification OK après retour au brouillon",
              updated.notes == "re-modifié" and updated.status == "draft")

        # Suppression
        await svc.delete_quote(quote.id)
        gone = await svc.get_quote(quote.id)
        check("Suppression après retour au brouillon", gone is None)

    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
````

````python
"""
````

````python
    """Scénario complet : produits → devis BAC → commande → fulfillment."""

    session.add(client)

    # 10×5.50m + 20×4.50m + 15×3.00m = 190 m @ 3500/m
    from app.modules.sales.services.quote_service import QuoteService
    from app.modules.sales.schemas import QuoteCreate, QuoteLineCreate

    qs = QuoteService(session)
    quote = await qs.create_quote(QuoteCreate(

                ],

    check(f"Devis créé : {quote.reference}", quote.reference.startswith("DEV"))

    check(f"Total devis = {float(quote.amount_total)} (attendu {total_expected})",

    check(f"Commande : coupes BAC préservées ({len(o_bac.cuts)})",

async def test_stock_and_fulfillment(session, cement, bac, order, check):
    """Entrepôt, stock et analyse de fulfillment hybride."""
    from app.modules.stock.models.inventory import Warehouse
    wh = Warehouse(company_id=cement.company_id, name="Entrepôt principal", code="WH1")
    session.add(wh)

    await ss.record_movement(
        movement_type="inbound", warehouse_id=wh.id,
        product_id=cement.id, quantity=80, unit_cost=4200,
        reference_document="PO-1",
    )
    avail = await ss.get_available_stock(cement.id)
    check(f"Stock ciment disponible = {avail} (attendu 80)", avail == 80.0)

    from app.modules.sales.services.order_service import OrderService
    osvc = OrderService(session)
    analysis = await osvc.analyze_fulfillment(order.id)

          len(analysis["reservations"]) == 1)
    check(f"Fulfillment : besoins achat={len(analysis['purchase_needs'])} (attendu 2)",
          len(analysis["purchase_needs"]) == 2)

    res = analysis["reservations"][0]
    check(f"Réservation ciment = {res['quantity']} (attendu 80)",
          res["quantity"] == 80.0)
    needs_by_product = {n["product_id"]: n["quantity"] for n in analysis["purchase_needs"]}
    check(f"Besoin achat ciment = {needs_by_product.get(cement.id)} (attendu 20)",
          needs_by_product.get(cement.id) == 20.0)
    check(f"Besoin achat BAC = {needs_by_product.get(bac.id)} (attendu 190)",
          needs_by_product.get(bac.id) == 190.0)

    avail_after = await ss.get_available_stock(cement.id)
    check(f"Stock dispo après réservation = {avail_after} (attendu 0)",
          avail_after == 0.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(asyncio.run(main()))
````

````python
"""
Test E2E — variante de produit sur les lignes des documents commerciaux.

Parcours : devis → commande → facture + bon de livraison + vente comptoir.

Valide :
- validation de la variante (propriétaire + actif) et prix par défaut repris
  de la variante plutôt que du produit de base ;
- instantané de ``variant_name`` résolu côté serveur (jamais depuis le client) ;
- propagation du couple (variant_id, variant_name) à chaque conversion ;
- rendu HTML (devis / facture / BL / ticket POS) avec badge de variante,
  y compris après renommage de la variante (l'instantané doit survivre).

Usage : ``python test_variant_flow.py`` (crée puis supprime sa base SQLite).
"""
import asyncio
import os
import sys

if hasattr(sys.stdout, "reconfigure"):
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")

BACKEND = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, BACKEND)
os.chdir(BACKEND)

DB_FILE = "test_variant_flow.db"
DB_URL = f"sqlite+aiosqlite:///./{DB_FILE}"
# À définir AVANT tout import de app.* : ContextBuilder construit les contextes
# de rendu via AsyncSessionLocal, qui doit pointer sur la base de test.
os.environ["DATABASE_URL"] = DB_URL

VARIANT_SUFFIX = "Rouleau 25 m"
RENAME_SUFFIX = "Rouleau 30 m (renomme)"

failures = []


def check(label, cond):
    status = "OK " if cond else "FAIL"
    print(f"[{status}] {label}")
    if not cond:
        failures.append(label)


async def main() -> int:

    import app.core.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.catalogue.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.crm.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.sales.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.stock.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.invoicing.models  # noqa: F401
    import app.modules.delivery.models  # noqa: F401

    db_path = os.path.join(BACKEND, DB_FILE)
    if os.path.exists(db_path):
        os.remove(db_path)
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Fixtures : entreprise, client, produit + variantes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        from app.modules.crm.models.partner import Partner
        from app.modules.catalogue.models.product import Product
        from app.modules.catalogue.models.variant import ProductVariant

        company = Company(name="Test Variante SARL", code="TVAR",
                          currency_code="XOF")
        session.add(company)
        await session.flush()
        cid = company.id

        partner = Partner(name="Client Variante", company_id=cid)
        product = Product(
            reference="TOL-BAC-40", name="Tôle bac 40/40", sale_mode="unit",
            selling_price=1000, price_per_meter=500, company_id=cid,
        )
        other = Product(
            reference="CIM-50", name="Ciment CPJ 45", sale_mode="unit",
            selling_price=2500, company_id=cid,

        session.add_all([partner, product, other])
        await session.flush()

        variant = ProductVariant(

        )
        orphan = ProductVariant(
            product_id=other.id, name_suffix="Sac 50 kg",
            selling_price=2750, company_id=cid,
        )
        inactive = ProductVariant(
            product_id=product.id, name_suffix="Variante inactive",
            selling_price=9999, is_active=False, company_id=cid,
        )
        session.add_all([variant, orphan, inactive])
        await session.commit()

        ids = {
            "product": product.id, "other": other.id,
            "variant": variant.id, "orphan": orphan.id,
            "inactive": inactive.id, "partner": partner.id, "company": cid,

        # Variante inactive → refus

        # Création valide : unit_price omis (0) → prix de la variante
        quote = await svc.create_quote(QuoteCreate(

        check("Devis : variant_name résolu côté serveur",

        # Confirmation → commande
        order = await svc.confirm_quote(quote_id)
        oline = order.lines[0]
        check("Commande : variant_id propagé depuis le devis",
              oline.variant_id == ids["variant"])
        check("Commande : variant_name propagé depuis le devis",
              oline.variant_name == VARIANT_SUFFIX)
        order_id = order.id

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:

        iline = invoice.lines[0]

        check("Facture : variant_name propagé",
              iline.variant_name == VARIANT_SUFFIX)

        from app.modules.delivery.services.delivery_service import (

        dline = delivery.lines[0]
        check("Bon de livraison : variant_id propagé",
              dline.variant_id == ids["variant"])
        check("Bon de livraison : variant_name propagé",
              dline.variant_name == VARIANT_SUFFIX)

        invoice_id, delivery_id = invoice.id, delivery.id

        # Vente comptoir (ticket POS 80 mm) avec variante
        from app.modules.sales.schemas import OrderLineCreate, SalesOrderCreate
        from app.modules.sales.services.order_service import OrderService

        pos_order = await OrderService(session).create_order(SalesOrderCreate(
            partner_id=ids["partner"], fulfillment_mode="pos",
            lines=[OrderLineCreate(product_id=ids["product"],
                                   variant_id=ids["variant"], quantity=1)],
        ))
        pos_id = pos_order.id
        pos_line = pos_order.lines[0]
        check("Comptoir : variant_id mémorisé",
              pos_line.variant_id == ids["variant"])
        check("Comptoir : variant_name résolu côté serveur",
              pos_line.variant_name == VARIANT_SUFFIX)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # 3. Instantané : renommer la variante ne doit pas modifier les docs
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        from app.modules.catalogue.models.variant import ProductVariant
        v = await session.get(ProductVariant, ids["variant"])
        v.name_suffix = RENAME_SUFFIX
        await session.commit()


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # 4. Rendu HTML des documents (contextes construits depuis la BDD)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    from app.core.documents.context import ContextBuilder
    from app.core.documents.engine import DocumentEngine

    docs = DocumentEngine()
    builder = ContextBuilder()

    async def render_ctx(get_ctx, template_name: str) -> str:
        """Construit le contexte (async, via BDD) puis rend le template."""
        return docs.render_to_html(template_name, await get_ctx())

    quote_html = await render_ctx(
        lambda: builder.build_quote_context(quote_id), "quote.html")
    check("Rendu devis : badge de variante présent",
          "variant-tag" in quote_html)
    check("Rendu devis : libellé d'origine affiché (instantané)",
          VARIANT_SUFFIX in quote_html)
    check("Rendu devis : libellé renommé NON affiché",
          RENAME_SUFFIX not in quote_html)

    invoice_html = await render_ctx(
        lambda: builder.build_invoice_context(invoice_id), "invoice.html")
    check("Rendu facture : badge de variante présent",
          "variant-tag" in invoice_html)
    check("Rendu facture : libellé d'origine affiché (instantané)",
          VARIANT_SUFFIX in invoice_html)

    delivery_html = await render_ctx(
        lambda: builder.load_delivery(delivery_id), "delivery.html")
    check("Rendu bon de livraison : badge de variante présent",
          "variant-tag" in delivery_html)
    check("Rendu bon de livraison : libellé d'origine affiché (instantané)",
          VARIANT_SUFFIX in delivery_html)

    pos_html = await render_ctx(
        lambda: builder.load_pos(pos_id), "pos_ticket.html")
    check("Rendu ticket POS : libellé de variante en ligne",
          VARIANT_SUFFIX in pos_html)

    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    code = asyncio.run(main())
    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
````
