````typescript
// --- Constantes du wizard ---
const STEPS = [
  { label: "Identification", icon: Building2 },
  { label: "Monnaie", icon: Coins },
  { label: "Coordonnées", icon: MapPin },
  { label: "Exercice", icon: CalendarRange },
  { label: "Plan comptable", icon: ListChecks },
] as const;

interface OhadaCountry {
  code: string;
  name: string;
  currency: string;
}

/** Les 17 États membres OHADA avec leur devise courante. */
const OHADA_COUNTRIES: OhadaCountry[] = [
  { code: "BF", name: "Burkina Faso", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "BJ", name: "Bénin", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "CI", name: "Côte d'Ivoire", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "SN", name: "Sénégal", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "TG", name: "Togo", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "ML", name: "Mali", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "NE", name: "Niger", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "GW", name: "Guinée-Bissau", currency: "XOF" },
  { code: "CM", name: "Cameroun", currency: "XAF" },
  { code: "GA", name: "Gabon", currency: "XAF" },
  { code: "CG", name: "Congo", currency: "XAF" },
  { code: "TD", name: "Tchad", currency: "XAF" },
  { code: "CF", name: "Centrafrique", currency: "XAF" },
  { code: "GQ", name: "Guinée équatoriale", currency: "XAF" },
  { code: "GN", name: "Guinée", currency: "GNF" },
  { code: "MR", name: "Mauritanie", currency: "MRU" },
  { code: "CD", name: "RD Congo", currency: "USD" },
];

const LEGAL_FORMS = [
  "SARL",
  "SAS",
  "SA",
  "SARLU",
  "SNC",
  "GIE",
  "EI",
  "Autre",
];

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none transition-colors placeholder:text-gray-400 focus:border-blue-600";

const labelClass =
  "mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700";

interface CompanyInfo {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  currency_code: string;
  phone?: string | null;
  email?: string | null;
  website?: string | null;
  address?: Record<string, string>;
  ncc?: string | null;
  rccm?: string | null;
  share_capital?: string | null;
  tax_country?: string | null;
}

export default function AccountingSetupPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: company } = useCurrentCompany() as { data: CompanyInfo | undefined };

  const settingLegalForm = useSetting("accounting_legal_form");
  const settingActivity = useSetting("accounting_naf_activity");
  const currentFiscalYear = useCurrentFiscalYear();
  const constraints = useOHADAConstraints();

  const upsertSetting = useUpsertSetting();
  const upsertParameter = useUpsertOHADAParameter();
  const upsertRate = useUpsertExchangeRate();
  const createFiscalYear = useCreateFiscalYear();
  const seedPlan = useSeedOhadaPlan();

  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<{ kind: "ok" | "warn"; text: string } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [seedResult, setSeedResult] = useState<SeedResult | null>(null);

  // Étape 1 — Identification
  const [legalName, setLegalName] = useState("");
  const [legalForm, setLegalForm] = useState("SARL");
  const [countryCode, setCountryCode] = useState("BF");

  // Étape 2 — Monnaie
  const [eurRate, setEurRate] = useState("0.00152");
  const [usdRate, setUsdRate] = useState("0.00163");
  const [vatRate, setVatRate] = useState("18");

  // Étape 3 — Coordonnées
  const [activity, setActivity] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [addressLine, setAddressLine] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [postalCode, setPostalCode] = useState("");
  const [ncc, setNcc] = useState("");
  const [rccm, setRccm] = useState("");
  const [capital, setCapital] = useState("");

  // Étape 4 — Exercice
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  const [fyName, setFyName] = useState(`Exercice ${currentYear}`);
  const [fyStart, setFyStart] = useState(`${currentYear}-01-01`);
  const [fyEnd, setFyEnd] = useState(`${currentYear}-12-31`);

  const selectedCountry = useMemo(
    () => OHADA_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === countryCode) ?? OHADA_COUNTRIES[0],
    [countryCode],
  );

  // Pré-remplissage depuis la société + les paramètres enregistrés
  useEffect(() => {
    if (hydrated) return;
    const companyReady = company !== undefined;
    const settingsReady =
      settingLegalForm.isSuccess && settingActivity.isSuccess;
    const fyReady = currentFiscalYear.isSuccess || currentFiscalYear.isError;
    if (!companyReady || !settingsReady || !fyReady) return;

    if (company) {
      setLegalName((prev) => prev || company.name);
      setPhone((prev) => prev || company.phone || "");
      setEmail((prev) => prev || company.email || "");
      setNcc((prev) => prev || company.ncc || "");
      setRccm((prev) => prev || company.rccm || "");
      setCapital((prev) => prev || company.share_capital || "");
      const addr = company.address ?? {};
      setAddressLine((prev) => prev || addr.line1 || addr.address || "");
      setCity((prev) => prev || addr.city || "");
      setPostalCode((prev) => prev || addr.postal_code || "");
      if (company.tax_country) {
        const found = OHADA_COUNTRIES.find(
          (c) => c.code === company.tax_country?.toUpperCase(),
        );
        if (found) setCountryCode(found.code);
      }
    }
    if (settingLegalForm.data?.value) {
      setLegalForm(settingLegalForm.data.value);
    }
    if (settingActivity.data?.value) {
      setActivity(settingActivity.data.value);
    }
    if (currentFiscalYear.data) {
      setFyName(currentFiscalYear.data.name);
      setFyStart(currentFiscalYear.data.start_date);
      setFyEnd(currentFiscalYear.data.end_date);
    }
    setHydrated(true);
  }, [
    hydrated,
    company,
    settingLegalForm.data,
    settingActivity.data,
    currentFiscalYear.data,
    settingLegalForm.isSuccess,
    settingActivity.isSuccess,
    currentFiscalYear.isSuccess,
    currentFiscalYear.isError,
  ]);

  const busy =
    upsertSetting.isPending ||
    upsertParameter.isPending ||
    upsertRate.isPending ||
    createFiscalYear.isPending ||
    seedPlan.isPending;

  /** PUT /core/companies/{id} — échoue en 403 si non super-admin (non bloquant). */
  const saveCompanyFields = async (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    if (!company || !user) return false;
    try {
      await apiClient.put(`/core/companies/${company.id}`, payload);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      setNotice({
        kind: "warn",
        text:
          "Coordonnées non enregistrées (droits insuffisants — réservé à l'administrateur). Les autres paramètres ont bien été sauvegardés.",
      });
      return false;
    }
  };

  const nextFromIdentification = async () => {
    setNotice(null);
    if (!legalName.trim()) {
      setNotice({ kind: "warn", text: "La raison sociale est obligatoire." });
      return;
    }
    await upsertSetting.mutateAsync({
      key: "accounting_legal_form",
      value: legalForm,
      description: "Forme juridique (wizard configuration comptable)",
    });
    await saveCompanyFields({ name: legalName.trim(), tax_country: countryCode });
    setStep(1);
  };

  const nextFromCurrency = async () => {
    setNotice(null);
    const eur = parseFloat(eurRate.replace(",", "."));
    const vat = parseFloat(vatRate.replace(",", "."));
    if (!(eur > 0)) {
      setNotice({ kind: "warn", text: "Le taux de change vers l'EUR doit être positif." });
      return;
    }
    await upsertParameter.mutateAsync({
      country_code: countryCode,
      currency_code: selectedCountry.currency,
      tax_rate_percentage: Number.isFinite(vat) ? vat : 0,
      fiscal_year_start: `${fyStart.slice(0, 4)}-01-01`,
      fiscal_year_end: `${fyStart.slice(0, 4)}-12-31`,
      is_active: true,
    });
    await upsertRate.mutateAsync({
      base_currency: selectedCountry.currency,
      quote_currency: "EUR",
      rate: eur,
    });
    const usd = parseFloat(usdRate.replace(",", "."));
    if (Number.isFinite(usd) && usd > 0) {
      await upsertRate.mutateAsync({
        base_currency: selectedCountry.currency,
        quote_currency: "USD",
        rate: usd,
      });
    }
    setStep(2);
  };

  const nextFromCoords = async () => {
    setNotice(null);
    await upsertSetting.mutateAsync({
      key: "accounting_naf_activity",
      value: activity.trim(),
      description: "Code activité NAF/OHADA (wizard configuration comptable)",
    });
    await saveCompanyFields({
      phone: phone.trim() || null,
      email: email.trim() || null,
      ncc: ncc.trim() || null,
      rccm: rccm.trim() || null,
      share_capital: capital.trim() || null,
      address: {
        ...(company?.address ?? {}),
        line1: addressLine.trim(),
        city: city.trim(),
        postal_code: postalCode.trim(),
        country: selectedCountry.name,
      },
    });
    setStep(3);
  };

  const handleCreateFiscalYear = async () => {
    setNotice(null);
    if (fyStart >= fyEnd) {
      setNotice({
        kind: "warn",
        text: "La date de début doit précéder la date de fin de l'exercice.",
      });
      return;
    }
    await createFiscalYear.mutateAsync({
      name: fyName.trim() || `Exercice ${fyStart.slice(0, 4)}`,
      start_date: fyStart,
      end_date: fyEnd,
    });
    setNotice({
      kind: "ok",
      text: `Exercice « ${fyName} » créé et ouvert.`,
    });
  };

  const handleSeedPlan = async () => {
    setNotice(null);
    const result = await seedPlan.mutateAsync();
    setSeedResult(result);
  };
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
          Configuration de la comptabilité
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
          Assistant OHADA — paramétrage conforme SYSCOHADA Révisé
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Stepper */}
      <ol className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
        {STEPS.map((s, i) => {
          const Icon = s.icon;
          const active = i === step;
          const done = i < step;
          return (
            <li key={s.label} className="flex items-center">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => done && setStep(i)}
                disabled={!done}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                  active
                    ? "bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white"
                    : done
                      ? "text-[#0a2a6b] hover:bg-blue-50"
                      : "text-gray-400"
                }`}
              >
                <span
                  className={`flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-xs ${
                    active
                      ? "bg-amber-400 text-gray-900"
                      : done
                        ? "bg-blue-100"
                        : "bg-gray-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  {done ? <BadgeCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : i + 1}
                </span>
                <span className="hidden sm:inline">{s.label}</span>
                <Icon className="hidden h-4 w-4 opacity-60 md:inline" />
              </button>
              {i < STEPS.length - 1 && (
                <span className="mx-1 h-px w-6 bg-gray-300" />
              )}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>

      {notice && (
        <div
          className={`rounded-md border px-4 py-3 text-sm ${
            notice.kind === "ok"
              ? "border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-green-800"
              : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
          }`}
        >
          {notice.kind === "warn" ? (
            <TriangleAlert className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" />
          ) : (
            <BadgeCheck className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          {notice.text}
        </div>
      )}

      <Card>
        {/* ---------------- Etape 1 — Identification ---------------- */}
        {step === 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Identification de la société
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Reprise automatique des informations générales de
                l&apos;entreprise — modifiables ici et dans les Paramètres.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>Raison sociale</label>
              <input
                className={inputClass}
                value={legalName}
                onChange={(e) => setLegalName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Ex. PrimeMAT Distribution SARL"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Forme juridique</label>
                <select
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={legalForm}
                  onChange={(e) => setLegalForm(e.target.value)}
                >
                  {LEGAL_FORMS.map((f) => (
                    <option key={f} value={f}>
                      {f}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Pays OHADA</label>
                <select
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={countryCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setCountryCode(e.target.value)}
                >
                  {OHADA_COUNTRIES.map((c) => (
                    <option key={c.code} value={c.code}>
                      {c.name} ({c.currency})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="rounded-md bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
              Code entreprise : <strong>{company?.code ?? "—"}</strong> — devise
              de tenue de compte : <strong>{company?.currency_code ?? "—"}</strong>
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ---------------- Etape 2 — Monnaie ---------------- */}
        {step === 1 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Monnaie de tenue de compte
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Comptabilité tenue en <strong>{selectedCountry.currency}</strong> ({selectedCountry.name}). Renseignez les taux de change utilisés pour les états financiers.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>
                  Taux 1 {selectedCountry.currency} vers EUR
                </label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={eurRate}
                  onChange={(e) => setEurRate(e.target.value)}
                  inputMode="decimal"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>
                  Taux 1 {selectedCountry.currency} vers USD
                </label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={usdRate}
                  onChange={(e) => setUsdRate(e.target.value)}
                  inputMode="decimal"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>TVA par défaut (%)</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={vatRate}
                  onChange={(e) => setVatRate(e.target.value)}
                  inputMode="decimal"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="rounded-md bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
              Le paramètre OHADA du pays "{selectedCountry.name}" sera créé ou mis à jour avec ces valeurs (devise {selectedCountry.currency}).
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ---------------- Étape 3 — Coordonnées ---------------- */}
        {step === 2 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Coordonnées de l&apos;entreprise
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Ces informations alimentent le module Société et les documents
                comptables (annexes, états financiers).
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Activité (code NAF/OHADA)</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={activity}
                  onChange={(e) => setActivity(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. 46690 — Commerce de gros"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Ville</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={city}
                  onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Ex. Ouagadougou"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className={labelClass}>Adresse</label>
              <input
                className={inputClass}
                value={addressLine}
                onChange={(e) => setAddressLine(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Rue, quartier, avenue…"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Code postal</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={postalCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setPostalCode(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Téléphone</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={phone}
                  onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Email</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>N° Contribuable (NCC)</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={ncc}
                  onChange={(e) => setNcc(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>RCCM</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={rccm}
                  onChange={(e) => setRccm(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className={labelClass}>Capital social</label>
                <input
                  className={inputClass}
                  value={capital}
                  onChange={(e) => setCapital(e.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ---------------- Étape 4 — Exercice ---------------- */}
        {step === 3 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Exercice comptable
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
                L&apos;exercice délimite les écritures comptables — aucune
                modification des dates après création.
              </p>
            </div>

            {currentFiscalYear.data ? (
              <div className="rounded-md border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-800">
                <BadgeCheck className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" />
                Exercice « {currentFiscalYear.data.name} » ouvert du{" "}
                {currentFiscalYear.data.start_date} au{" "}
                {currentFiscalYear.data.end_date}.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className={labelClass}>Nom de l&apos;exercice</label>
                  <input
                    className={inputClass}
                    value={fyName}
                    onChange={(e) => setFyName(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Date de début</label>
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      className={inputClass}
                      value={fyStart}
                      onChange={(e) => setFyStart(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className={labelClass}>Date de fin</label>
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      className={inputClass}
                      value={fyEnd}
                      onChange={(e) => setFyEnd(e.target.value)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleCreateFiscalYear}
                  disabled={createFiscalYear.isPending}
                  className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
                >
                  {createFiscalYear.isPending && (
                    <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                  )}
                  Créer et ouvrir l&apos;exercice
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ---------------- Étape 5 — Plan comptable ---------------- */}
        {step === 4 && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Reprise des éléments comptables
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
                Le plan comptable SYSCOHADA Révisé (9 classes) et les journaux
                par défaut sont initialisés en une seule opération.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-3 rounded-md border border-[#0a2a6b] bg-blue-50 p-3">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="seed-mode"
                  checked
                  readOnly
                  className="mt-1"
                />
                <span className="text-sm">
                  <strong>Modèle standard OHADA (recommandé)</strong>
                  <br />
                  <span className="text-gray-600">
                    Plan comptable complet, journaux Achat/Vente/Banque/Caisse/
                    Paie/OD pré-configurés.
                  </span>
                </span>
              </label>
              <label className="flex cursor-not-allowed items-start gap-3 rounded-md border p-3 opacity-50">
                <input type="radio" name="seed-mode" disabled className="mt-1" />
                <span className="text-sm">Sélection partielle (bientôt)</span>
              </label>
              <label className="flex cursor-not-allowed items-start gap-3 rounded-md border p-3 opacity-50">
                <input type="radio" name="seed-mode" disabled className="mt-1" />
                <span className="text-sm">Paramétrage entièrement manuel (bientôt)</span>
              </label>
            </div>

            {!seedResult && (
              <Button
                onClick={handleSeedPlan}
                disabled={seedPlan.isPending}
                className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
              >
                {seedPlan.isPending && (
                  <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                )}
                Initialiser le plan comptable OHADA
              </Button>
            )}

            {seedResult && (
              <div className="rounded-md border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-800">
                <BadgeCheck className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" />
                {seedResult.created > 0
                  ? `${seedResult.created} comptes créés`
                  : "Plan comptable déjà initialisé"}
                — {seedResult.total} comptes au total, {seedResult.journals_created}{" "}
                journaux par défaut.
              </div>
            )}

            {constraints.data && (
              <div
                className={`rounded-md border px-4 py-3 text-sm ${
                  constraints.data.can_open
                    ? "border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-green-800"
                    : "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800"
                }`}
              >
                {constraints.data.can_open
                  ? "Contraintes OHADA validées — la saisie comptable peut commencer."
                  : `À compléter : ${constraints.data.message}`}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* Navigation */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          onClick={() => setStep((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1))}
          disabled={step === 0 || busy}
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" /> Précédent
        </Button>

        {step === 0 && (
          <Button
            onClick={nextFromIdentification}
            disabled={busy}
            className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
          >
            {busy && <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
            Suivant <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        )}
        {step === 1 && (
          <Button
            onClick={nextFromCurrency}
            disabled={busy}
            className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
          >
            {busy && <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
            Suivant <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        )}
        {step === 2 && (
          <Button
            onClick={nextFromCoords}
            disabled={busy}
            className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
          >
            {busy && <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
            Suivant <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        )}
        {step === 3 &&
          (currentFiscalYear.data ? (
            <Button
              onClick={() => setStep(4)}
              disabled={busy}
              className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
            >
              Suivant <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button
              onClick={handleCreateFiscalYear}
              disabled={createFiscalYear.isPending}
              className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
            >
              {createFiscalYear.isPending && (
                <Loader2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              )}
              Créer et ouvrir l&apos;exercice
            </Button>
          ))}
        {step === 4 && (
          <Button
            onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard/accounting")}
            className="bg-[#0a2a6b] text-white hover:bg-[#0d3a8f]"
          >
            <Settings2 className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />
            Accéder à la comptabilité
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Page Comptabilité — états financiers SYSCOHADA.
 *
 * Onglets : Balance de vérification, Compte de résultat, Bilan,
 * Écritures du journal. Bouton de rattrapage pour comptabiliser
 * en masse les flux métier non encore traités.
 */
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  useTrialBalance,
  useIncomeStatement,
  useBalanceSheet,
  useJournalEntries,
  useBackfill,
} from "@/hooks/useAccounting";

type Tab = "balance" | "income" | "sheet" | "entries";

const TABS: { key: Tab; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "balance", label: "Balance de vérification" },
  { key: "income", label: "Compte de résultat" },
  { key: "sheet", label: "Bilan" },
  { key: "entries", label: "Écritures" },
];

const QUICK_LINKS: { label: string; href: string }[] = [
  { label: "Lettrage", href: "/dashboard/accounting/allocations" },
  { label: "Avoirs", href: "/dashboard/accounting/credit-notes" },
  { label: "Régime fiscal", href: "/dashboard/accounting/fiscal-regime" },
  { label: "Balance âgée", href: "/dashboard/accounting/aged-balance" },
  { label: "Cash-flow", href: "/dashboard/accounting/cash-flow" },
];

export default function AccountingPage() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("balance");
  const trial = useTrialBalance();
  const income = useIncomeStatement();
  const sheet = useBalanceSheet();
  const entries = useJournalEntries();
  const backfill = useBackfill();

  const loading = trial.isLoading || income.isLoading || sheet.isLoading;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Comptabilité</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
            États financiers SYSCOHADA (référentiel OHADA)
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              window.location.href = "/dashboard/accounting/setup";
            }}
          >
            Assistant de configuration
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={() => backfill.mutate()}
            disabled={backfill.isPending}
            className="bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-700"
          >
            {backfill.isPending
              ? "Comptabilisation…"
              : "Rattrapage des flux non comptabilisés"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {QUICK_LINKS.map((l) => (
          <a
            key={l.href}
            href={l.href}
            className="rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 shadow-sm transition-colors hover:bg-gray-50"
          >
            {l.label}
          </a>
        ))}
      </div>

      {backfill.isSuccess && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-800">
          {backfill.data.message}
        </div>
      )}
      {backfill.isError && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-800">
          Erreur lors du rattrapage : {(backfill.error as Error)?.message}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 border-b border-gray-200">
        {TABS.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t.key}
            onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
            className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
              tab === t.key
                ? "border-b-2 border-gray-900 text-gray-900"
                : "text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800"
````

````typescript
/**
 * Détail d'un produit — lecture + lien d'édition.
 */
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { use } from "react";
import { ArrowLeft, Pencil } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useProduct, useCategoryTree } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import { VariantsSection } from "@/components/catalogue/variants-section";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";

interface FlatCategory {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  saleMode: string;
  depth: number;
}

function flattenTree(
  nodes: { id: number; name: string; resolved_sale_mode?: string; sale_mode?: string; children?: unknown[] }[],
  depth = 0,
  out: FlatCategory[] = []
): FlatCategory[] {
  for (const n of nodes ?? []) {
    out.push({
      id: n.id,
      name: n.name,
      saleMode: n.resolved_sale_mode ?? n.sale_mode ?? "unit",
      depth,
    });
    if (n.children?.length)
      flattenTree(
        n.children as typeof nodes,
        depth + 1,
        out
      );
  }
  return out;
}

const MODE_LABELS: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  unit: { label: "À l'unité", cls: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-700" },
  length: { label: "Au mètre (BAC)", cls: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700" },
  dual: { label: "Unité + mètre", cls: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-700" },
};

const STORAGE_TYPE_BADGES: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  stockable: { label: "En stock", cls: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700" },
  on_demand: { label: "Production", cls: "bg-orange-100 text-orange-700" },
  hybrid: { label: "Stock + Production", cls: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700" },
  service: { label: "Service", cls: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600" },
};

export default function ProductDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id: idParam } = use(params);
  const id = Number(idParam) || 0;
  const { data: product, isLoading } = useProduct(id);
  const { data: tree = [] } = useCategoryTree();

  if (isLoading)
    return <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>;
  if (!product)
    return (
      <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">
        Produit introuvable (ou accès refusé).
      </p>
    );

  const cats = flattenTree(tree as never as { id: number; name: string; children?: unknown[] }[]);
  const category = cats.find((c) => c.id === product.category_id);
  const mode = MODE_LABELS[product.sale_mode] ?? MODE_LABELS.unit;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <Link href="/dashboard/catalogue" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-primary">
            <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" /> Retour au catalogue
          </Link>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{product.name}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
            {product.reference}
            {category ? ` · ${category.name}` : ""}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link href={`/dashboard/catalogue/new?id=${product.id}`}>
          <Button variant="outline" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" /> Modifier
          </Button>
        </Link>
      </div>

      <Card className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 p-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Mode de vente</p>
          <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${mode.cls}`}>
            {mode.label}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Type</p>
          {(() => {
            const b = STORAGE_TYPE_BADGES[product.storage_type] ?? STORAGE_TYPE_BADGES.stockable;
            return (
              <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${b.cls}`}>
                {b.label}
              </span>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Statut</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
            {product.status === "active" ? "Actif" : product.status}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Code-barres</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
            {product.barcode ?? "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 p-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Prix de vente unitaire</p>
          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">
            {product.selling_price != null && product.selling_price > 0
              ? formatCurrency(product.selling_price)
              : "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Prix au mètre linéaire</p>
          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">
            {product.price_per_meter != null && product.price_per_meter > 0
              ? formatCurrency(product.price_per_meter)
              : "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
            {product.sale_mode === "dual" ? "Longueur standard pièce" : "Longueur standard"}
          </p>
          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">
            {product.unit_length != null ? `${product.unit_length} m` : "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <VariantsSection
        productId={product.id}
        productPrice={product.selling_price ?? null}
      />

      {product.description && (
        <Card className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Description</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">{product.description}</p>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Création / édition d'un produit — mode de vente dérivé de la catégorie.
 */
"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  useCreateProduct,
  useUpdateProduct,
  useProduct,
  useCategoryTree,
} from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import { BarcodeScanner } from "@/components/catalogue/barcode-scanner";

interface FlatCategory {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  saleMode: string;
  depth: number;
}

function flattenTree(
  nodes: { id: number; name: string; resolved_sale_mode?: string; sale_mode?: string; children?: unknown[] }[],
  depth = 0,
  out: FlatCategory[] = []
): FlatCategory[] {
  for (const n of nodes ?? []) {
    out.push({
      id: n.id,
      name: n.name,
      saleMode: n.resolved_sale_mode ?? n.sale_mode ?? "unit",
      depth,
    });
    if (n.children?.length)
      flattenTree(n.children as typeof nodes, depth + 1, out);
  }
  return out;
}

const SALE_MODE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  unit: "À l'unité",
  length: "Au mètre (BAC)",
  dual: "Unité + mètre",
};

export default function NewProductPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <NewProductPageInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function NewProductPageInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const editId = Number(searchParams.get("id")) || null;
  const isEdit = !!editId;
  const createProduct = useCreateProduct();
  const updateProduct = useUpdateProduct();
  const { data: existing } = useProduct(editId ?? 0);
  const { data: tree = [] } = useCategoryTree();

  const categories = useMemo(
    () =>
      flattenTree(
        tree as never as { id: number; name: string; children?: unknown[] }[]
      ),
    [tree]
  );

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [isStock, setIsStock] = useState(true);       // Quincaillerie (en stock)
  const [isProduction, setIsProduction] = useState(false); // Production (a produire)
  const [barcode, setBarcode] = useState("");
  const [sellingPrice, setSellingPrice] = useState(0);
  const [pricePerMeter, setPricePerMeter] = useState(0);
  const [unitLength, setUnitLength] = useState(2.5);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Pré-remplissage en mode édition (une seule fois)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!existing || loaded) return;
    setLoaded(true);
    setName(existing.name);
    setCategoryId(existing.category_id);
    setSellingPrice(existing.selling_price ?? 0);
    setPricePerMeter(existing.price_per_meter ?? 0);
    setUnitLength(existing.unit_length ?? 2.5);
    setBarcode(existing.barcode ?? "");
    const st = existing.storage_type ?? "stockable";
    setIsStock(st === "stockable" || st === "hybrid");
    setIsProduction(st === "on_demand" || st === "hybrid");
  }, [existing, loaded]);

  const selectedCat = categories.find((c) => c.id === categoryId) ?? null;
  const mode = selectedCat?.saleMode ?? "unit";

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!name.trim()) return setError("Nom du produit requis.");
    if (!categoryId) return setError("Choisissez une catégorie.");
    if (!isStock && !isProduction)
      return setError("Cochez au moins un type : Quincaillerie et/ou Production.");
    const storage_type = isStock && isProduction ? "hybrid" : isProduction ? "on_demand" : "stockable";
    const data = {
      name: name.trim(),
      category_id: categoryId,
      storage_type,
      barcode: barcode.trim() || undefined,
      selling_price: mode === "length" ? undefined : Number(sellingPrice),
      price_per_meter: mode === "unit" ? undefined : Number(pricePerMeter),
      unit_length: mode === "dual" ? Number(unitLength) : undefined,
    };
    try {
      if (isEdit) {
        await updateProduct.mutateAsync({ id: editId, data });
      } else {
        await createProduct.mutateAsync(data);
      }
      router.push("/dashboard/catalogue");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data
          ?.detail;
      setError(
        typeof detail === "string"
          ? detail
          : `Erreur lors de ${isEdit ? "la modification" : "la création"}`
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
          {isEdit ? "Modifier le produit" : "Nouveau produit"}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
          Le mode de vente est défini par la catégorie
        </p>
      </div>

        {error && <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</div>}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Nom *</label>
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Ex : Tôle BAC Alu 0,30" />

            <select
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
              value={categoryId ?? ""}
              onChange={(e) => setCategoryId(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)}
            >
              <option value="">— Choisir —</option>
              {categories.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {"\u00A0".repeat(c.depth * 4)}
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Type de produit *</label>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 p-3 hover:border-primary">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isStock}
                onChange={(e) => setIsStock(e.target.checked)}
                className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300"
              />
              <span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">Quincaillerie</span>
                <span className="block text-xs text-gray-500">En stock — vendu depuis le stock</span>
              </span>
            </label>
            <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-300 p-3 hover:border-primary">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isProduction}
                onChange={(e) => setIsProduction(e.target.checked)}
                className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300"
              />
              <span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">Production</span>
                <span className="block text-xs text-gray-500">Pas en stock — nécessite production</span>
              </span>
            </label>
          </div>
          {(isStock || isProduction) && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
              Type enregistré :{" "}
              <strong>
                {isStock && isProduction ? "Stock + Production (hybride)" : isProduction ? "Production (sur commande)" : "Quincaillerie (en stock)"}
              </strong>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Code-barres / QR (optionnel)</label>
            <Input
              value={barcode}
              onChange={(e) => setBarcode(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Scanner le code du fabricant ou saisir manuellement"
            />

          <div className="flex items-end">

        {mode === "unit" && (
          <div className="w-48">
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Prix de vente (pièce)</label>
            <Input type="number" min={0} value={sellingPrice} onChange={(e) => setSellingPrice(Number(e.target.value))} />
          </div>
        )}
        {(mode === "length" || mode === "dual") && (
          <div className="w-48">
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Prix au mètre linéaire</label>
            <Input type="number" min={0} value={pricePerMeter} onChange={(e) => setPricePerMeter(Number(e.target.value))} />
          </div>
        )}
        {mode === "dual" && (
          <div className="w-48">
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Longueur standard pièce (m)</label>
            <Input type="number" step="0.01" min={0} value={unitLength} onChange={(e) => setUnitLength(Number(e.target.value))} />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={createProduct.isPending || updateProduct.isPending}>
            {createProduct.isPending || updateProduct.isPending
              ? "Enregistrement…"
              : isEdit
                ? "Enregistrer les modifications"
                : "Créer"}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard/catalogue")}>
            Annuler
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
 * Page Catalogue — liste des produits et accès à la création/édition.

 * Le mode de vente (unité / mètre linéaire / dual) est dérivé de la

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import { CATALOGUE_KEYS, useProducts } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";

const SALE_MODE_LABELS: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  unit: { label: "À l'unité", cls: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-700" },
  length: { label: "Au mètre (BAC)", cls: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700" },
  dual: { label: "Unité + mètre", cls: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-700" },
};

const STORAGE_TYPE_BADGES: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  stockable: { label: "En stock", cls: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700" },
  on_demand: { label: "Production", cls: "bg-orange-100 text-orange-700" },
  hybrid: { label: "Stock + Production", cls: "bg-violet-100 text-violet-700" },
  service: { label: "Service", cls: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-600" },
};

export default function CataloguePage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: products = [], isLoading } = useProducts();
  const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [scanMsg, setScanMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleScanLookup = async (code: string) => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(
        `/catalogue/products/lookup?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`
      );
      if (res.data?.found && res.data.product) {
        router.push(`/dashboard/catalogue/${res.data.product.id}`);
      } else {
        setScanMsg(`Aucun produit pour le code « ${code} » — créez-le avec ce code-barres.`);
        setTimeout(() => setScanMsg(null), 6000);
      }
    } catch {
      setScanMsg("Erreur lors de la recherche du code.");
    }
  };

  // Scan AIDC (douchette USB / terminal) — marche sans focus sur un champ.
  useEffect(() => {
    return attachHidScanner(handleScanLookup);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Catalogue</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">

          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <BarcodeScanner
            label="Scanner un produit"
            onScan={handleScanLookup}
          />
          <ExportButton endpoint="/catalogue/products/export" fallbackName="produits" />
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={() => setImportOpen(true)}
          >
            <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
            Importer
          </Button>
          <Link href="/dashboard/catalogue/new">
            <Button className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
              Nouveau produit
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ImportDialog
        open={importOpen}
        onClose={() => setImportOpen(false)}
        endpoint="/catalogue/products/import"
        title="Importer des produits"
        columnsHint="reference, nom, categorie, prix_achat, prix_vente, prix_ml, unite, vente_au_metre (oui/non), marque, code_barre"
        invalidateKeys={[CATALOGUE_KEYS.products]}
      />

      {scanMsg && (
        <div className="rounded-md bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm text-amber-700">{scanMsg}</div>
      )}

      <Card className="overflow-hidden p-0">
        {isLoading ? (
          <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>
        ) : products.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-10 text-center">
            <Package className="mx-auto mb-3 h-10 w-10 text-gray-300" />
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Aucun produit.</p>
            <Link href="/dashboard/catalogue/new" className="mt-3 inline-block">
              <Button size="sm">Créer le premier produit</Button>
            </Link>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Produit</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Réf.</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Mode de vente</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-center">Variantes</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Prix unité</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Prix / ml</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Pièce std</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {products.map((p) => {
                const sm = SALE_MODE_LABELS[p.sale_mode ?? "unit"];
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={p.id}
                    onClick={() => router.push(`/dashboard/catalogue/${p.id}`)}
                    className="cursor-pointer border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900 hover:text-primary hover:underline">
                      {p.name}{" "}
                      {(() => {
                        const b = STORAGE_TYPE_BADGES[p.storage_type];
                        return b ? (
                          <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${b.cls}`}>{b.label}</span>
                        ) : null;
                      })()}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-gray-500">{p.reference}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${sm?.cls ?? "bg-gray-100"}`}>
                        {sm?.label ?? p.sale_mode}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center text-gray-600">
                      {p.variants_count ? (
````

````typescript
/**
 * Création / édition d'un contact (client ou fournisseur).
 * - Sans `?id=`  → création
 * - Avec `?id=`  → édition (pré-remplie)
 */
"use client";

import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  useCreatePartner,
  usePartner,
  useUpdatePartner,
} from "@/hooks/useCRM";

export default function NewContactPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <NewContactPageInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function NewContactPageInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const editId = Number(searchParams.get("id")) || null;
  const createPartner = useCreatePartner();
  const updatePartner = useUpdatePartner();
  const { data: existing } = usePartner(editId ?? 0);

  const isEdit = !!editId;

  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [city, setCity] = useState("");
  const [isSupplier, setIsSupplier] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Pré-remplissage en mode édition (une seule fois)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!existing || loaded) return;
    setLoaded(true);
    setName(existing.name);
    setPhone(existing.phone ?? "");
    setEmail(existing.email ?? "");
    setCity(existing.addresses?.[0]?.city ?? "");
    setIsSupplier(existing.role === "supplier" || existing.role === "both");
  }, [existing, loaded]);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!name.trim()) return setError("Nom requis.");
    const data = {
      name: name.trim(),
      phone: phone || undefined,
      email: email || undefined,
      role: isSupplier ? "supplier" : "client",
      addresses: city ? [{ address_type: "main", city }] : undefined,
    };
    try {
      if (isEdit) {
        await updatePartner.mutateAsync({ id: editId, data });
      } else {
        await createPartner.mutateAsync(data);
      }
      router.push("/dashboard/contacts");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data
          ?.detail;
      setError(
        typeof detail === "string"
          ? detail
          : `Erreur lors de ${isEdit ? "la modification" : "la création"}`
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-2xl space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
          {isEdit ? "Modifier le contact" : "Nouveau contact"}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Client ou fournisseur</p>
      </div>

      <Card className="space-y-4 p-4">
        {error && <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</div>}
        <div>
          <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Nom *</label>
          <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Ex : Boutique Chez Fatou" />
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Téléphone</label>
            <Input value={phone} onChange={(e) => setPhone(e.target.value)} placeholder="+225 …" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">E-mail</label>
            <Input type="email" value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Ville</label>
            <Input value={city} onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center pt-6">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-700">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={isSupplier}
                onChange={(e) => setIsSupplier(e.target.checked)}
                className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300"
              />
              Fournisseur
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={createPartner.isPending || updatePartner.isPending}>
            {createPartner.isPending || updatePartner.isPending
              ? "Enregistrement…"
              : isEdit
                ? "Enregistrer les modifications"
                : "Créer le contact"}
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard/contacts")}>
            Annuler
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { use } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ArrowLeft, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  useDeliveryNote,
  useUpdateDeliveryStatus,
  useBackToDraftDelivery,
  useDeleteDelivery,
} from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { useClients } from "@/hooks/useCRM";
import { usePermission } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import {
  useConfirm,
  confirmBackToDraftOptions,
  confirmDeleteOptions,
} from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import { printDelivery } from "@/lib/api/pdf";
import { formatDate, StatusBadge } from "@/lib/utils";

const NEXT_STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; value: string }> = {
  draft: { label: "Confirmer", value: "pending" },
  planned: { label: "Expédier", value: "shipped" },
  shipped: { label: "Livrer", value: "delivered" },
  pending: { label: "Livrer", value: "delivered" },
  in_progress: { label: "Livrer", value: "delivered" },
  delivered: { label: "Terminer", value: "completed" },
};

export default function DeliveryDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { id: idParam } = use(params);
  const id = Number(idParam) || 0;
  const { data: d, isLoading } = useDeliveryNote(id);
  const { data: clients = [] } = useClients();
  const updateStatus = useUpdateDeliveryStatus();
  const backToDraft = useBackToDraftDelivery();
  const deleteDelivery = useDeleteDelivery();
  const can = usePermission();
  const canEditDelivery = can("delivery:edit");
  const canDeleteDelivery = can("delivery:delete");
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  const handleBackToDraft = async (reference: string) => {
    const { confirmed } = await confirm(
      confirmBackToDraftOptions(
        `${reference} — Seul un BL au brouillon peut être supprimé.`,
      ),
    );
    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await backToDraft.mutateAsync(id);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })
        ?.response?.data?.detail;
      alert(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la remise au brouillon");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (reference: string) => {
    const { confirmed } = await confirm(
      confirmDeleteOptions(
        `${reference} — Seuls les BL en brouillon et sans paiement restant peuvent être supprimés.`,
      ),
    );
    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await deleteDelivery.mutateAsync(id);
      router.push("/dashboard/delivery");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })
        ?.response?.data?.detail;
      alert(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la suppression");
    }
  };

  if (isLoading)
    return <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>;
  if (!d)
    return (
      <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">
        Bon de livraison introuvable (ou accès refusé).
      </p>
    );

  const client = clients.find((c) => c.id === d.partner_id);
  const next = NEXT_STATUS[d.status];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <Link href="/dashboard/delivery" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-primary">
            <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" /> Retour aux livraisons
          </Link>
          <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{d.reference}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
            {client?.name ?? `Client #${d.partner_id}`}
            {d.order_id ? ` · Commande #${d.order_id}` : ""}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {next && canEditDelivery && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              disabled={updateStatus.isPending}
              onClick={() =>
                updateStatus
                  .mutateAsync({ deliveryId: d.id, status: next.value })
                  .catch(() => alert("Erreur lors du changement de statut"))
              }
            >
              {next.label}
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={() => printDelivery(d.id)}
          >
            <Printer className="h-4 w-4" /> Imprimer
          </Button>
          {d.status !== "draft" && canEditDelivery && (

              variant="outline"

              onClick={() => handleBackToDraft(d.reference)}
            >
              {backToDraft.isPending ? "Reprise…" : "Remettre au brouillon"}
            </Button>
          )}
          {d.status === "draft" && canDeleteDelivery && (

            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 p-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div>

          <StatusBadge status={d.status} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Date prévue</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">

          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Expédié</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">

      <Card className="overflow-hidden p-0">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">

              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Commandé</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Livré</th>
              <th className="px-4 py-3">Unité</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {d.lines?.map((l) => (
              <tr key={l.id} className="border-b border-gray-100">
                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">
                  {l.description ?? `Produit #${l.product_id}`}
                  {l.variant_name && (
                    <span className="ml-2 inline-block rounded border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 align-middle text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-700">
                      {l.variant_name}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{l.quantity_ordered}</td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">
                  {l.quantity_delivered}
                </td>
                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-600">{l.unit ?? "—"}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {(!d.lines || d.lines.length === 0) && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={4} className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                  Aucune ligne.
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Page Livraison — bons de livraison, planning, impression.
 */
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ExportButton } from "@/components/shared/export-button";
import {
  useDeliveryNotes,
  useCreateDeliveryFromOrder,
  useUpdateDeliveryStatus,
  useBackToDraftDelivery,
  useDeleteDelivery,
} from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { useOrders } from "@/hooks/useSales";
import { useClients } from "@/hooks/useCRM";
import { usePermission } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { useConfirm } from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import {
  confirmBackToDraftOptions,
  confirmDeleteOptions,
} from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import { printDelivery } from "@/lib/api/pdf";
import { formatDate, StatusBadge } from "@/lib/utils";

const NEXT_STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; value: string }> = {
  draft: { label: "Confirmer", value: "pending" },
  planned: { label: "Expédier", value: "shipped" },
  shipped: { label: "Livrer", value: "delivered" },
  pending: { label: "Livrer", value: "delivered" },
  in_progress: { label: "Livrer", value: "delivered" },
  delivered: { label: "Terminer", value: "completed" },
};

export default function DeliveryPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: deliveries = [], isLoading } = useDeliveryNotes();
  const { data: orders = [] } = useOrders();
  const { data: clients = [] } = useClients();
  const createDelivery = useCreateDeliveryFromOrder();
  const updateStatus = useUpdateDeliveryStatus();
  const backToDraft = useBackToDraftDelivery();
  const deleteDelivery = useDeleteDelivery();
  const can = usePermission();
  const canEditDelivery = can("delivery:edit");
  const canDeleteDelivery = can("delivery:delete");
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  const [orderId, setOrderId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleBackToDraft = async (reference: string, deliveryId: number) => {
    const { confirmed } = await confirm(
      confirmBackToDraftOptions(
        `${reference} — Seul un BL au brouillon peut être supprimé.`,
      ),
    );
    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await backToDraft.mutateAsync(deliveryId);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })
        ?.response?.data?.detail;
      alert(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la remise au brouillon");
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteDelivery = async (reference: string, deliveryId: number) => {
    const { confirmed } = await confirm(
      confirmDeleteOptions(
        `${reference} — Seuls les BL en brouillon et sans paiement restant peuvent être supprimés.`,
      ),
    );
    if (!confirmed) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await deleteDelivery.mutateAsync(deliveryId);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })
        ?.response?.data?.detail;
      alert(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la suppression");
    }
  };

  const clientName = (id: number) =>
    clients.find((c) => c.id === id)?.name ?? `#${id}`;

  // Commandes confirmées sans bon de livraison
  const deliverable = orders.filter(
    (o) =>
      o.status === "confirmed" &&
      o.fulfillment_mode !== "pos" &&
      !deliveries.some((d) => d.order_id === o.id),
  );

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!orderId) return setError("Choisissez une commande.");
    try {
      await createDelivery.mutateAsync({ order_id: orderId });
      setOrderId(null);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la création");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Livraison</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Bons de livraison</p>
        </div>
        <ExportButton
          endpoint="/delivery/notes/export"
          fallbackName="livraisons"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Créer depuis commande */}
      <Card className="space-y-3 p-4">
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">Préparer une livraison</h2>
        {error && <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</div>}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <select
            className="min-w-64 rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
            value={orderId ?? ""}
            onChange={(e) => setOrderId(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)}
          >
            <option value="">— Commande confirmée —</option>
            {deliverable.map((o) => (
              <option key={o.id} value={o.id}>
                {o.reference} — {clientName(o.partner_id)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <Button onClick={handleCreate} disabled={createDelivery.isPending}>
            {createDelivery.isPending ? "Création…" : "Créer le bon de livraison"}
          </Button>
          {deliverable.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Aucune commande en attente de livraison.</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* Liste */}
      <Card className="overflow-hidden p-0">
        {isLoading ? (
          <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>
        ) : deliveries.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
            Aucun bon de livraison.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Référence</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Client</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Statut</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Date prévue</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3"></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {deliveries.map((d) => {
                const next = NEXT_STATUS[d.status];
                return (
                  <tr
                    key={d.id}
                    onClick={() => router.push(`/dashboard/delivery/${d.id}`)}
                    className="cursor-pointer border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50"
                  >
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900 hover:text-primary hover:underline">
                      {d.reference}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">{clientName(d.partner_id)}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3"><StatusBadge status={d.status} /></td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-600">
                      {d.expected_date ? formatDate(d.expected_date) : "—"}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                        {next && canEditDelivery && (
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="outline"
                            disabled={updateStatus.isPending}
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              updateStatus
                                .mutateAsync({ deliveryId: d.id, status: next.value })
                                .catch(() => alert("Erreur changement de statut"));
                            }}
                          >
                            {next.label}
                          </Button>
                        )}
                        {d.status !== "draft" && canEditDelivery && (
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="outline"
                            className="text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-50"
                            disabled={backToDraft.isPending}
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleBackToDraft(d.reference, d.id);
                            }}
                          >
                            Brouillon
                          </Button>
                        )}
                        {d.status === "draft" && canDeleteDelivery && (
                          <button
                            title={`Supprimer ${d.reference}`}
                            aria-label={`Supprimer ${d.reference}`}
                            disabled={deleteDelivery.isPending}
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              handleDeleteDelivery(d.reference, d.id);
                            }}
                            className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 disabled:opacity-50"
                          >
                            🗑
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <button
                          title={`Imprimer le bon ${d.reference}`}
                          aria-label={`Imprimer le bon ${d.reference}`}
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            printDelivery(d.id).catch(() =>
                              alert("Impossible de générer le PDF.")
                            );
                          }}
                          className="inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100"
                        >
                          🖨
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Détail d'une dépense — lecture.
 */
"use client";

import { use } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { useExpenses, type Expense } from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from "@/lib/utils";

const CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  general: "Général",
  transport: "Transport",
  salaires: "Salaires",
  loyer: "Loyer",
  utilities: "Eau / Électricité",
  achats: "Achats",
};

const METHOD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  cash: "Espèces",
  mobile_money: "Mobile Money",
  bank: "Virement",
};

export default function ExpenseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
}) {
  const { id: idParam } = use(params);
  const id = Number(idParam) || 0;
  const { data: expenses = [], isLoading } = useExpenses();

  const expense: Expense | undefined = expenses.find((e) => e.id === id);
  if (isLoading)
    return <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>;
  if (!expense)
    return (
      <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">
        Dépense introuvable (ou accès refusé).
      </p>
    );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div>
        <Link href="/dashboard/expenses" className="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-primary">
          <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 inline h-4 w-4" /> Retour aux dépenses
        </Link>
        <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">
          {expense.reference} — {expense.label}
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
          {expense.expense_date ? formatDate(expense.expense_date) : "Date inconnue"}
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6 p-4 sm:grid-cols-4">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Catégorie</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
            {CATEGORY_LABELS[expense.category] ?? expense.category}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Mode de paiement</p>
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">
            {METHOD_LABELS[expense.payment_method] ?? expense.payment_method}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Montant</p>
          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-red-600">
            -{formatCurrency(expense.amount)}
          </p>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {expense.notes && (
        <Card className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Notes</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-700">{expense.notes}</p>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````
