````typescript
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Onglet : Besoins issus des ventes (commandes confirmées)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function NeedsTab() {
  const { data: orders = [], isLoading } = useOrders();
  const { data: products = [] } = useProducts();

  // Agrège les besoins d'achat de toutes les commandes confirmées
  const byProduct = new Map<
    number,
    { name: string; quantity: number; sellByLength: boolean }
  >();
  for (const o of orders) {
    if (o.status !== "confirmed") continue;
    for (const l of o.lines ?? []) {
      const toBuy = Number(l.quantity_to_purchase ?? 0);
      if (toBuy <= 0 || !l.product_id) continue;
      const existing = byProduct.get(l.product_id);
      const name =
        l.description ??
        products.find((p) => p.id === l.product_id)?.name ??
        `#${l.product_id}`;
      if (existing) {
        existing.quantity += toBuy;
      } else {
        byProduct.set(l.product_id, {
          name,
          quantity: toBuy,
          sellByLength: l.sell_by_length,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  const needs = [...byProduct.entries()].map(([productId, info]) => ({
    productId,
    ...info,
  }));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
        Besoins d&apos;achat issus des commandes confirmées (à acheter auprès
        des fournisseurs).
      </p>
      <Card className="overflow-hidden p-0">
        {isLoading ? (
          <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>
        ) : needs.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
            Aucun besoin d&apos;achat en cours.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">
                <th className="px-4 py-3">Produit</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Quantité à acheter</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {needs.map((n) => (
                <tr
                  key={n.productId}
                  className="border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-50"
                >
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">
                    {n.name}
                    {n.sellByLength && (
                      <span className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-blue-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-blue-700">
                        au m
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-orange-600">
                    {n.quantity}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Point de vente (vente comptoir).
 *
 * - Vue « nouvelle vente » : layout split type caisse tactile (fusion des
 *   maquettes) — rail caisse à gauche (client facultatif, panier, totaux
 *   géants, tuiles de paiement + pavé numérique + encaissement), grille
 *   produits tactile à droite (recherche, catégories, tuiles produits).
 *   Sidebar + header masqués pendant la vente (mode focus `setPosFocus`).
 * - Encaissement sans client obligatoire : sans sélection, la vente est
 *   rattachée au partenaire walk-in « Client de passage » (backend).
 * - Vue « historique » (défaut) : ventes comptoir paginées (15/page,
 *   récent → ancien), ligne cliquable = réimpression du reçu POS.
 */
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Archive,
  ArrowLeft,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Eye,
  Pause,
  Play,
  Plus,
  Printer,
  ShoppingCart,
  Trash2,
  UserRound,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ProductSearchAdd } from "@/components/sales/product-search-add";
import { PosCartTable } from "@/components/sales/pos/PosCartTable";
import { PosCategoryRail } from "@/components/sales/pos/PosCategoryRail";
import { PosTotalsBar, computePosTotals } from "@/components/sales/pos/PosTotalsBar";
import { PosProductGrid } from "@/components/sales/pos/PosProductGrid";
import { PosPaymentPanel } from "@/components/sales/pos/PosPaymentPanel";
import { PosPartnerDialog } from "@/components/sales/pos/PosPartnerDialog";
import { useCategoryTree, useProducts } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import { useClients } from "@/hooks/useCRM";
import {
  SALES_KEYS,
  useArchivePosSale,
  usePosSale,
  usePosSales,
} from "@/hooks/useSales";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { printPosTicket } from "@/lib/api/pdf";
import { attachHidScanner } from "@/lib/hid-scanner";
import { setPosFocus } from "@/lib/pos-focus";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";

interface PosLine {
  key: number;
  product_id: number;
  name: string;
  reference?: string | null;
  variant_name?: string | null;
  sell_by_length: boolean;
  quantity: number; // pièces ou mètres selon le produit
  unit_price: number;
  discount_percent: number; // remise par ligne (%)
  category_id?: number | null;
}

const METHOD_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  cash: "Espèces",
  mobile_money: "Mobile Money",
  bank: "Virement",
  check: "Chèque",
};

let lineKey = 1;

/** TVA POS : 0 = prix affichés TTC, aucun calcul supplémentaire. */
const POS_TAX_PERCENT = 0;

interface SuspendedSale {
  id: string;
  savedAt: string;
  partnerId: number | null;
  method: string;
  lines: PosLine[];
}

const SUSPENDED_KEY = "erp-pos-suspended";

function loadSuspended(): SuspendedSale[] {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(SUSPENDED_KEY);
    if (!raw) return [];
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export default function PosPage() {
  const { data: clients = [] } = useClients();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [view, setView] = useState<"history" | "new" | "detail">("history");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [detailId, setDetailId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [suspended, setSuspended] = useState<SuspendedSale[]>(() => loadSuspended());
  const archiveSale = useArchivePosSale();
  const [archivingId, setArchivingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [partnerId, setPartnerId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<PosLine[]>([]);
  const [method, setMethod] = useState("cash");
  const [amountStr, setAmountStr] = useState(""); // montant reçu (pavé numérique)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [reprinting, setReprinting] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [lastSale, setLastSale] = useState<{ orderId: number; ref: string } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selectedKey, setSelectedKey] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [partnerDialogOpen, setPartnerDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const { data: history, isLoading } = usePosSales(page, 15);
  const sales = history?.items ?? [];
  const { data: detail, isLoading: detailLoading } = usePosSale(detailId);
  const { data: categoryTree = [] } = useCategoryTree();
  const { data: products = [], isLoading: productsLoading } = useProducts(
    undefined,
    240,
    categoryFilter,
  );

  // Mode focus caisse : masque sidebar + header pendant la vente.
  useEffect(() => {
    setPosFocus(view === "new");
    return () => setPosFocus(false);
  }, [view]);

  const totals = useMemo(() => {
    const gross = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.quantity * l.unit_price, 0);
    const t = computePosTotals(lines, 0, POS_TAX_PERCENT);
    // Les remises ligne sont déjà déduites du sous-total (remise commande à 0) :
    // on affiche ici l'écart brut − net correspondant.
    return { ...t, discountAmount: gross - t.subtotal };
  }, [lines]);

  // Scan AIDC (douchette USB / terminal) : produit ajouté direct au panier.
  const [scanMsg, setScanMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    return attachHidScanner(async (code) => {
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(
          `/catalogue/products/lookup?code=${encodeURIComponent(code)}`,
        );
        if (res.data?.found && res.data.product) {
          const p = res.data.product;
          setView("new");
          setScanMsg(null);
          addProduct({
            id: p.id,
            name: p.name,
            reference: p.reference,
            category_id: p.category_id,
            sell_by_length: p.sell_by_length,
            price_per_meter: p.price_per_meter,
            selling_price: p.selling_price,
          });
        } else {
          setScanMsg(`Produit introuvable pour le code « ${code} ».`);
        }
      } catch {
        setScanMsg("Erreur lors de la recherche du code scanné.");
      }
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);


  const addProduct = (p: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
    reference?: string | null;
    category_id?: number | null;
    sell_by_length?: boolean;
    price_per_meter?: number | null;
    selling_price?: number | null;
  }) => {
    const existing = lines.find((l) => l.product_id === p.id);
    if (existing && !p.sell_by_length) {
      setLines((ls) =>
        ls.map((l) => (l.product_id === p.id ? { ...l, quantity: l.quantity + 1 } : l)),
      );
      setSelectedKey(existing.key);
      return;
    }
    const key = lineKey++;
    setLines((ls) => [
      ...ls,
      {
        key,
        product_id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        reference: p.reference ?? null,
        category_id: p.category_id ?? null,
        sell_by_length: !!p.sell_by_length,
        quantity: 1,
        unit_price: p.sell_by_length ? (p.price_per_meter ?? 0) : (p.selling_price ?? 0),
        discount_percent: 0,
      },
    ]);
    setSelectedKey(key);
  };

  const updateLine = (key: number, patch: Partial<PosLine>) =>
    setLines((ls) => ls.map((l) => (l.key === key ? { ...l, ...patch } : l)));

  const removeLine = (key: number) => {
    setLines((ls) => ls.filter((l) => l.key !== key));
    setSelectedKey((k) => (k === key ? null : k));
  };

  const formatDate = (iso: string) =>
    new Date(iso).toLocaleString("fr-FR", { dateStyle: "short", timeStyle: "short" });

  const reprint = async (orderId: number) => {
    setReprinting(orderId);
    try {
      await printPosTicket(orderId);
    } catch {
      alert("Impression bloquée — autorisez les pop-ups pour ce site.");
    } finally {
      setReprinting(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (lines.length === 0) return setError("Ajoutez au moins un produit.");
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const received = Number(amountStr || 0);
      // Aucun sous-paiement en caisse : le reçu doit couvrir le total.
      if (received > 0 && received + 1e-6 < totals.total) {
        return setError(
          `Montant reçu insuffisant — reste à encaisser ${formatCurrency(totals.total - received)}.`,
        );
      }
      const payload = {
        // Client facultatif : absent → partenaire walk-in côté backend.
        ...(partnerId ? { partner_id: partnerId } : {}),
        method,
        amount: received > 0 ? received : totals.total,
        lines: lines.map((l) => ({
          product_id: l.product_id,
          description: l.name,
          quantity_ordered: l.quantity,
          unit: l.sell_by_length ? "ml" : "p",
          sell_by_length: l.sell_by_length,
          unit_price: l.unit_price,
          discount_percent: l.discount_percent || 0,
          ...(l.sell_by_length ? { cuts: [{ quantity: 1, length: l.quantity }] } : {}),
        })),
      };
      const res = await apiClient.post("/sales/pos/sales", payload);
      const order = res.data as {
        order?: { id?: number; reference?: string };
        id?: number;
        order_id?: number;
        order_reference?: string;
      };
      const orderId = order?.order?.id ?? order?.order_id ?? order?.id;
      if (orderId) {
        try {
          await printPosTicket(orderId);
        } catch {
          /* le reçu pourra être réimprimé depuis l'historique */
        }
        setLastSale({
          orderId,
          ref: order?.order_reference ?? order?.order?.reference ?? "",
        });
      }
      setLines([]);
      setSelectedKey(null);
      setCategoryFilter(null);
      setAmountStr("");
      setPartnerId(null);
      setPage(1);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [SALES_KEYS.posSales] });
      setView("history");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la vente");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };


  // Vue 1 : historique des ventes (défaut)
  const openDetail = (id: number) => {
    setDetailId(id);
    setView("detail");
  };

  const persistSuspended = (next: SuspendedSale[]) => {
    setSuspended(next);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(SUSPENDED_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch {
      /* stockage indisponible : la liste mémoire reste utilisable */
    }
  };

  /** Met la vente en cours en pause : historique accessible, reprise possible. */
  const handleSuspend = () => {
    if (lines.length === 0) return;
    const entry: SuspendedSale = {
      id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6)}`,
      savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      partnerId,
      method,
      lines,
    };
    persistSuspended([entry, ...suspended]);
    setLines([]);
    setPartnerId(null);
    setAmountStr("");
    setSelectedKey(null);
    setError(null);
    setView("history");
  };

  /** Reprend une vente suspendue dans l'écran de caisse. */
  const handleResume = (id: string) => {
    const found = suspended.find((s) => s.id === id);
    if (!found) return;
    setLines(found.lines);
    setPartnerId(found.partnerId);
    setMethod(found.method);
    setAmountStr("");
    setSelectedKey(null);
    setError(null);
    setLastSale(null);
    persistSuspended(suspended.filter((s) => s.id !== id));
    setView("new");
  };

  const handleDeleteSuspended = (id: string) => {
    persistSuspended(suspended.filter((s) => s.id !== id));
  };

  /** Archive une vente clôturée : masquage d'historique, comptabilité conservée. */
  const handleArchive = async (id: number) => {
    if (!window.confirm("Archiver cette vente ? Elle restera consultable via la facturation.")) return;
    setArchivingId(id);
    try {
      await archiveSale.mutateAsync(id);
      if (detailId === id) {
        setDetailId(null);
        setView("history");
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail ?? "Archivage impossible.");
    } finally {
      setArchivingId(null);
    }
  };

  // Vue détail : lecture seule d'une vente comptoir (lignes, facture, paiement)
  if (view === "detail") {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => {
                setDetailId(null);
                setView("history");
              }}
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" /> Historique
            </Button>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">
              Vente {detail?.reference ?? ""}
            </h1>
            {detail?.archived && (
              <span className="rounded bg-gray-200 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
                Archivée
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {detailId != null && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() =>

                    alert("Impression bloquée — autorisez les pop-ups."),

                }
                disabled={detailLoading}
              >
                <Printer className="h-4 w-4" /> Imprimer
              </Button>
            )}
            {detailId != null && !detail?.archived && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => handleArchive(detailId)}
                disabled={archivingId === detailId}
              >
                <Archive className="h-4 w-4" /> Archiver
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-700">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <Card className="p-4">
          {detailLoading ? (
            <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
              Chargement…
            </p>
          ) : !detail ? (
            <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">

            </p>
          ) : (

                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">Client</p>
                  <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                    {detail.partner?.name ?? "Client de passage"}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">Statut</p>
                  <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">{detail.status}</p>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">Facture</p>
                  <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">
                    {detail.invoice
                      ? `${detail.invoice.reference} (${detail.invoice.status})`
                      : "—"}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
````

````typescript
/**
 * Éditeurs de ligne de devis — coupes BAC multi-longueurs et pièce standard.
 */
"use client";

import { Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/types";

export interface CutState {
  key: number;
  quantity: number;
  length: number;
}

export interface LineState {
  key: number;
  product_id: number | null;
  /** Variante du produit (aucune = produit de base). */
  variant_id: number | null;
  /** Libellé de variante (instantané) — affichage en édition. */
  variant_name: string | null;
  description: string;
  sell_by_length: boolean;
  standard_piece: boolean;
  quantity: number;
  unit_price: number;
  discount_percent: number;
  cuts: CutState[];
}

interface CutsEditorProps {
  line: LineState;
  onLineChange: (patch: Partial<LineState>) => void;
}

/** Éditeur des sous-lignes « quantité de pièces × longueur » (tôles BAC / au ml). */
export function CutsEditor({ line, onLineChange }: CutsEditorProps) {
  const price = Number(line.unit_price) || 0;

  const updateCut = (cutKey: number, patch: Partial<CutState>) =>
    onLineChange({
      cuts: line.cuts.map((c) => (c.key === cutKey ? { ...c, ...patch } : c)),
    });

  const removeCut = (cutKey: number) =>
    onLineChange({ cuts: line.cuts.filter((c) => c.key !== cutKey) });

  const addCut = () =>
    onLineChange({ cuts: [...line.cuts, { key: Date.now(), quantity: 1, length: 0 }] });

  return (
    <div>
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">
            <th className="pb-1">Qté pièces</th>
            <th className="pb-1">Longueur (m)</th>
            <th className="pb-1 text-right">Total partiel</th>
            <th className="pb-1"></th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {line.cuts.map((cut) => (
            <tr key={cut.key}>
              <td className="py-1 pr-2">
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  className="h-8 w-24"
                  value={cut.quantity}
                  onChange={(e) => updateCut(cut.key, { quantity: Number(e.target.value) })}
                />
              </td>
              <td className="py-1 pr-2">
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  step="0.01"
                  className="h-8 w-28"
                  value={cut.length}
                  onChange={(e) => updateCut(cut.key, { length: Number(e.target.value) })}
                />
              </td>
              <td className="py-1 text-right text-gray-700">
                {formatCurrency(
                  (Number(cut.quantity) || 0) * (Number(cut.length) || 0) * price,
                )}
              </td>
              <td className="py-1 text-right">
                <button
                  onClick={() => removeCut(cut.key)}
                  className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </button>
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      <Button
        size="sm"
        variant="outline"
        className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1"
        onClick={addCut}
      >
        <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        Ajouter une longueur
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

interface StandardPieceEditorProps {
  line: LineState;
  product: Product | null;
  totalLength: number;
  subtotal: number;
  onLineChange: (patch: Partial<LineState>) => void;
}

/** Vente à la pièce standard (mode dual) — facturée au prorata du ml. */
export function StandardPieceEditor({
  line,
  product,
  totalLength,
  subtotal,
  onLineChange,
}: StandardPieceEditorProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
      <div className="w-40">
        <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
          Nombre de pièces
        </label>
        <Input
          type="number"
          min={1}
          value={line.quantity}
          onChange={(e) => onLineChange({ quantity: Number(e.target.value) })}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="pb-2.5 text-xs text-gray-500">
        {formatNumber(line.quantity)} × {formatNumber(product?.unit_length ?? 0, 2)} m ={" "}
        <strong>{formatNumber(totalLength, 2)} m</strong> → {formatCurrency(subtotal)}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Devis / Commande — formulaire plein écran façon Odoo.
 *
 * - Barre d'actions contextuelle + barre de statut en chevrons
 * - Champs en 2 colonnes (client/adresses | dates/conditions)
 * - Onglets : Lignes · Autres informations · Notes
 * - Tableau de lignes dense avec coupes BAC en sous-lignes dépliables
 * - Remise par ligne, remise globale et TVA — totaux HT / TVA / Total
 */
"use client";

import { Suspense, Fragment, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import {
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  Scissors,
  ArrowLeft,
  Printer,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  ReceiptText,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { useProducts } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import {
  usePartners,
  useSites,
} from "@/hooks/useCRM";
import {
  useCreateQuote,
  useConfirmQuote,
  useOrder,
  useOrders,
  useQuote,
  useUpdateOrder,
  useUpdateQuote,
} from "@/hooks/useSales";
import {
  useCreateInvoiceFromQuote,
  useInvoices,
} from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { useSalespersons } from "@/hooks/useUsers";
import { ClientAutocomplete } from "@/components/crm/client-autocomplete";
import { ProductPicker } from "@/components/sales/product-picker";
import { VariantPicker } from "@/components/sales/variant-picker";
import { printOrder, printQuote } from "@/lib/api/pdf";
import { handleApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { Partner, Product, ProductVariant } from "@/lib/types";
import {
  CutsEditor,
  type LineState,
} from "./line-editors";

let lineKey = 1;

function emptyLine(): LineState {
  return {
    key: lineKey++,
    product_id: null,
    variant_id: null,
    variant_name: null,
    description: "",
    sell_by_length: false,
    standard_piece: false,
    quantity: 1,
    unit_price: 0,
    discount_percent: 0,
    cuts: [{ key: Date.now(), quantity: 1, length: 0 }],
  };
}

/** Totaux d'une ligne selon son mode de vente. */
function lineTotals(line: LineState, product: Product | null) {
  // Une ligne sans produit n'est pas facturable : ni quantité, ni montant.
  if (line.product_id == null) return { totalLength: 0, subtotal: 0 };
  const price = Number(line.unit_price) || 0;
  const disc = (Number(line.discount_percent) || 0) / 100;
  if (line.sell_by_length) {
    const totalLength = line.cuts.reduce(
      (s, c) => s + (Number(c.quantity) || 0) * (Number(c.length) || 0),
      0
    );
    const raw = line.cuts.reduce(
      (s, c) => s + (Number(c.quantity) || 0) * (Number(c.length) || 0) * price,
      0
    );
    return { totalLength, subtotal: raw * (1 - disc) };
  }
  if (line.standard_piece) {
    const ul = Number(product?.unit_length) || 0;
    const totalLength = (Number(line.quantity) || 0) * ul;
    return { totalLength, subtotal: totalLength * price * (1 - disc) };
  }
  const totalLength = Number(line.quantity) || 0;
  return { totalLength, subtotal: totalLength * price * (1 - disc) };
}

/**
 * Message d'erreur lisible pour l'utilisateur : le `detail` FastAPI quand il
 * existe, sinon un texte exploitable. Sans cela, un 500 — dont le corps est du
 * texte brut « Internal Server Error », sans champ `detail` — n'affichait que
 * « Request failed with status code 500 », sans aucun indice sur la cause.
 */
function describeError(err: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  const { message, status } = handleApiError(err);
  if (!message) return fallback;
  if (status && status >= 500) {
    return `${message} — erreur serveur (HTTP ${status}). ${fallback}`;
  }
  return message;
}

const PAYMENT_TERMS = [
  "Immédiat",
  "À la commande",
  "7 jours",
  "15 jours",
  "30 jours",
  "45 jours",
  "60 jours",
];

/** Date ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) + 1 mois — jour clampé (31/01 → 28/02). */
function addOneMonthISO(iso: string): string {
  const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number);
  if (!y || !m || !d) return "";
  const nextY = m === 12 ? y + 1 : y;
  const nextM = m === 12 ? 1 : m + 1;
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(nextY, nextM, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return `${nextY}-${String(nextM).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(
    Math.min(d, lastDay)
  ).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

export default function NewQuotePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={null}>
      <NewQuotePageInner />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

function NewQuotePageInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const editId = Number(searchParams.get("id")) || null; // devis
  const editOrderId = Number(searchParams.get("orderId")) || null; // commande
  const editingOrder = !!editOrderId;

  const { data: partners = [] } = usePartners();
  const { data: sites = [] } = useSites();
  const { data: products = [] } = useProducts();
  const createQuote = useCreateQuote();
  const updateQuote = useUpdateQuote();
  const updateOrder = useUpdateOrder();
  const confirmQuote = useConfirmQuote();
  const { data: existingQuote } = useQuote(editId ?? 0);
  const { data: existingOrder } = useOrder(editOrderId ?? 0);
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: salespersons = [] } = useSalespersons();
  const { data: orders = [] } = useOrders();
  const { data: invoices = [] } = useInvoices();
  const createInvoice = useCreateInvoiceFromQuote();

  const entity = existingQuote ?? existingOrder;
  const locked = entity?.status === "confirmed";

  // --- Parcours de vente : facture liée au devis / à la commande (étape 2) ---
  const activeInvoices = useMemo(
    () => invoices.filter((i) => !["cancelled", "credit"].includes(i.status)),
    [invoices]
  );
  const linkedOrder = useMemo(
    () => (editId ? orders.find((o) => o.quote_id === editId) ?? null : null),
    [orders, editId]
  );
  const quoteInvoice = useMemo(
    () =>
      linkedOrder
        ? activeInvoices.find((i) => i.order_id === linkedOrder.id) ?? null
        : null,
    [activeInvoices, linkedOrder]
  );
  const linkedInvoice = useMemo(
    () =>
      editOrderId
        ? activeInvoices.find((i) => i.order_id === editOrderId) ?? quoteInvoice
        : quoteInvoice,
    [activeInvoices, editOrderId, quoteInvoice]
  );

  // --- État du formulaire ---
  const [partnerId, setPartnerId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [siteId, setSiteId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [salespersonId, setSalespersonId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [quoteDate, setQuoteDate] = useState(
    new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  );
  // Validité par défaut : 1 mois après la date d'émission.
  const [validUntil, setValidUntil] = useState(() =>
    addOneMonthISO(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10))
  );
  const validTouchedRef = useRef(false);
  const [paymentTerm, setPaymentTerm] = useState("Immédiat");
  const [customerReference, setCustomerReference] = useState("");
  const [deliveryDate, setDeliveryDate] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [terms, setTerms] = useState("");
  const [taxPercent, setTaxPercent] = useState(0);
  const [globalDiscount, setGlobalDiscount] = useState(0);
  const [lines, setLines] = useState<LineState[]>([emptyLine()]);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"lines" | "info" | "notes">("lines");
  const [expandedKey, setExpandedKey] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [justSaved, setJustSaved] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const loadedForRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const partner: Partner | null =
    partners.find((p) => p.id === partnerId) ?? null;
  const productOf = (line: LineState): Product | null =>
    products.find((p) => p.id === line.product_id) ?? null;
  const partnerSites = sites.filter((s) => s.partner_id === partnerId);

  // --- Contact commercial ---
  // Choix du commercial : admin/manager uniquement (miroir des règles
  // backend `_is_privileged_seller_chooser`). Un compte commercial voit
  // le champ grisé avec le nom concerné.
  const roleCodes = new Set(
    (currentUser?.roles ?? []).map((r) => (r.code ?? "").trim().toLowerCase())
  );
  const isChooser =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true ||
    ["admin", "manager", "administrateur"].some((c) => roleCodes.has(c));
  const salespersonLabel = (() => {
    const found = salespersons.find((sp) => sp.id === salespersonId);
    if (found) return `${found.first_name} ${found.last_name}`;
    if (salespersonId != null) return `Utilisateur #${salespersonId}`;
    // Nouveau devis : le commercial sera le créateur.
    return currentUser
      ? `${currentUser.first_name} ${currentUser.last_name}`
      : "—";
  })();

  // --- Pré-remplissage en mode édition (une seule fois par entité) ---
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      !entity ||
      loadedForRef.current === `${entity.id}-${editingOrder ? "o" : "q"}`
    )
      return;
    loadedForRef.current = `${entity.id}-${editingOrder ? "o" : "q"}`;
    setPartnerId(entity.partner_id);
    setSiteId(entity.site_id ?? null);
    setNotes(entity.notes ?? "");
    setLines(
      entity.lines.map((l) => {
        const product = products.find((p) => p.id === l.product_id) ?? null;
        const cuts = (l.cuts ?? []).map((c, i) => ({
          key: Date.now() + i,
          quantity: Number(c.quantity),
          length: Number(c.length),
        }));
        const isStandardPiece =
          product?.sale_mode === "dual" &&
          cuts.length === 1 &&
          product.unit_length != null &&
          Math.abs(cuts[0].length - Number(product.unit_length)) < 0.001;
        return {
          key: lineKey++,
          product_id: l.product_id,
          variant_id: l.variant_id ?? null,
          variant_name: l.variant_name ?? null,
          description: l.description ?? "",
          sell_by_length: l.sell_by_length && !isStandardPiece,
          standard_piece: isStandardPiece,
          quantity: isStandardPiece
            ? Number(cuts[0].quantity)
            : Number(
                (l as { quantity?: number }).quantity ??
                  (l as { quantity_ordered?: number }).quantity_ordered ??
                  1
              ),
          unit_price: Number(l.unit_price),
          discount_percent: Number(
            (l as { discount_percent?: number }).discount_percent ?? 0
          ),
          cuts:
            cuts.length > 0
              ? cuts
              : [{ key: Date.now(), quantity: 1, length: 0 }],
        };
      })
    );
    if (!editingOrder && "quote_date" in entity) {
      const q = entity as typeof existingQuote & { quote_date: string };
      setQuoteDate(q.quote_date?.slice(0, 10) ?? "");
      setSalespersonId(q.salesperson_id ?? null);
      setValidUntil(q.valid_until?.slice(0, 10) ?? "");
      validTouchedRef.current = true; // ne pas recalculer en mode édition
      setTerms(q.terms ?? "");
      setTaxPercent(Number(q.metadata_json?.tax_percent ?? 0));
      setGlobalDiscount(Number(q.discount_amount ?? 0));
      setPaymentTerm(q.metadata_json?.payment_term ?? "Immédiat");
      setCustomerReference(q.metadata_json?.customer_reference ?? "");
    }
  }, [entity, editingOrder, products]);

  // --- Mutations des lignes ---
  const updateLine = (key: number, patch: Partial<LineState>) =>
    setLines((ls) => ls.map((l) => (l.key === key ? { ...l, ...patch } : l)));

  // Une ligne sans produit produirait une ligne de devis vide (« null » côté
  // API) : on refuse d'en ajouter une nouvelle tant que la précédente n'est
  // pas renseignée, plutôt que de laisser une erreur 422 à l'enregistrement.
  const productlessLineIndex = lines.findIndex((l) => l.product_id == null);
  const hasProductlessLine = productlessLineIndex >= 0;
  const addLineDisabledReason = hasProductlessLine
    ? `Sélectionnez un produit sur la ligne ${productlessLineIndex + 1} avant d'ajouter une nouvelle ligne.`
    : undefined;

  const addLine = () => {
    if (hasProductlessLine) {
      setError(addLineDisabledReason ?? null);
      return;
    }
    setLines((ls) => [...ls, emptyLine()]);
  };

  const removeLine = (key: number) =>
    setLines((ls) => (ls.length > 1 ? ls.filter((l) => l.key !== key) : ls));

  const handleProductChange = (
    key: number,
    productId: number | null,
    provided?: Product | null
  ) => {
    const product =
      provided ?? products.find((p) => p.id === productId) ?? null;
    const patch: Partial<LineState> = {
      product_id: productId,
      // Changer de produit invalide la variante précédente.
      variant_id: null,
      variant_name: null,
      standard_piece: false,
      sell_by_length: false,
    };
    if (product) {
      if (product.sale_mode === "length") {
        patch.sell_by_length = true;
        patch.unit_price = Number(product.price_per_meter) || 0;
      } else if (product.sale_mode === "dual") {
        patch.unit_price = Number(product.price_per_meter) || 0;
      } else {
        patch.unit_price = Number(product.selling_price) || 0;
      }
    }
    updateLine(key, patch);
  };

  /**
   * Sélection d'une variante : mémorise le couple (id, libellé) et applique
   * le prix de la variante s'il en définit un (miroir de la règle backend).
   */
  const handleVariantChange = (
    key: number,
    variantId: number | null,
    variant: ProductVariant | null
  ) => {
    const line = lines.find((l) => l.key === key);
    const product = line ? productOf(line) : null;
    const patch: Partial<LineState> = {
      variant_id: variantId,
      variant_name: variant?.name_suffix ?? null,
    };
    if (variant) {
      const byMeter = Number(variant.price_per_meter) || 0;
      const byPiece = Number(variant.selling_price) || 0;
      const useMeter =
        product != null &&
        (product.sale_mode === "length" || product.sale_mode === "dual");
      const price = useMeter ? byMeter || byPiece : byPiece || byMeter;
      if (price > 0) patch.unit_price = price;
    }
    updateLine(key, patch);
  };

  // --- Totaux globaux ---
  // `lineTotals` ignore déjà les lignes sans produit (comme `buildPayloadLines`).
  const subTotal = useMemo(
    () => lines.reduce((s, l) => s + lineTotals(l, productOf(l)).subtotal, 0),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [lines, products]
  );
  const base = Math.max(subTotal - (Number(globalDiscount) || 0), 0);
  const taxAmount = base * ((Number(taxPercent) || 0) / 100);
  const grandTotal = base + taxAmount;

  // --- Enregistrement ---
  const buildPayloadLines = () =>
    lines
      .filter(
        (l): l is LineState & { product_id: number } => l.product_id != null
      )
      .map((l) => {
        const product = productOf(l);
        const isBac =
          !!product &&
          (product.sale_mode === "length" ||
            (l.sell_by_length && !l.standard_piece));
        if (isBac) {
          return {
            product_id: l.product_id,
            variant_id: l.variant_id,
            quantity: 1,
            unit: "ml",
            sell_by_length: true,
            unit_price: l.unit_price,
            discount_percent: l.discount_percent,
            cuts: l.cuts
              .filter((c) => Number(c.length) > 0 && Number(c.quantity) > 0)
              .map((c) => ({ quantity: c.quantity, length: c.length })),
          };
        }
        const totalLen = lineTotals(l, product).totalLength;
        return {
          product_id: l.product_id,
          variant_id: l.variant_id,
          ...(editingOrder
            ? { quantity_ordered: totalLen }
            : { quantity: l.quantity }),
          unit: l.standard_piece ? "pièce" : (product as unknown as { unit?: string } | null)?.unit ?? "u",
          sell_by_length: false,
          unit_price: l.unit_price,
          discount_percent: l.discount_percent,
        };
      });

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setError(null);
    setJustSaved(null);
    if (!partnerId) {
      setError("Veuillez sélectionner ou créer un client.");
      return;
    }
    if (!lines.some((l) => l.product_id != null)) {
      setError("Ajoutez au moins une ligne avec un produit.");
      return;
    }
    const payloadLines = buildPayloadLines();
    try {
      if (editId) {
        await updateQuote.mutateAsync({
          id: editId,
          data: {
            partner_id: partnerId,
            site_id: siteId,
            quote_date: quoteDate || undefined,
            valid_until: validUntil || null,
            notes: notes || null,
            terms: terms || null,
            discount_amount: Number(globalDiscount) || 0,
            tax_percent: Number(taxPercent) || 0,
            payment_term: paymentTerm,
            customer_reference: customerReference || null,
            lines: payloadLines,
            // Le backend ignore la valeur pour un compte non-admin.
            ...(isChooser ? { salesperson_id: salespersonId } : {}),
          },
        });
        setJustSaved("Devis enregistré");
      } else if (editOrderId) {
        await updateOrder.mutateAsync({
          id: editOrderId,
          data: {
            partner_id: partnerId,
            site_id: siteId,
            delivery_date_planned: deliveryDate || null,
            notes: notes || null,
            lines: payloadLines,
          },
        });
        setJustSaved("Commande enregistrée");
      } else {
        const created = await createQuote.mutateAsync({
          partner_id: partnerId,
          site_id: siteId,
          quote_date: quoteDate || undefined,
          valid_until: validUntil || null,
          notes: notes || null,
          terms: terms || null,
          discount_amount: Number(globalDiscount) || 0,
          tax_percent: Number(taxPercent) || 0,
          payment_term: paymentTerm,
          customer_reference: customerReference || null,
          lines: payloadLines,
          ...(isChooser ? { salesperson_id: salespersonId } : {}),
        });
        // Reste sur le document (façon Odoo) — l'URL porte désormais l'id
        router.replace(`/dashboard/sales/quotes/new?id=${created.id}`);
        setJustSaved(`Devis ${created.reference} créé`);
        printQuote(created.id).catch(() => undefined);
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(
        describeError(err, "Erreur lors de l'enregistrement du devis.")
      );
    }
  };

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    if (!editId) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      const order = await confirmQuote.mutateAsync(editId);
      setJustSaved(`Devis confirmé — commande ${order.reference} créée`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(
        describeError(err, "Erreur lors de la confirmation du devis.")
      );
    }
  };

  const handleInvoice = async () => {
    if (!editId) return;
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await createInvoice.mutateAsync({ quoteId: editId });
      router.push(`/dashboard/invoicing/${res.invoice_id}`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(
        describeError(err, "Erreur lors de la création de la facture.")
      );
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    if (editId)
      printQuote(editId).catch(() =>
        alert("Impossible de générer le PDF du devis.")
      );
    else if (editOrderId)
      printOrder(editOrderId).catch(() => alert("Impossible de générer le PDF."));
  };

  const busy =
    createQuote.isPending || updateQuote.isPending || updateOrder.isPending;

  // Titre + étape du workflow
  const title = editingOrder
    ? entity?.reference ?? "Nouvelle commande"
    : entity?.reference ?? "Nouveau devis";
  const timelineSteps = editingOrder
    ? ["Brouillon", "Confirmée", "Facturée"]
    : ["Brouillon", "Confirmé", "Facturé"];
  const currentStep = linkedInvoice ? timelineSteps.length : locked ? 2 : 1;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-5 pb-24">
      {/* Barre d'actions (façon Odoo) */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          className="flex items-center gap-1"
          onClick={() => router.push("/dashboard/sales")}
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          Retour
        </Button>
        <div className="mx-1 h-6 w-px bg-gray-200" />
        {!locked && (
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Enregistrement…" : "Enregistrer"}
          </Button>
        )}
        {!editingOrder && editId && !locked && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={handleConfirm}
            disabled={confirmQuote.isPending}
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />
            Confirmer
          </Button>
        )}
        {!editingOrder && editId && locked && !quoteInvoice && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={handleInvoice}
            disabled={createInvoice.isPending}
          >
            <ReceiptText className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
            {createInvoice.isPending ? "Facturation…" : "Créer facture"}
          </Button>
        )}
        {linkedInvoice && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={() =>
              router.push(`/dashboard/invoicing/${linkedInvoice.id}`)
            }
          >
            <ReceiptText className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
            Voir la facture
          </Button>
        )}
        {entity && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={handlePrint}
          >
            <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
            Imprimer
          </Button>
        )}

        {/* Barre de statut — chevrons du workflow */}
        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-gray-200">
          {timelineSteps.map((step, i) => {
            const stepNo = i + 1;
            const isCurrent = stepNo === currentStep;
            const isDone = stepNo < currentStep;
            return (
              <div
                key={step}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium ${
                  isCurrent
                    ? "bg-green-50 text-green-700"
                    : isDone
                      ? "text-green-600"
                      : "text-gray-400"
                }`}
              >
                {step}
                {i < timelineSteps.length - 1 && (
                  <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-gray-300" />
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Titre du document */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">{title}</h1>
        {entity && (
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-gray-500">
            {editingOrder ? "Commande client" : "Devis client"} · créé le{" "}
            {new Date(entity.created_at).toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
      {justSaved && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-green-200 bg-green-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-green-700">
          {justSaved}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Formulaire verrouillé si confirmé */}
      <fieldset disabled={locked} className="space-y-5">
        {/* Champs en 2 colonnes */}
        <Card className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 p-5 md:grid-cols-2">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                Client *
              </label>
              <ClientAutocomplete
                value={partnerId}
                onChange={(v) => {
                  setPartnerId(v);
                  setSiteId(null);
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                Adresse de facturation
              </label>
              <p className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                {partner
                  ? (() => {
                      const addr = partner.addresses?.[0];
                      const txt = [addr?.line_1, addr?.city]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(", ");
                      return txt || partner.phone || "—";
                    })()
                  : "Sélectionnez un client"}
              </p>
            </div>
            {!editingOrder && (
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                  Contact commercial
                </label>
                {isChooser ? (
                  <select
                    value={salespersonId ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setSalespersonId(
                        e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null
                      )
                    }
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="">— Par défaut (moi-même) —</option>
                    {salespersons.map((sp) => (
                      <option key={sp.id} value={sp.id}>
                        {`${sp.first_name} ${sp.last_name}`}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                ) : (
                  <p className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                    {salespersonLabel}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                  {editingOrder ? "Date de commande" : "Date du devis"}
                </label>
                {editingOrder ? (
                  <p className="min-h-9 rounded-md border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
                    {entity && "order_date" in entity
                      ? String(entity.order_date)
                      : quoteDate}
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <Input
                    type="date"
                    value={quoteDate}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setQuoteDate(e.target.value);
                      // Validité recalculée tant que l'utilisateur n'y est pas touché.
                      if (!validTouchedRef.current && e.target.value) {
                        setValidUntil(addOneMonthISO(e.target.value));
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                  {editingOrder ? "Livraison prévue" : "Validité (expiration)"}
                </label>
                <Input
                  type="date"
                  value={editingOrder ? deliveryDate : validUntil}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    if (editingOrder) {
                      setDeliveryDate(e.target.value);
                    } else {
                      validTouchedRef.current = true;
                      setValidUntil(e.target.value);
                    }
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {!editingOrder && (
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">
                  Conditions de paiement
                </label>
                <select
                  value={paymentTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setPaymentTerm(e.target.value)}
                  className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 text-sm focus:border-primary focus:outline-none"
                >
                  {PAYMENT_TERMS.map((t) => (
                    <option key={t} value={t}>
                      {t}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* Onglets */}
        <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-gray-200">
          {(
            [
              ["lines", "Lignes de commande"],
              ["info", "Autres informations"],
              ["notes", "Notes"],
            ] as const
          ).map(([key, label]) => (
            <button
              key={key}
              onClick={() => setActiveTab(key)}
              className={`-mb-px border-b-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
                activeTab === key
                  ? "border-primary text-primary"
                  : "border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700"
              }`}
            >

                {formatCurrency(grandTotal)}
              </p>
            </div>
            {!locked && (
              <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={busy} size="lg">
                {busy ? "Enregistrement…" : "Enregistrer"}
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Page Ventes — liste des devis et commandes client.
 */
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

import {
  Plus,
  FileText,
  ShoppingCart,
  CheckCircle2,
  Printer,
  Pencil,
  ReceiptText,
  Trash2,
  Eye,
  Undo2,
  Search,
  X,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  Upload,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ImportDialog } from "@/components/shared/import-dialog";
import { ExportButton } from "@/components/shared/export-button";
import {
  useConfirm,
  confirmBackToDraftOptions,
  confirmCloseOptions,
  confirmDeleteOptions,
  confirmPostOptions,
} from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import {
  useQuotes,
  useOrders,
  useConfirmQuote,
  useDeleteQuote,
  useDeleteOrder,
  useOrderBackToDraft,
  useQuoteBackToDraft,
  SALES_KEYS,
} from "@/hooks/useSales";
import { usePartners } from "@/hooks/useCRM";
import {
  useInvoices,
  useCreateInvoiceFromOrder,
  useCreateInvoiceFromQuote,
  type Invoice,
} from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import type { Partner, Quote, SalesOrder } from "@/lib/types";
import { formatCurrency, formatDate, StatusBadge } from "@/lib/utils";
import { printQuote, printOrder } from "@/lib/api/pdf";

/** Nombre de lignes par page (pagination façon Odoo). */
const PAGE_SIZE = 25;

interface ListDoc {
  id: number;
  reference: string;
  partner_id: number;
  status: string;
}

/** Filtre + tri (plus récents d'abord) d'une liste de documents. */
function filterDocs<T extends ListDoc>(
  list: T[],
  search: string,
  statusFilter: "all" | "draft" | "confirmed",
  partnerMap: Map<number, Partner>,
): T[] {
  let out = list;
  if (statusFilter !== "all") out = out.filter((d) => d.status === statusFilter);
  const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (q) {
    out = out.filter((d) => {
      const p = partnerMap.get(d.partner_id);
      return (
        d.reference.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p?.name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (p?.phone ?? "").includes(q)
      );
    });
  }
  return [...out].sort((a, b) => b.id - a.id);
}

export default function SalesPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"quotes" | "orders">("quotes");
  const [importOpen, setImportOpen] = useState(false);
  const { data: quotes = [], isLoading: loadingQuotes } = useQuotes();
  const { data: orders = [], isLoading: loadingOrders } = useOrders();
  const { data: invoices = [] } = useInvoices();
  const { data: partners = [] } = usePartners();
  const confirmQuote = useConfirmQuote();
  const deleteQuote = useDeleteQuote();
  const quoteBackToDraft = useQuoteBackToDraft();
  const deleteOrder = useDeleteOrder();
  const orderBackToDraft = useOrderBackToDraft();
  const createInvoice = useCreateInvoiceFromOrder();
  const createInvoiceFromQuote = useCreateInvoiceFromQuote();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  // --- Facturation : reste à facturer par commande ---
  const [invoiceFor, setInvoiceFor] = useState<SalesOrder | null>(null);
  const invoicedByOrder = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<number, number>();
    invoices.forEach((i) => {
      if (i.order_id && !["cancelled", "credit"].includes(i.status)) {
        m.set(i.order_id, (m.get(i.order_id) ?? 0) + i.amount_total);
      }
    });
    return m;
  }, [invoices]);
  const remainingFor = (orderId: number, total: number) =>
    Math.max(total - (invoicedByOrder.get(orderId) ?? 0), 0);

  const handleCreateInvoice = async (p: {
    mode: "full" | "down_payment_percent" | "down_payment_fixed";
    value: number | null;
    dueDays: number;
  }) => {
    if (!invoiceFor) return;
    const inv = await createInvoice.mutateAsync({
      orderId: invoiceFor.id,
      dueDays: p.dueDays,
      mode: p.mode,
      value: p.value,
      post: false,
    });
    setInvoiceFor(null);
    router.push(`/dashboard/invoicing/${inv.id}`);
  };

  /** Parcours de vente : « Créer facture » directement depuis un devis. */
  const handleQuoteInvoice = async (quoteId: number) => {
    try {
      const res = await createInvoiceFromQuote.mutateAsync({ quoteId });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [SALES_KEYS.quotes] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [SALES_KEYS.orders] });
      router.push(`/dashboard/invoicing/${res.invoice_id}`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data
          ?.detail;
      alert(detail || "Erreur lors de la création de la facture");
    }
  };

  // --- Recherche, filtres, sélection et pagination (façon Odoo) ---
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<"all" | "draft" | "confirmed">("all");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  const partnerMap = useMemo(
    () => new Map(partners.map((p) => [p.id, p])),
    [partners]
  );
  const partnerName = (id: number) =>
    partnerMap.get(id)?.name ?? `Partenaire #${id}`;
  const partnerPhone = (id: number) => partnerMap.get(id)?.phone ?? null;

  const filteredQuotes = useMemo(
    () => filterDocs(quotes, search, statusFilter, partnerMap),
    [quotes, search, statusFilter, partnerMap]
  );
  const filteredOrders = useMemo(
    () => filterDocs(orders, search, statusFilter, partnerMap),
    [orders, search, statusFilter, partnerMap]
  );

  const docs = tab === "quotes" ? filteredQuotes : filteredOrders;
  const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(docs.length / PAGE_SIZE));
  const safePage = Math.min(page, totalPages);
  const pageSlice = docs.slice((safePage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, safePage * PAGE_SIZE);
  const quotesPage = tab === "quotes" ? (pageSlice as Quote[]) : [];
  const ordersPage = tab === "orders" ? (pageSlice as SalesOrder[]) : [];

      alert(detail || "Erreur lors de la suppression du devis");
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteOrder = async (orderId: number, reference: string) => {

    );
    if (!confirmed) return;

      await deleteOrder.mutateAsync(orderId);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      alert(detail || "Erreur lors de la suppression de la commande");
    }
  };

  const handleBackToDraft = async (orderId: number, reference: string) => {
    const { confirmed } = await confirm({

      description:
        "Les réservations de stock seront libérées. Vous pourrez modifier la commande puis la confirmer à nouveau.",
    });
    if (!confirmed) return;
    try {
      await orderBackToDraft.mutateAsync(orderId);

      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      alert(detail || "Erreur lors de la remise au brouillon");

    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Ventes</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">Devis et commandes clients</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <ExportButton
            key={tab}
            endpoint={
              tab === "quotes" ? "/sales/quotes/export" : "/sales/orders/export"

            fallbackName={tab === "quotes" ? "devis" : "commandes"}

          <Button

            className="flex items-center gap-2"
            onClick={() => setImportOpen(true)}

            <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />

            <Button className="flex items-center gap-2">

            </Button>
          </Link>

      <ImportDialog

      {/* Onglets */}
      <div className="flex gap-4 border-b border-gray-200">

      {/* Barre d'actions groupées */}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 rounded-md border border-blue-200 bg-blue-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm">

                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }

                      <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">

                      {partnerPhone(o.partner_id) && (

                          {partnerPhone(o.partner_id)}

                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-gray-600">{formatDate(o.order_date)}</td>

                        ? "Hybride"

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">
                      {formatCurrency(o.paid_amount)}

                    <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">

                        {(() => {
                          const isDraft = o.status === "draft";
                          const isConfirmed =
                            o.status === "confirmed" && o.fulfillment_mode !== "pos";
                          return (
                            <>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  isDraft
                                    ? `Confirmer la commande ${o.reference}`
                                    : `Commande ${o.reference} déjà confirmée`

                                className={
                                  isDraft
                                    ? "text-green-600 hover:bg-green-50"
                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }
                                onClick={() => handleConfirm(o.id)}
                              >
                                <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  isDraft
                                    ? `Modifier la commande ${o.reference}`
                                    : "Seule une commande brouillon peut être modifiée"
                                }
                                disabled={!isDraft}
                                className={
                                  isDraft
                                    ? "text-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-50"
                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }
                                onClick={() =>
                                  router.push(`/dashboard/sales/quotes/new?orderId=${o.id}`)
                                }
                              >
                                <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  isDraft
                                    ? `Supprimer la commande ${o.reference}`
                                    : "Seule une commande brouillon peut être supprimée"
                                }
                                disabled={!isDraft || deleteOrder.isPending}
                                className={
                                  isDraft
                                    ? "text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }
                                onClick={() => handleDeleteOrder(o.id, o.reference)}
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  isConfirmed
                                    ? `Voir / imprimer le bon de commande ${o.reference}`
                                    : "Le bon de commande n'est disponible qu'une fois confirmé"
                                }
                                disabled={!isConfirmed}
                                className={
                                  isConfirmed
                                    ? "text-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-50"
                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }
                                onClick={() => printOrder(o.id).catch(() =>
                                  alert("Impossible de générer le bon de commande.")
                                )}
                              >
                                <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  isConfirmed
                                    ? `Remettre la commande ${o.reference} au brouillon`
                                    : "Seule une commande confirmée peut être remise au brouillon"
                                }
                                disabled={!isConfirmed || orderBackToDraft.isPending}
                                className={
                                  isConfirmed
                                    ? "text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-50"
                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }
                                onClick={() => handleBackToDraft(o.id, o.reference)}
                              >
                                <Undo2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  isConfirmed
                                    ? remainingFor(o.id, o.amount_total) > 0
                                      ? `Créer une facture pour ${o.reference}`
                                      : `${o.reference} déjà entièrement facturée`
                                    : "La facturation nécessite une commande confirmée"
                                }
                                disabled={
                                  !isConfirmed || remainingFor(o.id, o.amount_total) <= 0
                                }
                                className={
                                  isConfirmed && remainingFor(o.id, o.amount_total) > 0
                                    ? "text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-50"
                                    : "text-gray-300"
                                }
                                onClick={() => setInvoiceFor(o)}
                              >
                                <ReceiptText className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                              <IconAction
                                title={
                                  o.fulfillment_mode === "pos"
                                    ? `Imprimer le ticket ${o.reference}`
                                    : `Imprimer la facture de ${o.reference}`
                                }
                                className="text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100"
                                onClick={() => printOrder(o.id).catch(() =>
                                  alert("Impossible de générer le PDF de la commande.")
                                )}
                              >
                                <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
                              </IconAction>
                            </>
                          );
                        })()}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            <ListPager
              from={(safePage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE + 1}
              to={Math.min(safePage * PAGE_SIZE, docs.length)}
              total={docs.length}
              page={safePage}
              totalPages={totalPages}
              onPage={setPage}
            />
            </>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Dialogue « Créer une facture » (façon Odoo) */}
      {invoiceFor && (
        <CreateInvoiceDialog
          order={invoiceFor}
          remaining={remainingFor(invoiceFor.id, invoiceFor.amount_total)}
          existing={invoices.filter((i) => i.order_id === invoiceFor.id)}
          onClose={() => setInvoiceFor(null)}
          onCreate={handleCreateInvoice}
          pending={createInvoice.isPending}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Dialogue « Créer une facture » façon Odoo : totale, acompte % ou acompte fixe. */
function CreateInvoiceDialog({
  order,
  remaining,
  existing,
  onClose,
  onCreate,
  pending,
}: {
  order: SalesOrder;
  remaining: number;
  existing: Invoice[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreate: (p: {
    mode: "full" | "down_payment_percent" | "down_payment_fixed";
    value: number | null;
    dueDays: number;
  }) => Promise<unknown>;
  pending: boolean;
}) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<
    "full" | "down_payment_percent" | "down_payment_fixed"
  >("full");
  const [value, setValue] = useState("30");
  const [dueDays, setDueDays] = useState("0");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const valueNum = parseFloat(value.replace(",", ".")) || 0;
  const preview =
    mode === "full"
      ? remaining
      : mode === "down_payment_percent"
        ? Math.min(remaining, (order.amount_total * valueNum) / 100)
        : Math.min(remaining, valueNum);

  const submit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    const v = mode === "full" ? null : valueNum;
    if (mode !== "full" && (!v || v <= 0)) {
      return setError("Saisissez une valeur positive.");
    }
    if (mode === "down_payment_percent" && v !== null && v > 100) {
      return setError("Le pourcentage doit être compris entre 0 et 100.");
    }
    try {
      await onCreate({ mode, value: v, dueDays: parseInt(dueDays, 10) || 0 });
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(
        typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la création de la facture",
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl bg-white p-6 shadow-xl"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
          Créer facture — {order.reference}
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-gray-500">
          Total commande : {formatCurrency(order.amount_total)} · Reste à facturer :{" "}
          <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{formatCurrency(remaining)}</span>
        </p>

        <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
          {(
            [
              ["full", "Facture normale", "Facturation du solde restant"],
              ["down_payment_percent", "Acompte (pourcentage)", "% du total commande"],
              ["down_payment_fixed", "Acompte (montant fixe)", "Montant en devises"],
            ] as const
          ).map(([m, label, hint]) => (
            <label
              key={m}
              className={`flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-md border p-3 ${
                mode === m ? "border-primary bg-primary/5" : "border-gray-200"
              }`}
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="invoice-mode"
                checked={mode === m}
                onChange={() => setMode(m)}
                className="h-4 w-4 accent-primary"
              />
              <span>
                <span className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{label}</span>
                <span className="block text-xs text-gray-500">{hint}</span>
              </span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>

        {mode !== "full" && (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
              {mode === "down_payment_percent" ? "Pourcentage (%)" : "Montant"}
            </label>
            <input
              type="number"
              min="0"
              step="any"
              value={value}
              onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
            />
            {valueNum > 0 && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                Montant de la facture : <strong>{formatCurrency(preview)}</strong>
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-3">
          <label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
            Délai de paiement (jours)
          </label>
          <input
            type="number"
            min="0"
            value={dueDays}
            onChange={(e) => setDueDays(e.target.value)}
            className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
          />
        </div>

        {existing.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-md bg-gray-50 p-3 text-xs text-gray-600">
            <p className="font-medium text-gray-700">Déjà facturé :</p>
            <ul className="mt-1 space-y-0.5">
              {existing.map((i) => (
                <li key={i.id}>
                  {i.reference} — {formatCurrency(i.amount_total)} ({i.status})
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div className="mt-3 rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Annuler
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={pending}>
            {pending ? "Création…" : "Créer brouillon"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Pied de pagination façon Odoo : « X–Y / total » + navigation. */
function ListPager({
  from,
  to,
  total,
  page,
  totalPages,
  onPage,
}: {
  from: number;
  to: number;
  total: number;
  page: number;
  totalPages: number;
  onPage: (p: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-gray-200 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
      <span>{total === 0 ? "0 résultat" : `${from}–${to} / ${total}`}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <IconAction
          title="Page précédente"
          disabled={page <= 1}
          className="text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100"
          onClick={() => onPage(page - 1)}
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        </IconAction>
        <IconAction
          title="Page suivante"
          disabled={page >= totalPages}
          className="text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100"
          onClick={() => onPage(page + 1)}
        >
          <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
        </IconAction>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Bouton d'action réduit, icône seule, avec infobulle. */
function IconAction({
  title,
  onClick,
  disabled,
  className = "",
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      title={title}
      aria-label={title}
      disabled={disabled}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onClick();
      }}
      className={`inline-flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40 ${className}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Page des paramètres système.
 *
 * - Général       : informations de l'application
 * - Modules       : activation / désactivation des modules (superadmin)
 * - Utilisateurs  : création de comptes avec rôles/permissions (RBAC)
 */
"use client";

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  Building2,
  ImagePlus,
  Power,

  Users,
````
