````typescript
  Trash2,
  UserRound,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { COMPANY_KEY, useCurrentCompany, useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { useModules, useModuleActions } from "@/hooks/useModules";
import {
  useCategories,
  useCreateCategory,
  useUpdateCategory,
  useDeleteCategory,
} from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import type { Company, ModuleInfo } from "@/lib/types";
import { DocumentsTab } from "@/components/settings/documents-tab";
import CategoriesTab from "@/components/settings/categories-tab";
import {
  useConfirm,
  confirmDeleteOptions,
} from "@/components/ui/confirm";

interface SystemUser {
  id: number;
  email: string;
  first_name: string;
  last_name: string;
  phone?: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  is_superuser: boolean;
  company_id: number;
  created_at: string;
}

interface Paginated<T> {
  items: T[];
  total: number;
}

interface CompanyLite {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
}

interface RoleLite {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  description?: string;
  is_system: boolean;
}

const MODULES_KEY = ["settings", "modules"];
const USERS_KEY = ["settings", "users"];
const ROLES_KEY = ["settings", "roles"];
const COMPANIES_KEY = ["settings", "companies"];

function moduleName(name: string): string {
  return name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1);
}

export default function SettingsPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const confirm = useConfirm();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("general");
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();

  const canManageModules = currentUser?.is_superuser ?? false;
  const permissions = currentUser?.permissions ?? [];
  const canManageUsers =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true ||
    permissions.includes("user:view") ||
    permissions.includes("user:create");
  const canEditUsers =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true || permissions.includes("user:edit");
  const canDeleteUsers =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true || permissions.includes("user:delete");

  const canManageCategories =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true ||
    permissions.includes("category:view");

  const { data: appInfo } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["core", "system", "info"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/core/system/info");
      return res.data as { name: string; version: string; environment: string; debug: boolean };
    },
  });

  // --- Informations de l'entreprise (onglet Général) ---
  const { data: company, isLoading: loadingCompany } = useCurrentCompany();
  const canEditCompany = currentUser?.is_superuser === true;
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [companyForm, setCompanyForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    code: "",
    establishment: "",
    slogan: "",
    phone: "",
    email: "",
    website: "",
    currency_code: "XOF",
    tax_country: "",
    street: "",
    city: "",
    country: "",
    ncc: "",
    rccm: "",
    share_capital: "",
    logo: null as string | null,
  });
  const [companyError, setCompanyError] = useState("");
  // --- SGAV : Conditions Générales de Vente (page finale des devis/factures) ---
  const [cgv, setCgv] = useState("");
  const [cgvSaved, setCgvSaved] = useState(false);

  // Charge la CGV depuis les paramètres
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    apiClient
      .get("/core/settings/cgv_content")
      .then((res) => {
        if (mounted) setCgv(String(res.data?.value ?? ""));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setCgv("");
      });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const saveCgv = async () => {
    setCgvSaved(false);
    await apiClient.post(
      "/core/settings/",
      { key: "cgv_content", value: cgv, is_public: true },

    setTimeout(() => setCgvSaved(false), 3000);
  };

  // Pré-remplit le formulaire quand l'entreprise est chargée
  useEffect(() => {

  }, [company]);

  const handleLogoChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];

    reader.onerror = () => setCompanyError("Impossible de lire le fichier.");
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const updateCompanyMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (!company) throw new Error("Aucune entreprise chargée.");
      if (!companyForm.name.trim()) throw new Error("Le nom de l'entreprise est obligatoire.");
      if (!companyForm.code.trim()) throw new Error("Le code entreprise est obligatoire.");
      const res = await apiClient.put(`/core/companies/${company.id}`, {
        name: companyForm.name.trim(),
        code: companyForm.code.trim(),
        establishment: companyForm.establishment || null,
        slogan: companyForm.slogan || null,
        phone: companyForm.phone || null,
        email: companyForm.email || null,
        website: companyForm.website || null,
        currency_code: companyForm.currency_code,
        tax_country: companyForm.tax_country || null,
        address: {
          ...(company.address ?? {}),
          street: companyForm.street || null,
          city: companyForm.city || null,
          country: companyForm.country || null,
        },
        ncc: companyForm.ncc || null,
        rccm: companyForm.rccm || null,
        share_capital: companyForm.share_capital || null,
        logo: companyForm.logo,
      });
      return res.data as Company;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      setCompanyError("");
      // Rafraîchit l'entreprise partout (sidebar, header, formulaire)
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: COMPANY_KEY });
    },
  });

  const handleSaveCompany = async () => {
    try {
      await updateCompanyMut.mutateAsync();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setCompanyError(
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail ||
          (err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Erreur lors de l'enregistrement."),
      );
    }
  };

  // Modules (liste + actions)
  const { data: modules = [], isLoading: loadingModules } = useModules();
  const { activate, deactivate } = useModuleActions();

  // Utilisateurs / rôles / entreprises pour la gestion des comptes
  const { data: usersPage, isLoading: loadingUsers } = useQuery({
    queryKey: USERS_KEY,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<Paginated<SystemUser>> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/core/users/", { params: { limit: 200 } });
      return res.data;
    },
    enabled: canManageUsers,
  });
  const users = usersPage?.items ?? [];

  const { data: roles = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ROLES_KEY,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<RoleLite[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/core/roles/");
      return res.data;
    },
    enabled: canManageUsers,

  const { data: companies = [] } = useQuery({

      const res = await apiClient.get("/core/companies/");
      return res.data;
    },
    enabled: canManageUsers,
  });

  // --- Formulaire de création d'utilisateur ---
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    email: "",
    first_name: "",
    last_name: "",
    password: "",
    company_id: 0,
    role_ids: [] as number[],
  });
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const createUser = useMutation({

    onSuccess: () => {

  return (

      <div className="flex gap-4 border-b border-gray-200">

        {tabBtn("Catégories", "categories", canManageCategories)}
        {tabBtn("Modules", "modules", canManageModules)}
        {tabBtn("Utilisateurs", "users", canManageUsers)}

      {activeTab === "general" && (

          <Card className="p-6">
            <h2 className="mb-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold">

            <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-gray-500">
              Ces informations identifient l'entreprise dans le tableau de bord et sur les
              documents. Le logo s'affiche dans la barre latérale.
            </p>

            {loadingCompany ? (
              <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-500">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Chargement...
              </p>
            ) : !company ? (

            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-5">
                {/* Logo */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                  {companyForm.logo ? (

                    <img

                      alt="Logo de l'entreprise"
                      className="h-20 w-20 rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white object-contain p-1"
                    />
                  ) : (

                  )}
                  {canEditCompany && (

                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <Button
                          type="button"

                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                        >
                          <ImagePlus className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />

                        </Button>
                        {companyForm.logo && (
                          <Button
                            type="button"

                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">PNG, JPG ou SVG — 300 Ko max.</p>

function ModuleManager({
  modules,
  loading,
  onToggle,
  actionPending,
}: {
  modules: ModuleInfo[];
  loading: boolean;
  onToggle: (m: ModuleInfo) => void;
  actionPending: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Card className="p-6">
      <h2 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold">
        <Boxes className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
        Gestion des modules
      </h2>
      <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-gray-500">
        Activez ou désactivez les modules métier. Le module Core est toujours actif.
      </p>

      {loading ? (
        <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-gray-500">
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" /> Chargement des modules...
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">
                <th className="px-3 py-2">Module</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">Version</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">Statut</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Action</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {modules.map((m) => {
                const isCore = m.name === "core";
                const active = m.status === "active";
                return (
                  <tr key={m.name} className="border-b border-gray-100">
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-medium text-gray-900">
                      {moduleName(m.name)}
                      {isCore && (
                        <span className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">Core</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-gray-500">{m.version}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">
                      <span className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${active ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700" : "bg-red-100 text-red-600"}`}>
                        {active ? "Actif" : m.status === "installed" ? "Installé" : "Inactif"}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">
                      <Button
                        variant={active ? "outline" : "default"}
                        size="sm"
                        disabled={isCore || actionPending}
                        onClick={() => onToggle(m)}
                      >
                        {active ? (
                          <>
                            <PowerOff className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" /> Désactiver
                          </>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <Power className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" /> Activer
                          </>
                        )}
                      </Button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Page Stock — entrepôts, niveaux (réel / réservé / disponible), mouvements.
 */
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  useWarehouses,
  useStockLevels,
  useStockMovements,
  useCreateWarehouse,
  useCreateMovement,
  STOCK_KEYS,
} from "@/hooks/useStock";
import { useProducts } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";

export default function StockPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data: warehouses = [] } = useWarehouses();
  const { data: levels = [], isLoading: loadingLevels } = useStockLevels();
  const { data: movements = [] } = useStockMovements(0, 30);
  const { data: products = [] } = useProducts();
  const createWarehouse = useCreateWarehouse();
  const createMovement = useCreateMovement();

  const [whName, setWhName] = useState("");
  const [mvProduct, setMvProduct] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [mvWarehouse, setMvWarehouse] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [mvQty, setMvQty] = useState(0);
  const [mvType, setMvType] = useState("in");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const productName = (id: number) =>
    products.find((p) => p.id === id)?.name ?? `Produit #${id}`;

  const handleAddWarehouse = async () => {
    if (!whName.trim()) return;
    try {
      await createWarehouse.mutateAsync({ name: whName.trim() });
      setWhName("");
    } catch {
      alert("Erreur lors de la création de l'entrepôt");
    }
  };

  const handleAddMovement = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!mvProduct || !mvWarehouse || mvQty <= 0)
      return setError("Produit, entrepôt et quantité > 0 requis.");
    try {
      await createMovement.mutateAsync({
        movement_type: mvType === "in" ? "purchase_receipt" : "manual_out",
        warehouse_id: mvWarehouse,
        product_id: mvProduct,
        quantity: mvType === "in" ? mvQty : -mvQty,
      });
      setMvQty(0);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur mouvement de stock");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Stock</h1>
````

````typescript
/**
 * Layout du dashboard — sidebar + header + contenu.
 *
 * Client component : gère l'état réduit/étendu de la sidebar
 * (persisté en localStorage).
 */
"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Sidebar } from "@/components/layout/sidebar";
import { Header } from "@/components/layout/header";
import { subscribePosFocus } from "@/lib/pos-focus";

const SIDEBAR_KEY = "erp-sidebar-collapsed";

export default function DashboardLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false);
  // Mode focus caisse : la page POS masque sidebar + header pendant la vente.
  const [posFocus, setPosFocus] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      setCollapsed(localStorage.getItem(SIDEBAR_KEY) === "1");
    } catch {
      // localStorage indisponible — garde la sidebar étendue
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => subscribePosFocus(setPosFocus), []);

  const toggleSidebar = () => {
    setCollapsed((prev) => {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(SIDEBAR_KEY, prev ? "0" : "1");
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      return !prev;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen bg-gray-50">
      {!posFocus && <Sidebar collapsed={collapsed} />}
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
        {!posFocus && (
          <Header
            showBackButton
            showSidebarToggle
            sidebarCollapsed={collapsed}
            onToggleSidebar={toggleSidebar}
          />
        )}
        <main
          className={
            posFocus
              ? "min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden p-4"
              : "flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-[150px] py-[32px]"
          }
        >
          {children}
        </main>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````css
/**
 * Styles globaux — Tailwind directives + thème personnalisable.
 */
@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

/* Couleurs thématiques personnalisables (HSL pour contrôle d'opacité) */
:root {
  --primary-hue: 221 83% 53%;    /* Bleu Material par défaut */
  --secondary-hue: 142 48% 47%;  /* Vert par défaut */
  --accent-hue: 34 100% 50%;     /* Orange par défaut */
}

/* Styles personnalisés */
body {
  @apply bg-gray-50 antialiased;
}

/* Scrollbar personnalisée */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #f1f5f9;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #cbd5e1;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #94a3b8;
}

/* ===== MODE SOMBRE ===== */
.dark {
  color-scheme: dark;
}

.dark body {
  background-color: #0f172a;
  color: #e2e8f0;
}

/* Surfaces */
.dark .bg-white { background-color: #1e293b !important; }
.dark .bg-gray-50 { background-color: #0f172a !important; }
.dark .bg-gray-100 { background-color: #24324a !important; }
.dark .bg-gray-200 { background-color: #334155 !important; }
.dark .bg-gray-900 { background-color: #0b1220 !important; }
/* Ligne sélectionnée du panier POS — bg-blue-50 n'est pas couvert par les
   surfaces ci-dessus (uniquement les <tr>, pour préserver les badges bleus). */
.dark tr.bg-blue-50 { background-color: #172554 !important; }

/* Texte */
.dark .text-gray-900 { color: #f1f5f9 !important; }
.dark .text-gray-800 { color: #e2e8f0 !important; }
.dark .text-gray-700 { color: #cbd5e1 !important; }
.dark .text-gray-600 { color: #94a3b8 !important; }
.dark .text-gray-500 { color: #94a3b8 !important; }
.dark .text-gray-400 { color: #7c8ba1 !important; }

/* Bordures */
.dark .border-gray-100 { border-color: #26334d !important; }
.dark .border-gray-200 { border-color: #334155 !important; }
.dark .border-gray-300 { border-color: #475569 !important; }

/* États de survol */
.dark .hover\:bg-gray-50:hover { background-color: #1e293b !important; }
.dark .hover\:bg-gray-100:hover { background-color: #24324a !important; }
.dark .hover\:bg-gray-800:hover { background-color: #1e293b !important; }
.dark .hover\:bg-red-50:hover { background-color: #3b1d24 !important; }
.dark .hover\:text-white:hover { color: #f8fafc !important; }

/* Scrollbar */
.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0f172a; }
.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #334155; }
.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #475569; }

/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Panneau du ProductPicker (rendu dans un portail, hors du tableau)
   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Les règles `.dark .bg-white` / `.dark .text-gray-800` ci-dessus sont en
   `!important` : à l'intérieur d'un `<td>` ou d'un Card en `overflow-hidden`,
   un menu déroulant en thème sombre devient illisible (texte clair sur fond
   sombre inversé, rogné par l'overflow de la cellule). Le panneau est donc
   stylé par des classes dédiées, hors de la portée des overrides `.dark`,
   pour garantir un texte foncé sur fond clair dans les deux thèmes.
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.picker-panel {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  color: #111827;
  border-color: #e5e7eb;
}
.picker-panel .picker-item { color: #111827; background-color: #ffffff; }
.picker-panel .picker-item:hover,
.picker-panel .picker-item[data-active="true"] {
  background-color: #eff6ff;
  color: #111827;
}
.picker-panel .picker-ref { color: #6b7280; }
.picker-panel .picker-price { color: #4b5563; }
.picker-panel .picker-empty { color: #6b7280; }
.picker-panel .picker-footer { border-top-color: #e5e7eb; }
````

````typescript
/**
 * Providers — regroupe QueryClient et ThemeProvider côté client.
 */
"use client";

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ConfirmProvider } from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import { DownloadLoader } from "@/components/shared/download-loader";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@/components/providers/theme-provider";

export function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [queryClient] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5,
            retry: 1,
          },
        },
      }),
  );

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
      <ThemeProvider>
        <ConfirmProvider>{children}</ConfirmProvider>
        <DownloadLoader />
      </ThemeProvider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Scanner de codes-barres / QR — caméra via html5-qrcode.
 *
 * - Bouton « Scanner » ouvre la caméra et lit QR + codes-barres (EAN, UPC, Code 128/39).
 * - Repli manuel si la caméra est indisponible (saisie du code au clavier).
 */
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Camera, Keyboard, X } from "lucide-react";
import type { Html5Qrcode } from "html5-qrcode";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

const ELEMENT_ID = "barcode-scanner-region";
const FORMATS = [
  "QR_CODE", "EAN_13", "EAN_8", "UPC_A", "UPC_E", "CODE_128", "CODE_39", "ITF",
];

interface BarcodeScannerProps {
  /** Appelé avec le code détecté (ou saisi manuellement). */
  onScan: (code: string) => void;
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function BarcodeScanner({ onScan, label = "Scanner", className }: BarcodeScannerProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [manualMode, setManualMode] = useState(false);
  const [manualCode, setManualCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const scannerRef = useRef<Html5Qrcode | null>(null);
  const startingRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || manualMode) return;
    let cancelled = false;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const { Html5Qrcode: Scanner, Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats } = await import(
          "html5-qrcode"
        );
        if (cancelled) return;
        const formats = FORMATS.map(
          (f) =>
            Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats[f as keyof typeof Html5QrcodeSupportedFormats]
        ).filter((f) => f !== undefined);
        const scanner = new Scanner(
          ELEMENT_ID,
          formats.length ? { verbose: false, formatsToSupport: formats } : undefined
        );
        scannerRef.current = scanner;
        startingRef.current = true;
        await scanner.start(
          { facingMode: "environment" },
          { fps: 10, qrbox: { width: 260, height: 180 } },
          (decoded) => {
            void stopScanner();
            setOpen(false);
            onScan(decoded.trim());
          },
          () => {
            /* frames sans lecture — silencieux */
          }
        );
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setError(
            "Caméra indisponible — utilisez la saisie manuelle ou autorisez l'accès à la caméra."
          );
          setManualMode(true);
        }
      } finally {
        startingRef.current = false;
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      void stopScanner();
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [open, manualMode]);

  const stopScanner = async () => {
    const scanner = scannerRef.current;
    scannerRef.current = null;
    if (scanner) {
      try {
        await scanner.stop();
      } catch {
        /* deja arrete */
      }
      try {
        scanner.clear();
      } catch {
        /* no-op */
      }
    }
  };

  const close = async () => {
    await stopScanner();
    setOpen(false);
    setManualMode(false);
    setManualCode("");
    setError(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        type="button"
        variant="outline"
        className={className}
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      >
        <Camera className="h-4 w-4" /> {label}
      </Button>

      {open && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md space-y-3 rounded-xl bg-white p-4 shadow-xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
                Scanner un code
              </h3>
              <button
                onClick={close}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700"
                aria-label="Fermer le scanner"
              >
                <X className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {!manualMode ? (
              <>
                <div
                  id={ELEMENT_ID}
                  className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-gray-900"
                  style={{ minHeight: 240 }}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-primary"
                  onClick={async () => {
                    await stopScanner();
                    setManualMode(true);
                  }}
                >
                  <Keyboard className="h-4 w-4" /> Saisie manuelle du code
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {error && (
                  <p className="rounded-md bg-amber-50 p-2 text-xs text-amber-700">{error}</p>
                )}
                <Input
                  autoFocus
                  value={manualCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setManualCode(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" && manualCode.trim()) {
                      void close();
                      onScan(manualCode.trim());
                    }
                  }}
                  placeholder="Code-barres ou QR (ex. 3401234567890)"
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  className="w-full"
                  disabled={!manualCode.trim()}
                  onClick={() => {
                    void close();
                    onScan(manualCode.trim());
                  }}
                >
                  Valider le code
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Section Variantes d'un produit :
 * 1. Gestion des propriétés (Couleur, Finition...) et de leurs valeurs
 * 2. Génération des variantes (produit cartésien des valeurs cochées)
 * 3. Tableau des variantes — prix inline, défaut exclusif, activation
 */
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Plus, Trash2, X, Check, Loader2, Layers } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useConfirm, confirmDeleteOptions } from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import {
  useProperties,
  useVariants,
  useCreateProperty,
  useDeleteProperty,
  useAddPropertyValue,
  useDeletePropertyValue,
  useGenerateVariants,
  useUpdateVariant,
  useDeleteVariant,
} from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import type { ProductVariant } from "@/lib/types";

interface VariantsSectionProps {
  productId: number;
  productPrice: number | null;
}

export function VariantsSection({ productId, productPrice }: VariantsSectionProps) {
  const { data: properties = [], isLoading } = useProperties();
  const { data: variants = [] } = useVariants(productId);
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  const createProperty = useCreateProperty();
  const deleteProperty = useDeleteProperty();
  const addValue = useAddPropertyValue();
  const deleteValue = useDeletePropertyValue();
  const generate = useGenerateVariants();
  const updateVariant = useUpdateVariant();
  const deleteVariant = useDeleteVariant();

  const [newPropName, setNewPropName] = useState("");
  const [valueInputs, setValueInputs] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Record<number, number[]>>({});

  const chosenCount = Object.entries(selected).filter(([, ids]) => ids.length > 0);
  const totalCombos = chosenCount.length
    ? chosenCount.reduce((acc, [, ids]) => acc * ids.length, 1)
    : 0;

  const toggleValue = (propId: number, valueId: number) => {
    setSelected((prev) => {
      const current = prev[propId] ?? [];
      return {
        ...prev,
        [propId]: current.includes(valueId)
          ? current.filter((id) => id !== valueId)
          : [...current, valueId],
      };
    });
  };

  const handleCreateProperty = async () => {
    const name = newPropName.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    try {
      await createProperty.mutateAsync({ name, values: [] });
      setNewPropName("");
    } catch {
      /* doublon : le libellé reste saisissable */
    }
  };

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    if (!totalCombos) return;
    try {
      await generate.mutateAsync({ productId, values: selected });
      setSelected({});
    } catch {
      /* valeur invalide : sélection conservée */
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* ---------------- Propriétés & valeurs ---------------- */}
      <Card className="p-4">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h3 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
              <Layers className="h-4 w-4" /> Propriétés du produit
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              Ex. « Couleur » avec les valeurs Rouge, Vert, Gris foncé…
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Input
              value={newPropName}
              onChange={(e) => setNewPropName(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && handleCreateProperty()}
              placeholder="Nouvelle propriété (ex. Couleur)"
              className="h-9 w-56"
            />
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="h-9"
              disabled={!newPropName.trim() || createProperty.isPending}
              onClick={handleCreateProperty}
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> Ajouter
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {isLoading ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>
        ) : properties.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">
            Aucune propriété — créez-en une pour définir les variantes.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {properties.map((prop) => (
              <div key={prop.id} className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{prop.name}</span>
                  <button
                    className="text-xs text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600"
                    onClick={async () => {
                      const { confirmed } = await confirm({
                        title: `Supprimer la propriété « ${prop.name} » ?`,
                        description:
                          "Les variantes concernées perdront cette caractéristique. Réaffectez-les si nécessaire.",
                        confirmLabel: "Supprimer",
                        cancelLabel: "Annuler",
                        tone: "danger",
                      });
                      if (confirmed) deleteProperty.mutate(prop.id);
                    }}
                  >
                    Supprimer
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  {prop.values.map((v) => (
                    <span
                      key={v.id}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs text-gray-700"
                    >
                      {v.value}
                      <button
                        className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600"
                        onClick={() => deleteValue.mutate({ propertyId: prop.id, valueId: v.id })}
                        aria-label={`Supprimer ${v.value}`}
                      >
                        <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                      </button>
                    </span>
                  ))}
                  <Input
                    value={valueInputs[prop.id] ?? ""}
                    onChange={(e) => setValueInputs((p) => ({ ...p, [prop.id]: e.target.value }))}
                    onKeyDown={async (e) => {
                      if (e.key === "Enter") {
                        const val = (valueInputs[prop.id] ?? "").trim();
                        if (val) {
                          await addValue.mutateAsync({ propertyId: prop.id, value: val });
                          setValueInputs((p) => ({ ...p, [prop.id]: "" }));
                        }
                      }
                    }}
                    placeholder="Ajouter une valeur + Entrée"
                    className="h-7 w-44 text-xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ---------------- Génération ---------------- */}
      <Card className="p-4">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">Générer les variantes</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
          Cochez les valeurs à combiner — chaque combinaison crée une variante.
        </p>
        <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {properties.map((prop) => (
            <div key={prop.id} className="rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-3">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">{prop.name}</p>
              <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
                {prop.values.map((v) => (
                  <label key={v.id} className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-700">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={(selected[prop.id] ?? []).includes(v.id)}
                      onChange={() => toggleValue(prop.id, v.id)}
                      className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300"
                    />
                    {v.value}
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button
            size="sm"
            disabled={!totalCombos || generate.isPending}
            onClick={handleGenerate}
          >
            {generate.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            Générer {totalCombos > 0 ? `${totalCombos} variante${totalCombos > 1 ? "s" : ""}` : ""}
          </Button>
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
            Les combinaisons existantes sont ignorées (aucun doublon).
          </span>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {/* ---------------- Tableau des variantes ---------------- */}
      <Card className="overflow-hidden p-0">
        <div className="border-b border-gray-200 px-4 py-3">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">
            Variantes ({variants.length})
          </h3>
        </div>
        {variants.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
            Aucune variante — générez-en depuis les propriétés ci-dessus.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-gray-200 text-left text-xs uppercase text-gray-500">
                <th className="px-4 py-2">Réf.</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2">Combinaison</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2">Caractéristiques</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right">Prix de vente</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2 text-center">Défaut</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2 text-center">Active</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2"></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {variants.map((v: ProductVariant) => (
                <tr key={v.id} className="border-b border-gray-100">
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-gray-500">{v.reference ?? "—"}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 font-medium text-gray-900">{v.name_suffix}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-gray-600">
                    {v.properties.map((pp) => `${pp.property_name}: ${pp.value}`).join(" · ")}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">
                    <PriceCell
                      value={v.selling_price}
                      fallback={productPrice}
                      onSave={(price) => updateVariant.mutate({ id: v.id, data: { selling_price: price } })}
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 text-center">
                    <input
                      type="radio"
                      name={`variant-default-${productId}`}
                      checked={v.is_default}
                      onChange={() => updateVariant.mutate({ id: v.id, data: { is_default: true } })}
                      className="h-4 w-4"
                      aria-label={`Définir ${v.name_suffix} comme variante par défaut`}
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 text-center">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={v.is_active}
                      onChange={(e) => updateVariant.mutate({ id: v.id, data: { is_active: e.target.checked } })}
                      className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300"
                      aria-label={`Activer ${v.name_suffix}`}
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right">
                    <button
                      className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600"
                      onClick={async () => {
                      const { confirmed } = await confirm(
                        confirmDeleteOptions(`la variante ${v.name_suffix}`),
                      );
                      if (confirmed) deleteVariant.mutate(v.id);
                    }}
                      aria-label={`Supprimer ${v.name_suffix}`}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Cellule prix éditable — vide = prix du produit de base. */
function PriceCell({
  value,
  fallback,
  onSave,
}: {
  value: number | null;
  fallback: number | null;
  onSave: (price: number | null) => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
        <Input
          autoFocus
          value={draft}
          onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") {
              const n = parseFloat(draft.replace(",", "."));
              onSave(isNaN(n) ? null : n);
              setEditing(false);
            } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
              setEditing(false);
            }
          }}
          className="h-8 w-24 text-right text-sm"
        />
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            const n = parseFloat(draft.replace(",", "."));
            onSave(isNaN(n) ? null : n);
            setEditing(false);
          }}
          className="text-green-600 hover:text-green-700"
          aria-label="Enregistrer"
        >
          <Check className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setEditing(false)}
          className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
          aria-label="Annuler"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      className="text-sm text-gray-900 hover:text-primary hover:underline"
      onClick={() => {
        setDraft(value != null ? String(value) : "");
        setEditing(true);
      }}
      title="Cliquer pour modifier le prix"
    >
      {value != null ? (
        formatCurrency(value)
      ) : fallback != null ? (
        <span className="text-gray-400">{formatCurrency(fallback)} (base)</span>
      ) : (
        "—"
      )}
    </button>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/crm/client-autocomplete.tsx
````typescript
/**
 * Autocomplete client — saisie libre, suggestions, création à la volée.
 *
 * - Tape ≥ 2 caractères → recherche API (`/crm/partners?search=…`)
 * - Si des clients correspondent → sélection dans la liste
 * - Sinon deux actions :
 *   1. « Créer et continuer » — crée le client (nom seul) et le sélectionne
 *   2. « Créer et compléter » — crée puis ouvre le formulaire détaillé
 *      (téléphone, e-mail, adresse…) avant de reprendre le devis
 */
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { UserPlus, PencilLine } from "lucide-react";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { Partner } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  value: number | null;
  onChange: (partnerId: number | null) => void;
  /** Nombre de propositions affichées au clic sur un champ vide. */
  limit?: number;
}

interface QuickForm {
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  email: string;
  city: string;
  line_1: string;
}

export function ClientAutocomplete({
  value,
  onChange,
  limit = 5,
}: Props) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Partner[]>([]);
  const [selectedName, setSelectedName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Partner | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<QuickForm>({
    name: "", phone: "", email: "", city: "", line_1: "",
  });
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [initialized, setInitialized] = useState(false);

  /** Charge les premiers clients (propositions par défaut au clic). */
  const loadProposals = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(
        `/crm/partners?role=client&limit=${limit}`
      );
      setResults(res.data ?? []);
      setOpen(true);
    } catch {
      setResults([]);
    }
  }, [limit]);

  /** Recherche full-text dès que l'utilisateur tape. Retourne une fonction d'annulation. */
  const search = useCallback((q: string) => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const t = setTimeout(async () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(
          `/crm/partners?role=client&search=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=${limit}`
        );
        if (cancelled) return;
        setResults(res.data ?? []);
        setOpen(true);
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setResults([]);
      }
    }, 300);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearTimeout(t);
    };
  }, [limit]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Réinitialise la sélection quand la valeur externe change.
    if (value && selectedName && query === selectedName) return;
    if (!value) {
      setSelectedName(null);
    }
  }, [value, selectedName, query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Saisie utilisateur : recherche si ≥ 2 car., sinon vide.
    if (query.trim().length >= 2) {
      const cancel = search(query.trim());
      return () => cancel();
    }
    setResults([]);
  }, [query, search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (boxRef.current && !boxRef.current.contains(e.target as Node))
        setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, []);
  const select = (p: Partner) => {
    onChange(p.id);
    setSelectedName(p.name);
    setQuery(p.name);
    setOpen(false);
  };


  const createPartner = async (detailed: boolean) => {
    if (!query.trim() || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/crm/partners", {
        name: query.trim(),
        role: "client",
        entity_type: "individual",
      });
      const p: Partner = res.data;
      onChange(p.id);
      setSelectedName(p.name);
      setQuery(p.name);
      setResults([]);
      setOpen(false);
      if (detailed) {
        setEditing(p);
        setForm({
          name: p.name, phone: p.phone ?? "", email: p.email ?? "",
          city: "", line_1: "",
        });
      }
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const saveDetails = async () => {
    if (!editing || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.put(`/crm/partners/${editing.id}`, {
        name: form.name || editing.name,
        phone: form.phone || undefined,
        email: form.email || undefined,
      });
      if (form.line_1 || form.city) {
        await apiClient.post(`/crm/partners/${editing.id}/addresses`, {
          address_type: "delivery",
          line_1: form.line_1 || undefined,
          city: form.city || undefined,
          is_primary: true,
        });
      }
      setEditing(null);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className="relative">
      <Input
        value={query}
        onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        onFocus={() => {
          if (query.trim().length >= 2) {
            setOpen(true);
            return;
          }
          if (!initialized) {
            loadProposals();
            setInitialized(true);
          } else {
            setOpen(true);
          }
        }}
        placeholder="Tapez le nom du client…"
      />
      {open && (
        <div className="absolute z-20 mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-lg">
          {results.length > 0 ? (
            results.map((p) => (
              <button
                key={p.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => select(p)}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                <span className="font-medium text-gray-800">{p.name}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{p.phone ?? ""}</span>
              </button>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-400">
              Aucun client trouvé
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-100 p-2">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="flex w-full items-center gap-2"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => createPartner(false)}
            >
              <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
              {query.trim()
                ? `Créer « ${query.trim()} » et continuer le devis`
                : "Créer un client et continuer le devis"}
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="mt-2 flex w-full items-center gap-2"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => createPartner(true)}
            >
              <PencilLine className="h-4 w-4" />
              Créer et compléter le contact
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {editing && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40">
          <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-lg bg-white p-5 shadow-xl">
            <h3 className="mb-4 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
              Compléter le contact
            </h3>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Nom</label>
                <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Téléphone</label>
                  <Input value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value })} />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">E-mail</label>
                  <Input value={form.email} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Adresse</label>
                <Input value={form.line_1} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, line_1: e.target.value })} placeholder="Rue, quartier…" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Ville</label>
                <Input value={form.city} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, city: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>Annuler</Button>
              <Button onClick={saveDetails} disabled={busy}>Enregistrer</Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Lanceur d'applications — grille façon Odoo des modules ACTIVÉS.
 *
 * - Tuiles colorées des applications dont le module backend est actif
 * - Section « Autres applications disponibles » : modules installés mais
 *   désactivés (tuiles grisées → Paramètres pour activer)
 * - Généré dynamiquement : désactiver un module dans Paramètres le retire
 *   instantanément de l'accueil
 */
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { useModuleStates } from "@/hooks/useModules";
import { APP_TILES, type AppTile } from "@/lib/module-registry";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

function Tile({
  app,
  disabled = false,
}: {
  app: AppTile;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  const tooltip = disabled
    ? `${app.label} — Désactivé`
    : `${app.label} — ${app.description}`;
  const inner = (
    <Card
      title={tooltip}
      className={cn(
        "group flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center gap-2 p-3 transition-all duration-200",
        disabled
          ? "cursor-default opacity-55 grayscale"
          : "hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg"
      )}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br text-white shadow-sm",
          app.gradient
        )}
      >
        <app.icon className="h-6 w-6" />
      </div>
      <p className="text-center text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{app.label}</p>
    </Card>
  );

  if (disabled) return inner;
  return (
    <Link href={app.href} aria-label={tooltip} title={tooltip}>
      {inner}
    </Link>
  );
}

export function AppLauncher() {
  const { data: moduleStates = [], isLoading } = useModuleStates();

  // Modules backend actifs (core exclu — pas une application métier)
  const activeModules = new Set(
    moduleStates
      .filter((m) => m.is_active && m.status === "active" && m.name !== "core")
      .map((m) => m.name)
  );

  const activeApps = APP_TILES.filter(
    (a) => a.always || activeModules.has(a.module)
  );

  // Modules installés mais désactivés → section « autres applications »
  const knownModules = new Set(
    APP_TILES.filter((a) => !a.always).map((a) => a.module)
  );
  const inactiveModules = moduleStates.filter(
    (m) =>
      m.name !== "core" &&
      knownModules.has(m.name) &&
      !activeModules.has(m.name) &&
      m.status !== "uninstalled"
  );

  // Applications du catalogue rattachées à un module désactivé
  const inactiveApps = APP_TILES.filter(
    (a) => !a.always && inactiveModules.some((m) => m.name === a.module)
  );
  // Dé-duplique : une seule tuile par module désactivé
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const disabledApps = inactiveApps.filter((a) => {
    if (seen.has(a.module)) return false;
    seen.add(a.module);
    return true;
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <section>
        <h2 className="mb-4 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Applications</h2>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-gray-100"
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section>
      <h2 className="mb-4 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Applications</h2>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6">
        {activeApps.map((app) => (
          <Tile key={app.key} app={app} />
        ))}
      </div>

      {(disabledApps.length > 0 || activeApps.length === 0) && (
        <div className="mt-6">
          <h3 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
            Autres applications disponibles
          </h3>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6">
            {disabledApps.map((app) => (
              <Link key={`off-${app.key}`} href="/dashboard/settings">
                <Tile app={app} disabled />
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-400">
            Activez-les dans Paramètres → Modules. D&apos;autres applications
            pourront être ajoutées à l&apos;ERP.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Section Modules principaux — accès aux modules clés du ERP.
 *
 * Modules : Ventes, Point de vente, Facturation, Contacts
 */
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { ShoppingCart, Euro, FileText, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQuotes, useOrders } from "@/hooks/useSales";
import { useInvoices } from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { usePartners } from "@/hooks/useCRM";
import { formatNumber } from "@/lib/utils";

type MainModule = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon: typeof ShoppingCart;
  href: string;
  color: string;
  iconColor: string;
  staticStats?: string;
};

const mainModules: MainModule[] = [
  {
    key: "sales",
    label: "Ventes",
    description: "Devis, commandes, factures",
    icon: ShoppingCart,
    href: "/dashboard/sales",
    color: "bg-blue-50",
    iconColor: "text-blue-600",
  },
  {
    key: "pos",
    label: "Point de vente",
    description: "Vente comptoir et caisse",
    icon: Euro,
    href: "/dashboard/sales/pos",
    color: "bg-green-50",
    iconColor: "text-green-600",
    staticStats: "Ouvert",
  },
  {
    key: "invoicing",
    label: "Facturation",
    description: "Factures et paiements",
    icon: FileText,
    href: "/dashboard/invoicing",
    color: "bg-indigo-50",
    iconColor: "text-indigo-600",
  },
  {
    key: "contacts",
    label: "Contacts",
    description: "Clients, fournisseurs, chantiers",
    icon: Users,
    href: "/dashboard/contacts",
    color: "bg-purple-50",
    iconColor: "text-purple-600",
  },
];

export function MainModulesSection() {
  const { data: quotes = [] } = useQuotes();
  const { data: orders = [] } = useOrders();
  const { data: invoices = [] } = useInvoices();
  const { data: partners = [] } = usePartners();

  const statsByKey = useMemo<Record<string, string>>(() => {
    const draftQuotes = quotes.filter((q) => q.status === "draft").length;
    const unpaid = invoices.filter(
      (i) => i.status !== "paid" && i.status !== "cancelled"
    ).length;
    const actives = partners.filter((p) => (p as { is_active?: boolean }).is_active !== false).length;
    return {
      sales:
        quotes.length === 0 && orders.length === 0
          ? "Aucun devis pour le moment"
          : `${formatNumber(draftQuotes)} devis en brouillon`,
      pos: "Ouvert",
      invoicing:
        invoices.length === 0
          ? "Aucune facture pour le moment"
          : unpaid === 0
            ? "Toutes les factures sont soldées"
            : `${formatNumber(unpaid)} facture${unpaid > 1 ? "s" : ""} à recouvrer`,
      contacts:
        partners.length === 0
          ? "Aucun contact pour le moment"
          : `${formatNumber(actives)} contact${actives > 1 ? "s" : ""} enregistré${actives > 1 ? "s" : ""}`,
    };
  }, [quotes, orders, invoices, partners]);

  return (
    <section>
      <h2 className="mb-4 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Modules principaux</h2>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        {mainModules.map((module) => (
          <Link key={module.key} href={module.href}>
            <Card className="group cursor-pointer p-6 transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-lg">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className={`rounded-xl p-3 ${module.color}`}>
                  <module.icon className={`h-6 w-6 ${module.iconColor}`} />
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 group-hover:text-primary">{module.label}</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{module.description}</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
                    {module.staticStats ?? statsByKey[module.key]}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </Card>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Section Suivi opérations — livraisons prévues et commandes en production.
 *
 * Données réelles : commandes confirmées (livraisons) et commandes
 * en brouillon/préparation (production). Base vide → états vides.
 */
"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useOrders } from "@/hooks/useSales";
import { useDeliveryNotes } from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from "@/lib/utils";

const statusConfigs: Record<string, { label: string; className: string }> = {
  draft: { label: "Brouillon", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-700" },
  confirmed: { label: "Confirmé", className: "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800" },
  preparing: { label: "En préparation", className: "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800" },
  in_production: { label: "En production", className: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-800" },
  preparation: { label: "Préparation", className: "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800" },
  shipped: { label: "Expédié", className: "bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800" },
  delivered: { label: "Livré", className: "bg-green-100 text-green-800" },
};

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const config = statusConfigs[status] || { label: status, className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800" };
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${config.className}`}>
      {config.label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function OperationsTrackingSection() {
  const { data: orders = [] } = useOrders();
  const { data: deliveries = [] } = useDeliveryNotes();

  const plannedDeliveries = useMemo(
    () =>
      orders
        .filter((o) => o.status === "confirmed")
        .slice(0, 3)
        .map((o) => ({
          id: o.id,
          order: o.reference,
          // Le nom client complet arrive via l'endpoint détail ; ici on affiche la référence
          client: `Commande ${o.reference}`,
          date: o.order_date ?? null,
          status: o.status,
          items: o.lines?.length ?? 0,
          amount: o.amount_total ?? 0,
        })),
    [orders]
  );

  const ordersInProduction = useMemo(
    () =>
      orders
        .filter((o) => o.status === "draft")
        .slice(0, 3)
        .map((o) => ({
          id: o.id,
          order: o.reference,
          client: `Commande ${o.reference}`,
          status: o.status,
          items: o.lines?.length ?? 0,
          // Progression : part des lignes livrées si des BL existent, sinon 0
          progress: 0,
        })),
    [orders]
  );

  void deliveries;

  return (
    <section>
      <h2 className="mb-4 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Suivi opérations</h2>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
        {/* Planned Deliveries */}
        <Card className="p-6">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Livraisons prévues</h3>
            <Link href="/dashboard/delivery" className="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
              Voir tout
            </Link>
          </div>
          {plannedDeliveries.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
              Aucune commande confirmée pour le moment.
            </p>
          ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {plannedDeliveries.map((delivery) => (
              <div key={delivery.id} className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-3 last:border-0">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">{delivery.order}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{delivery.client}</p>
                  </div>
                  <StatusBadge status={delivery.status} />
                </div>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500">
                  <span>{formatDate(delivery.date)} • {delivery.items} article{delivery.items > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
                  <span className="font-medium tabular-nums text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(delivery.amount)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          )}
        </Card>

        {/* Orders in Production */}
        <Card className="p-6">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Commandes en production</h3>
            <Link href="/dashboard/sales" className="text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
              Voir tout
            </Link>
          </div>
          {ordersInProduction.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-gray-400">
              Aucun brouillon en cours pour le moment.
            </p>
          ) : (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {ordersInProduction.map((order) => (
              <div key={order.id} className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-3 last:border-0">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium text-gray-900">{order.order}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{order.client}</p>
                  </div>
                  <StatusBadge status={order.status} />
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500">
                    <span>{order.items} article{order.items > 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
                    <span>{order.progress}%</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 h-1.5 w-full rounded-full bg-gray-200">
                    <div
                      className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary"
                      style={{ width: `${order.progress}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
          )}
        </Card>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Theme Selector — permet de changer le thème couleur de l'application.
 */
"use client";

import { useTheme, themePresets } from "@/components/providers/theme-provider";
import { Paintbrush } from "lucide-react";

export function ThemeSelector() {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
      <Paintbrush className="h-4 w-4 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400" />
      <select
        value={Object.keys(themePresets).find(
          (key) =>
            themePresets[key].primary === theme.primary &&
            themePresets[key].secondary === theme.secondary,
        ) || "default"}
        onChange={(e) => setTheme(themePresets[e.target.value])}
        className="text-sm text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-gray-300 dark:border-slate-600 rounded-md px-2 py-1 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary"
      >
        <option value="default">Bleu (défaut)</option>
        <option value="ocean">Océan</option>
        <option value="forest">Forêt</option>
        <option value="sunset">Coucher de soleil</option>
        <option value="royal">Royal</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Theme Toggle — interrupteur on/off du mode sombre.
 */
"use client";

import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
import { useTheme } from "@/components/providers/theme-provider";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function ThemeToggle() {
  const { mode, toggleMode } = useTheme();
  const isDark = mode === "dark";

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="switch"
      aria-checked={isDark}
      onClick={toggleMode}
      title={isDark ? "Passer en mode clair" : "Passer en mode sombre"}
      className={cn(
        "relative inline-flex h-7 w-13 shrink-0 items-center rounded-full transition-colors duration-200",
        isDark ? "bg-slate-600" : "bg-gray-200"
      )}
      style={{ width: 52 }}
    >
      <span
        className={cn(
          "flex h-5.5 w-5.5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform duration-200",
          isDark ? "translate-x-7" : "translate-x-1"
        )}
        style={{ height: 22, width: 22 }}
      >
        {isDark ? (
          <Moon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-700" />
        ) : (
          <Sun className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500" />
        )}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
}
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useCurrentUser, useLogout } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";

import { ThemeSelector } from "@/components/dashboard/ThemeSelector";
import { ThemeToggle } from "@/components/dashboard/ThemeToggle";
import { useCurrentCompany } from "@/hooks/useAuth";

export function Header({
  title = "Tableau de bord",
  showBackButton = false,
  showSidebarToggle = false,
  sidebarCollapsed = false,
  onToggleSidebar,
}: {
  title?: string;
  showBackButton?: boolean;
  showSidebarToggle?: boolean;
  sidebarCollapsed?: boolean;
  onToggleSidebar?: () => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  const { data: company } = useCurrentCompany();
  const logoutMutation = useLogout();

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await logoutMutation.mutateAsync();
  };

  return (
    <header className="flex h-16 items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

            size="sm"
            onClick={onToggleSidebar}

          >

              <PanelLeftOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
            ) : (
              <PanelLeftClose className="h-4 w-4" />
            )}

        )}
        {showBackButton && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => router.push("/")}
            title="Retour à toutes les applications"

            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Applications</span>
          </Button>
        )}
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{title}</h2>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
          <span>{company?.name ?? "Entreprise"}</span>
          {company?.establishment && (

              <span className="text-gray-500">{company.establishment}</span>
            </>

}
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { useId } from "react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/**
 * FadeArc — spinner en arc de cercle avec traînée en dégradé.
 * Source : loading-ui.com (registre shadcn @loading-ui/fade-arc),
 * repris tels quels pour rester autonomes (aucune dépendance npm).
 * - Teinte via `currentColor` (hérite de la couleur du texte → dark OK)
 * - Vitesse via la variable CSS `--duration` (défaut 1s)
 * - Taille via les utilitaires Tailwind (classes h-* et w-*)
 */
function FadeArc({ className, style, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"svg">) {
  const baseId = useId().replace(/:/g, "");
  const leadingGradientId = `${baseId}-leading`;
  const trailingGradientId = `${baseId}-trailing`;

  return (
    <>
      <style>{`
        @keyframes loading-ui-fade-arc-spin {
          to {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }
      `}</style>
      <svg
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        role="status"
        className={cn(className)}
        style={{
          animationName: "loading-ui-fade-arc-spin",
          animationDuration: "var(--duration, 1s)",
          animationTimingFunction: "linear",
          animationIterationCount: "infinite",
          ...style,
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        <defs>
          <linearGradient
            id={leadingGradientId}
            x1="50%"
            x2="50%"
            y1="5.271%"
            y2="91.793%"
          >
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.55" />
          </linearGradient>
          <linearGradient
            id={trailingGradientId}
            x1="50%"
            x2="50%"
            y1="15.24%"
            y2="87.15%"
          >
            <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0" />
            <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.55" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <g fill="none">
          <path
            d="M8.749.021a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 .497 2.958A7.5 7.5 0 0 0 3 10.375a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 7.5 7.5v3c-5.799 0-10.5-4.7-10.5-10.5C0 5.23 3.726.865 8.749.021"
            fill={`url(#${leadingGradientId})`}
            transform="translate(1.5 1.625)"
          />
          <path
            d="M15.392 2.673a1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2.119-.115A10.48 10.48 0 0 1 21 10.375c0 5.8-4.701 10.5-10.5 10.5v-3a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 5.007-13.084a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-.115-2.118"
            fill={`url(#${trailingGradientId})`}
            transform="translate(1.5 1.625)"
          />
        </g>
      </svg>
    </>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Theme Provider — gestion du thème couleur personnalisable.
 *
 * Permet de changer les couleurs primaires/secondaires de l'application
 * via le LocalStorage et le context React.
 */
"use client";

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from "react";

type Theme = {
  primary: string;
  secondary: string;
  accent: string;
};

export type ThemeMode = "light" | "dark";

type ThemeContextType = {
  theme: Theme;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
  mode: ThemeMode;
  toggleMode: () => void;
};

const defaultTheme: Theme = {
  primary: "221 83% 53%", // bleu Material
  secondary: "142 48% 47%", // vert
  accent: "34 100% 50%", // orange
};

const ThemeContext = createContext<{
  theme: Theme;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
  mode: ThemeMode;
  toggleMode: () => void;
} | undefined>(undefined);

const THEME_KEY = "erp-theme";
const MODE_KEY = "erp-theme-mode";

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>(defaultTheme);
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState<ThemeMode>("light");

  // Restaurer le mode sauvegardé (ou suivre le système au 1er lancement)
  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(MODE_KEY);
    if (saved === "dark" || saved === "light") {
      setModeState(saved);
    } else if (window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches) {
      setModeState("dark");
    }
  }, []);

  // Appliquer la classe `dark` sur <html>
  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", mode === "dark");
  }, [mode]);

  const toggleMode = () => {
    setModeState((prev) => {
      const next: ThemeMode = prev === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
      localStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY, next);
      return next;
    });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (parsed.primary && parsed.secondary) {
          setThemeState({ ...defaultTheme, ...parsed });
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignore parse errors
      }
    }
  }, []);

  const setTheme = (newTheme: Theme) => {
    const merged = { ...defaultTheme, ...newTheme };
    setThemeState(merged);
    localStorage.setItem(THEME_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));

    // Apply CSS variables
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.style.setProperty("--primary-hue", merged.primary);
    root.style.setProperty("--secondary-hue", merged.secondary);
    root.style.setProperty("--accent-hue", merged.accent);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Apply saved theme on mount
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.style.setProperty("--primary-hue", theme.primary);
    root.style.setProperty("--secondary-hue", theme.secondary);
    root.style.setProperty("--accent-hue", theme.accent);
  }, [theme]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme, mode, toggleMode }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme() {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

// Available theme presets
export const themePresets: Record<string, Theme> = {
  default: {
    primary: "221 83% 53%",
    secondary: "142 48% 47%",
    accent: "34 100% 50%",
  },
  ocean: {
    primary: "210 100% 50%",
    secondary: "197 73% 45%",
    accent: "32 100% 50%",
  },
  forest: {
    primary: "142 48% 47%",
    secondary: "210 50% 50%",
    accent: "34 100% 50%",
  },
  sunset: {
    primary: "30 95% 55%",
    secondary: "0 85% 60%",
    accent: "34 100% 50%",
  },
  royal: {
    primary: "255 73% 48%",
    secondary: "270 70% 55%",
    accent: "34 100% 50%",
  },
};
````
