````typescript
"use client";

import { Minus, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { formatCurrency, formatNumber } from "@/lib/utils";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface PosCartLineVM {
  key: number;
  product_id: number;
  name: string;
  reference?: string | null;
  variant_name?: string | null;
  sell_by_length: boolean;
  quantity: number;
  unit_price: number;
  discount_percent: number;
}

interface Props {
  lines: PosCartLineVM[];
  selectedKey: number | null;
  onSelect: (key: number) => void;
  onQuantity: (key: number, qty: number) => void;
  onPrice: (key: number, price: number) => void;
  onDiscount: (key: number, pct: number) => void;
  onRemove: (key: number) => void;
}

export function posLineTotal(l: PosCartLineVM): number {
  const gross = l.quantity * l.unit_price;
  return gross * (1 - (l.discount_percent || 0) / 100);
}

export function PosCartTable({
  lines,
  selectedKey,
  onSelect,
  onQuantity,
  onPrice,
  onDiscount,
  onRemove,
}: Props) {
  if (lines.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white p-8 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
        Panier vide — recherchez un produit ci-dessus, scannez un code-barres,
        ou utilisez l&apos;ajout rapide.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white">
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-left text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">
            <th className="px-3 py-2">Produit</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">PU</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-center">Qté</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-center">Rem.%</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right">Total</th>
            <th className="w-10 px-2 py-2" />
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {lines.map((l) => {
            const active = l.key === selectedKey;
            return (
              <tr
                key={l.key}
                onClick={() => onSelect(l.key)}
                className={cn(
                  "cursor-pointer border-t border-gray-100 transition-colors",
                  active ? "bg-blue-50" : "hover:bg-gray-50",
                )}
              >
                <td className="max-w-[220px] px-3 py-2">
                  <p className="truncate font-medium text-gray-900">{l.name}</p>
                  {(l.reference || l.variant_name) && (
                    <p className="truncate text-xs italic text-gray-400">
                      {[l.reference, l.variant_name].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
                      {l.sell_by_length ? " · au mètre" : ""}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    value={l.unit_price}
                    onChange={(e) => onPrice(l.key, Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="h-11 w-24 rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 text-right text-sm text-gray-900"
                  />
                </td>
                <td className="px-3 py-2" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-label="Diminuer la quantité"
                      onClick={() => onQuantity(l.key, Math.max(0, +(l.quantity - 1).toFixed(3)))}
                      className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 active:bg-gray-100"
                    >
                      <Minus className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </button>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={0}
                      step={l.sell_by_length ? "0.5" : "1"}
                      value={l.quantity}
                      onChange={(e) => onQuantity(l.key, Number(e.target.value))}
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { LayoutGrid } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { CategoryTreeNode } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  tree: CategoryTreeNode[];
  selectedId: number | null;
  onSelect: (id: number | null) => void;
}

function flatten(nodes: CategoryTreeNode[], depth = 0): { node: CategoryTreeNode; depth: number }[] {
  const out: { node: CategoryTreeNode; depth: number }[] = [];
  for (const n of nodes) {
    out.push({ node: n, depth });
    if (n.children?.length) out.push(...flatten(n.children, depth + 1));
  }
  return out;
}

export function PosCategoryRail({ tree, selectedId, onSelect }: Props) {
  const flat = flatten(tree);
  if (flat.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => onSelect(null)}
        className={cn(
          "flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-sm",
          selectedId === null
            ? "border-primary bg-primary text-white"
            : "border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50",
        )}
      >
        <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4" />
        Tout
      </button>
      {flat.map(({ node, depth }) => (
        <button
          key={node.id}
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onSelect(node.id === selectedId ? null : node.id)}
          title={node.name}
          className={cn(
            "shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 py-2 text-sm",
            node.id === selectedId
              ? "border-primary bg-primary text-white"
              : "border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50",
          )}
          style={depth > 0 ? { marginLeft: 0, opacity: 0.92 } : undefined}
        >
          {depth > 0 ? `${"· ".repeat(Math.min(depth, 2))}${node.name}` : node.name}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/sales/pos/PosKeypad.tsx
````typescript
/**
 * Pavé numérique tactile (maquette caisse B) — saisie du montant reçu.
 *
 * Composant totalement contrôlé : la valeur est une chaîne gérée par le
 * parent (« », « 1500 », « 1500.50 »), ce qui évite tout désynchronisation
 * avec l'affichage.
 */
"use client";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface Props {
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  /** Remplace la saisie par le montant exact du panier (bouton « Exact »). */
  onExact?: () => void;
}

export function PosKeypad({ value, onChange, onExact }: Props) {
  const press = (k: string) => {
    if (k === "." && value.includes(".")) return;
    if (k === "00" && (value === "" || value === "0")) return;
    if (value.length >= 12) return;
    // Supprime le zéro non significatif avant un chiffre (« 0 » + « 5 » → « 5 »).
    const next = value === "0" && k !== "." ? k : value + k;
    onChange(next);
  };

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
      {["7", "8", "9"].map((d) => (
        <Key key={d} label={d} onPress={() => press(d)} />
      ))}
      <Key label="⌫" muted onPress={() => onChange(value.slice(0, -1))} />

      {["4", "5", "6"].map((d) => (
        <Key key={d} label={d} onPress={() => press(d)} />
      ))}
      <Key label="C" muted onPress={() => onChange("")} />

      {["1", "2", "3"].map((d) => (
        <Key key={d} label={d} onPress={() => press(d)} />
      ))}
      {/* Exact occupe les deux dernières rangées de la colonne droite. */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onExact}
        disabled={!onExact}
        className="row-span-2 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-green-600 bg-green-50 px-2 text-sm font-bold text-green-700 transition hover:bg-green-100 active:bg-green-200"
      >
        Exact
      </button>

      <Key label="." onPress={() => press(".")} />
      <Key label="0" onPress={() => press("0")} />
      <Key label="00" onPress={() => press("00")} />
    </div>
  );
}

function Key({
  label,
  onPress,
  muted,
}: {
  label: string;
  onPress: () => void;
  muted?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onPress}
      className={cn(
        "h-12 rounded-md border text-lg font-semibold shadow-sm transition active:scale-[0.97]",
        muted
          ? "border-gray-300 bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200"
          : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50",
      )}
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Popup « Nouveau client » depuis la caisse — permet d'ajouter un client
 * absent de la liste sans quitter la vente (le partenaire walk-in
 * « Client de passage » reste le défaut).
 */
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import type { FormEvent } from "react";
import { UserRound } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { useCreatePartner } from "@/hooks/useCRM";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Appelé avec l'id du partenaire créé (présélection en caisse). */
  onCreated: (partnerId: number) => void;
}

const EMPTY = { name: "", phone: "", email: "" };

export function PosPartnerDialog({ open, onOpenChange, onCreated }: Props) {
  const createPartner = useCreatePartner();
  const [form, setForm] = useState(EMPTY);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const close = (o: boolean) => {
    if (!o) {
      setForm(EMPTY);
      setError(null);
    }
    onOpenChange(o);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = form.name.trim();
    if (!name) {
      setError("Le nom du client est obligatoire.");
      return;
    }
    setError(null);
    try {
      const partner = await createPartner.mutateAsync({
        name,
        role: "client",
        ...(form.phone.trim() ? { phone: form.phone.trim() } : {}),
        ...(form.email.trim() ? { email: form.email.trim() } : {}),
      });
      onCreated(partner.id);
      setForm(EMPTY);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      // Détail backend (ex. permission « partner.create » refusée au caissier).
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: unknown } } })
        ?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(
        typeof detail === "string" && detail
          ? detail
          : "Création du client impossible. Vérifiez les champs saisis.",
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={close}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <UserRound className="h-5 w-5" /> Nouveau client
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Ajoutez un client en quelques secondes — la vente en cours est
            conservée.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label
              htmlFor="pos-partner-name"
              className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700"
            >
              Nom du client <span className="text-red-600">*</span>
            </label>
            <Input
              id="pos-partner-name"
              value={form.name}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="Ex. : Entreprise BAT SARL"
              autoFocus
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label
                htmlFor="pos-partner-phone"
                className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700"
              >
                Téléphone
              </label>
              <Input
                id="pos-partner-phone"
                value={form.phone}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, phone: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Ex. : 0700000000"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label
                htmlFor="pos-partner-email"
                className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700"
              >
                Email
              </label>
              <Input
                id="pos-partner-email"
                type="email"
                value={form.email}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, email: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="Ex. : client@exemple.com"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose asChild>
              <Button type="button" variant="outline">
                Annuler
              </Button>
            </DialogClose>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={createPartner.isPending}
              className="bg-green-600 text-white hover:bg-green-700"
            >
              {createPartner.isPending ? "Création…" : "Créer et sélectionner"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````typescript
"use client";

const METHODS = [
  { id: "cash", label: "Espèces", Icon: Banknote },
  { id: "mobile_money", label: "Mobile Money", Icon: Smartphone },
  { id: "bank", label: "Virement", Icon: Landmark },

] as const;

interface Props {
  method: string;
  onMethod: (method: string) => void;

  amount: string;

  /** Panier vide : bloque l'encaissement. */

}

export function PosPaymentPanel({
  method,
  onMethod,
  amount,
  onAmount,
  total,
  disabled,
  submitting,
  error,
  onSubmit,
}: Props) {
  const received = Number(amount || 0);
  const change = received - total;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3 shadow-sm">
      <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">

          <button
            key={id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onMethod(id)}
            className={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-3 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition",
              method === id
                ? "border-primary bg-primary text-white shadow"
                : "border-gray-300 bg-white text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50",
            )}
          >
            <Icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0" />
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Affichage montant reçu / monnaie — style terminal encaisseur */}
      <div className="rounded-md bg-gray-900 p-3 text-right">
        <p className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
          Montant reçu
        </p>
        <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-white">
          {formatCurrency(received)}
        </p>
        <p
          className={cn(
            "mt-1 text-sm font-medium",
            change > 0
              ? "text-green-400"
              : received > 0 && change < 0
                ? "text-amber-400"
                : "text-gray-500",
          )}
        >
          {change > 0
            ? `Monnaie à rendre : ${formatCurrency(change)}`
            : received > 0 && change < 0
              ? `Reste à encaisser : ${formatCurrency(-change)}`
              : "\u00A0"}
        </p>
      </div>

      <PosKeypad
        value={amount}
        onChange={onAmount}
        onExact={() => onAmount(String(total))}
      />

      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <Button
        size="lg"
        onClick={onSubmit}
        disabled={disabled || submitting || (received > 0 && change < 0)}
        className="h-14 w-full bg-green-600 text-base font-bold text-white hover:bg-green-700"
      >
        {submitting
          ? "Encaissement…"
          : `Encaisser ${formatCurrency(total)}`}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
interface Props {

            </p>
````

````typescript
            </p>
          </div>
          <div>

            </p>

            </p>
          </div>

            </p>

            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

          <span className="text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500">
            Total
          </span>
          <span className="text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-gray-900">
            {formatCurrency(total)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white p-3 text-sm sm:grid-cols-5">
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">Sous-total</p>
        <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(subtotal)}</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">Remise</p>
        <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(discountAmount)}</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">
          TVA ({formatNumber(taxPercent, 2)} %)
        </p>
        <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(taxAmount)}</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">Articles</p>
        <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">{formatNumber(itemsCount, 2)}</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">Total</p>
        <p className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">{formatCurrency(total)}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface PosTotals {
  subtotal: number;
  discountAmount: number;
  taxable: number;
  taxAmount: number;
  total: number;
  itemsCount: number;
}

export function computePosTotals(
  lines: { quantity: number; unit_price: number; discount_percent: number }[],
  discountAmount: number,
  taxPercent: number,
): PosTotals {
  const subtotal = lines.reduce((s, l) => {
    const gross = l.quantity * l.unit_price;
    return s + gross * (1 - (l.discount_percent || 0) / 100);
  }, 0);
  const taxable = Math.max(0, subtotal - (discountAmount || 0));
  const taxAmount = taxable * ((taxPercent || 0) / 100);
  const itemsCount = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + (l.quantity || 0), 0);
  return {
    subtotal,
    discountAmount: discountAmount || 0,
    taxable,
    taxAmount,
    total: taxable + taxAmount,
    itemsCount,
  };
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/sales/PaymentDialog.tsx
````typescript
/**
 * PaymentDialog — fenêtre d'encaissement d'une facture
 * (étape 4 du parcours de vente).
 *
 * Choix intégral / partiel (boutons radio), date, montant, méthode
 * (espèces, Mobile Money, virement, chèque, carte) et journal comptable
 * (caisse, banque…). Après enregistrement, le reçu PDF est proposé
 * (téléchargement nommé + aperçu) via printReceipt().
 */
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Banknote } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useCreatePayment, useJournals } from "@/hooks/useOperations";
import { printReceipt } from "@/lib/api/pdf";

interface PaymentDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  invoiceId: number;
  partnerId: number;
  remaining: number;
  currency: string;
}

const METHODS = [
  { value: "cash", label: "Espèces" },
  { value: "mobile_money", label: "Mobile Money" },
  { value: "bank_transfer", label: "Virement" },
  { value: "check", label: "Chèque" },
  { value: "card", label: "Carte" },
];

/** Journal suggéré par défaut selon la méthode de paiement. */
function suggestedJournalCode(
  journals: { code: string; name: string }[],
  method: string
): string {
  const codes = new Set(journals.map((j) => j.code));
  if (method === "cash" && codes.has("CAI")) return "CAI";
  if (method === "bank_transfer" || method === "check" || method === "card") {
    if (codes.has("BAN")) return "BAN";
  }
  if (method === "mobile_money") {
    const mobile = journals.find((j) =>
      /mobile|money|momo|mtn|moov|wave|orange/i.test(`${j.code} ${j.name}`)
    );
    if (mobile) return mobile.code;
    if (codes.has("BAN")) return "BAN";
  }
  return [...codes][0] ?? "";
}

export function PaymentDialog(props: PaymentDialogProps) {
  return <PaymentDialogBody {...props} />;
}
function PaymentDialogBody({
  open,
  onClose,
  invoiceId,
  partnerId,
  remaining,
  currency,
}: PaymentDialogProps) {
  const createPayment = useCreatePayment();
  const { data: journals = [] } = useJournals();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"full" | "partial">("full");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [payDate, setPayDate] = useState("");
  const [method, setMethod] = useState("cash");
  const [journalCode, setJournalCode] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [justPaidId, setJustPaidId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setMode("full");
      setAmount(String(remaining));
      setPayDate(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      setMethod("cash");
      setError(null);
      setJustPaidId(null);
    }
  }, [open, remaining]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && journals.length > 0) {
      setJournalCode((current) => {
        const known = journals.some((j) => j.code === current);
        if (current && known) return current;
        return suggestedJournalCode(journals, method);
      });
    }
  }, [open, journals, method]);

  const parsedAmount = useMemo(
    () => parseFloat(amount.replace(",", ".")),
    [amount]
  );
  const handleModeChange = (next: "full" | "partial") => {
    setMode(next);
    setError(null);
    if (next === "full") setAmount(String(remaining));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!parsedAmount || parsedAmount <= 0) {
      return setError("Saisissez un montant positif.");
    }
    if (parsedAmount > remaining + 0.005) {
      return setError("Le montant dépasse le reste dû.");
    }
    if (!payDate) {
      return setError("Choisissez la date du paiement.");
    }
    try {
      const payment = await createPayment.mutateAsync({
        partner_id: partnerId,
        invoice_id: invoiceId,
        method,
        amount: parsedAmount,
        payment_date: payDate,
        journal_code: journalCode || undefined,
        direction: "in",
      });
      setJustPaidId(payment.id);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })
        ?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(
        typeof detail === "string"
          ? detail
          : "Erreur lors de l'enregistrement du paiement"
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className={!open ? "hidden" : ""}
      role="presentation"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4">
        <PayOverlay
          onClose={onClose}
          remaining={remaining}
          currency={currency}
          error={error}
          justPaidId={justPaidId}
          mode={mode}
          onModeChange={handleModeChange}
          payDate={payDate}
          onPayDateChange={setPayDate}
          amount={amount}
          onAmountChange={setAmount}
          method={method}
          onMethodChange={setMethod}
          journalCode={journalCode}
          onJournalChange={setJournalCode}
          journals={journals}
          pending={createPayment.isPending}
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface PayOverlayProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  remaining: number;
  currency: string;
  error: string | null;
  justPaidId: number | null;
  mode: "full" | "partial";
  onModeChange: (next: "full" | "partial") => void;
  payDate: string;
  onPayDateChange: (v: string) => void;
  amount: string;
  onAmountChange: (v: string) => void;
  method: string;
  onMethodChange: (v: string) => void;
  journalCode: string;
  onJournalChange: (v: string) => void;
  journals: { code: string; name: string }[];
  pending: boolean;
  onSubmit: () => void;
}

function PayOverlay(p: PayOverlayProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className="w-full max-w-md space-y-4 rounded-lg bg-white p-6 shadow-xl"
      onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      role="dialog"
      aria-label="Enregistrer un paiement"
    >
      <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">
        <Banknote className="h-5 w-5 text-green-600" />
        Enregistrer un paiement
      </h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">
        Reste dû :{" "}
        <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900">
          {p.remaining} {p.currency}
        </span>
      </p>

      {p.error && (
        <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">
          {p.error}
        </div>
      )}

      {p.justPaidId ? (
        <div className="space-y-3 rounded-md bg-green-50 p-4 text-sm text-green-800">
          <p className="font-medium">Paiement enregistré avec succès.</p>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => printReceipt(p.justPaidId as number)}>
              Imprimer le reçu
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={p.onClose}>
              Fermer
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <fieldset className="text-sm">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
              Type de paiement
            </legend>
            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="pay-mode"
                  checked={p.mode === "full"}
                  onChange={() => p.onModeChange("full")}
                />
                Intégral
              </label>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="pay-mode"
                  checked={p.mode === "partial"}
                  onChange={() => p.onModeChange("partial")}
                />
                Partiel
              </label>
            </div>
          </fieldset>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
                Date
              </label>
              <input
                type="date"
                value={p.payDate}
                onChange={(e) => p.onPayDateChange(e.target.value)}
                className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
                Montant
              </label>
              <input
                type="number"
                min="0"
                step="any"
                value={p.amount}
                readOnly={p.mode === "full"}
                onChange={(e) => p.onAmountChange(e.target.value)}
                placeholder={String(p.remaining)}
                className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm disabled:bg-gray-50"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
              Méthode
            </label>
            <select
              value={p.method}
              onChange={(e) => p.onMethodChange(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
            >
              {METHODS.map((m) => (
                <option key={m.value} value={m.value}>
                  {m.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-600">
              Journal comptable
            </label>
            {p.journals.length > 0 ? (
              <>
                <select
                  value={p.journalCode}
                  onChange={(e) => p.onJournalChange(e.target.value)}
                  className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                >
                  {p.journals.map((j) => (
                    <option key={j.code} value={j.code}>
                      {j.code} — {j.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                  Registre où le paiement sera comptabilisé (caisse, banque…).
                </p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
                Journal déduit automatiquement du mode de paiement
                (comptabilisation automatique).
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={p.onClose}>
              Annuler
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={p.onSubmit}
              disabled={p.pending}
              className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
            >
              {p.pending ? "Enregistrement…" : "Encaisser"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Sélecteur de produit avec recherche — pour les lignes de devis / commande.
 *
 * - Affiche le produit choisi (nom + référence) ou un libellé d'invite.
 * - À l'ouverture : liste initiale issue des produits déjà chargés,
 *   puis recherche serveur par nom ou référence (débounce 250 ms).
 * - Navigation clavier (↑ / ↓ / Entrée / Échap) et fermeture au clic extérieur.
 * - Option « Ajout rapide » si le produit est introuvable.
 * - Le panneau est rendu dans un portail `document.body` en `position: fixed` :
 *   dans une cellule de tableau, un menu `absolute` est rogné par le Card en
 *   `overflow-hidden`, et les overrides `.dark .bg-white` (en `!important`)
 *   le rendent illisible. Le portail sort des deux contraintes.
 */
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, PackagePlus, X } from "lucide-react";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/types";
import { QuickProductDialog } from "./quick-product-dialog";

interface Props {
  /** Identifiant du produit sélectionné (``null`` = aucune sélection). */
  value: number | null;
  /** Liste déjà chargée (affichage instantané + résolution du libellé). */
  products: Product[];
  /** Appelé avec le produit choisi (ou ``null`` après effacement). */
  onChange: (productId: number | null, product: Product | null) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Proposer la création rapide lorsque la recherche ne donne rien. */
  allowCreate?: boolean;
}

/** Suffixe de mode de vente affiché à côté du nom. */
function saleModeSuffix(p: Product): string {
  if (p.sale_mode === "length") return " · au mètre";
  if (p.sale_mode === "dual") return " · ml / pièce";
  return "";
}

/** Prix de vente affiché à droite de la suggestion. */
function priceLabel(p: Product): string {
  if (p.sale_mode === "length" || p.sale_mode === "dual") {
    const ml = Number(p.price_per_meter) || 0;
    if (ml > 0) return `${formatCurrency(ml)}/ml`;
  }
  return formatCurrency(Number(p.selling_price) || 0);
}

/** Hauteur maximale du panneau du menu déroulant. */
const PANEL_MAX_H = 320;
/** Marge conservée entre le panneau et les bords de la fenêtre. */
const EDGE_GAP = 8;
/** En deçà de cette hauteur disponible, le panneau se retourne au-dessus. */
const FLIP_THRESHOLD = 220;
/** Largeur minimale du panneau (le texte long doit rester lisible). */
const PANEL_MIN_W = 320;

export function ProductPicker({
  value,
  products,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
  allowCreate = true,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [highlight, setHighlight] = useState(0);
  const [quickOpen, setQuickOpen] = useState(false);
  const [created, setCreated] = useState<Product | null>(null);
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState<{ top: number; left: number } | null>(null);

  const selected =
    products.find((p) => p.id === value) ??
    (created && created.id === value ? created : null);

  /**
   * Recalcule la position du panneau à partir du rectangle du déclencheur.
   * Largeur : au moins celle de la cellule, 320 px au minimum, bornée à la
   * fenêtre. Hauteur : contenu, plafonnée, et basculée au-dessus du
   * déclencheur s'il n'y a pas la place en dessous.
   */
  /**
   * Recalcule la position du panneau depuis le rectangle du déclencheur.
   * Largeur : au moins celle de la cellule et 320 px, bornée par la fenêtre.
   * Hauteur : plafonnée à la place disponible, et bascule au-dessus du
   * déclencheur s'il n'y a pas assez d'espace en dessous.
   */
  const updatePosition = useCallback(() => {
    const el = boxRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const vw = window.innerWidth;
    const vh = window.innerHeight;
    const panelW = Math.max(PANEL_MIN_W, r.width);
    const left = Math.max(EDGE_GAP, Math.min(r.left, vw - panelW - EDGE_GAP));
    const below = vh - r.bottom - EDGE_GAP;
    const above = r.top - EDGE_GAP;
    const flip = below < FLIP_THRESHOLD && above > below;
    const available = flip ? above : below;
    const maxHeight = Math.max(160, Math.min(PANEL_MAX_H, available));
    const top = flip
      ? Math.max(EDGE_GAP, r.top - maxHeight - 4)
      : Math.min(r.bottom + 4, vh - EDGE_GAP);
    setPos({ top, left });
    const panel = panelRef.current;
    if (panel) {
      panel.style.maxHeight = `${maxHeight}px`;
      panel.style.width = `${panelW}px`;
    }
  }, []);

  // Recherche serveur (débouncée) — liste initiale si aucune saisie.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const q = query.trim();
    if (!q) {
      setResults(products.slice(0, 8));
      setHighlight(0);
      return;
    }
    const t = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(
          `/catalogue/products?search=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&limit=8`,
        );
        setResults(res.data ?? []);
        setHighlight(0);
      } catch {
        setResults([]);
      }
    }, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [query, open, products]);

  // Position initiale + recalcul au défilement / au redimensionnement.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    updatePosition();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", updatePosition, true);
    window.addEventListener("resize", updatePosition);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", updatePosition, true);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", updatePosition);
    };
  }, [open, updatePosition, results.length]);

  // Focus le champ de saisie quand le panneau s'ouvre — indispensable dans
  // un Dialog (Radix piège le focus, `autoFocus` seul n'est pas fiable).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, [open]);

  // Fermeture au clic extérieur. Le panneau étant dans un portail, il vit
  // hors de `boxRef` : les deux conteneurs doivent être testés, sinon un clic
  // sur une suggestion fermerait la liste avant que son onClick ne s'exécute.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as Node;
      if (
        boxRef.current?.contains(t) ||
        panelRef.current?.contains(t)
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setOpen(false);
      setQuery("");
      setPos(null);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, [open]);

  const pick = (p: Product) => {
    setCreated(p);
    onChange(p.id, p);
    setOpen(false);
    setQuery("");
  };

  const clear = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    setCreated(null);
    onChange(null, null);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setOpen(false);
      setQuery("");
      return;
    }
    if (results.length === 0) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlight((h) => Math.min(h + 1, results.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlight((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (results[highlight]) pick(results[highlight]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className="relative w-full">
      {open ? (
        <Input
          ref={inputRef}
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          placeholder="Rechercher un produit (nom ou référence)…"
        />
      ) : (
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={disabled}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setOpen(true);
          }}
          className="flex h-8 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 text-left text-sm hover:border-primary focus:border-primary focus:outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
        >
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">
            {selected ? (
              <>
                <span className="text-gray-800">{selected.name}</span>
                <span className="ml-1.5 text-xs text-gray-400">
                  {selected.reference}
                </span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-gray-400">— Choisir un produit —</span>
            )}
          </span>
          {selected && !disabled && (
            <span
              role="button"
              tabIndex={-1}
              title="Retirer le produit"
              onClick={clear}
              className="shrink-0 text-gray-400 hover:text-red-600"
            >
              <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </span>
          )}
        </button>
      )}
      {/* Chevron : bascule l'ouverture / fermeture du panneau. */}
      {open ? (
        <ChevronUp
          className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400 cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-600"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setOpen(false);
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <ChevronDown
          className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-gray-400 cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-600"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            setOpen(true);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Panneau en portail : échappe au `overflow-hidden` du Card et aux
          overrides `.dark .bg-white`. Position `fixed` calculée depuis le
          rectangle du déclencheur, donc jamais contraint par la cellule. */}
      {open &&
        typeof document !== "undefined" &&
        createPortal(
          <div
            ref={panelRef}
            style={{
              top: pos?.top ?? -9999,
              left: pos?.left ?? -9999,
              visibility: pos ? "visible" : "hidden",
            }}
            className="picker-panel fixed z-[9999] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain rounded-md border shadow-lg"
          >
            {results.length === 0 && (
              <p className="picker-empty px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                Aucun produit trouvé.
              </p>
            )}
            {results.map((p, i) => (
              <button
                key={p.id}
                type="button"
                data-active={i === highlight}
                onClick={() => pick(p)}
                onMouseEnter={() => setHighlight(i)}
                className="picker-item flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm"
              >
                <span className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="block truncate font-medium">{p.name}</span>
                  <span className="picker-ref text-xs">
                    {p.reference}
                    {saleModeSuffix(p)}
                  </span>
                </span>
                <span className="picker-price shrink-0 text-xs">
                  {priceLabel(p)}

              </button>
            ))}
            {allowCreate && (
              <div className="picker-footer border-t p-2">
                <Button
                  size="sm"

                  className="flex w-full items-center gap-2"
                  onClick={() => setQuickOpen(true)}
                >
                  <PackagePlus className="h-4 w-4" />
                  {query.trim()
                    ? `Produit introuvable ? Ajout rapide « ${query.trim()} »`
                    : "Produit introuvable ? Ajout rapide"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>,
          document.body,
        )}

      {quickOpen && (
        <QuickProductDialog
          initialName={query.trim()}
          onClose={() => setQuickOpen(false)}
          onCreated={(p) => {
            setQuickOpen(false);
            pick(p);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Recherche produit par nom pour le Point de vente.
 *
 * - Dès la 1ʳᵉ lettre tapée : suggestions depuis la base produits
 *   (nom ou référence) → clic ou Entrée = ajout au panier
 * - Produit inexistant → « Ajout rapide » (dialog minimal : nom prérempli
 *   + prix de vente, catégorie facultative) puis le produit créé est
 *   ajouté automatiquement au panier, sans interrompre la vente.
 */
"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { PackagePlus } from "lucide-react";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatCurrency } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/types";
import { QuickProductDialog } from "./quick-product-dialog";

interface Props {
  onAdd: (product: Product) => void;
  /** Filtre les suggestions par catégorie (null = Tout). */
  categoryId?: number | null;
}

export function ProductSearchAdd({ onAdd, categoryId }: Props) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Product[]>([]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [highlight, setHighlight] = useState(0);
  const [quickOpen, setQuickOpen] = useState(false);
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const q = query.trim();
    if (!q) {
      setResults([]);
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    const t = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: String(8) });
        if (categoryId) params.set("category_id", String(categoryId));
        if (q) params.set("search", q);
        const res = await apiClient.get(`/catalogue/products?${params.toString()}`);
        setResults(res.data ?? []);
        setHighlight(0);
        setOpen(true);
      } catch {
        setResults([]);
      }
    }, 250);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [query]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (boxRef.current && !boxRef.current.contains(e.target as Node))
        setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, []);

  const add = (p: Product) => {
    onAdd(p);
    setQuery("");
    setResults([]);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const onKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    if (!open || results.length === 0) return;
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlight((h) => Math.min(h + 1, results.length - 1));
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      setHighlight((h) => Math.max(h - 1, 0));
    } else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (results[highlight]) add(results[highlight]);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className="relative">
      <Input
        autoFocus
        value={query}
        onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        onFocus={() => {
          if (query.trim()) setOpen(true);
        }}
        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
        placeholder="Tapez le nom du produit (ex. ciment, fer à béton…)"
      />
      {open && (
        <div className="absolute z-20 mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-lg">
          {results.length === 0 && (
            <p className="px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-500">Aucun produit trouvé.</p>
          )}
          {results.map((p, i) => (
            <button
              key={p.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => add(p)}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHighlight(i)}
              className={`flex w-full items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm ${
                i === highlight ? "bg-blue-50" : "hover:bg-gray-50"
              }`}
            >
              <span className="font-medium text-gray-800">
                {p.name}
                <span className="ml-2 text-xs text-gray-400">{p.reference}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                {p.sell_by_length
                  ? `${formatCurrency(p.price_per_meter ?? 0)}/ml`
                  : formatCurrency(p.selling_price ?? 0)}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
          <div className="border-t border-gray-100 p-2">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="flex w-full items-center gap-2"
              onClick={() => setQuickOpen(true)}
            >
              <PackagePlus className="h-4 w-4" />
              Produit introuvable ? Ajout rapide « {query.trim()} »
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {quickOpen && (
        <QuickProductDialog
          initialName={query.trim()}
          onClose={() => setQuickOpen(false)}
          onCreated={(p) => {
            setQuickOpen(false);
            add(p);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Dialog « Ajout rapide de produit ».
 *
 * Utilisé lorsque l'utilisateur cherche un produit introuvable (POS ou
 * lignes de devis/commande) : création minimale (nom + prix de vente),
 * la référence étant générée automatiquement par le backend.
 */
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { useCreateProduct } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  initialName: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (p: Product) => void;
}

export function QuickProductDialog({ initialName, onClose, onCreated }: Props) {
  const createProduct = useCreateProduct();
  const [name, setName] = useState(initialName);
  const [price, setPrice] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const save = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) return setError("Le nom est obligatoire.");
    if (!(Number(price) > 0)) return setError("Saisissez un prix de vente valide.");
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const product = await createProduct.mutateAsync({
        name: name.trim(),
        selling_price: Number(price),
        status: "active",
      } as Partial<Product>);
      onCreated(product);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      setError(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors de la création du produit.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-lg bg-white p-5 shadow-xl">
        <h3 className="mb-1 text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">Ajout rapide de produit</h3>
        <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-gray-500">
          La référence est générée automatiquement. Complétez la fiche plus tard dans le Catalogue.
        </p>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Nom *</label>
            <Input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-gray-500">Prix de vente *</label>
            <Input
              type="number"
              min={0}
              value={price}
              onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="0"
            />
          </div>
          {error && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        </div>
        <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Annuler
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={busy}>
            {busy ? "Création…" : "Créer et ajouter"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Sélecteur de variante de produit — pour les lignes de devis / commande.
 *
 * - Rendu conditionnel : le composant ne s'affiche que si le produit
 *   sélectionné possède au moins une variante active (sinon la ligne reste
 *   un simple produit, sans champ parasite).
 * - Le libellé (`name_suffix`) sert d'intitulé ; le prix éventuellement
 *   défini par la variante est appliqué par le parent via `onChange`.
 */
"use client";

import { useVariants } from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import type { ProductVariant } from "@/lib/types";

interface Props {
  /** Produit concerné (``null`` = aucune ligne produit → rien à afficher). */
  productId: number | null;
  /** Variante sélectionnée (``null`` = produit de base). */
  value: number | null;
  /** Appelé avec la variante choisie (ou ``null`` après retour au produit). */
  onChange: (variantId: number | null, variant: ProductVariant | null) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function VariantPicker({
  productId,
  value,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
}: Props) {
  const { data: variants = [], isLoading } = useVariants(productId ?? 0);

  const active = variants.filter((v) => v.is_active !== false);
  // Pas de produit, chargement en cours ou aucune variante → pas de champ.
  if (!productId || isLoading || active.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <select
      aria-label="Variante du produit"
      disabled={disabled}
      className="mt-1 h-7 w-full max-w-xs rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 text-xs text-gray-700 focus:border-primary focus:outline-none disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-gray-50 disabled:text-gray-400"
      value={value ?? ""}
      onChange={(e) => {
        const raw = e.target.value;
        const id = raw ? Number(raw) : null;
        onChange(id, active.find((v) => v.id === id) ?? null);
      }}
    >
      <option value="">Variante : aucune (produit de base)</option>
      {active.map((v) => (
        <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>
          {v.name_suffix}
          {v.reference ? ` (${v.reference})` : ""}
        </option>
      ))}
    </select>
  );
}
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useConfirm, confirmDeleteOptions } from "@/components/ui/confirm";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { useCurrentUser } from "@/hooks/useAuth";
import {
  useCategories,
  useCreateCategory,
  useUpdateCategory,
  useDeleteCategory,
} from "@/hooks/useCatalogue";
import type { ProductCategory } from "@/lib/types";

export default function CategoriesTab() {
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  const permissions = currentUser?.permissions ?? [];
  const canCreateCategory =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true ||
    permissions.includes("category:create");
  const canEditCategory =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true || permissions.includes("category:edit");
  const canDeleteCategory =
    currentUser?.is_superuser === true || permissions.includes("category:delete");

  const { data: categories = [], isLoading: loadingCategories } =
    useCategories();
  const createCategory = useCreateCategory();
  const updateCategory = useUpdateCategory();
  const deleteCategory = useDeleteCategory();
  const confirm = useConfirm();

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [parentId, setParentId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [saleMode, setSaleMode] = useState("unit");

  const resetForm = () => {
    setEditId(null);
    setName("");
    setCode("");
    setDescription("");
    setParentId(null);
    setSaleMode("unit");
  };

  const openEdit = (c: ProductCategory) => {
    setEditId(c.id);
    setName(c.name);
    setCode(c.code ?? "");
    setDescription(c.description ?? "");
    setParentId(c.parent_id ?? null);
    setSaleMode(c.sale_mode ?? "unit");
    setShowForm(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      setError("Le nom est obligatoire.");
      return;
    }
    try {
      if (editId) {
        await updateCategory.mutateAsync({
          id: editId,
          data: {
            name: name.trim(),
            code: code.trim() || null,
            description: description.trim() || null,
            parent_id: parentId,
            sale_mode: saleMode,
          },
        });
      } else {
        await createCategory.mutateAsync({
          name: name.trim(),
          code: code.trim() || null,
          description: description.trim() || null,
          parent_id: parentId,
          sale_mode: saleMode,
        });
      }
      resetForm();
      setShowForm(false);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(
        e?.response?.data?.detail || e?.message || "Erreur d'enregistrement.",
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (categoryName: string, categoryId: number) => {
    const { confirmed } = await confirm(
      confirmDeleteOptions(`${categoryName} — Supprimer cette catégorie ?`),
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;
    try {
      await deleteCategory.mutateAsync(categoryId);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || "Suppression impossible.");
    }
  };

  const parentOptions = categories.filter(
    (c) => c.is_active && c.id !== editId,
  );



  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{categories.length} catégorie(s)</p>
        {canCreateCategory && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              resetForm();
              setShowForm((v) => !v);
            }}
          >
            {showForm ? "Fermer" : "+ Nouvelle catégorie"}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-md bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</div>
      )}

      {showForm && (
        <Card className="space-y-3 p-4">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-gray-800">
            {editId ? "Modifier la catégorie" : "Nouvelle catégorie"}
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <div className="col-span-1 sm:col-span-2">
              <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Nom *</label>
              <Input placeholder="Ex. Ciments, Ferraillage" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Code</label>
              <Input placeholder="Ex. CIM" value={code} onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div className="col-span-1 sm:col-span-2">
              <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Description</label>
              <Input placeholder="Optionnel" value={description} onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Catégorie parente</label>
              <select value={parentId ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setParentId(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)} className="rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                <option value="">— Aucune (racine) —</option>
                {parentOptions.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Mode de vente</label>
              <select value={saleMode} onChange={(e) => setSaleMode(e.target.value)} className="rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm">
                <option value="unit">À l'unité</option>
                <option value="length">Au mètre linéaire</option>
                <option value="dual">Au ml ou à la pièce</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}>Annuler</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={createCategory.isPending || updateCategory.isPending}>
              {editId ? "Mettre à jour" : "Créer la catégorie"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card className="overflow-x-auto p-0">
        {loadingCategories ? (
          <p className="p-6 text-sm text-gray-500">Chargement…</p>
        ) : categories.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="p-10 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">Aucune catégorie.</p>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">

              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">Nom</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">Code</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">Parente</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">Mode de vente</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">Actif</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-gray-500">Actions</th>

                  <td className="px-4 py-2.5">{c.code ?? "—"}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2.5">{c.parent_id != null ? categories.find((p) => p.id === c.parent_id)?.name ?? "—" : "—"}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2.5">{c.sale_mode === "length" ? "Au ml" : c.sale_mode === "dual" ? "Dual" : "Unité"}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2.5">{c.is_active ? "Oui" : "Non"}</td>
                  <td className="px-4 py-2.5">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      {canEditCategory && (
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => openEdit(c)}>Modifier</Button>
                      )}
                      {canDeleteCategory && (
                        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleDelete(c.name, c.id)}>Supprimer</Button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Onglet Paramètres → Documents.
 *
 * - Nomenclature des documents : par type (devis, commandes, factures…),
 *   préfixe, longueur de série, période de réinitialisation, suffixe
 *   (aucun / MMAA / AAAA / personnalisé) et aperçu de la prochaine référence.
 * - Conditions Générales de Vente (page finale des documents).
 * - Filigrane des documents (image superposée en transparence, opacité
 *   réglable, pages A4 uniquement).

const RESET_OPTIONS: { value: DocNomenclature["reset"]; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "never", label: "Jamais" },
  { value: "month", label: "Mensuel" },
  { value: "quarter", label: "Trimestriel" },
  { value: "semester", label: "Semestriel" },
  { value: "year", label: "Annuel" },
];

const SUFFIX_OPTIONS: { value: DocNomenclature["suffix_type"]; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "none", label: "Aucun" },

  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);

    if (config) setDraft({ ...config });
  }, [config]);

    setDraft((d) => ({

                          })
                        }
                      >
                        {RESET_OPTIONS.map((o) => (

                            {o.label}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>

        <div className="mt-5 flex items-center gap-3">

      .then((res) => {
        setInfo(res.data);
        if (typeof res.data?.opacity === "number") setOpacity(res.data.opacity);
        if (typeof res.data?.saturation === "number")
          setSaturation(res.data.saturation);
      })
      .catch(() => setInfo({ exists: false, opacity: 10, saturation: 100 }));
  };

  /** Sauvegarde différée (500 ms) : pas d'appel API à chaque cran du curseur. */
  const saveOpacity = async (v: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.put("/core/settings/watermark/opacity", { value: v });
      setOpacitySaved(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setOpacitySaved(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      setMsg("Échec de l'enregistrement de l'opacité.");
    }
  };

  const saveSaturation = async (v: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.put("/core/settings/watermark/saturation", { value: v });
      setSaturationSaved(true);
      window.setTimeout(() => setSaturationSaved(false), 2500);
    } catch {
      setMsg("Échec de l'enregistrement de la saturation.");
    }
  };

  const onOpacityChange = (v: number) => {
    setOpacity(v);
    setOpacitySaved(false);
    if (saveTimer.current) clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = setTimeout(() => void saveOpacity(v), 500);
  };

  const onSaturationChange = (v: number) => {
    setSaturation(v);
    setSaturationSaved(false);
    if (saveTimer.current) clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    saveTimer.current = setTimeout(() => void saveSaturation(v), 500);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    refresh();
    return () => {
      if (saveTimer.current) clearTimeout(saveTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const upload = async (f: File) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setMsg("");
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("file", f);
      const res = await apiClient.post("/core/settings/watermark", form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
      });
      setMsg(`Filigrane chargé ✓ (${((res.data.size ?? 0) / 1024).toFixed(0)} Ko) — il couvrira le tableau des produits à l'export du PDF.`);
      refresh();
    } catch {
      setMsg("Échec du chargement (PNG ou JPEG, max 2 Mo).");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const remove = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await apiClient.delete("/core/settings/watermark");
      setMsg("Filigrane supprimé.");
      refresh();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="p-6">
      <h2 className="mb-1 text-lg font-semibold">Filigrane des documents</h2>
      <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-gray-500">
        Image <strong>superposée en transparence</strong> sur toutes les pages A4
        des documents PDF (PNG ou JPEG — max 2 Mo), hors page CGV annexée et hors
        ticket POS. Réglez son opacité ci-dessous.
      </p>
      <div className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-4">
        {info?.exists && info.preview ? (
          // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
          <img
            src={info.preview}
            alt="Aperçu du filigrane"
            className="h-24 w-24 rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 object-contain p-1"
          />
        ) : (
          <div className="flex h-24 w-24 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-dashed border-gray-300 text-xs text-gray-400">
            Aucun filigrane
          </div>
        )}
        <div>
          <input
            ref={fileRef}
            type="file"
            accept="image/png,image/jpeg,.png,.jpg,.jpeg"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0];
              if (f) void upload(f);
              e.target.value = "";
            }}
          />
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" disabled={busy} onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>
              {busy ? "Traitement…" : info?.exists ? "Remplacer l'image" : "Charger une image"}
            </Button>
            {info?.exists && (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                className="text-red-600"
                disabled={busy}
                onClick={() => void remove()}
              >
                Supprimer
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          {info?.exists && info.size ? (
            <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500">{(info.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} Ko</p>
          ) : null}
          {msg && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-600">{msg}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4">
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="wm-opacity" className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
            Opacité du filigrane
          </label>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{opacity} %</span>
        </div>
        <input
          id="wm-opacity"
          type="range"
          min={1}
          max={100}
          step={1}
          value={opacity}
          onChange={(e) => onOpacityChange(Number(e.target.value))}
          className="w-full max-w-md cursor-pointer accent-blue-600"
        />
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
          Valeur basse = filigrane très discret (recommandé : 5–15 %), valeur
          haute = plus visible mais gêne la lecture.
          {opacitySaved && (
            <span className="ml-1 font-medium text-green-600">Enregistré ✓</span>
          )}
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4">
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
          <label htmlFor="wm-saturation" className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">
            Saturation du filigrane
          </label>
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{saturation} %</span>
        </div>
        <input
          id="wm-saturation"
          type="range"
          min={0}
          max={100}
          step={1}
          value={saturation}
          onChange={(e) => onSaturationChange(Number(e.target.value))}
          className="w-full max-w-md cursor-pointer accent-purple-600"
        />
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500">
          100 % = couleur pleine, 0 % = niveaux de gris (N&B).
          {saturationSaved && (
            <span className="ml-1 font-medium text-green-600">Enregistré ✓</span>
          )}
        </p>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

/** Conditions Générales de Vente (CGV) : PDF chargé ou texte de repli. */
function CgvCard() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [cgv, setCgv] = useState("");
  const [cgvSaved, setCgvSaved] = useState(false);
  const [pdfInfo, setPdfInfo] = useState<{ exists: boolean; size?: number } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [pdfMsg, setPdfMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pdfBusy, setPdfBusy] = useState(false);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    apiClient
      .get("/core/settings/cgv_content")
      .then((res) => {
        if (mounted) setCgv(String(res.data?.value ?? ""));
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setCgv("");
      });
    apiClient
      .get("/core/settings/cgv-pdf")
      .then((res) => {
        if (mounted) setPdfInfo(res.data);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (mounted) setPdfInfo({ exists: false });
      });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, [queryClient]);

  const saveCgv = async () => {
    setCgvSaved(false);
    await apiClient.post("/core/settings/", {
      key: "cgv_content",
      value: cgv,
      is_public: true,
    });
    setCgvSaved(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCgvSaved(false), 3000);
  };

  const uploadPdf = async (file: File) => {
    setPdfBusy(true);
    setPdfMsg(null);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append("file", file);
      await apiClient.post("/core/settings/cgv-pdf", fd);
      const res = await apiClient.get("/core/settings/cgv-pdf");
      setPdfInfo(res.data);
      setPdfMsg("PDF de CGV chargé ✓ — joint en dernière page des devis et factures.");
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data?.detail;
      setPdfMsg(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Erreur lors du chargement du PDF.");
    } finally {
      setPdfBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const deletePdf = async () => {
    setPdfBusy(true);
    setPdfMsg(null);
    try {
      await apiClient.delete("/core/settings/cgv-pdf");
      setPdfInfo({ exists: false });
      setPdfMsg("PDF supprimé — le texte CGV ci-dessous est utilisé.");
    } catch {
      setPdfMsg("Erreur lors de la suppression du PDF.");
    } finally {
      setPdfBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const downloadPdf = () => {
    void withLoader(
      apiClient
        .get("/core/settings/cgv-pdf/download", { responseType: "blob" })
        .then((res) => {
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(res.data);
          window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener");
          setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
        }),
      "Téléchargement du PDF…",
    );
  };

  return (
    <Card className="p-6">
      <h2 className="mb-1 text-lg font-semibold">
        Conditions Générales de Vente (CGV)
      </h2>
      <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-gray-500">
        Deux options : un <strong>PDF chargé</strong> (recommandé — ajouté en dernière page
        des devis et factures) ou le <strong>texte</strong> ci-dessous (repli).
      </p>

      {/* PDF de CGV */}
      <div className="mb-5 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-4">
        <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800">PDF de CGV</h3>
        {pdfInfo?.exists ? (
          <p className="mb-2 text-sm text-gray-600">
            <span className="font-medium text-green-700">PDF chargé ✓</span>
            {pdfInfo.size ? ` — ${(pdfInfo.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} Ko` : ""}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <p className="mb-2 text-sm text-gray-500">Aucun PDF chargé.</p>
        )}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <input
            ref={fileRef}
            type="file"
            accept="application/pdf,.pdf"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={(e) => {
              const f = e.target.files?.[0];
              if (f) void uploadPdf(f);
              e.target.value = "";
            }}
          />
          <Button
            size="sm"
            disabled={pdfBusy}
            onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
          >
            {pdfBusy ? "Traitement…" : pdfInfo?.exists ? "Remplacer le PDF" : "Charger un PDF"}
          </Button>
          {pdfInfo?.exists && (
            <>
              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={downloadPdf}>
                Télécharger
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                className="text-red-600"
                disabled={pdfBusy}
                onClick={() => void deletePdf()}
              >
                Supprimer
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
        {pdfMsg && <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-600">{pdfMsg}</p>}
      </div>

      {/* Texte CGV (repli) */}
      <h3 className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800">Texte des CGV (repli)</h3>
      <p className="mb-2 text-xs text-gray-500">
        Utilisé uniquement si aucun PDF n'est chargé. Affiché en dernière page des
        devis et factures.
      </p>
      <textarea
        className="min-h-[140px] w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 p-3 text-sm"
        value={cgv}
        onChange={(e) => setCgv(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Conditions Générales de Vente…"
      />
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-3">
        <Button onClick={saveCgv}>
          {cgvSaved ? "CGV enregistrées ✓" : "Enregistrer le texte"}
        </Button>
        {cgvSaved && (
          <span className="text-xs text-green-600">
            Page finale des documents mise à jour.
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Overlay global de téléchargement (spinner plein écran).
 *
 * Rendu uniquement quand au moins un téléchargement est en vol — voir
 * `@/lib/loader`. Monté une fois dans `app/providers.tsx`, il couvre donc
 * tous les appels (exports Excel/CSV, PDF de documents, tickets POS…)
 * sans rien changer dans les pages.
 */
"use client";

import { useSyncExternalStore, type CSSProperties } from "react";

import { FadeArc } from "@/components/loading-ui/fade-arc";
import { getLoaderState, subscribeLoader } from "@/lib/loader";

export function DownloadLoader() {
  const { count, message } = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeLoader,
    getLoaderState,
    getLoaderState,
  );

  if (count === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      aria-live="polite"
      aria-busy="true"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-black/50"
    >
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-xl bg-white px-8 py-7 shadow-2xl dark:bg-slate-800">
        <FadeArc
          className="h-9 w-9 text-blue-600"
          style={{ "--duration": "1.2s" } as CSSProperties}
        />
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-200">
          {message}
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Download, FileSpreadsheet, FileText, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { downloadFile } from "@/lib/api/download";

type ExportFormat = "xlsx" | "csv";

interface ExportButtonProps {
  /** Endpoint backend, ex. "/crm/partners/export" */
  endpoint: string;
  /** Nom de repli si l'en-tête Content-Disposition est absent */
  fallbackName?: string;
  /** Libellé du bouton */
  label?: string;
  /** Paramètres de requête supplémentaires (filtres de la page) */
  params?: Record<string, string>;
  className?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Bouton « Exporter » avec choix du format (Excel / CSV).
 *
 * Symétrique du bouton « Importer » : le fichier produit par l'endpoint
 * ``…/export`` reprend les mêmes colonnes que l'import, il se réimporte
 * donc tel quel.
 */
export function ExportButton({
  endpoint,
  fallbackName = "export.xlsx",
  label = "Exporter",
  params,
  className,
  disabled = false,
}: ExportButtonProps) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<ExportFormat | null>(null);

  const run = async (format: ExportFormat) => {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(format);
    try {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({ format, ...(params ?? {}) });
      await downloadFile(`${endpoint}?${query.toString()}`, `${fallbackName}.${format}`);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail = (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response
        ?.data?.detail;
      alert(typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Échec de l'export.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className={className ?? "flex items-center gap-2"}
          disabled={disabled || busy !== null}
        >
          {busy ? (
            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          {busy ? "Export…" : label}
        </Button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
        <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => run("xlsx")}>
          <FileSpreadsheet className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          Excel (.xlsx)
        </DropdownMenuItem>
        <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={() => run("csv")}>
          <FileText className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
          CSV (.csv)
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}
````
