/**
 * Boîte de dialogue d'import Excel / CSV (réutilisable).
 *
 * Choisir un fichier .xlsx / .csv → POST multipart vers l'endpoint
 * d'import → affiche le bilan (créés / mis à jour / erreurs).
 * Les requêtes de liste passées dans ``invalidateKeys`` sont invalidées.
 */
"use client";

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Download, FileSpreadsheet, Loader2, Upload, X } from "lucide-react";

import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { downloadFile } from "@/lib/api/download";

export interface ImportResult {
  created?: number;
  updated?: number;
  orders_created?: number;
  lines_created?: number;
  errors?: { line: string | number; error: string }[];
  total?: number;
}

interface ImportDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** Endpoint backend, ex. "/catalogue/products/import" */
  endpoint: string;
  title: string;
  /** Description des colonnes attendues (première ligne du fichier) */
  columnsHint: string;
  /** Clés de requête react-query à invalider après succès */
  invalidateKeys?: string[];
  /**
   * Endpoint d'export servant de modèle vierge (en-têtes seuls).
   * Dérivé de ``endpoint`` par défaut : « .../import » → « .../export ».
   */
  templateEndpoint?: string;
}

export function ImportDialog({
  open,
  onClose,
  endpoint,
  title,
  columnsHint,
  invalidateKeys = [],
  templateEndpoint,
}: ImportDialogProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ImportResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  /** Modèle vierge : mêmes en-têtes que l'import (endpoint « .../export »). */
  const exportEndpoint =
    templateEndpoint ?? endpoint.replace(/\/import\/?$/, "/export");

  if (!open) return null;

  const reset = () => {
    setResult(null);
    setError(null);
    if (fileRef.current) fileRef.current.value = "";
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const onSubmit = async () => {
    const file = fileRef.current?.files?.[0];
    if (!file) {
      setError("Sélectionnez un fichier (.xlsx ou .csv).");
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append("file", file);
      const res = await apiClient.post(endpoint, form, {
        headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
        timeout: 120_000, // imports potentiellement volumineux
      });
      setResult(res.data as ImportResult);
      invalidateKeys.forEach((key) =>
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [key] }),
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const detail =
        (err as { response?: { data?: { detail?: string } } })?.response?.data
          ?.detail;
      setError(
        typeof detail === "string" ? detail : "Échec de l'import du fichier.",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  /** Télécharge le modèle vierge : en-têtes seuls, prêts à remplir. */
  const onDownloadTemplate = async () => {
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      await downloadFile(`${exportEndpoint}?template=1`, "modele_import.xlsx");
    } catch {
      alert("Téléchargement du modèle impossible.");
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  const imported = result
    ? (result.created ?? 0) + (result.updated ?? 0) + (result.orders_created ?? 0)
    : 0;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 p-4"
      onClick={handleClose}
    >
      <div
        className="w-full max-w-lg rounded-xl bg-white p-6 shadow-xl"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-blue-50">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900">{title}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                Fichier Excel (.xlsx) ou CSV — première ligne = en-têtes
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleClose}
            className="rounded-md p-1 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-600"
            aria-label="Fermer"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {result ? (
          <div className="mt-5 space-y-3">
            <div className="rounded-md bg-green-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-green-800">
              <p className="font-semibold">Import terminé</p>
              <p className="mt-1">
                {imported} élément(s) traité(s)
                {result.updated ? ` (${result.updated} mis à jour)` : ""}
                {result.orders_created
                  ? ` — ${result.orders_created} commande(s), ${result.lines_created ?? 0} ligne(s)`
                  : ""}
              </p>
            </div>
            {result.errors && result.errors.length > 0 && (
              <div className="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto rounded-md bg-red-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-700">
                <p className="font-semibold">
                  {result.errors.length} ligne(s) en erreur :
                </p>
                <ul className="mt-1 list-inside list-disc space-y-0.5 text-xs">
                  {result.errors.slice(0, 20).map((e, i) => (
                    <li key={i}>
                      Ligne {e.line} : {e.error}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={reset}
                className="rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                Importer un autre fichier
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleClose}
                className="rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white hover:bg-primary-hover"
              >
                Fermer
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="mt-5 rounded-md bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs text-gray-600">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-medium text-gray-700">Colonnes attendues :</p>
                  <p className="mt-1 leading-relaxed">{columnsHint}</p>
                </div>
                {exportEndpoint !== endpoint && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onDownloadTemplate}
                    disabled={downloading}
                    className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    {downloading ? (
                      <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    Modèle vierge
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <label className="mt-4 flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 px-4 py-8 text-sm text-gray-500 hover:border-primary hover:bg-gray-50">
              <Upload className="h-6 w-6" />
              <span>Cliquez pour choisir un fichier</span>
              <input
                ref={fileRef}
                type="file"
                accept=".xlsx,.xlsm,.csv"
                className="hidden"
              />
            </label>

            {error && (
              <p className="mt-3 rounded-md bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleClose}
                className="rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={onSubmit}
                disabled={busy}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white hover:bg-primary-hover disabled:opacity-60"
              >
                {busy && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
                Importer
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Rendu d'un dialogue de confirmation (tons danger / warning / info,
 * mot-clé à retaper, case d'acquittement).
 */
"use client";

import { AlertTriangle, Info } from "lucide-react";
import * as React from "react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import type { ConfirmRequest } from "./types";

function toneIcon(tone: ConfirmRequest["tone"]): React.ReactNode {
  if (tone === "danger") {
    return (
      <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
    );
  }
  if (tone === "warning") {
    return (
      <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
    );
  }
  return <Info className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />;
}

export function ConfirmDialogView({
  request,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  request: ConfirmRequest;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const [keyword, setKeyword] = React.useState("");
  const [acknowledged, setAcknowledged] = React.useState(false);
  const confirmRef = React.useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (request.autoFocusConfirm) confirmRef.current?.focus();
  }, [request.autoFocusConfirm]);

  const keywordOk =
    !request.requireKeyword || keyword.trim() === request.requireKeyword;
  const ackOk = !request.acknowledgement || acknowledged;
  const canConfirm = keywordOk && ackOk;

  return (
    <DialogContent
      hideCloseButton={!request.allowClose}
      onEscapeKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (!request.allowClose) e.preventDefault();
      }}
      onInteractOutside={(e) => {
        if (!request.allowClose) e.preventDefault();
      }}
    >
      <DialogHeader>
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 pr-6">
          <span className="mt-0.5">{toneIcon(request.tone)}</span>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
            <DialogTitle>{request.title}</DialogTitle>
            {request.description && (
              <DialogDescription>{request.description}</DialogDescription>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogHeader>

      {request.content}

      {request.requireKeyword && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
          <label
            htmlFor={`confirm-keyword-${request.id}`}
            className="text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300"
          >
            {request.keywordLabel ??
              `Tapez « ${request.requireKeyword} » pour confirmer`}
          </label>
          <input
            id={`confirm-keyword-${request.id}`}
            type="text"
            value={keyword}
            onChange={(e) => setKeyword(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={request.requireKeyword}
            autoComplete="off"
            className="h-10 rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-white px-3 text-sm text-gray-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100"
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {request.acknowledgement && (
        <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 text-sm text-gray-600 dark:text-slate-300">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={acknowledged}
            onChange={(e) => setAcknowledged(e.target.checked)}
            className="mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 accent-primary"
          />
          <span>{request.acknowledgement}</span>
        </label>
      )}

      <DialogFooter>
        {!request.hideCancelButton && (
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onCancel}>
            {request.cancelLabel}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button
          ref={confirmRef}
          variant={request.tone === "danger" ? "destructive" : "default"}
          className={cn(
            request.tone === "warning" &&
              "bg-amber-600 text-white hover:bg-amber-700",
          )}
          disabled={!canConfirm}
          onClick={onConfirm}
        >
          {request.confirmLabel}
        </Button>
      </DialogFooter>
    </DialogContent>
  );
}
````

/**
 * Presets métier FR pour le système de confirmation.
 *
 * Usage : `const { confirmed } = await confirm(confirmDeleteOptions("le devis DEV-1"));`
 */
import type { ConfirmOptions } from "./types";

/** Suppression standard (ton danger, réversible ou non). */
export function confirmDeleteOptions(label: string): ConfirmOptions {
  return {
    title: `Supprimer « ${label} » ?`,
    description:
      "Cette action est irréversible. L'élément supprimé ne pourra pas être récupéré.",
    confirmLabel: "Supprimer",
    cancelLabel: "Annuler",
    tone: "danger",
  };
}

/** Suppression sensible : exige de retaper le nom exact (équivalent `confirmationKeyword`). */
export function confirmHardDeleteOptions(
  label: string,
  keyword: string = label,
): ConfirmOptions {
  return {
    ...confirmDeleteOptions(label),
    title: `Supprimer définitivement « ${label} » ?`,
    description:
      "Pour confirmer, retapez le nom exact de l'élément ci-dessous. Cette action est irréversible.",
    requireKeyword: keyword,
    keywordLabel: `Tapez « ${keyword} » pour confirmer`,
  };
}

/** Remise au brouillon (le document pourra être modifié puis confirmé à nouveau). */
export function confirmBackToDraftOptions(label: string): ConfirmOptions {
  return {
    title: `Remettre « ${label} » au brouillon ?`,
    description: "Le document pourra être modifié puis confirmé à nouveau.",
    confirmLabel: "Remettre au brouillon",
    cancelLabel: "Annuler",
    tone: "warning",
  };
}

/** Confirmation / validation d'un document. */
export function confirmPostOptions(label: string): ConfirmOptions {
  return {
    title: `Confirmer « ${label} » ?`,
    description:
      "Le document confirmé ne pourra plus être modifié sans remise au brouillon.",
    confirmLabel: "Confirmer",
    cancelLabel: "Annuler",
    tone: "info",
  };
}

/** Clôture de vente. */
export function confirmCloseOptions(label: string): ConfirmOptions {
  return {
    title: `Clôturer « ${label} » ?`,
    description: "La vente clôturée sera archivée. Cette action est irréversible.",
    confirmLabel: "Clôturer",
    cancelLabel: "Annuler",
    tone: "warning",
  };
}

## File: frontend/src/components/ui/confirm/ConfirmProvider.tsx
````typescript
/**
 * ConfirmProvider — clone du pattern `material-ui-confirm` sur notre Dialog shadcn.
 *
 * À monter une fois sous le ThemeProvider (déjà fait dans `app/providers.tsx`) :
 * les écrans appellent ensuite `const confirm = useConfirm()` puis
 * `const { confirmed } = await confirm(confirmDeleteOptions("le devis DEV-1"))`.
 */
"use client";

import * as React from "react";

import { ConfirmContext } from "./ConfirmContext";
import { ConfirmDialogView } from "./ConfirmDialogView";
import { Dialog } from "@/components/ui/dialog";

import type {
  ConfirmFn,
  ConfirmOptions,
  ConfirmRequest,
  ConfirmResult,
  ConfirmTone,
} from "./types";

const BASE_DEFAULTS: {
  title: string;
  description: React.ReactNode;
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  tone: ConfirmTone;
  allowClose: boolean;
  hideCancelButton: boolean;
  autoFocusConfirm: boolean;
} = {
  title: "Confirmer l'action",
  description: "Voulez-vous vraiment continuer ?",
  confirmLabel: "Confirmer",
  cancelLabel: "Annuler",
  tone: "info",
  allowClose: true,
  hideCancelButton: false,
  autoFocusConfirm: true,
};

let nextRequestId = 1;

function withDefaults(
  options: ConfirmOptions,
  defaults: typeof BASE_DEFAULTS & ConfirmOptions,
  id: number,
  resolve: (result: ConfirmResult) => void,
): ConfirmRequest {
  return {
    id,
    resolve,
    title: options.title ?? defaults.title ?? BASE_DEFAULTS.title,
    description: options.description ?? defaults.description,
    content: options.content ?? defaults.content,
    confirmLabel:
      options.confirmLabel ?? defaults.confirmLabel ?? BASE_DEFAULTS.confirmLabel,
    cancelLabel:
      options.cancelLabel ?? defaults.cancelLabel ?? BASE_DEFAULTS.cancelLabel,
    tone: options.tone ?? defaults.tone ?? BASE_DEFAULTS.tone,
    allowClose: options.allowClose ?? defaults.allowClose ?? true,
    hideCancelButton:
      options.hideCancelButton ?? defaults.hideCancelButton ?? false,
    requireKeyword: options.requireKeyword ?? defaults.requireKeyword,
    keywordLabel: options.keywordLabel ?? defaults.keywordLabel,
    acknowledgement: options.acknowledgement ?? defaults.acknowledgement,
    autoFocusConfirm:
      options.autoFocusConfirm ??
      defaults.autoFocusConfirm ??
      BASE_DEFAULTS.autoFocusConfirm,
  };
}

export function ConfirmProvider({
  children,
  defaultOptions,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  defaultOptions?: ConfirmOptions;
}) {
  const [queue, setQueue] = React.useState<ConfirmRequest[]>([]);
  const queueRef = React.useRef<ConfirmRequest[]>([]);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    queueRef.current = queue;
  }, [queue]);

  const defaults = React.useMemo(
    () => ({ ...BASE_DEFAULTS, ...defaultOptions }),
    [defaultOptions],
  );

  const confirm = React.useCallback<ConfirmFn>(
    (options = {}) =>
      new Promise<ConfirmResult>((resolve) => {
        const id = nextRequestId++;
        setQueue((q) => [...q, withDefaults(options, defaults, id, resolve)]);
      }),
    [defaults],
  );

  // Les demandes en attente lors du démontage sont résolues en "natural".
  React.useEffect(
    () => () => {
      queueRef.current.forEach((r) =>
        r.resolve({ confirmed: false, reason: "natural" }),
      );
    },
    [],
  );

  const settle = React.useCallback((result: ConfirmResult) => {
    const head = queueRef.current[0];
    if (!head) return;
    head.resolve(result);
    setQueue((q) => q.slice(1));
  }, []);

  const current = queue[0] ?? null;

  const handleOpenChange = (open: boolean) => {
    if (!open && current && current.allowClose) {
      settle({ confirmed: false, reason: "natural" });
    }
  };

  return (
    <ConfirmContext.Provider value={confirm}>
      {children}
      <Dialog open={current !== null} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
        {current && (
          <ConfirmDialogView
            key={current.id}
            request={current}
            onConfirm={() => settle({ confirmed: true, reason: "confirm" })}
            onCancel={() => settle({ confirmed: false, reason: "cancel" })}
          />
        )}
      </Dialog>
    </ConfirmContext.Provider>
  );
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Types du système de confirmation — clone du pattern `material-ui-confirm`
 * adapté à notre stack (shadcn/ui + Tailwind, textes FR).
 */
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/** Origine de la résolution : explicite (boutons) ou naturelle (Échap / overlay / démontage). */
export type ConfirmReason = "confirm" | "cancel" | "natural";

/** Ton visuel du dialogue : danger (suppressions), warning (brouillon/clôture), info (confirmations). */
export type ConfirmTone = "danger" | "warning" | "info";

export interface ConfirmOptions {
  /** Titre du dialogue. Défaut : « Confirmer l'action ». */
  title?: string;
  /** Texte explicatif sous le titre. */
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** Contenu libre additionnel (sous la description). */
  content?: ReactNode;
  /** Libellé du bouton de confirmation. Défaut : « Confirmer ». */
  confirmLabel?: string;
  /** Libellé du bouton d'annulation. Défaut : « Annuler ». */
  cancelLabel?: string;
  /** Ton visuel. Défaut : « info ». */
  tone?: ConfirmTone;
  /**
   * Si faux, l'utilisateur ne peut pas fermer sans choisir
   * (Échap / overlay / croix désactivés). Défaut : true.
   */
  allowClose?: boolean;
  /** Masque le bouton d'annulation (confirmation obligatoire). Défaut : false. */
  hideCancelButton?: boolean;
  /**
   * Mot-clé à retaper pour activer la confirmation
   * (équivalent de `confirmationKeyword` de material-ui-confirm).
   */
  requireKeyword?: string;
  /** Libellé d'aide du champ mot-clé. */
  keywordLabel?: string;
  /**
   * Si fourni, une case à cocher obligatoire avec ce libellé
   * (équivalent de `acknowledgement` de material-ui-confirm).
   */
  acknowledgement?: string;
  /** Focus automatique sur le bouton de confirmation (validation au clavier). Défaut : true. */
  autoFocusConfirm?: boolean;
}

export interface ConfirmResult {
  confirmed: boolean;
  reason: ConfirmReason;
}

/** Signature du hook : `confirm(options)` retourne une promesse résolue dans tous les cas (API v4). */
export type ConfirmFn = (options?: ConfirmOptions) => Promise<ConfirmResult>;

export interface ConfirmRequest {
  id: number;
  resolve: (result: ConfirmResult) => void;
  title: string;
  description?: ReactNode;
  content?: ReactNode;
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  tone: ConfirmTone;
  allowClose: boolean;
  hideCancelButton: boolean;
  requireKeyword?: string;
  keywordLabel?: string;
  acknowledgement?: string;
  autoFocusConfirm: boolean;
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/ui/confirm/useConfirm.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Hook `useConfirm` — pendant de `useConfirm()` de material-ui-confirm.
 *
 * ```tsx
 * const confirm = useConfirm();
 * const { confirmed } = await confirm({ title: "Supprimer ?" });
 * if (confirmed) await deleteItem(id);
 * ```
 */
"use client";

import { useContext } from "react";

import { ConfirmContext } from "./ConfirmContext";
import type { ConfirmFn } from "./types";

export function useConfirm(): ConfirmFn {
  const confirm = useContext(ConfirmContext);
  if (!confirm) {
    throw new Error("useConfirm doit être utilisé à l'intérieur de <ConfirmProvider>.");
  }
  return confirm;
}
````

          <X className="h-4 w-4" />

````typescript
"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, UserPlus } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export interface SearchableSelectOption {
  id: string | number;
  label: string;
  subLabel?: string;
}

interface SearchableSelectProps<TValue extends string | number> {
  value: TValue | null;
  displayLabel?: string | null;
  onChange: (id: TValue) => void;
  options?: SearchableSelectOption[];
  fetchOptions?: (q: string) => Promise<SearchableSelectOption[]>;
  limit?: number;
  placeholder?: string;
  createLabel?: string;
  onCreate?: (name: string) => Promise<SearchableSelectOption | null>;
  creatable?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function SearchableSelect<TValue extends string | number>({
  value,
  displayLabel,
  onChange,
  options,
  fetchOptions,
  limit = 5,
  placeholder = "Rechercher…",
  createLabel,
  onCreate,
  creatable = false,
  className,
  disabled,
}: SearchableSelectProps<TValue>) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<SearchableSelectOption[]>([]);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [initialized, setInitialized] = useState(false);
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const loadDefault = useCallback(async () => {
    if (fetchOptions) {
      setBusy(true);
      try {
        const data = await fetchOptions("");
        setResults(data.slice(0, limit));
      } catch {
        setResults([]);
      } finally {
        setBusy(false);
      }
      setOpen(true);
    } else if (options) {
      setResults(options.slice(0, limit));
      setOpen(true);
    }
  }, [fetchOptions, options, limit]);

  const runSearch = useCallback(
    (q: string) => {
      let cancelled = false;
      const t = setTimeout(async () => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setBusy(true);
        try {
          const data = fetchOptions
            ? await fetchOptions(q)
            : options?.filter((o) =>
                o.label.toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()),
              ) ?? [];
          if (cancelled) return;
          setResults(data.slice(0, limit));
          setOpen(true);
        } catch {
          if (!cancelled) setResults([]);
        } finally {
          if (!cancelled) setBusy(false);
        }
      }, 200);
      return () => {
        cancelled = true;
        clearTimeout(t);
      };
    },
    [fetchOptions, options, limit],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (query.trim().length > 0) {
      const cancel = runSearch(query.trim());
      return () => cancel();
    }
    setResults([]);
  }, [query, runSearch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (boxRef.current && !boxRef.current.contains(e.target as Node))
        setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, []);

  const select = (opt: SearchableSelectOption) => {
    onChange(opt.id as TValue);
    setQuery(opt.label);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!query.trim() || creating || !onCreate || !creatable) return;
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      const created = await onCreate(query.trim());
      if (created) {
        select(created);
      }
    } finally {
      setCreating(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={`relative ${className ?? ""}`}>
      <Input
        disabled={disabled}
        value={query}
        onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
        onFocus={() => {
          if (query.trim().length > 0) {
            setOpen(true);
            return;
          }
          if (!initialized) {
            loadDefault();
            setInitialized(true);
          } else {
            setOpen(true);
          }
        }}
        placeholder={query ? "" : placeholder}
      />
      {!disabled && (
        <ChevronDown className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400 h-4 w-4 pointer-events-none" />
      )}

      {open && (
        <div className="absolute z-20 mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-lg max-h-60 overflow-y-auto">
          {busy && <div className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-400">Recherche…</div>}
          {results.length > 0 ? (
            results.map((opt) => (
              <button
                key={String(opt.id)}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => select(opt)}
                className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm hover:bg-gray-50"
              >
                <span className="font-medium text-gray-800">{opt.label}</span>
                {opt.subLabel && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">{opt.subLabel}</span>
                )}
              </button>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-400">
              Aucun résultat
            </div>
          )}
          {creatable && onCreate && (
            <div className="border-t border-gray-100 p-2">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2"
                disabled={busy || creating}
                onClick={handleCreate}
              >
                <UserPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
                {createLabel || `Créer « ${query.trim() || ""} »`}
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

/**
 * Hooks du module Comptabilité — états financiers SYSCOHADA.
 *
 * Balance de vérification, compte de résultat, bilan, écritures
 * du journal et rattrapage comptable (backfill).
 */
"use client";

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import {
  CreditNote,
  CreditNoteApply,
  CreditNoteCreate,
  CreditNoteIssue,
} from "@/lib/types";

export const ACCOUNTING_KEYS = {
  trialBalance: "accounting-trial-balance",
  incomeStatement: "accounting-income-statement",
  balanceSheet: "accounting-balance-sheet",
  journalEntries: "accounting-journal-entries",
  agedBalance: "accounting-aged-balance",
  cashFlow: "accounting-cash-flow",
};

// --- Types (réponses API) ---
export interface TrialBalanceLine {
  account_code: string;
  account_name: string;
  debit: number;
  credit: number;
  balance: number;
}

export interface TrialBalance {
  lines: TrialBalanceLine[];
  total_debit: number;
  total_credit: number;
  balanced: boolean;
}

export interface IncomeStatementLine {
  label: string;
  codes: string[];
  amount: number;
}

export interface IncomeStatement {
  income: IncomeStatementLine[];
  expenses: IncomeStatementLine[];
  total_income: number;
  total_expenses: number;
  net_income: number;
}

export interface BalanceSheetLine {
  label: string;
  amount: number;
}

// --- Balance âgée ---
export interface AgedBalanceLine {
  partner_id: number;
  partner_name: string;
  invoice_count: number;
  total_due: number;
  not_due: number;
  d0_30: number;
  d31_60: number;
  d61_90: number;
  d90_plus: number;
}

export interface AgedBalanceTotals {
  total_due: number;
  not_due: number;
  d0_30: number;
  d31_60: number;
  d61_90: number;
  d90_plus: number;
}

export interface AgedBalance {
  partner_type: "customer" | "supplier";
  as_of: string;
  lines: AgedBalanceLine[];
  totals: AgedBalanceTotals;
  total_due: number;
}

// --- Cash-flow ---
export interface CashFlowAccount {
  account_code: string;
  account_name: string;
  opening_balance: number;
  inflows: number;
  outflows: number;
  net_flow: number;
  closing_balance: number;
}

export interface CashFlow {
  date_from: string | null;
  date_to: string | null;
  opening_balance: number;
  inflows: number;
  outflows: number;
  net_flow: number;
  closing_balance: number;
  by_account: CashFlowAccount[];
}

export interface BalanceSheet {
  assets: BalanceSheetLine[];
  liabilities: BalanceSheetLine[];
  total_assets: number;
  total_liabilities: number;
  net_income: number;
}

export interface JournalEntryLine {
  account_code: string;
  label: string | null;
  debit: number;
  credit: number;
}

export interface JournalEntry {
  id: number;
  reference: string;
  entry_date: string;
  journal_code: string;
  source_type: string | null;
  source_id: number | null;
  description: string | null;
  total_debit: number;
  total_credit: number;
  status: string;
  lines: JournalEntryLine[];
}

// --- Balance de vérification ---
export function useTrialBalance() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.trialBalance],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<TrialBalance> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/financial/trial-balance");
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

// --- Compte de résultat ---
export function useIncomeStatement() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.incomeStatement],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<IncomeStatement> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get(
        "/accounting/financial/income-statement"
      );
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

// --- Bilan ---
export function useBalanceSheet() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.balanceSheet],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<BalanceSheet> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/financial/balance-sheet");
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

// --- Balance âgée ---
export function useAgedBalance(
  params?: { partner_type?: "customer" | "supplier"; as_of?: string }
) {
  const partnerType = params?.partner_type ?? "customer";
  const asOf = params?.as_of;
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.agedBalance, partnerType, asOf ?? null],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<AgedBalance> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/financial/aged-balance", {
        params: {
          partner_type: partnerType,
          ...(asOf ? { as_of: asOf } : {}),
        },
      });
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

// --- Cash-flow ---
export function useCashFlow(params?: { date_from?: string; date_to?: string }) {
  const dateFrom = params?.date_from;
  const dateTo = params?.date_to;
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.cashFlow, dateFrom ?? null, dateTo ?? null],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<CashFlow> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/financial/cash-flow", {
        params: {
          ...(dateFrom ? { date_from: dateFrom } : {}),
          ...(dateTo ? { date_to: dateTo } : {}),
        },
      });
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

// --- Écritures du journal ---
export function useJournalEntries(limit = 50) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.journalEntries, limit],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<JournalEntry[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/journal-entries", {
        params: { limit },
      });
      return Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data.items ?? [];
    },
  });
}

// --- Rattrapage comptable (comptabilise les flux non traités) ---
export function useBackfill() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (): Promise<{
      total: number;
      created: Record<string, number>;
      message: string;
    }> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/accounting/post/backfill");
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.trialBalance],
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.incomeStatement],
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [ACCOUNTING_KEYS.balanceSheet],
      });
    },
  });
}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- //
// Avoirs / notes de crédit
// --------------------------------------------------------------------------- //
export const CREDIT_NOTE_KEYS = {
  list: "accounting-credit-notes",
};

/**
 * Liste des avoirs de l'entreprise.
 * Params optionnels : status, partner_id, type (customer|supplier).
 */
export function useCreditNotes(params?: {
  status?: string;
  partner_id?: number;
  type?: string;
}) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [CREDIT_NOTE_KEYS.list, params ?? {}],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<CreditNote[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/credit-notes", { params });
      return Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
    },
  });
}

/** Créer un avoir (brouillon). */
export function useCreateCreditNote() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: CreditNoteCreate): Promise<CreditNote> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/accounting/credit-notes", data);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [CREDIT_NOTE_KEYS.list] });
    },
  });
}

/** Émettre (comptabiliser) un avoir : draft → issued. */
export function useIssueCreditNote() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      data,
    }: {
      id: number;
      data: CreditNoteIssue;
    }): Promise<CreditNote> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        `/accounting/credit-notes/${id}/issue`,
        data
      );
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [CREDIT_NOTE_KEYS.list] });
    },
  });
}

/** Imputer un avoir sur une facture : issued → applied. */
export function useApplyCreditNote() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      data,
    }: {
      id: number;
      data: CreditNoteApply;
    }): Promise<CreditNote> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        `/accounting/credit-notes/${id}/apply`,
        data
      );
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [CREDIT_NOTE_KEYS.list] });
    },
  });
}

````typescript
/**
 * Hooks du module Comptabilité — lettrage tiers (rapprochement paiement ↔ facture).
 *
 * Fournit :
 * - useCreateAllocation   : création d'un lettrage (allocation)
 * useAllocationsForInvoice : lettrages d'une facture donnée
 * useAllocationsForPayment : lettrages d'un paiement donné
 * useAllocationSummary   : résumé factures avec solde restant à lettrer
 */
"use client";

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";

export const ALLOCATION_KEYS = {
  summary: "accounting-allocation-summary",
  forInvoice: (invoiceId: number) => ["accounting-allocations", "invoice", invoiceId],
  forPayment: (paymentId: number) => ["accounting-allocations", "payment", paymentId],
};

// --- Types (réponses API) ---
export interface InvoiceAllocation {
  id: number;
  company_id: number;
  invoice_id: number;
  payment_id: number;
  allocated_amount: number;
  allocation_date: string;
  notes: string | null;
}

export interface InvoiceAllocationCreate {
  invoice_id: number;
  payment_id: number;
  allocated_amount: number;
  allocation_date: string;
  notes?: string;
}

export interface InvoiceAllocationSummary {
  invoice_id: number;
  invoice_reference: string;
  amount_total: number;
  allocated_amount: number;
  remaining_amount: number;
}

// --- Créer un lettrage ---
export function useCreateAllocation() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: InvoiceAllocationCreate): Promise<InvoiceAllocation> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/accounting/allocations", body);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: [ALLOCATION_KEYS.summary],
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ALLOCATION_KEYS.forInvoice(variables.invoice_id),
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ALLOCATION_KEYS.forPayment(variables.payment_id),
      });
    },
  });
}

// --- Lettrages d'une facture ---
export function useAllocationsForInvoice(invoiceId: number | null) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ALLOCATION_KEYS.forInvoice(invoiceId ?? 0),
    queryFn: async (): Promise<InvoiceAllocation[]> => {
      if (!invoiceId) return [];
      const res = await apiClient.get(
        `/accounting/allocations/invoice/${invoiceId}`

/**
 * Hooks pour l'authentification — utilise react-query.
 */
"use client";

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { apiClient, handleApiError } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { setTokens, clearTokens, isAuthenticated } from "@/lib/auth/auth";
import { Company, LoginRequest, Token, UserWithRoles } from "@/lib/types";

// Keys pour react-query
export const QUERY_KEYS = {
  user: "user",
  companies: "companies",
  modules: "modules",
  permissions: "permissions",
};

export function useLogin() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: LoginRequest): Promise<Token> => {
      const response = await apiClient.post("/core/auth/login", data);
      return response.data;
    },
    onSuccess: async (token) => {
      setTokens(token);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.user] });
      // Premier lancement : si l'entreprise n'est pas encore configurée,
      // on redirige vers l'étape 2 du wizard (profil entreprise).
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get("/core/setup/status");
        const status = res.data as {
          needs_company?: boolean;
          company_code?: string | null;
        };
        if (status?.needs_company || !status?.company_code) {
          router.push("/setup/company");
          return;
        }
      } catch {
        // Statut indisponible — comportement normal
      }
      router.push("/");
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      const err = handleApiError(error);
      console.error("Login failed:", err.message);
    },
  });
}

export function useLogout() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      try {
        await apiClient.post("/core/auth/logout");
      } catch {
        // La deconnexion locale doit aboutir meme si l endpoint echoue
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      clearTokens();
      queryClient.clear();
      router.push("/login");
      router.refresh();
    },
  });
}

export function useCurrentUser() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [QUERY_KEYS.user],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<UserWithRoles | null> => {
      if (!isAuthenticated()) return null;
      try {
        const response = await apiClient.get("/core/auth/me");
        return response.data;
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof Error && "response" in error) {
          const axiosError = error as { response?: { status: number } };
          if (axiosError.response?.status === 401) {
            clearTokens();
            return null;
          }
        }
        throw error;
      }
    },
    staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5, // 5 minutes
  });
}

/**
 * Vérifie une permission de l'utilisateur courant (code « ressource:action »).
 *
 * Masque les boutons sensibles (suppression paiement/facture/BL/devis) —
 * la sécurité réelle reste serveur (require_permission → 403).
 */
export function usePermission() {
  const { data: currentUser } = useCurrentUser();
  const permissions = currentUser?.permissions ?? [];
  const isSuper = currentUser?.is_superuser === true;
  return (code: string): boolean => isSuper || permissions.includes(code);
}

/**
 * Entreprise de l'utilisateur courant (logo, nom, coordonnées...).
 * Invalider COMPANY_KEY après une mise à jour (page Paramètres).
 */
export const COMPANY_KEY = ["core", "company"];

export function useCurrentCompany() {
  const { data: user } = useCurrentUser();
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [...COMPANY_KEY, user?.company_id],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<Company | null> => {
      if (!user?.company_id) return null;
      const response = await apiClient.get(`/core/companies/${user.company_id}`);
      return response.data;
    },
    enabled: !!user?.company_id,
    staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 5,
  });
}
````

/**
 * Hooks pour la nomenclature des documents (Paramètres → Documents).
 *
 * Config stockée dans le paramètre JSON `doc_nomenclature` :
 *   { quote: { prefix, padding, reset, suffix_type, suffix_custom }, ... }
 */
"use client";

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";

export interface DocNomenclature {
  prefix: string;
  padding: number;
  reset: "never" | "month" | "quarter" | "semester" | "year";
  suffix_type: "none" | "mmaa" | "aaaa" | "custom";
  suffix_custom: string;
}

export type NomenclatureMap = Record<string, DocNomenclature>;

export const NOMENCLATURE_KEY = ["settings", "doc_nomenclature"];

export const DOC_MODELS: { key: string; label: string }[] = [
  { key: "quote", label: "Devis" },
  { key: "order", label: "Commandes" },
  { key: "invoice", label: "Factures" },
  { key: "delivery", label: "Bons de livraison" },
  { key: "payment", label: "Reçus / Paiements" },
  { key: "expense", label: "Dépenses" },
  { key: "journal", label: "Écritures comptables" },
];

export const DEFAULT_NOMENCLATURE: DocNomenclature = {
  prefix: "",
  padding: 6,
  reset: "year",
  suffix_type: "none",
  suffix_custom: "",
};

export function useNomenclature() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: NOMENCLATURE_KEY,
    queryFn: async (): Promise<NomenclatureMap> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/core/settings/doc_nomenclature");
      return (res.data?.value ?? {}) as NomenclatureMap;
    },
  });
}

export function useSaveNomenclature() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (config: NomenclatureMap) => {
      await apiClient.post("/core/settings/", {
        key: "doc_nomenclature",
        value: JSON.stringify(config),
        type: "json",
        is_public: true,
      });
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: NOMENCLATURE_KEY });
    },
  });
}

/** Aperçu local de la référence (sans toucher au compteur backend). */
export function previewReference(cfg: DocNomenclature): string {
  const now = new Date();
  const pad = Math.min(8, Math.max(3, cfg.padding || 6));
  const serial = "0".repeat(pad);
  let suffix = "";
  if (cfg.suffix_type === "mmaa") {
    suffix = `${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}${String(now.getFullYear()).slice(-2)}`;
  } else if (cfg.suffix_type === "aaaa") {
    suffix = String(now.getFullYear());
  } else if (cfg.suffix_type === "custom") {
    suffix = (cfg.suffix_custom || "").trim();
  }
  const prefix = (cfg.prefix || "").trim().replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  const body = prefix ? `${prefix}-${serial}` : serial;
  return suffix ? `${body}-${suffix}` : body;
}
````

/**
 * Hooks du module Comptabilité — configuration OHADA (Phase 1).
 *
 * Paramètres par pays, exercices comptables, taux de change,
 * contraintes OHADA et initialisation du plan comptable standard.
 */
"use client";

import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { AxiosError } from "axios";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";

export const OHADA_KEYS = {
  parameters: "ohada-parameters",
  constraints: "ohada-constraints",
  fiscalYears: "ohada-fiscal-years",
  currentFiscalYear: "ohada-current-fiscal-year",
  exchangeRates: "ohada-exchange-rates",
  seedResult: "ohada-seed-result",
};

// --- Types (miroir des schémas backend) ---
export interface OHADAParameter {
  id: number;
  company_id: number;
  country_code: string;
  currency_code: string;
  rate_to_fx: number | null;
  fiscal_year_start: string | null;
  fiscal_year_end: string | null;
  tax_rate_percentage: number | null;
  is_active: boolean;
}

export interface OHADAParameterPayload {
  country_code: string;
  currency_code: string;
  rate_to_fx?: number | null;
  fiscal_year_start?: string | null;
  fiscal_year_end?: string | null;
  tax_rate_percentage?: number | null;
  is_active?: boolean;
}

export interface FiscalYear {
  id: number;
  company_id: number;
  name: string;
  start_date: string;
  end_date: string;
  status: string;
}

export interface FiscalYearPayload {
  name: string;
  start_date: string;
  end_date: string;
}

export interface ExchangeRate {
  id: number;
  company_id: number;
  base_currency: string;
  quote_currency: string;
  rate: number;
}

export interface ExchangeRatePayload {
  base_currency: string;
  quote_currency: string;
  rate: number;
}

export interface OHADACheckConstraint {
  can_open: boolean;
  message: string;
}

export interface SeedResult {
  created: number;
  total: number;
  journals_created: number;
}

export interface SettingValue {
  key: string;
  value: string;
}

// --- Paramètres OHADA (configuration par pays) ---
export function useOHADAParameters() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.parameters],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<OHADAParameter[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/ohada/parameters");
      return Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
    },
  });
}

export function useUpsertOHADAParameter() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: OHADAParameterPayload): Promise<OHADAParameter> => {
      const res = await apiClient.put("/accounting/ohada/parameters", data);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.parameters] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.constraints] });
    },
  });
}

// --- Contraintes OHADA (paramètre actif + exercice ouvert) ---
export function useOHADAConstraints() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.constraints],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<OHADACheckConstraint> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/ohada/constraints");
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

// --- Exercices comptables ---
export function useFiscalYears(status?: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.fiscalYears, status ?? "all"],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<FiscalYear[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/fiscal-years", {
        params: status ? { status } : undefined,
      });
      return Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
    },
  });
}

export function useCurrentFiscalYear() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.currentFiscalYear],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<FiscalYear | null> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/fiscal-years/current");
      return res.data ?? null;
    },
    retry: false,
  });
}

export function useCreateFiscalYear() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: FiscalYearPayload): Promise<FiscalYear> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/accounting/fiscal-years", data);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.fiscalYears] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.currentFiscalYear] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.constraints] });
    },
  });
}

export function useCloseFiscalYear() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (yearId: number): Promise<FiscalYear> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(`/accounting/fiscal-years/${yearId}/close`);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.fiscalYears] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.currentFiscalYear] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.constraints] });
    },
  });
}

// --- Taux de change ---
export function useExchangeRates() {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.exchangeRates],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<ExchangeRate[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/accounting/exchange-rates");
      return Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
    },
  });
}

export function useUpsertExchangeRate() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: ExchangeRatePayload): Promise<ExchangeRate> => {
      const res = await apiClient.put("/accounting/exchange-rates", data);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.exchangeRates] });
    },
  });
}

// --- Plan comptable OHADA (seed du modèle standard) ---
export function useSeedOhadaPlan() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (): Promise<SeedResult> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/accounting/accounts/seed");
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OHADA_KEYS.seedResult] });
    },
  });
}

// --- Paramètres libres (forme juridique, activité NAF/OHADA) ---
export function useSetting(key: string) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ["core-setting", key],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<SettingValue | null> => {
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get(`/core/settings/${key}`);
        return res.data as SettingValue;
      } catch (error) {
        // Paramètre absent : valeur par défaut côté wizard
        if (error instanceof AxiosError && error.response?.status === 404) {
          return null;
        }
        throw error;
      }
    },
    retry: false,
  });
}

export function useUpsertSetting() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: {
      key: string;
      value: string;
      type?: string;
      is_public?: boolean;
      description?: string;
    }): Promise<SettingValue> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/core/settings/", {
        type: "string",
        is_public: true,
        ...data,
      });
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["core-setting", variables.key] });
    },
  });
}
````

/**
 * Hooks des modules opérationnels — facturation, paiements,
 * livraison, dépenses.
 */
"use client";

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";

export const OPERATIONS_KEYS = {
  invoices: "invoices",
  payments: "payments",
  deliveries: "deliveries",
  expenses: "expenses",
  journals: "journals",
};

// --- Types minimaux (réponses API) ---
export interface InvoiceLine {
  id: number;
  invoice_id: number;
  product_id: number | null;
  variant_id?: number | null;
  variant_name?: string | null;
  description: string | null;
  quantity: number;
  sell_by_length: boolean;
  unit_price: number;
  subtotal: number;
  cuts?: { id: number; quantity: number; length: number }[];
}

export interface Invoice {
  id: number;
  reference: string;
  order_id: number | null;
  partner_id: number;
  status: string;
  invoice_date: string;
  due_date: string | null;
  currency_code: string;
  amount_untaxed: number;
  tax_amount: number;
  amount_total: number;
  paid_amount: number;
  notes?: string | null;
  lines: InvoiceLine[];
}

export interface Payment {
  id: number;
  reference: string;
  payment_type: string;
  direction: string;
  partner_id: number | null;
  invoice_id: number | null;
  method: string;
  journal_code: string | null;
  amount: number;
  payment_date: string;
  status: string;
}

export interface DeliveryNote {
  id: number;
  reference: string;
  order_id: number | null;
  partner_id: number;
  status: string;
  expected_date: string | null;
  shipped_date: string | null;
  delivered_date: string | null;
  lines?: {
    id: number;
    product_id: number | null;
    variant_id?: number | null;
    variant_name?: string | null;
    description: string | null;
    quantity_ordered: number;
    quantity_delivered: number;
    unit: string | null;
  }[];
}

export interface Expense {
  id: number;
  reference: string;
  label: string;
  category: string;
  amount: number;
  expense_date: string | null;
  payment_method: string;
  supplier_id: number | null;
  notes: string | null;
}

// --- Factures ---
export function useInvoices(orderId?: number) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices, orderId ?? "all"],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<Invoice[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/invoicing/invoices", {
        params: orderId ? { order_id: orderId } : undefined,
      });
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

export function useInvoice(invoiceId: number) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices, invoiceId],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<Invoice> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get(`/invoicing/invoices/${invoiceId}`);
      return res.data;
    },
    enabled: !!invoiceId,
  });
}

export function useCreateInvoiceFromOrder() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      orderId,
      dueDays = 0,
      mode = "full",
      value = null,
      post = false,
    }: {
      orderId: number;
      dueDays?: number;
      /** "full" : totale/solde — "down_payment_percent" / "down_payment_fixed" : acompte */
      mode?: "full" | "down_payment_percent" | "down_payment_fixed";
      value?: number | null;
      post?: boolean;
    }): Promise<Invoice> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/invoicing/invoices/from-order", {
        order_id: orderId,
        due_days: dueDays,
        mode,
        value,
        post,
      });
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
    },
  });
}

/** Résultat du parcours « Créer facture » depuis un devis. */
export interface QuoteInvoiceResult {
  quote_id: number;
  quote_reference: string;
  order_id: number;
  order_reference: string;
  invoice_id: number;
  invoice_reference: string;
  invoice_status: string;
  created: boolean;
}

/**
 * Crée la facture d'un devis confirmé (parcours de vente, étape 2).
 *
 * Idempotent côté serveur : si la commande liée est déjà facturée, la facture
 * existante est renvoyée avec `created = false` — le bouton sert alors de
 * « Voir la facture ».
 */
export function useCreateInvoiceFromQuote() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      quoteId,
      mode = "full",
      value = null,
      dueDays = 0,
      post = false,
    }: {
      quoteId: number;
      mode?: "full" | "down_payment_percent" | "down_payment_fixed";
      value?: number | null;
      dueDays?: number;
      post?: boolean;
    }): Promise<QuoteInvoiceResult> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(`/sales/quotes/${quoteId}/invoice`, {
        mode,
        value,
        due_days: dueDays,
        post,
      });
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
    },
  });
}

/** Confirme une facture brouillon (brouillon → comptabilisée). */
export function usePostInvoice() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (invoiceId: number): Promise<Invoice> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(`/invoicing/invoices/${invoiceId}/post`);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
    },
  });
}

/** Remet une facture confirmée en brouillon (refusé si un paiement existe). */
export function useResetInvoiceToDraft() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (invoiceId: number): Promise<Invoice> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        `/invoicing/invoices/${invoiceId}/reset-to-draft`
      );
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
    },
  });
}

/** Annule une facture non payée (la commande redevient facturable). */
export function useCancelInvoice() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (invoiceId: number): Promise<Invoice> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(`/invoicing/invoices/${invoiceId}/cancel`);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
    },
  });
}

/** Supprime une facture (brouillon uniquement — cascade serveur). */
export function useDeleteInvoice() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (invoiceId: number): Promise<void> => {
      await apiClient.delete(`/invoicing/invoices/${invoiceId}`);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sales-orders"] });
    },
  });
}

// --- Paiements ---
export function usePayments(invoiceId?: number) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.payments, invoiceId ?? "all"],
    queryFn: async (): Promise<Payment[]> => {
      const res = await apiClient.get("/payments/payments", {
        params: invoiceId ? { invoice_id: invoiceId } : undefined,
      });
      return res.data;
    },
  });
}

export function useCreatePayment() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: {
      partner_id: number;
      invoice_id?: number | null;
      method?: string;
      amount: number;
      payment_date?: string;
      journal_code?: string | null;
      direction?: string;
      notes?: string;
    }): Promise<Payment> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post("/payments/payments", data);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (payment) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.payments] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
      if (payment.invoice_id) {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices, payment.invoice_id],
        });
      }
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Remet un paiement en brouillon — révocation (facture + écriture
 * comptable), étape préalable à sa suppression.
 */
export function useBackToDraftPayment() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (paymentId: number): Promise<Payment> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(
        `/payments/payments/${paymentId}/back-to-draft`
      );
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (payment) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.payments] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
      if (payment.invoice_id) {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices, payment.invoice_id],
        });
      }
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Re-confirme un paiement en brouillon — symétrique de
 * ``useBackToDraftPayment`` (recrédite la facture + écriture comptable).
 */
export function useConfirmPayment() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (paymentId: number): Promise<Payment> => {
      const res = await apiClient.post(`/payments/payments/${paymentId}/confirm`);
      return res.data;
    },
    onSuccess: (payment) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.payments] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
      if (payment.invoice_id) {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
          queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices, payment.invoice_id],
        });
      }
    },
  });
}

/** Supprime un paiement (brouillon uniquement — cascade serveur). */
export function useDeletePayment() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (paymentId: number): Promise<void> => {
      await apiClient.delete(`/payments/payments/${paymentId}`);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.payments] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: [OPERATIONS_KEYS.invoices] });
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Hooks pour le module Achats — fournisseurs, demandes (DA),
 * bons de commande (BC), réceptions (BR), factures fournisseur.
 */
"use client";

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import {
  Supplier,
  SupplierCreate,
  SupplierUpdate,
  SupplierSuggest,
  PurchaseRequest,
  PurchaseRequestCreate,
  PurchaseRequestUpdate,
  PurchaseOrder,
  PurchaseOrderCreate,
  PurchaseOrderLine,
  PurchaseReception,
  PurchaseReceptionCreate,
  SupplierInvoice,
  SupplierInvoiceCreate,
  SupplierInvoicePay,

````typescript
/**
 * API client — wrapper Axios autour de l'ERP backend.
 *
 * Gère automatiquement :
 * - l'ajout du token JWT (Authorization: Bearer)
 * - le rafraîchissement du token
 * - les réponses d'erreur
 */
import axios, { AxiosError, InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from "axios";

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000/api/v1",
  timeout: 30000,
});

// Intercepteur requête — ajoute le token
apiClient.interceptors.request.use(
  (config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
    const token = typeof window !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("accessToken") : null;
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }
    return config;
  },
  (error: AxiosError) => Promise.reject(error),
);

// Intercepteur réponse — rafraîchit le token si expiré
let isRefreshing = false;
let failedQueue: Array<{
  resolve: (value: unknown) => void;
  reject: (error: unknown) => void;
}> = [];

function processQueue(error: unknown) {
  failedQueue.forEach((prom) => {
    if (error) prom.reject(error);
    else prom.resolve(null);
  });
  failedQueue = [];
}

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  async (error: AxiosError) => {
    const originalRequest = error.config as InternalAxiosRequestConfig & {
      _retry?: boolean;
    };

    if (error.response?.status === 401 && !originalRequest._retry) {
      if (isRefreshing) {
        // Attend le rafraîchissement en cours
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          failedQueue.push({ resolve, reject });
        }).then(() => apiClient(originalRequest));
      }

      originalRequest._retry = true;
      isRefreshing = true;

      try {
        const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem("refreshToken");
        if (refreshToken) {
          const res = await apiClient.post("/core/auth/refresh", {
            refresh_token: refreshToken,
          });
          const { access_token, refresh_token: newRefresh } = res.data;
          localStorage.setItem("accessToken", access_token);
          if (newRefresh) localStorage.setItem("refreshToken", newRefresh);
          processQueue(null);
          originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${access_token}`;
          return apiClient(originalRequest);
        }
      } catch (refreshError) {
        processQueue(refreshError);
        localStorage.removeItem("accessToken");
        localStorage.removeItem("refreshToken");
        window.location.href = "/login";
      } finally {
        isRefreshing = false;
      }
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  },
);

export type ApiResponse<T = unknown> = {
  data: T;
  status: number;
  statusText: string;
};

export type ApiError = {
  message: string;
  status?: number;
  detail?: string;
};

export function handleApiError(error: unknown): ApiError {
  if (error instanceof AxiosError) {
    return {
      message: error.response?.data?.detail || error.message,
      status: error.response?.status,
      detail: error.response?.data?.detail,
    };
  }
  if (error instanceof Error) {
    return { message: error.message };
  }
  return { message: "Erreur inconnue" };
}
````

````typescript
/**
 * Téléchargement de fichiers protégés par JWT (export Excel / CSV, PDF…).
 *
 * Un simple lien <a href> échouerait en 401 : le token doit passer par
 * axios, puis le blob est diffusé côté navigateur.
 */
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { hideLoader, showLoader } from "@/lib/loader";

/** Enregistre un blob sous le nom fourni (déclenche le téléchargement). */
export function saveBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.rel = "noopener";
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  // Libère l'URL après un délai suffisant pour que le téléchargement démarre
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 60_000);
}

/**
 * Nom de fichier porté par l'en-tête Content-Disposition.
 *
 * Gère la forme RFC 5987 (`filename*=UTF-8''Re%C3%A7u%20…`, accents) puis le
 * repli ASCII (`filename="…"`). Retourne null si l'en-tête est absent
 * (repli d'URL, réponse sans nom…).
 */
export function filenameFromDisposition(header: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof header !== "string" || !header) return null;
  const extended = /filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i.exec(header);
  if (extended?.[1]) {
    try {
      return decodeURIComponent(extended[1].trim());
    } catch {
      // En-tête illisible : on retombe sur la forme ASCII ci-dessous
    }
  }
  const simple = /filename="?([^";]+)"?/.exec(header);
  return simple?.[1]?.trim() ?? null;
}

/**
 * Télécharge une URL d'export et l'enregistre sous son nom serveur
 * (« Contacts_2026-10-02.xlsx »), avec repli sur ``fallbackName``.
 */
export async function downloadFile(
  path: string,
  fallbackName: string,
  timeout = 120_000,
): Promise<void> {
  showLoader("Téléchargement du fichier…");
  try {
    const res = await apiClient.get(path, { responseType: "blob", timeout });
    const filename =
      filenameFromDisposition(res.headers["content-disposition"]) ?? fallbackName;
    saveBlob(res.data as Blob, filename);
  } finally {
    hideLoader();
  }
}
````

/**
 * Télécharge un document PDF protégé par JWT et l'ouvre dans un nouvel
 * onglet (aperçu + impression navigateur).
 *
 * Un simple lien <a href> échouerait en 401 : il faut passer le token
 * via axios puis diffuser le blob.
 *
 * Le fichier est enregistré sous le nom du rapport
 * (« Devis - DEV-000019.pdf ») puis affiché dans un nouvel onglet : ce nom
 * provient de l'en-tête Content-Disposition construit par le backend
 * (app/core/documents/naming.py) et exposé au JS par `expose_headers` (CORS).
 */
import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client";
import { filenameFromDisposition, saveBlob } from "@/lib/api/download";
import { withLoader } from "@/lib/loader";

export function openPdf(path: string, fallbackName = "document.pdf"): Promise<void> {
  return withLoader(openPdfTask(path, fallbackName), "Génération du PDF…");
}

async function openPdfTask(path: string, fallbackName: string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await apiClient.get(path, { responseType: "blob" });
  const filename =
    filenameFromDisposition(res.headers["content-disposition"]) ?? fallbackName;
  const blob: Blob = res.data;

  // Aperçu + impression d'abord : l'activation utilisateur du clic est encore
  // valide pour window.open() (l'onglet la consomme, pas le téléchargement).
  const previewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  window.open(previewUrl, "_blank", "noopener");
  // Libère l'URL après un délai suffisant pour l'affichage
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl), 60_000);

  // Enregistrement nommé du même PDF (« Devis - DEV-000019.pdf »)
  saveBlob(blob, filename);
}

export function printQuote(quoteId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return openPdf(`/sales/quotes/${quoteId}/print`);
}

export function printInvoice(invoiceId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return openPdf(`/invoicing/invoices/${invoiceId}/print`);
}

export function printDelivery(deliveryId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return openPdf(`/delivery/notes/${deliveryId}/print`);
}

export function printReceipt(paymentId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return openPdf(`/payments/payments/${paymentId}/receipt`);
}

export function printPosTicket(orderId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return printPosHtml(orderId);
}

/** PDF du bon de commande fournisseur (serveur WeasyPrint + téléchargement). */
export function printPurchaseOrder(orderId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return openPdf(`/purchases/orders/${orderId}/pdf`);
}

/**
 * Impression ticket POS sur imprimante thermique 80 mm :
 * récupère le HTML du ticket et l'envoie dans une fenêtre d'impression
 * ( dialogue d'impression système → choisir l'imprimante POS ).
 * Aucun PDF n'est téléchargé pour les tickets.
 *
 * NB : sans `noopener` dans les features de window.open(), sinon la
 * référence renvoyée est null et le document ne peut pas être écrit
 * (popup vide). Fallback : impression via iframe cachée si les pop-ups
 * sont bloquées.
 */
export function printPosHtml(orderId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return withLoader(printPosHtmlTask(orderId), "Préparation du ticket…");
}

async function printPosHtmlTask(orderId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  const res = await apiClient.get(`/sales/pos/sales/${orderId}/ticket-html`, {
    responseType: "text",
  });
  const html: string = typeof res.data === "string" ? res.data : String(res.data);

  const win = window.open("", "_blank", "width=320,height=600");
  if (!win) {
    printHtmlInIframe(html);
    return;
  }

  win.document.open();
  win.document.write(html);
  win.document.close();
  win.focus();

  // Attend le chargement complet du document avant le dialogue d'impression
  const doPrint = () => {
    try {
      win.focus();
      win.print();
    } catch {
      printHtmlInIframe(html);
    }
    // Ferme la popup automatiquement une fois le dialogue passé
    win.onafterprint = () => win.close();
  };
  if (win.document.readyState === "complete") {
    setTimeout(doPrint, 400);
  } else {
    win.addEventListener("load", () => setTimeout(doPrint, 400), { once: true });
    // Filet de sécurité si l'événement load a déjà été manqué
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (win.document.readyState === "complete") doPrint();
    }, 1500);
  }
}

/** Impression de secours sans popup : iframe caché → dialogue système. */
function printHtmlInIframe(html: string): void {
  const existing = document.getElementById("pos-print-iframe");
  if (existing) existing.remove();
  const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
  iframe.id = "pos-print-iframe";
  iframe.style.position = "fixed";
  iframe.style.right = "0";
  iframe.style.bottom = "0";
  iframe.style.width = "0";
  iframe.style.height = "0";
  iframe.style.border = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);
  const doc = iframe.contentWindow?.document;
  if (!doc) throw new Error("Impression impossible dans ce navigateur");
  doc.open();
  doc.write(html);
  doc.close();
  iframe.contentWindow!.focus();
  const print = () => {
    iframe.contentWindow!.print();
    iframe.contentWindow!.addEventListener("afterprint", () => iframe.remove());
    // Nettoyage tardif si afterprint n'est pas déclenché
    setTimeout(() => iframe.remove(), 60_000);
  };
  if (doc.readyState === "complete") {
    setTimeout(print, 300);
  } else {
    iframe.onload = () => setTimeout(print, 300);
  }
}

/**
 * PDF d'une commande :
 * - vente comptoir → ticket de caisse
 * - autre commande → facture (auto-générée côté serveur si absente)
 */
export function printOrder(orderId: number | string): Promise<void> {
  return openPdf(`/sales/orders/${orderId}/print`);
}

/**
 * Utilitaires d'authentification — gestion du token dans le localStorage.
 */
import { Token } from "../types";

const ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY = "accessToken";
const REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY = "refreshToken";

export function setTokens(token: Token): void {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    localStorage.setItem(ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY, token.access_token);
    localStorage.setItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY, token.refresh_token);
  }
}

export function getAccessToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    return localStorage.getItem(ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
  }
  return null;
}

export function getRefreshToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    return localStorage.getItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
  }
  return null;
}

export function clearTokens(): void {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    localStorage.removeItem(ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY);
    localStorage.removeItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
  }
}

export function isAuthenticated(): boolean {
  return getAccessToken() !== null;
}

export function getAuthHeader(): string | null {
  const token = getAccessToken();
  return token ? `Bearer ${token}` : null;
}

## File: frontend/src/lib/hid-scanner.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Support AIDC — douchettes / terminaux USB en mode « clavier » (HID).
 *
 * Une douchette émule un clavier : les caractères du code arrivent en
 * rafale (< 30 ms entre touches) et se terminent par « Entrée ». Un
 * écouteur global capture cette signature — le champ actif n'a pas
 * besoin d'avoir le focus — et appelle ``onScan`` avec le code lu.
 *
 * La saisie clavier humaine est naturellement ignorée : les frappes
 * manuelles ne maintiennent jamais un écart < 30 ms sur 6 caractères.
 *
 * Usage :
 *   useEffect(() => attachHidScanner(handleScan), []);
 */
export interface HidScannerOptions {
  /** Longueur minimale du code (défaut 6). */
  minLength?: number;
  /** Écart maximal entre deux touches (ms, défaut 30). */
  gapMs?: number;
  /** Durée maximale totale de la saisie (ms, défaut 500). */
  maxDurationMs?: number;
  /** Bip de confirmation (défaut true). */
  beep?: boolean;
}

export function attachHidScanner(
  onScan: (code: string) => void,
  options: HidScannerOptions = {},
): () => void {
  const {
    minLength = 6,
    gapMs = 30,
    maxDurationMs = 500,
    beep = true,
  } = options;

  let buffer = "";
  let firstKeyAt = 0;
  let lastKeyAt = 0;

  const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.isComposing || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.metaKey) return;

    const now = performance.now();

    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      const code = buffer;
      const elapsed = now - firstKeyAt;
      buffer = "";
      lastKeyAt = 0;
      firstKeyAt = 0;
      if (code.length >= minLength && elapsed <= maxDurationMs) {
        e.preventDefault(); // le code est consommé, pas soumis au formulaire
        if (beep) playBeep();
        onScan(code);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (e.key.length !== 1) {
      // Touches spéciales (Tab, flèches...) : cassent le buffer.
      buffer = "";
      lastKeyAt = 0;
      firstKeyAt = 0;
      return;
    }

    if (lastKeyAt === 0 || now - lastKeyAt <= gapMs) {
      if (lastKeyAt === 0) firstKeyAt = now;
      buffer += e.key;
      lastKeyAt = now;
      if (buffer.length > 48) {
        buffer = "";
        lastKeyAt = 0;
        firstKeyAt = 0;
      }
    } else {
      // Frappe trop lente : saisie humaine — on repart à zéro.
      buffer = e.key;
      firstKeyAt = now;
      lastKeyAt = now;
    }
  };

  window.addEventListener("keydown", handler, true);
  return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler, true);
}

/** Bip court de confirmation du scan (WebAudio). */
function playBeep(): void {
  try {
    const ctx = new AudioContext();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.frequency.value = 1200;
    gain.gain.value = 0.08;
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
    osc.onended = () => void ctx.close();
  } catch {
    /* audio indisponible — silencieux */
